glossary.aisunqun: aisu- — to come; participle in -nqun, 'the ones coming' [來的每]
glossary.aisuqu-ji: aisu- — to come, to approach; imperfective participle -qu with accusative -ji, 'the coming (of them)' [來的行]
glossary.ažiγ̇ai: a- — to be; past ažiγ̇ai, 'there was' [有來]
glossary.ažuγ̇u: a- — to be; past ažuγ̇u, 'there was, he was' [有來]
glossary.aγtastu: aγta — gelding; plural -s plus -tu 'having', 'having geldings' [騸馬每有的]
glossary.aγ̇užam-boroγ̇ul-un: Aγ̇užam-Boroγ̇ul — Aqujam-Boroqul; genitive -un after a consonant [人名的]
glossary.batačiγan: Batačiγan — Batachiqan, son of Börte Chino [人名, 'a personal name']
glossary.bijü: bü- — to be; present bijü, 'there is' [有]
glossary.boro: Boro — Boro, a horse's name (boro 'grey') [馬名] · also 'blue-grey, grey', a colour (here of a cloak: boro örmüge-ben, 'one's own blue-grey cloak'; Ming 靑 'blue-green') · also 'young, fledgling' (boro šibaγ̇un, 'a fledgling hawk'; Ming 雛 'chick, fledgling'; the sense is uncertain)
glossary.boržigidai-mergen: Boržigidai-Mergen — Borjigidai the Marksman; the Borjigin clan takes its name from him [兒名]
glossary.burqan-qaldun: Burqan-Qaldun — the holy mountain of the Mongols [山名]
glossary.böleg: böleg — a group, a body, a band of people [叢]
glossary.börte: börte — blue-grey, the grey of a wolf's coat; also the ancestor's name Börte [蒼色] · also the woman's name Börte (Temüjin's betrothed; Ming (女)名 'a woman's name')
glossary.böġesü: bü- — to be; conditional böġesü, 'if it be, if it is that' [有來] · also glossed 有呵, with 呵 the marker of 'if' (Ming 有來 or 有呵); with ele, 'if only … be'
glossary.büleġe: bü- — to be; past büleġe, 'there was, used to be' [有來]
glossary.dair: Dair — Dayir, a horse's name [馬名] · also 'great' (Ming 大), in Dair Etügen 'Great Earth' (compare the horse's name Dair)
glossary.deġere: deġere — above, upper, on top [上] · also (Ming 一面 'one side, besides') after amaraγ: amaraγ deġere dabqur amaraγ, 'close, and besides, doubly close' (uncertain) · also 'besides, in addition' after an adjective (Ming 上), as in čüġen deġere, 'besides being few'
glossary.deġereče: deġere — above, top; ablative -če, 'from above, from the top' [上自]
glossary.deġü-deġen: deġü — younger brother; dative-locative with reflexive-possessive, 'to his own younger brother' [弟自的行]
glossary.deġü-jüġen: deġü — younger brother; accusative with reflexive-possessive, 'his own younger brother' [弟自的行]
glossary.deġü-lüġe-beġen: deġü — younger brother; -lüġe 'together with' + -beġen reflexive-possessive: 'with his own younger brother' [弟一同自的]
glossary.dobün-mergen: Dobun-Mergen — Dobun the Marksman; spelled Dobün here, the same name [人名]
glossary.dotora: dotora — inside, within, among [內] · also 'inside, within, among' (Ming 裏 'within') [裏]
glossary.dunda: dunda — middle, in the middle of [中] · also 'half, part-way' (adverb, before a possessive: dunda keġelitei 'half-belly-having'; Ming 半孕 'half-pregnant')
glossary.duwa-soqor: Duwa-Soqor — Duwa the One-eyed (soqor 'blind, one-eyed') [兒名]
glossary.ese: ese — not (negates a past action; ülü negates present or future) [不曾] · before a converb: ese toγ̇aγdažu 'not yet counted' (as ese ögdegsen 'not given' in §6), where ülü is the usual negative of a converb
glossary.gergei: gergei — wife, the woman of a household [妻]
glossary.gergeitü: gergei — wife; with -tü 'having', so 'having a wife, married to' [妻有的]
glossary.huruγ̇u: huruγ̇u — downstream, following the course, along [順]
glossary.hužaγ̇ur: hužaγ̇ur — root, origin, the stock a line springs from [根源] · also 'end, tip' (Ming 尖 'point')
glossary.ilebe: ile- — to send; past -be, 'sent' [敎去了] · also where the Ming reads 去了 'went' (uncertain) [去了]
glossary.in-ü: in-ü — his, her, its (third-person genitive, placed after its noun) [他的] · also set before its noun (in-ü kižiγ̇ar, ‘his border’)
glossary.irebe: ire- — to come; past -be, 'came' [來了] · also where the Ming has 去了 'went' (Boγ̇orču … urižu irebe, §95, 'came'; ire- means 'come', so the Ming 去了 is not translated)
glossary.irgen: irgen — people, the common folk of a camp or realm [百姓]
glossary.ketülžü: ketül- — to cross over (water); imperfective converb -žü, 'crossing' [渡着]
glossary.köġün: köġün — son [子] · also read as a collective, 'sons', before a list of several names (Menen-Tudun-(n)u köġün … doloγ̇an, 'seven'; the plural köġüd is the usual form) · also 'lad, young man' (Ming 後生 'junior'), as in köġün küġün 'a young man'
glossary.külüġüd: külüg — a swift, outstanding horse; plural -üd [駿, plural] · also külüg 'hero, outstanding man' (Ming 傑), plural -üd, 'heroes' (noun + plural; Ming 傑每)
glossary.maral: maral — hind, the female red deer [鹿]
glossary.maṅlai: maṅlai — forehead, brow [額] · also 'the vanguard, lead scouts' (Ming 頭哨), a further reading of the word for 'forehead' [頭哨] · also 'at the head, leading' after a name (Ming 爲頭 'as head'): Žebe-ji maṅlai ilebe
glossary.monγolžin-toγ̇a: Monγolžin-Toγ̇a — Mongoljin-Qo'a (toγ̇a/γoγ̇a 'fair, comely') [婦人名, 'a woman's name']
glossary.na: -(n)a — dative-locative: at, in, to (back-vowel form) [行] · also a particle na (Ming 好生 'well, very'; sense uncertain), in bolγaqu na žöb, 'to be made, na, right' (§126) · also Waṅ-Qān-(n)a, 'to Wang Qan' (after a stem ending in n; the (n) is Shiratori's; Ming 人名行)
glossary.ne: -(n)e — dative-locative: at, in, to (front-vowel form) [行] · also on names, De-Sečen-(n)e and Höġelün-(n)e, 'to De-Sechen, to Högelün' (Ming 行), where the (n) is Shiratori's · also -(n)e after küġün (küġün-(n)e), the agent after a passive, 'by a person' (Ming 被人行) · also müren-(n)e, 'to the river' (müren ends in n; the (n) is Shiratori's; Ming 河 行)
glossary.neġürid: neġüri — one stage of a nomadic move, the ground covered between camps; plural -d [程, 'a stage of a journey']
glossary.neġüžü: neġü- — to move camp, to migrate; converb, 'moving camp' [起着]
glossary.nidütü: nidün — eye; with -tü 'having', 'having an eye' [眼有的]
glossary.nigen: nigen — one, a [一] · also 'together, as one' (Ming 一同) · also 'one, a' with Ming 一箇, before the thing counted
glossary.nu: -(n)u — genitive: of (back-vowel form; the n appears after a vowel-final stem) [的] · also printed after stems that already end in n (Menen-Tudun-(n)u, Qačin-(n)u, Qaγan-(n)u, Onan-(n)u), where the (n) is Shiratori's; the Ming 的 as elsewhere · also küġün-(n)u, 'of a person' · also printed after Waṅ-Qān-(n)u, 'of Wang Qan' (Ming 的), where the (n) is Shiratori's
glossary.nutuγlažu: nutuγla- — to camp, to occupy as pasture (from nutuγ, home ground); converb, 'camping' [營盤做着]
glossary.nü: -(n)ü — genitive: of (front-vowel form) [的] · also printed after an n-final stem (Tumbinai-Sečen-(n)ü) and after back-vowel names (Qabul-Qaγan-(n)ü), where the front-vowel form breaks harmony; the Ming 訥 writes -nu and -nü alike
glossary.onan: Onan — the Onon, the river of Chinggis's homeland [河名, 'name of a river']
glossary.orožu: oro- — to enter, to come in; converb [入着] · here also 'following, going along with' (Ming 從着), in eje-dür an-u orožu
glossary.qaraqu: qara- — to look, to see; imperfective participle -qu [望見] · also 'looking' (Ming 看), a participle of looking, 'that looks'
glossary.qaraγ̇utai: qara — black; with -tai 'having' (the front-vowel twin of -tu), so 'black' [黑]
glossary.qojar: qojar — two; it follows the pair it counts [兩箇] · also before the thing counted: qojar sumu, 'two arrows' (Ming 兩隻 'two (arrows)')
glossary.qoričar-mergen: Qoričar-Mergen — Qorichar the Marksman (mergen 'good shot, wise') [兒名]
glossary.sali-qačaγ̇u-jin: Sali-Qačaγ̇u — Sali-Qachaqu; genitive -jin after a vowel [人名的]
glossary.tamača-jin: Tamača — Tamacha; genitive -jin after a vowel [人的]
glossary.tede: tede — those, they (plural of tere) [那的每]
glossary.tergen-ü: terge — cart, wagon; genitive, 'of the cart' [車的] · also read as tergen (the n-stem 'cart', as in tergen-dür) + genitive -ü, 'of the cart' (Ming 車 的)
glossary.teriġün-e: teriġün — head, source, beginning; here dative-locative, 'at the head of' [源行]
glossary.teṅgeri-eče: teṅgeri — Heaven, the sky as a power; here ablative -eče, 'from Heaven' [天處] · also Ming 天 行 'from Heaven', 行 for the ablative
glossary.teṅgis: Teṅgis — the Tenggis, an inland sea or great lake [水名, 'name of a water']
glossary.töregsen: töre- — to be born; past participle -gsen, 'born, the one born' [生了的]
glossary.tüṅgelig: Tüṅgelig — the Tünggelig, a stream [水名]
glossary.ögdegsen: ög- — to give; passive -de- plus past participle -gsen, 'having been given' [與了的]
glossary.ölžige-de: ölžige — the front-board or forward seat of a cart; dative-locative [前行]
glossary.üdür: üdür — day [日] · also 'daytime, midday' (Ming 晝), in üdür düli naran 'the noon sun'
glossary.ügülerün: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb -rün, 'saying' [說]
glossary.üžere: üže- — to see; purposive converb -re, 'in order to see' [看]
glossary.čima-da: či — thou; dative-locative čima-da, 'to thee, for thee' [你行]
glossary.čiṅgis: Čiṅgis — Chinggis, the title borne by Temüjin from 1206 [Ming gloss: 太祖名, 'the name of Taizu']
glossary.žajaγ̇atu: žajaγ̇a — destiny, fate allotted; here with -tu 'having', 'destined' [命有的]
glossary.žalaγ̇utu: žalaγ̇u — young man, retainer; with -tu 'having' [後生有的]
glossary.γarba: γar- — to go out, to go up; past -ba, 'went up' [上去了]
glossary.γažar-a: γažar — earth, ground, country; here dative-locative, 'over the land' [地行] · also 'in the land, in the country' (keġer γažar-a 'in the wild country'; Ming 裏 'in')
glossary.γoγ̇ai: γoγ̇ai — pale, wan, fallow; also the name Qo'ai [慘白色]
glossary.γujuja: γuju- — to ask for, to request; first-person volitional -ja, 'let me ask' [索]
glossary.γurban: γurban — three [三] · also 'three' of horses (Ming 三疋)
glossary.irgen-dür: irgen-dür — among the people, in the folk (irgen 'people' + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [百姓 裏] · also 'to, against the people' (Ming 百姓行), after a verb of sending out (morilaγ̇ulba, čaγ̇uraγ̇ulba)
glossary.kürüġesü: kürü- — to reach, arrive; conditional converb -ġesü, 'when/if arriving' (verb, converb) [到呵]
glossary.ünen-kü: ünen-kü — truly, true (ünen 'true' + -kü, adjectival ending, uncertain) [實 也]
glossary.γoγ̇a: γoγ̇a — beautiful, fair; also the name element Qo'a (adjective) [美] · also 'pale' (of a colour; Ming 慘白), against 'beautiful, fair' (Ming 美)
glossary.nere: nere — name (noun) [名] · also 'name, title, rank' (Ming 名分, 'rank'), as in Žaγ̇ud-quri nere, Waṅ nere, 'the title Ja'ud-quri, the title Wang', and čaotao nere, 'the rank of Chaotao' · also 'name and fame' (Ming 姓名)
glossary.jeketei: jeke-tei — great, having greatness (jeke 'great' + possessive -tei, front-vowel form) [大 有的]
glossary.alan-γoγ̇a: Alan-Γoγ̇a — Alan-Qo'a, a woman's name (personal name) [(女名)]
glossary.neretei: nere-tei — named, having a name (nere 'name' + possessive -tei) [名(有的)]
glossary.ber: ber — even, also (particle) [也] · also glossed Ming 裏 'in', where it may rather be the instrumental -ber, 'with' (uncertain)
glossary.ögteġei: ög- — to give; read as passive -te- plus past -ġei, 'was given'; uncertain, inferred (verb, passive past) [與]
glossary.köl-barγužin: Köl-Barγužin — Köl-Barqujin, a place name; what köl means is not known (place name) [地名]
glossary.tögüm-ün: Tögüm-ün — of Tögüm, 'hollow, low ground' per the Ming (name + genitive -ün, front-vowel form after a consonant) [窊的]
glossary.barγudai-mergen: Barγudai-Mergen — Barqudai the marksman, a man's name (personal name) [人名 的]
glossary.barγužin-γoγ̇a: Barγužin-Γoγ̇a — Barqujin-Qo'a, a woman's name (personal name) [女名]
glossary.ni: -(n)i — accusative, marks the object (e.g. ökin-(n)i 'the girl' as object); the Ming writes 行 (case suffix) [女 行] · also on names and on müren (Temüžin-(n)i, De-Sečen-(n)i, müren-(n)i), where the (n) is Shiratori's; in places topic-like, 'as for Temüjin' (Ming 行 or (行))
glossary.qori-tumad-un: Qori-Tumad-un — of the Qori-Tumad, a people (tribal name + genitive -un, back-vowel form after a consonant) [部落名(的)]
glossary.qorilartai-mergen: Qorilartai-Mergen — Qorilartai the marksman, a man's name (personal name) [人名 行]
glossary.ariγ-usun: Ariγ-Usun — Ariq-Usun, a place name (ariγ 'clean', usun 'water') (place name) [地名 行]
glossary.barγužin-γoγ̇ača: Barγužin-Γoγ̇a-ča — from Barqujin-Qo'a (name + ablative -ča; the full -ača/-eče occur elsewhere, and what governs the short form is unclear) [婦人名(自)]
glossary.tere: tere — that, that one; also 'he, she' (demonstrative and third-person pronoun; plural tede) [那般] · also with Ming 那 ('that'), before a noun: tere deleme üge
glossary.γažar-turi: γažar-tur(i) — in the land (γažar 'land' + dative-locative -tur, a variant of -dur; the (i) belongs to the reflexive -(i)jan that follows) [地 自的行]
glossary.jan: -(i)jan — reflexive-possessive, one's own (back-vowel form; the token left after γažar-tur(i)- and γažar(i)-) [地 自的行] · also after aqui-dur(i)- (a participle with dative-locative) · also after quruγ̇ud(i)-, 'one's own fingers' (a plural noun with the accusative i; Ming 指頭 自的行) · also after tergen-dur(i)- ('to one's own cart'), amin(i)- ('one's own life', accusative), γar-tur(i)- ('in one's own hand') and niγ̇ur-tur(i)- ('in one's own face'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after oin-dur(i)- ('in one's own mind') and morin(i)- ('one's own horse', accusative), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after aγ̇ur(i)- ('one's own breath, rage'), botoγan(i)- ('one's own camel foal') and turγaγ̇ud(i)- ('one's own companions'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also -(i)jan after kituγai-jar(i)- (instrumental, 'with one's own knife') · also after tuk(i)- ('one's own banner'), qurdun(i)- and dun(i)- ('one's own fast horse'), qujag(i)- ('one's own armour') and sumun(i)- ('one's own arrow'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after bolulčaγsan(i)- (a past participle with the accusative, 'what they had done together, their own'; Ming 共 做了的 自的行) and after jor(i)- ('his own sounding arrowhead'; the Ming 自的 has no 行), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after Uruγ̇ud(i)- and Moṅγud(i)- (people names; Ming 一種 自的行), 'one's own Uruqud, one's own Mongqud' · also after amin-dur(i)- ('in one's own life'; dative-locative, the (i) being Shiratori's; Ming 性命 自的行) · also after ulus(i)- ('one's own people'), ulus-tur(i)- ('to one's own people') and deġel-qubčasun(i)- ('one's own robe and clothing'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after qaγan-dur(i)- ('with one's own qahan'), and after alaγsan(i)- and daisurγaγsan(i)- (past participles with the accusative, 'what one had killed, what one had rebelled against'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after qān(i)- ('one's own lord', accusative) and tus(i)- ('our own rightful lord'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after sumud(i)- ('one's own arrows', plural noun with the Shiratori (i); Ming 箭(每) 自的行) · also after qos-tur(i)- ('in one's own house'; dative-locative, the (i) being Shiratori's; Ming 房子 自的行) · also after aγtas(i)- and aγtans(i)- ('one's own geldings'), baγ̇atud(i)- ('one's own warriors'), Žirgin(i)- ('one's own Jirgin') and qačar(i)- ('one's own cheek'), where the (i) is Shiratori's (Ming 自的行) · also after omog(i)- ('one's own bravery', Ming 勇 自的行) and qor(i)- ('one's own quiver', Ming 箭筒 自的行), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after niγ̇ur(i)- ('one's own face', accusative; Ming 面皮 自的行), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after žarimud(i)- ('some, one's own parts'; Ming 一伴 自的行), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after kilin-dur(i)- ('in one's own anger', dative-locative; Ming 怒裏自的行) and γal(i)- ('one's own fire'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after balaγad(i)- ('one's own towns') and Sartaγ̇ul(i)- ('one's own Sartaul'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after nogod(i)- ('one's own dogs'; Ming 狗每 自的行), where the (i) is Shiratori's
glossary.keremün: keremün — squirrel (the Ming's 靑鼠 'blue squirrel') (noun) [靑鼠]
glossary.göreġetei: göreġe-tei — having game (göreġe 'game, wild animals' + possessive -tei) [野物 有的]
glossary.γažari: γažar(i) — land, followed by the reflexive -(i)jan 'one's own'; the (i) is a linking vowel or perhaps the accusative -i, uncertain (noun + reflexive-possessive stem) [地 自的(行)] · also γažar(i)-jar, 'by way of the land', with the instrumental -jar following (Ming 地面 裏 / 地行)
glossary.qorilaldužu: qorila-ldu-žu — forbidding one another (qorila- 'forbid, restrain' + reciprocal -ldu- + converb -žu) [相禁約着]
glossary.maγ̇ulaldužu: maγ̇ula-ldu-žu — troubling one another (maγ̇ula- 'vex, treat ill', from maγ̇u 'bad', + reciprocal -ldu- + converb -žu) [煩惱着]
glossary.qorilar: Qorilar — the Qorilar, a clan name (clan name) [姓氏]
glossary.oboγtu: oboγ-tu — having a clan (oboγ 'clan, lineage' + possessive -tu, back-vowel form) [姓(有的)]
glossary.bolžu: bol- — to become; converb -žu, 'becoming' (verb, converb) [做着]
glossary.göreġesün: göreġesün — game, wild animals (noun) [野物] · also with Ming 獸 'beast'
glossary.görüġüli: görüġüli — catchable, able to be taken in the hunt; inner form unclear, uncertain (adjective) [可捕]
glossary.saitu: sai-tu — having good, fine (sai 'good' + possessive -tu, back-vowel form) [好有的]
glossary.keġen: keġe- — to say; keġen 'saying', the converb that closes a quotation (verb, converb) [麽道]
glossary.ežed: ežen — lord, master; plural ežed, 'masters' (noun + plural -d) [主每]
glossary.burqan-bosqaγsan: Burqan-Bosqaγsan — Burqan-Bosqaqsan, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.sinči-bajan: Sinči-Bajan — Sinchi-Bayan, a man's name (bajan 'rich') (personal name) [人名]
glossary.urjaṅqai-dur: Urjaṅqai-dur — among the Uriangqai (tribal name + dative-locative -dur, back-vowel form) [部落名 裏]
glossary.aisun: aisu- — to come, approach; ending -n, converb or participle, uncertain (verb) [來]
glossary.alan-γoγ̇a-ji: Alan-Γoγ̇a-ji — Alan-Qo'a as object (name + accusative -ji after a vowel) [(女名) 行]
glossary.tende: tende — there, then (from tere 'that'; locative adverb) [那裏]
glossary.γujužu: γuju- — to ask for, demand (here, a bride); converb -žu, 'asking for' (verb, converb) [索着]
glossary.abuγsan: ab- — to take, get (here, a wife); past participle -γsan, 'having taken, the one who took' (verb, participle) [要了的]
glossary.josun: josun — custom, reason, the right way (noun) [理]
glossary.teimü: teimü — so, thus, it is so (adverb) [那般]
glossary.dobün-mergen-dür: Dobün-Mergen-dür — to Dobun the marksman (name + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [(人)名 行]
glossary.irežü: ire- — to come; converb -žü, 'coming' (verb, converb) [來着]
glossary.töreġülbi: töre- — to be born; causative -ġül- plus past -bi, 'caused to be born': bore, begot (verb, causative past) [生了]
glossary.bügünütei: Bügünütei — a son's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.belgünütei: Belgünütei — a son's name; the Ming gloss cannot be read (personal name) [人起]
glossary.nereten: nere-ten — having names, named (nere 'name' + plural possessive -ten) [名(有)的(每)]
glossary.aqa: aqa — elder brother (noun) [兄] · also Ming 長 'eldest', in aqa Žüči, 'the eldest, Jüchi' (the noun used as an adjective)
glossary.dörben: dörben — four (numeral) [四] · also Dörben, a people (the word is 'four'; the Ming marks it 種(名)), also Dörben-(n)ü 'of the Dörben' [種(名)] · also 'four' (Ming 四箇 'four pieces') [四箇]
glossary.köġütü: köġü-tü — having sons (köġün 'son' + possessive -tü, front-vowel form) [子(有的)]
glossary.tedüi: tedüi — so much, so, thus (adverb) [那般] · also 'so, then, thereupon' (a sentence adverb; Ming 便 'at once') · also 'so much, like, as' after a genitive, the size comparison (Ming 般) · also a pronoun, 'those, so many' (Ming 那些 'those')
glossary.atala: a- — to be, remain; converb -tala, 'while, until' (verb, converb) [住間]
glossary.ügei: ügei — without, there is not (negative particle) [無]
glossary.boluba: bolu- — to become; past -ba, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了]
glossary.boluγsan: bolu- — to become; past participle -γsan, 'the one who became, having become' (verb, participle) [做了 的]
glossary.köġüd: köġün — son; plural köġüd, 'sons' (noun + plural -d) [子每] · also 'lords, princes' in the address Taičiγud köġüd (Ming 大王每)
glossary.abaγa-juγ̇an: abaγa-juγ̇an — own paternal uncle (abaγa 'father's younger brother' + reflexive-possessive -juγ̇an; here 'their own') [叔叔(自的)行]
glossary.uruγ-a: uruγ-a — as kin, to the kin (uruγ 'kin, relatives, offspring' + dative -a) [親戚行] · also 'to the offspring' (Ming 子孫行), as in Uruγ-un uruγ-a kürtele 'down to the offspring of the offspring'
glossary.ülü: ülü — not (negates present or converb forms) [不] · also before participles (ülü boluqui, ülü ögteküi), 'not' · also before a bare stem (ülü buča 'does not conceal') and a converb (ülü jaγaran 'not hurrying')
glossary.bolγan: bol- — to become; causative -γa- plus -n, 'making, treating as'; converb (verb, causative converb) [做] · also Ming 審 'scrutinise', glossing the whole word; the reading stays 'making' (uncertain)
glossary.doramžilažu: doramžila- — to look down on, slight; converb -žu (verb, converb) [下覻着]
glossary.qaγačažu: qaγača- — to part from, separate from; converb -žu (verb, converb) [分離着]
glossary.gežü: ge- — to cast aside, abandon, per the Ming; possibly the 'say' verb keġe- in an idiom, uncertain; converb -žü (verb, converb) [撇着]
glossary.neġübe: neġü- — to move camp; past -be, 'moved camp' (verb, past tense) [起了]
glossary.oboγtan: oboγ-tan — having a clan (oboγ 'clan, lineage' + plural possessive -tan) [姓(有的)]
glossary.bolba: bol- — to become; past -ba, 'became' (verb, past tense) [做了] · also an auxiliary after a participle in -qu, -kü: bariqu bolba, kürgekü bolba, 'came to seize, came to lay on'
glossary.teġün-ü: teġün-ü — of that, his, her (tere, stem teġün- before case endings, + genitive -ü, front-vowel form) [那的]
glossary.toqočaγ-ündür: Toqočaγ-Ündür — Toqochaq-Ündür, a hill (ündür 'high') (place name) [地名 山名]
glossary.göreġelere: göreġele- — to hunt; purposive converb -re, 'in order to hunt' (verb, converb) [捕獸]
glossary.urjaṅqadai: Urjaṅqadai — a man of the Uriangqai (Urjaṅqai + -dai, person of; the suffix uncertain) [部落名]
glossary.čüġe-buγu: čüġe-buγu — three-year-old deer (čüġe 'three years old' + buγu 'deer, stag') (noun phrase) [三歲 鹿]
glossary.alažu: ala- — to kill; converb -žu (verb, converb) [殺︀着]
glossary.abid: abid — entrails, innards (Ming 肚臟); read as abi, a stem inferred from the Ming, plus plural -d (noun) [肚臟]
glossary.širažu: šira- — to roast; converb -žu (verb, converb) [燒着]
glossary.bükü-ji: bü- — to be; participle -kü, 'the one who is' + accusative -ji (verb, participle + case) [有的]
glossary.žoluγažu: žoluγa- — to meet, come upon; converb -žu (verb, converb) [遇着]
glossary.sirolγada: širolγa- — to give roast (meat), apparently from šira- 'roast'; stem and ending -da uncertain, read as a request (verb) [燒(肉)與的]
glossary.kēžüġü: keġe- — to say (written kē- when contracted); past narrative -žüġü, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]
glossary.ögsü: ög- — to give; optative -sü, 'let it be given, I will give' (verb, optative) [與(呵)]
glossary.aγ̇ušigitu: aγ̇ušigi-tu — having lung (aγ̇ušigi 'lung' + possessive -tu, back-vowel form) [肺有的]
glossary.žildu: žildu — half the body cavity, half-carcass, per the Ming (noun) [半截腔子]
glossary.abču: ab- — to take; converb -ču, 'taking' (verb, converb) [要着]
glossary.čüġe-buγu-jin: čüġe-buγu-jin — of the three-year-old deer (čüġe-buγu + genitive -jin after a vowel) [三歲鹿 的]
glossary.miqa: miqa — meat; stem miqan before an ending (noun) [肉]
glossary.gübčin-i: gübčin-i — the whole, entire, as object (gübčin 'whole' + accusative -i after a consonant) [全行]
glossary.ögbe: ög- — to give; past -be, 'gave' (verb, past tense) [與了]
glossary.čüġe-buγu-ji: čüġe-buγu-ji — the three-year-old deer as object (čüġe-buγu + accusative -ji after a vowel) [三歲鹿 行]
glossary.ačižu: ači- — to carry as a load, pack; converb -žu (verb, converb) [駄着]
glossary.aisurun: aisu- — to come; converb of time -run, 'when coming' (verb, converb) [來時]
glossary.žaγ̇ura: žaγ̇ur-a — midway, in the middle (žaγ̇ur 'middle' + dative-locative -a, back-vowel form) [路間] · also 'among, between' (Ming 間), in žaba žaγ̇ura dürüžu, 'into the crevice' · also 'meanwhile, in the meantime' (Ming 其間)
glossary.jadaṅgi: jadaṅgi — poor, in want (from jada- 'be lacking') (adjective) [窮乏]
glossary.köġün-beġen: köġün-beġen — own son (köġün 'son' + reflexive-possessive -beġen; the possessor is the subject: 'his own', 'my own') [子 自的(行)]
glossary.kötölžü: kötöl- — to lead, draw along; converb -žü (verb, converb) [牽引着]
glossary.jabuqu-ji: jabu- — to walk, go; participle -qu 'the one who goes' + accusative -ji (verb, participle + case) [行(的行)]
glossary.žolγažu: žolγa- — to meet; converb -žu (verb, converb) [遇着]
glossary.jaγ̇un: jaγ̇un — what (interrogative pronoun) [甚麽] · also 'what' before a noun, 'what use' (Ming 有甚)
glossary.či: či — you, thou (second-person singular pronoun) [你] · also (uncertain) a particle after a noun, 'as for, if' (Ming 呵), as in ger či oira bijü, not the pronoun 'you'
glossary.asaγasuγ̇asu: asaγa- — to ask; conditional converb -γ̇asu 'if/when'; the element -su- is unaccounted for, uncertain (verb, converb) [問呵]
glossary.bi: bi — I (first-person singular pronoun; the stems na-, nama-, min- before case endings) [我] · also 'is, exists' (verb, perhaps a short form of bü-, compare bijü; Ming 有)
glossary.maγ̇aliγ-bajaγ̇udai: Maγ̇aliγ-Bajaγ̇udai — Maqaliq-Bayaqudai, a clan name; the Ming glosses it 姓氏 'clan name' in one place and 人名 'personal name' in another, and it is the same name (clan name) [姓氏]
glossary.jadažu: jada- — to be in want, to lack; converb -žu (verb, converb) [窮乏着] · also jada- 'to be unable', converb -žu, 'being unable' (Ming 不得着, 不能着), as in köġüd(i)-jen gelin jadažu, 'unable to drive off'
glossary.jabumu: jabu- — to walk, go about; present -mu, 'goes, is going' (verb, present tense) [行有]
glossary.göre: göre — first half of göreġesün 'game', which the edition prints split across two entries (noun, split word) [野物]
glossary.ġesün-ü: -ġesün-ü — second half of the split göre-ġesün 'game', with genitive -ü, 'of game' (noun, split word + genitive) [的]
glossary.miqan-ača: miqan-ača — from the meat (miqa, stem miqan, + ablative -ača, back-vowel form) [肉裏]
glossary.na-da: na-da — to me (bi, stem na-, + dative-locative -da, back-vowel form) [我行]
glossary.ög: ög- — to give; the bare stem is the imperative, 'give!' (verb, imperative) [與]
glossary.ene: ene — this (demonstrative pronoun; plural ede) [這] · also with the Ming 俺 'we' written under it, in ene höröne Baγtad (the Han 額捏 is ene; the Ming looks like a slip; read 'this' here; uncertain)
glossary.üge-dür: üge-dür — in the word, in the speech (üge 'word' + dative-locative -dür, front-vowel form) [言語 裏] · also üge 'word, speech' + dative-locative -dür (Ming 言語 行)
glossary.oreġele: oreġele — one of a pair, a piece; form uncertain (noun/numeral) [一隻]
glossary.quγulžü: quγul- — to break off; converb -žü, 'breaking' (verb, converb) [折着]
glossary.ögčü: ög- — to give; converb -čü after a consonant, 'giving' (verb, converb) [與着]
glossary.abčiražü: abčira- — to bring along (ab- 'take' plus a second verb); form uncertain; converb -žü (verb, converb) [將(來)着]
glossary.ger: ger — house, tent, household (noun) [家] · also 'house, tent' (Ming 室)
glossary.žaružu: žaru- — to employ, use (a person); converb -žu (verb, converb) [使着]
glossary.aqu: a- — to dwell, stay; participle -qu, 'the one who stays' (verb, participle) [住] · also 'there is' (Ming 有; a- as 'be', not 'dwell')
glossary.dobun-mergen-i: Dobun-Mergen-i — Dobun the marksman as object (name + accusative -i) [(人名)行]
glossary.boluγsa: bolu- — to become; first part of the past participle -γsa(n), which the edition breaks across two entries (verb, split participle) [做了]
glossary.n-u: -n-u — last letter n of the split participle boluγsa-n plus genitive -u, completing boluγsan-(n)u (split ending, genitive) [的]
glossary.ere: ere — husband, man, male (noun) [丈夫] · also 'man, male; person, head (of people)' (Ming 人口 'persons') · also 'men' (as soldiers, the men of a force) in ba olon ere aγta, 'we, many men and geldings' (Ming 軍 'army')
glossary.ügeiġüi: ügeiġüi — without, none; ügei with a redundant negative -ġüi, uncertain (negative particle) [無]
glossary.böġed: bü- — to be; ending -ġed, 'being so, even so', uncertain (verb, converb) [便] · also read as a particle of sequence, 'and then, thereupon' (Ming 便), as in süni böġed 'then in the night' · also (Ming 見有 'being, there being') 'being so'
glossary.buγu-qatagi: Buγu-Qatagi — Buqu-Qatagi, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
glossary.buqatu-salži: Buqatu-Salži — Buqatu-Salji, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
glossary.bodončar-muṅqaγ: Bodončar-Muṅqaγ — Bodonchar-Munqaq, a son's name; muṅqaγ is an epithet 'simple' (personal name) [(兒)名]
glossary.urida: urida — formerly, before, in front (adverb) [在前] · also 'first, beforehand' (Ming 先)
glossary.dobun-mergen-eče: Dobun-Mergen-eče — from Dobun the marksman (name + ablative -eče, front-vowel form) [(人名)處]
glossary.eke-jüġen: eke-jüġen — own mother (eke 'mother' + reflexive-possessive -jüġen; here 'their own') [娘 自的]
glossary.alan-γoγ̇a-jin: Alan-Γoγ̇a-jin — of Alan-Qo'a (name + genitive -jin after a vowel) [母名 的]
glossary.ečine: ečine — behind, at the back (adverb/postposition) [背處]
glossary.ügüleldürün: ügüle- — to speak; reciprocal -ldu- + converb of time -rün, 'while speaking together' (verb, converb) [共說]
glossary.bidan-u: bidan-u — of us, our (bida 'we, inclusive', stem bidan-, + genitive -u, back-vowel form) [咱的]
glossary.ujaγaja: ujaγaja — near kin of the same branch; form unclear, uncertain (noun) [房親]
glossary.ügelġüi: ügelġüi — without; spelling variant, perhaps a misprint, of ügeiġüi, uncertain (negative particle) [無]
glossary.böġetele: bü- — to be (böġe- before an ending); converb -tele, 'while, although' (verb, converb) [旣] · also bü- 'to be', converb -tele, 'while' (Ming 有間)
glossary.ede: ede — these (plural of ene) (demonstrative pronoun) [這(的每)]
glossary.teġün-ü-ġei: teġün-ü-ġei — his own, his (tere, stem teġün-, + genitive -ü + -ġei, which I take as 'belonging to'; uncertain) [他的]
glossary.bi-že: bü- — to be; stem bi- before -že, 'indeed is' (verb + assertion particle -že, 'indeed, surely') [有]
glossary.keleldüküi-ji: kele- — to speak; reciprocal -ldü-, participle -küi, accusative -ji, 'the speaking together' (verb, participle + case) [共說的行]
glossary.an-u: an-u — their (back-vowel companion of in-ü, third-person genitive placed after its noun) [他的]
glossary.uqažu: uqa- — to understand, perceive, find out; converb -žu (verb, converb) [覺着]
glossary.küṅsilemel: küṅsilemel — a word of unclear form; the Ming 臘 suggests 'winter-cured, preserved (meat)', uncertain (noun/adjective) [臘]
glossary.činažu: čina- — to boil; converb -žu (verb, converb) [煮︀着]
glossary.köġüdi: köġüd(i) — sons; the (i) is read as the accusative -i (the Ming marks 行) before the reflexive -(i)jen (köġün + plural -d) [子每(自的)行] · also köġüd(i)-jer-en, 'with one's own sons' (Ming 兒子(每)自的行), where the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel before the instrumental -jer, as in tümed(i)-jer, not the accusative
glossary.jen: -(i)jen — reflexive-possessive, one's own (front-vowel form; the token left after köġüd(i)-; here 'her own') [子每(自的)行] · also after ger-tür(i)- (dative-locative), 'one's own home' · also after ökin(i)-, 'one's own daughter' · also after kekül(i)- ('one's own tuft'), šibülgel(i)- ('one's own braid') and nidün-dür(i)- ('in one's own eye'), and after the accusative in žeġüdün-(n)i-jen (token ni-jen) · also after bergen(i)- ('one's own sister-in-law') and deġü-ner(i)- ('one's own younger brothers'), where the (i) is Shiratori's accusative; also after köġün(i)- ('one's own son') and ökid(i)- ('one's own daughters') · also -(i)jen after esüg(i)- ('one's own ripe mare's milk') and after -dür(i)- ('to one's own', ulus irgen -dür(i)-jen) · also after emeġel(i)- ('one's own saddle') · also after hüker(i)- ('one's own ox'), güžüġün-dür(i)-, ebčeġün-dür(i)- ('at one's own neck, chest') and üge-dür(i)- ('in one's own word') · also after ösül(i)- ('one's own enmity'), ebür(i)- ('one's own bosom'), čeriġüd(i)- ('one's own troops') and deġel(i)- ('one's own robe') · also after üges-tür(i)- ('in one's own words'), nököd(i)- ('one's own companions'), helige-ber(i)- ('prone, lying', analysis uncertain) and plain tür(i)- ('in one's own') · also after čerig(i)- ('one's own troops') and eje-dür(i)- ('in one's own counsel', eje uncertain), the token left being jen · also after geġüd(i)- ('one's own mares', stem uncertain) and öġer(i)- ('one's own self', Ming 自己 自), the token left being jen · also after sedkil(i)- ('one's own heart'), sedkigsen(i)- ('what one has thought') and žüġegseġer(i)- ('those one has set in place'), where the (i) is Shiratori's · also after ger(i)- ('one's own home', Ming 家 自的行) and kököd(i)- ('one's own breasts', plural, Ming 乳每 自的行), where the (i) is Shiratori's
glossary.žergelen: žergelen — in a row (žerge 'row, rank' + -len, adverbial, uncertain) [列]
glossary.saγ̇ulžu: saγ̇ul- — to seat, make sit; converb -žu (verb, converb) [坐着] · also saγ̇u- — to sit; causative -l-, 'make sit' (Ming 敎坐着)
glossary.nižiġed: nižiġed — one each, one apiece; form uncertain (distributive numeral) [每一隻]
glossary.müsüd: müsü — arrow shaft; plural müsüd (noun + plural -d) [箭榦(每)]
glossary.quγuludqun: quγul- — to break; imperative(-optative) -(u)dqun, 'do break' (the Ming adds 您 'you'); the inner -ud- is unexplained (verb, imperative) [折折您]
glossary.nižiġed-i: nižiġed-i — one each as object (nižiġed + accusative -i) [一隻行]
glossary.jaγ̇u: jaγ̇u — what, how (interrogative) [怎] · also 'what' (Ming 甚), in jaγ̇u keġeldüleġei 'what we said together' · also 'anything', with ber … ese (Ming 甚麽), jaγ̇u ber … ese 'not anything'
glossary.baiγ̇ulqun: bai- — to stand, be; causative -γul- + imperative-optative -qun, 'let it stand, stop' (verb, imperative) [敎停住]
glossary.quγučižu: quγul- — to break; -či- 'each, one by one', uncertain; converb -žu (verb, converb) [各折折着]
glossary.oγ̇orba: oγ̇or- — to go off, depart; stem unknown, Ming 去了 may also mean 'done', uncertain; past -ba (verb, past tense) [去了] · also oγ̇or- 'to let fly, send off' (Ming 放了 'let go', of a hawk or bird); past -ba
glossary.qamtu: qamtu — together, jointly (adverb) [一同] · also glossed Ming 一箇 'one' ('together' remains the reading; sense uncertain)
glossary.čuγlažu: čuγla- — to gather up, bundle; converb -žu (verb, converb) [束着]
glossary.kēžü: keġe- — to say (written kē- when contracted); converb -žü, 'saying' (verb, converb) [說着]
glossary.tabuγ̇ula: tabun-γ̇ula — all five together (tabun 'five' + -γ̇ula 'all together, the whole lot') [五箇]
glossary.čuγtai: čuγ-tai — bundled, having a bundle (čuγ 'bundle' + possessive -tai, back-vowel form) [束的]
glossary.küġüleldün: küġüleldün — each man, one by one; form uncertain (distributive) [每人]
glossary.barižu: bari- — to take hold of, grasp; converb -žu (verb, converb) [拿着]
glossary.bitüġülžü: bitüġül- — to take in turn (Ming 輪着); form uncertain; converb -žü (verb, converb) [輪着] · also 'taking round, parading' (Ming 敎徇着), the causative converb of §81's bitüġülün
glossary.quγuluu: quγul- — to break; converb -un, 'breaking'; printed quγuluu but the Han 侖 reads lun, so quγulun (verb, converb) [折折]
glossary.jadaba: jada- — to lack, be in want; also 'be unable' (Ming 不能了); past -ba (verb, past tense) [不能了]
glossary.ügülebi: ügüle- — to speak; past -bi, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]
glossary.ta: ta — you, plural polite (second-person plural pronoun; stem tan- before case endings) [(您)]
glossary.min-u: min-u — my, of me (bi, genitive stem min-, + -u, set after its noun) [我的]
glossary.nama-ji: nama-ji — me, as object (bi, stem nama-, + accusative -ji after a vowel) [我行]
glossary.köġüd-i: köġüd-i — the sons, as object (köġün + plural -d + accusative -i) [子每(行)] · also 'the princes' as object (Ming 大王每(行)), of the Činos princes
glossary.ken-ü: ken-ü — whose, of whom (ken 'who' + genitive -ü, front-vowel form) [誰的]
glossary.sereldün: sere- — to be wary, suspect; reciprocal -ldu- + converb -n, 'suspecting one another' (verb, converb) [疑的]
glossary.keleldümüi: kele- — to speak; reciprocal -ldu- + present -müi, 'speak together' (verb, present tense) [共說有]
glossary.sereküi: sere- — to suspect; participle -küi, 'the suspecting, suspicion' (verb, participle/noun of action) [疑的]
glossary.tan-u: tan-u — your (plural) (ta, stem tan-, + genitive -u) [您的]
glossary.žöb: žöb — right, correct, proper (adjective) [是] · also 'exactly, just', before tende 'just then' (Ming 正)
glossary.sünid: sün — night; plural sünid, 'nights' (noun + plural -d) [夜(每)] · also a clan name, the Sünid (Ming 一種(名) 'a kind of …'), perhaps the same word with the plural -d, but not the 'nights' (proper name)
glossary.büri: büri — each, every (distributive particle) [每] · also Büri, a man's name (personal name; Ming 人名) [人名] · also 'whole, all' (Ming 全 'whole') [全]
glossary.ger-ün: ger-ün — of the tent, of the house (ger + genitive -ün, front-vowel form after a consonant) [房的]
glossary.erüge: erüge — smoke-hole, roof-window of the tent (Ming 天窗 'skylight') (noun) [天窗]
glossary.dotoγa-jin: dotoγa-jin — of the door-lintel, the upper edge of the doorway, per the Ming; uncertain (dotoγa + genitive -jin after a vowel) [門額 的]
glossary.gegeġer: gegeġe-r — in the light, by brightness (gegeġe 'light' + -r, instrumental or locative, uncertain) [明裏]

glossary.čažin-örtegei: Čažin-Örtegei — Chajin-Örtegei, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]

glossary.čaraγai-linγu-jin: Čaraγai-Linγu — Charaqai-Linggu, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel (name + case) [(人)名 的]

glossary.ambaγai-tan: Ambaγai — Ambaqai, a man's name; -tan either plural, 'Ambaγai and his company', or possessive, 'having Ambaγai' (uncertain; the Ming has only 每 'plural') [(兒)名 每]
glossary.taičiγ̇ud: Taičiγ̇ud — the Taichi'ud, a clan name, (proper name; the ending -d is probably the plural, which the Ming does not mark) [一種(名)]

glossary.čažin-ortegei-jin: Čažin-Ortegei — Chajin-Örtegei, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel (name + case) [(人)名 的]

glossary.qutuγtu-müṅgür: Qutuγtu-Müṅgür — Qutuqtu-Münggür, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
glossary.qutula: Qutula — Qutula, a son's name (personal name; also Qutula Qaγan) [(兒)名]

glossary.qutuγtu-jürki-jin: Qutuγtu-Jürki — Qutuqtu-Yürki, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel (name + case) [(人)名 的]
glossary.seče-beki: Seče-Beki — Seche-Beki, a son's name (personal name; the meaning of beki is not known from these sources) [(兒)名]

glossary.jürki: Jürki — the Yürki, a clan name (proper name; Ming 一姓 'a clan') [一姓]
glossary.bartan-baγ̇atur-un: Bartan-Baγ̇atur — Bartan-Ba'atur, a man's name; genitive -un after a consonant (name + case) [(人)名的]
glossary.möngetü-kijan: Möngetü-Kijan — Möngetü-Kiyan, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]

glossary.qutuγtu-müṅgür-ün: Qutuγtu-Müṅgür — Qutuqtu-Münggür, a man's name; genitive -ün after a consonant (name + case) [(人)名的]

glossary.belgütei-jin: Belgütei — Belgütei, the younger brother of Chinggis (Ming 太祖弟名); genitive -jin after a vowel (name + case) [太祖︀弟名 的]
glossary.mürü: mürü — shoulder, shoulder-blade (noun; Ming 肩甲) [肩甲]

glossary.tödöġen: Tödöġen — Tödögen, a man's name (personal name) [(人名)]

glossary.qamuγ: qamuγ — all, the whole (Ming 普) (quantifier) [普]
glossary.monγol-i: Monγol — the Mongols (the Ming glosses 達達 'Tatars'); accusative -i after a consonant (name + case; the Ming writes 行) [達達行]

glossary.seṅgün-bilge-jin: Seṅgün-Bilge — Senggün-Bilge, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel (name + case) [(人名) 的]
glossary.ambaγai: Ambaγai — Ambaqai, a man's name (personal name) [(人名)]
glossary.büjür: Büjür — Büyür, a lake or water (Ming 水名 'water name') [水名]

glossary.tatar: Tatar — the Tatar, a people (proper name) [(種名)]

glossary.öġesün: öġesün — oneself, himself, emphatic (pronoun; Ming 自己) [自己]

glossary.odqu: od- — to go; participle -qu, 'the one going' (verb, participle) [去的]

glossary.köġüd-ün: köġün — son; plural -d + genitive -ün, 'of the sons' (noun + plural + case) [兒子的]

glossary.ulus-un: ulus — realm, state, people; genitive -un, 'of the realm' (noun + case, back-vowel form after a consonant) [國(的)]
glossary.bolužu: bolu- — to become; converb -žu, 'becoming' (verb, converb) [做著︀]

glossary.kimül: kimül — fingernail (noun; Ming 指甲) [指甲]

glossary.merkid-ün: Merkid — the Merkid, a people; genitive -ün after a consonant (name + case) [種名(的)]
glossary.jeke-čiledü: Jeke-Čiledü — Yeke-Chiledü, a man's name (jeke 'great' + Čiledü) [(人)名]
glossary.olqunuγ̇ud: Olqunuγ̇ud — the Olqunu'ud, a people (proper name; the ending -d is probably the plural, which the Ming does not mark) [種名]
glossary.irgen-eče: irgen — people; ablative -eče, 'from' (noun + case, front-vowel form; the Ming 處) [百姓 處]
glossary.öki: öki — girl, daughter (a form of ökin without its n) (noun) [女子]
glossary.eġüsgežü: eġüsge- — to take a wife, to wed (Ming 取; 'wed' is a reading); converb -žü, 'wedding' (verb, converb) [取著︀] · also eġüsge- 'to begin, set out' (Ming 起着 'rising, setting out'; stem inferred); converb -žü, 'setting out, beginning'
glossary.öngeižü: öngei- — to peer in, look closely (Ming 探著; the stem is uncertain, perhaps related to önge); converb -žü (verb, converb; uncertain) [探著︀]
glossary.üžeġesü: üže- — to see; conditional converb -ġesü, 'if, when (he) looked' (verb, converb; Ming 看呵) [看呵]
glossary.önge: önge — colour, complexion (noun; Ming 顏) [顏]
glossary.žisü: žisü — colour, hue (noun; Ming 色) [色]
glossary.bušitai: buši — other, different; possessive -tai, 'having something different, uncommon' (adjective + possessive, back-vowel form; Ming 別有的) [別有的]
glossary.qatud: qatun — lady; plural -d (Ming 婦人(每)) (noun + plural; uncertain: whether it names the girl, 'a lady', or stands as a plural, 'the ladies', is not settled; the Ming has no 'of rank') [婦人(每)] · also 'queens, ladies', plural of a ruler's wives (Ming 娘子每 'the ladies')
glossary.qarin: qarin — back, again (adverb; Ming 回) [囘] · also 'tribe, division' (Ming 部 'division, section'; sense uncertain), in harban γurban qarin, 'thirteen divisions' · also read as qari- 'to return' + converb -n, 'returning' (Ming 囘) · also 'nation, state' (Ming 邦), in aimaγ qarin irgen, 'tribes, nations and peoples'; sense uncertain
glossary.qaγ̇lžu: qaγ̇l- — to run, rush (Ming 奔; the stem is uncertain); converb -žu, 'rushing' (verb, converb) [奔著︀]
glossary.deġü-ben: deġü — younger brother; reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own younger brother' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [弟 (自的)行]
glossary.irežüġü: ire- — to come; past narrative -žüġü, 'came' (verb, past narrative, front-vowel form; Ming 來了) [來了]
glossary.kürküi-lüġe: kür- — to reach, arrive; participle -küi + -lüġe 'together with' (the postposition of deġü-lüġe-beġen) after a participle, 'as soon as' (analysis tentative), 'as soon as arriving' (verb, participle + postposition) [到了 呵]
glossary.čiledü: Čiledü — Chiledü, a man's name (personal name) [(人)名]
glossary.ajužu: aju- — to fear, be afraid; converb -žu, 'fearing' (verb, converb) [怕著︀]
glossary.qurdun: qurdun — swift, quickly (adverb or adjective; the Ming 快 does not say which) [快]
glossary.qubitu: qubi — yellow (horse); possessive -tu, 'yellow-horse-having' (noun + possessive; Ming 黃馬 'yellow horse') [黃馬(有的)]
glossary.qubi-juγ̇an: qubi — yellow horse; reflexive-possessive -juγ̇an, 'his own yellow horse' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [黃馬 自的]
glossary.deledčü: dele- — to strike, to whip; converb -dču, 'striking' (verb, converb; the d is unexplained, as in uduridču) [打著︀] · also Ming 打造着 'forging': dele- 'to forge' (temür terege deledčü, 'having forged an iron cart'); converb -dčü, 'forging' [打造着]
glossary.quburi: quburi — hill, rise of ground (noun; the Ming 岡 'ridge') [岡]
glossary.nambalis: nambalis — crossing over, passing across (form uncertain; stem not identified, only the Ming 越過 'cross over'; perhaps a converb in -s) [越過]

glossary.γurbaγ̇ula: γurban — three; collective -γ̇ula, 'the three together' (numeral + collective; Ming 箇 'item') [三箇]
glossary.udaγ̇alalduba: udaγ̇ala- — to follow close, pursue (stem uncertain; Ming 隨卽趕 'follow and chase'); -ldu- 'together, mutually' + past -ba, 'pursued' (verb, past tense) [隨卽趕了]
glossary.qošiγ̇un: qošiγ̇un — spur, point of a hill (noun; Ming 山觜 'mountain beak') [山觜]
glossary.qučilis: qučili- — to round, go round (stem uncertain); converb -s, 'rounding' (verb, converb; Ming 褁過 'wrap round') [褁過]

glossary.tergen-duri: tergen — cart; dative-locative -dur, 'to, at the cart' (noun + case; the (i) is Shiratori's and belongs to the reflexive -(i)jan that follows as the token jan; Ming 車子 + 行) [車子 自的行]
glossary.ireküi-lüġe: ire- — to come; participle -küi + -lüġe 'together with' (the postposition of deġü-lüġe-beġen) after a participle, 'as soon as' (analysis tentative), 'as soon as coming' (verb, participle + postposition) [來了呵]
glossary.höġelün-üžin: Höġelün-Üžin — Högelün-Üjin, a woman's name (personal name, one two-part name) [婦人名]

glossary.čirai: čirai — face, countenance (noun; Ming 顏色 'colour of the face') [顏色]

glossary.busud: busu — other, not so, different; plural -d, 'the others' (adjective/noun + plural; the Ming 不是 is 'not so'; the sense in its context is uncertain) [不是] · also Ming 別的每 'the others' (busu + plural -d)
glossary.amin-dur: amin — life, breath; dative-locative -dur, 'in the life' (noun + case; Ming 性命 + 裏) [性命 裏] · also 'to/by the life' (Ming 性命 行)
glossary.kürküi: kür- — to reach, arrive; participle -küi, 'arriving, the arrival' (verb, participle; Ming 到的) [到的]
glossary.čiraitan: čirai — face; plural possessive -tan, 'those having faces' (noun + plural possessive; Ming 顏色(有的)每 'those with colour'; sense uncertain) [顏色(有的)每]
glossary.amin: amin — life, breath (noun; Ming 性命) [性命]
glossary.ele: ele — emphatic particle: only, but, indeed (Ming 但 'only, but') · after ker, 'how-like, of what sort' (Ming 般 'sort, manner'), where it is not 'indeed'; the particle's force is not settled [但]
glossary.ölžige: ölžige — front of the cart, cart-front (word unclear, the Ming 車前 only; the sense is taken from the context) [車前]
glossary.ökid: ökin — girl, daughter; plural -d, 'girls' (noun + plural; Ming 女子每) [女子每]
glossary.qaraγ̇u: qaraγ̇u — black cart, 'the black one' (stem qara 'black' with an ending not identified; the Ming 黑車 is 'black cart'; uncertain) [黑車]
glossary.olu: olu- — to get, obtain, find; the bare stem, written apart from its ending (verb; the following word i may be the ending, uncertain) [得]

glossary.busu: busu — other, not so (adjective; Ming 別 'other, another') [別]
glossary.nerete-ji: nere — name; possessive -te + accusative -ji, 'the one having a name' (noun + possessive + case; Ming 名字(有)的(行)) [名字(有)的(行)]
glossary.höġelün: Höġelün — Högelün, a woman's name (personal name) [婦人名]
glossary.taki: taki — also, again, too (particle; Ming 也) [也]
glossary.nereidüjü: nere- — to name, call by name (nere 'name' + -id-, uncertain); converb -üjü, 'naming' (verb, converb; same word as nereidčü, here with a different converb spelling; Ming 名喚 'be called') [名喚]

glossary.γoloγ: γolo- — to carry off, take away (Ming 刁出去 'carry off in the mouth, go out'; the stem and the imperative -γ are uncertain) [刁出去]
glossary.hünür: hünür — scent, fragrance (noun; Ming 香氣) [香氣] · also plain 'smell, odour' (Ming 氣), as in hünür maγ̇utan, 'having a bad smell'
glossary.hünüsčü: hünüs- — to smell, scent; converb -čü, 'smelling' (verb, converb; Ming 聞 'to smell') [聞者︀]
glossary.jabu: jabu- — to go; the bare stem, imperative, 'go!' (verb, imperative; Ming 行) [行]
glossary.čamča-ban: čamča — shirt, garment; reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own shirt' (noun + reflexive-possessive; Ming 衫兒) [衫兒自的(行)]
glossary.mültülžü: mültül- — to strip off, pull off; converb -žü, 'stripping' (verb, converb; Ming 脫) [脫著︀]
glossary.deġerēče: deġere — above, upper; ablative -ēče, 'from above' (adverb + case, front-vowel form with a long ē) [上自]
glossary.naruidču: naru(i)- — to reach, grope; converb -dču, 'reaching' (verb, converb; Ming 探 'probe'; stem uncertain) [探著︀]
glossary.abqui-luγ̇a: ab- — to take; participle -qui + -luγ̇a, the back-vowel partner of -lüġe, 'together with', after a participle 'as soon as taking' (analysis tentative; not the past -luγ̇a of aluγ̇a; Ming 拾要了呵) [拾要了呵]
glossary.qučildužu: qučil- — to round, wrap round; -du- 'together, mutually' + converb -žu, 'wrapping together' (verb, converb; Ming 裹 'wrap') [裹著︀]
glossary.aisuqu-luγ̇a: aisu- — to come; participle -qu + -luγ̇a, the back-vowel partner of -lüġe, 'together with', after a participle 'as soon as coming' (analysis tentative; not the past -luγ̇a of aisuluγ̇a) [來了呵]
glossary.qubi-jin: qubi — yellow horse; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the yellow horse' (noun + case) [黃馬 的]
glossary.žuqus: žuqus — hurriedly, in haste (adverb; Ming 急忙) [急忙]
glossary.dutaγ̇ažu: dutaγ̇a- — to flee, run away; converb -žu, 'fleeing' (verb, converb; Ming 走 'run') [走著︀]

glossary.dabatala: daba- — to cross a pass, pass over; -tala 'until, as far as, while' (verb + terminal converb; Ming 越過 'cross over') [越過]
glossary.hüldežü: hülde- — to chase, overtake (stem inferred from the Ming 趕); converb -žü, 'chasing' (verb, converb) [趕了] · also hülde- — 'to drive (animals) on' (Ming 趕着) · also with the Ming 逐着 'chasing, pursuing'
glossary.höġelün-üžin-i: Höġelün-Üžin — Högelün-Üjin, a woman's name; accusative -i, as object (name + case; Ming 婦人名 行) [婦人名 行]
glossary.delbege-dēče: delbege — rein, halter (noun; Ming 韁索); ablative -dēče, 'from, by the rein' (front-vowel form with a long ē; Ming 處) [韁索 處]
glossary.kilikü: kilikü — shaft of a cart (noun; Ming 車轅) [車轅]
glossary.dergečežü: dergeče- — to hold fast, cling to (Ming 𠊓, a rare character; stem uncertain); converb -žü, 'clinging' (verb, converb) [𠊓著︀]
glossary.aisuqui-dur: aisu- — to come; participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'at the coming, when coming' (verb, participle + case; Ming 來時) [來時]
glossary.keküli: kekül — tuft of hair, hair-knot (reading uncertain; Ming 髯揫); the (i) is Shiratori's and belongs to the reflexive -(i)jen that follows as the token jen (noun) [髯揫(自的行)]
glossary.keisümüser: keisü- — to blow (of wind; Ming 刮); negative past -müser, 'never blown' (verb, negative past; the ending is read from the Ming 不曾 'never') [不曾刮]
glossary.keġer: keġer — wild, open country, the steppe (noun or adjective; Ming 野) [野] · also the second half of the horse's name Aman-Čaγaγ̇an-Keġer (Ming 名 or 馬名), not 'steppe'
glossary.keġeli-ben: keġeli — belly; reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own belly' (noun + reflexive-possessive; Ming 肚 + 自的行) [肚 自的(行)]
glossary.ölöšümüser: ölöš- — to hunger, be hungry (Ming 飢); negative past -müser, 'never hungry' (verb, negative past) [不曾飢]
glossary.büliġi: bü- — to be; past -liġi, 'there was' (verb, past; the Ming 有來 is the same as for büleġe, and I take it for a variant of it) [有來]
glossary.ker: ker — how, what manner (interrogative adverb; Ming 怎生); in ker ele, 'how, of what sort' [怎生]
glossary.šibülgeli: šibülgel — braid, queue (reading uncertain; Ming 練椎, where 椎 is 'mallet'); the (i) is Shiratori's and belongs to the reflexive -(i)jen that follows as the token jen (noun) [練︀椎 自的行]
glossary.nigente: nigen — one; dative-locative -te, here 'once, one time' (numeral + case; the Ming 遍 'time, turn' is the only evidence; uncertain) [一遍] · also 'at one blow' (nigente deledüġed, 'struck once'; Ming 一下)
glossary.aru: aru — back (of the body), behind (noun; Ming 背) [背] · also Aru, a people name, capitalised (Aru, Maru, Madasari irgen; Ming 種(名) 'a clan or people')
glossary.deġere-jen: deġere — above, upon; reflexive-possessive -jen, 'upon one's own' (adverb/noun + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form; Ming 上 + 自的行) [上 自的(行)]
glossary.oγ̇orču: oγ̇or- — to throw, toss, fling (Ming 丢; stem uncertain); converb -čü, 'throwing' (verb, converb) [丢著︀] · also 'going, making for' (Ming 去着 'going'), where the stem oγ̇or- is read as 'go' (uncertain; the sense 'throw' is not supported here)
glossary.ebür-ġen: ebür — bosom, lap (noun; Ming 懷裏); reflexive-possessive -ġen, 'one's own bosom' (noun + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form after r) [懷裏自的(行)]
glossary.uruγšida: uru- — front, forward (stem uncertain; Ming 前); directional -γšida, 'toward' (Ming 向): 'forward' (noun + directional) [向前]
glossary.qoinaγšida: qoina — behind, after; directional -γšida, 'toward' (Ming 向): 'backward' (noun + directional) [向後]
glossary.odumui: od- — to go; present -mui, 'goes' (verb, present; Ming 去有) [去有]
glossary.kēġed: keġe- — to say; converb -ġed, 'having said' (verb, converb; keġe- + -ġed run together and written with a long ē; Ming 說了) [說了]
glossary.tolkistala: tolkis- — to heave in waves, surge (Ming 震動波浪); -tala 'while, so that' (verb + terminal converb) [震動波浪]
glossary.žubur: žubur — stream, valley, flat (reading uncertain; Ming 川 'stream, plain') [川]
glossary.daγ̇uristala: daγ̇uris- — to resound, ring out (perhaps from daγ̇u 'voice'; Ming 震動 'shake'); -tala 'while, so that' (verb + terminal converb) [震動]
glossary.daγ̇u-bar: daγ̇u — voice, sound (noun); instrumental -bar, 'with a voice, aloud' (noun + case; Ming 聲 + 裏) [聲 裏]
glossary.uilažu: uila- — to weep; converb -žu, 'weeping' (verb, converb; Ming 哭) [哭著︀]
glossary.teberikü: teberi- — to embrace, clasp; participle -kü, 'the one embracing' (verb, participle; Ming 摟抱的) [摟抱的]
glossary.dabaγ̇ad: daba — mountain pass, ridge (noun); plural -γ̇ad, 'passes' (noun + plural; Ming 嶺每) [嶺每]
glossary.olon: olon — many (adjective or quantifier; Ming 多) [多]
glossary.dababa: daba- — to cross a pass; past -ba, 'crossed' (verb, past tense; Ming 過了) [過了]
glossary.uiladaqu: uila- — to weep; participle -daqu, 'the one weeping' (verb, participle; Ming 哭的) [哭的]
glossary.usud: usun — water; plural -d, 'waters' (noun + plural; the Ming 水(每) marks the plural in brackets) [水(每)]
glossary.ketülbe: ketül- — to cross, ford (Ming 渡); past -be, 'crossed' (verb, past tense) [渡了]
glossary.qailaγ̇asu: qaila- — to call out (stem uncertain; Ming 叫); conditional -γ̇asu, 'if (he) calls' (verb, conditional; back-vowel partner of -ġesü; Ming 呵) [叫呵] · also qaila- 'to cherish, spare' (Ming 愛惜呵), conditional 'if (you) had cherished', amin čin-u qailaγ̇asu
glossary.qaraižu: qarai- — to look back (Ming 囘顧); converb -žu, 'looking back' (verb, converb) [囘顧著︀]
glossary.üžekü: üže- — to see; participle -kü, 'seeing, the one who sees' (verb, participle; Ming 看有) [看有]
glossary.čima-ji: či — you; accusative -ji on the oblique stem čima-, 'you' as object (pronoun + case; Ming 你行) [你行]
glossary.qaibasu: qai- — to seek (stem uncertain; Ming 尋他踪 'seek his tracks'); conditional -basu, 'if (one) seeks' (verb, conditional; Ming 呵) [尋他踪呵]
glossary.qaγ̇uluγa: qaγ̇uluγa — road, way (noun; Ming 道路) · also 'ditch, channel' (Ming 路渠 'road-ditch'), where the road is cut into a channel; the two senses are the one word read by the Ming [道路] · also standing with no Ming gloss, where its meaning is unknown and the road / ditch sense is not assumed
glossary.oluqu: olu- — to get, find; participle -qu, 'finding' (verb, participle; Ming 得) [得]
glossary.simboli: simbo- — to be silent, keep quiet (Ming 禁聲 'forbid sound'; form uncertain); -li, imperative or optative (uncertain; Ming 勾了) [禁聲勾了]
glossary.idqaba: idqa- — to urge, exhort (Ming 勸); past -ba, 'urged' (verb, past tense) [勸了]
glossary.jesügei: Jesügei — Yesügei, a man's name (personal name) [(人)名]
glossary.abčiraba: abčira- — to bring along, carry off (ab- 'take' plus a second verb; uncertain; Ming 將來); past -ba, 'brought' (verb, past tense) [將來了]
glossary.jesügei-jin: Jesügei — Yesügei; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Yesügei' (name + case) [(人)名 的]
glossary.abčiraγsan: abčira- — to bring along; past participle -γsan, 'the one who brought' (verb, past participle; Ming 將來了的) [將來了的]
glossary.qojar-i: qojar — two; accusative -i, 'the two' as object (numeral + case; Ming 兩箇行) [兩箇行]
glossary.iregseġer: ire- — to come; past participle -gsen + instrumental -ġer, 'because of the coming' (verb, participle + case; Ming 說來的上頭, 'on account of'; the Ming 說 is not translated) [說來的上頭]
glossary.monγol: Monγol — the Mongols, a people (the Ming glosses 達達 'Tatars', as in the published monγol-i) (name) [達達]
glossary.γorqonaγ: Γorqonaγ — Gorqonaq, a place (place name; Ming 地名) [地名]
glossary.quražu: qura- — to gather, assemble; converb -žu, 'gathering' (verb, converb; Ming 聚) [聚著︀]
glossary.qutula-ji: Qutula — Qutula, a man's name; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Qutula' as object (name + case; Ming (人)名 行) [(人)名 行]
glossary.moṅγol-un: Monγol — the Mongols (the Ming glosses 達達 'Tatars'); genitive -un, 'of the Mongols' (name + case, back-vowel form; written with a dotted ṅ) [達達的]
glossary.žirγalaṅ: žirγalaṅ — joy, rejoicing (Ming 快活; a noun, or a converb in -n of a verb žirγala-; uncertain) [快活]
glossary.debsen: debse- — to leap, dance; converb -n, 'leaping' (verb, converb; Ming 跳躍) [跳躍]
glossary.qurimlan: qurim — feast, banquet (Ming 筵會); verb-forming -la- + converb -n, 'feasting' (noun-derived verb, converb) [筵會]
glossary.žirγaqu: žirγa- — to rejoice, be glad; participle -qu, 'rejoicing' (verb, participle; Ming 快活的) [快活的]
glossary.ergüġed: ergü- — to lift, raise, set up (Ming 立); converb -ġed, 'having raised' (verb, converb) [立了]
glossary.γorqonaγ-un: Γorqonaγ — Gorqonaq, a place; genitive -un, 'of Gorqonaq' (place name + case) [地名(的)]
glossary.saγlaγar: saγlaγar — thick, bushy, dense (Ming 鬔鬆 'shaggy'; word class uncertain) [鬔鬆]
glossary.modun: modun — tree, trees, wood (noun; Ming 樹) [樹]
glossary.horčin: horčin — around, round about, surroundings (Ming 周圍; word class uncertain: noun or postposition) [周圍] · also horči- 'to encircle', converb -n, 'surrounding' (Ming 圍; form uncertain), as in siγui-dur horčin sakižu
glossary.qabirγa-ta: qabirγa — rib, side (noun); possessive -ta, 'rib-having', 'up to the ribs' (noun + possessive; Ming 沒肋扇的, 沒 'reach to, sink') [沒肋扇的]
glossary.ebüdüg-te: ebüdüg — knee (noun); possessive -te, 'knee-having', 'up to the knees' (noun + possessive; Ming 沒膝的) [沒膝的]
glossary.ölkeg: ölkeg — dust (noun; Ming 灰土) [灰土]
glossary.bolutala: bol- — to become; linking vowel -u- + -tala 'until, so that' (verb + terminal converb; the stem is bol-, with bolu- only the stem before a vowel or consonant ending; Ming 做了) [做了]
glossary.debsebe: debse- — to leap, dance; past -be, 'danced' (verb, past tense; Ming 跳躍了) [跳躍了]
glossary.boluγ̇ad: bol- — to become; linking vowel -u- + converb -γ̇ad, 'having become' (verb, converb, back-vowel form; the stem is bol-; compare abuγ̇ad; Ming 做了) [做了]
glossary.qadaγ̇an-taiši: Qadaγ̇an-Taiši — Qada'an-Taishi, a man's name (personal name; taiši 'prince') [(人)名]
glossary.tatar-un: Tatar — the Tatars, a people; genitive -un, 'of the Tatars' (name + case; Ming (種名)的) [(種名)的]
glossary.ködön-baraγa: Ködön-Baraγa — Ködön-Baraqa, a man's name (personal name) [(人)名]
glossary.žali-buqa: Žali-Buqa — Jali-Buqa, a man's name (personal name) [(人)名]
glossary.qojar-tur: qojar — two; dative-locative -tur, 'in, among the two' (numeral + case; Ming 兩箇 + 裏) [兩箇 裏]
glossary.γurbanta: γurban — three; dative-locative -ta, here 'three times' (numeral + case; the Ming 遍 'time, turn' is the only evidence; uncertain) [三遍]
glossary.qadquldužu: qadqul- — to fight, clash (Ming 厮殺); -du- 'together, mutually' + converb -žu, 'fighting each other' (verb, converb) [厮殺︀着]
glossary.ösül: ösül — enmity, grievance, wrong (noun; Ming 仇); paired with ösün [仇]
glossary.ösün: ösün — the second half of the doublet ösül ösün, 'enmity' (noun, perhaps; the Ming glosses the pair once; word not otherwise known) [no Ming gloss]
glossary.kisal: kisal — vengeance, requital (noun; Ming 讎) [讎] · also glossed 仇 (Ming), 'grudge, enmity, a score to settle' · also 'grievance, wrong' (Ming 寃), set beside ösül 'enmity' (Ming 讐)
glossary.kisa: kisa- — to repay, avenge (Ming 報 'repay'); bare stem (verb; form in the sentence uncertain, perhaps a noun-stem used as a verbal complement) [報]
glossary.temüžin-üge: Temüžin-Üge — Temüjin-Üge, a man's name (personal name) [(人)名]
glossary.qori-buqa: Qori-Buqa — Qori-Buqa, a man's name (personal name) [(人)名]
glossary.tatar-i: Tatar — the Tatars; accusative -i, 'the Tatars' as object (name + case; Ming 種名行) [(種名行)]
glossary.ireġesü: ire- — to come; conditional -ġesü, 'when, if (he) came' (verb, conditional; Ming 來了呵) [來了呵] · also with the Ming 來呵 'if (he) comes'
glossary.bürün: bü- — to be; converb -rün, 'being' (verb, converb; Ming (有)的) [(有)的] · also 'as for, being' after či (Ming 呵), 'as for you' · also after ergi-de and the like, 'being, having been' (Ming 有來) · also 'dwelling' (Ming 住着) · also bü- 'to be', converb of time -rün (Ming 有着)
glossary.deliġün-boldaγ-a: Deliġün-Boldaγ — Deligün-Boldaq, a place; dative-locative -a, 'at Deligün-Boldaq' (place name + case; Ming 地名(行)) [地名(行)]
glossary.büküi-dür: bü- — to be; participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'at the being, when being' (verb, participle + case; Ming 有時) [有時]
glossary.törežüġüi: töre- — to be born; past narrative -žüġüi, 'was born' (verb, past; the same ending as -žüġü in the published kēžüġü, with a final -i; analysis uncertain; Ming 生了有來) [生了有來]
glossary.töreküi-dür: töre- — to be born; participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'at the birth, when born' (verb, participle + case; Ming 生時) [生時]
glossary.baraγ̇un: baraγ̇un — right (hand or side; adjective; Ming 右) [右]
glossary.γar-turi: γar — hand; dative-locative -tur, 'in the hand' (noun + case; the (i) is Shiratori's and belongs to the reflexive -(i)jan that follows as the token jan; Ming 手 + 自的行) [手 自的(行)]
glossary.siγ̇a-jin: siγ̇a — a game bone, 'knucklebone' (Ming 髀石 'thigh-stone'); genitive -jin after a vowel (noun + case; the sense 'knucklebone' is from outside the sources, the Ming gives only 'thigh-stone') [髀石 的]
glossary.nodun: nodun — blood clot (noun; Ming 血塊) [血塊]
glossary.hadqun: hadqu- — to grip, clutch (Ming 握; perhaps the adqu- of §63); converb -n, 'gripping' (verb, converb) [握著︀]
glossary.temüžin-üge-ji: Temüžin-Üge — Temüjin-Üge, a man's name; accusative -ji after a vowel, as object (name + case; Ming (人名)行) [(人名)行]
glossary.abčiraγsan-dur: abčira- — to bring along; past participle -γsan + dative-locative -dur, 'at the bringing, when (he) brought' (verb, participle + case; Ming 將來 時) [將來 時]
glossary.temüžin: Temüžin — Temüjin, a boy's name (personal name; Ming (兒名)) [(兒名)]
glossary.ögküi: ög- — to give; participle -küi, 'giving, the one who gives' (verb, participle; Ming 與的) [與的]
glossary.jesügei-baγ̇atur-un: Jesügei-Baγ̇atur — Yesügei-Ba'atur, Yesügei the Brave; genitive -un, 'of Yesügei the Brave' (name + case, back-vowel form after a consonant) [(人)名 的]
glossary.höġelün-üžin-eče: Höġelün-Üžin — Högelün-Üjin, a woman's name; ablative -eče, 'from Högelün-Üjin' (name + case; Ming (妻)名處) [(妻)名處]
glossary.qasar: Qasar — Qasar, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名] · also a hound's name, 'a kind of dog' (Ming 狗名), in the simile qarbisu-ban qužaqu Qasar noγai · also Qasar, Chinggis's brother (Ming 人名)
glossary.temüge: Temüge — Temüge, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
glossary.temülün: Temülün — Temülün, a girl's name (personal name; Ming (女)名) [(女)名]
glossary.törebi: töre- — to be born; past -bi, 'was born' (verb, past tense; apparently a spelling variant of -be) [生了]
glossary.jesün: jesün — nine (numeral; Ming 九) [九] · also nine, 'nine times' (Ming 九次) · also, where the Ming writes 九十 'ninety', the Mongol word is still 'nine'
glossary.nasutu: nasu — age, years of life (noun); possessive -tu, 'having years', 'aged' (noun + possessive; Ming 歲(有的)) [歲(有的)]
glossary.žüči-qasar: Žüči-Qasar — Jüchi-Qasar, a son's name (personal name, one two-part name) [(兒)名]
glossary.qačiγ̇un-elči: Qačiγ̇un-Elči — Qachi'un-Elchi, a son's name (personal name, one two-part name; elči 'envoy', as in the published elčin) [(兒)名]
glossary.temüge-ödčigin: Temüge-Ödčigin — Temüge-Ödchigin, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
glossary.γunan: γunan — three years old (Ming 三歲; noun or adjective, uncertain) [三歲] · also Γunan, a man's name (Qunan; Ming 人名), not the word 'three years old'
glossary.ölegetei: ölege — cradle (noun; Ming 搖車); possessive -tei, 'cradle-having' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [搖車(有)的]
glossary.törgüd: törgü — family, kin (Ming 家 'house, family'; stem and sense uncertain); plural -d (noun + plural; the Ming does not mark the plural) [家]
glossary.naγaču-nar-ača: naγaču — maternal uncle (noun; Ming 母舅); plural of persons -nar + ablative -ača, 'from the maternal uncles' (noun + plural + case; Ming 母舅每行) [母舅 每行]
glossary.γujusu: γuju- — to ask for, seek (Ming 索); -su, purpose ending (uncertain), 'in order to ask' (verb + purpose) [索]
glossary.jorčiba: jorči- — to set out, go (Ming 去; stem inferred); past -ba, 'set out' (verb, past tense) [去了]
glossary.čegčer: Čegčer — Chegcher, a mountain (place name; Ming 山名) [山名]
glossary.čigürkü: Čigürkü — Chigürkü, a mountain (place name; Ming 山名) [山名]
glossary.qojar-un: qojar — two; genitive -un, 'of the two' (numeral + case; Ming 兩的) [兩的]
glossary.ongiradai: Ongiradai — a man of the Ongira(?) clan (clan name with -dai, as in Urjaṅqadai; uncertain; Ming 人氏 'a man of the clan') [人氏]
glossary.de-sečen: De-Sečen — De-Sechen, a man's name (personal name, one two-part name; Ming (人)名) [(人)名]
glossary.žolγaba: žolγa- — to meet (Ming 遇); past -ba, 'met' (verb, past tense) [遇(了)]
glossary.quda: quda — in-law, relation by marriage (noun; Ming 親家) [親家]
glossary.ken-dür: ken — who; dative-locative -dür, 'to whom, at whose' (pronoun + case; Ming 誰行) [誰行]
glossary.žorižü: žori- — to aim at, point at, set out for (Ming 指); converb -žü, 'aiming' (verb, converb) [指着]
glossary.aisulaγ̇a: aisu- — to come; past narrative -laγ̇a, 'have come' (verb, past; a spelling of -luγ̇a as in aluγ̇a, not the 'together with' -luγ̇a of aisuqu-luγ̇a; uncertain) [來]
glossary.keġežüġü: keġe- — to say; past narrative -žüġü, 'said' (verb, past; as in the published kēžüġü; Ming 說有) [說有]
glossary.köġün-ü: köġün — son; genitive -ü after n, 'of the son' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [兒子 的]
glossary.naγaču-nar: naγaču — maternal uncle; plural of persons -nar, 'the maternal uncles' (noun + plural; Ming 母舅每) [母舅 每]
glossary.aisuluγ̇a: aisu- — to come; past narrative -luγ̇a, 'have come' (verb, past, as in aluγ̇a; uncertain; not the 'together with' -luγ̇a of aisuqu-luγ̇a; Ming 來) [來]
glossary.nidün-düri: nidün — eye; dative-locative -dür, 'in the eye' (noun + case; the (i) is Shiratori's and belongs to the reflexive -(i)jen that follows as the token jen; Ming 眼 + 自的行) [眼 自的行]
glossary.γaltu: γal — fire; possessive -tu, 'fire-having', 'with fire' (noun + possessive; Ming (火)有的) [(火)有的]
glossary.niγ̇ur-turi: niγ̇ur — face (noun); dative-locative -tur, 'in the face' (noun + case; the (i) is Shiratori's and belongs to the reflexive -(i)jan that follows as the token jan; Ming 面 + 自的行) [面 自的行]
glossary.geretü: gere — light (noun); possessive -tü, 'light-having', 'with light' (noun + possessive; Ming 光 有的) [光 有的]
glossary.žeġüdülebe: žeġüdüle- — to dream (žeġüdün 'dream' + verb-forming -le-); past -be, 'dreamed' (verb, past tense; Ming 夢了) [夢了]
glossary.šinqor: šinqor — gyrfalcon, a hunting falcon (noun; Ming 海靑) [海︀靑]
glossary.sara: sara — moon, month (noun; Ming 月) [月]
glossary.adqun: adqu- — to grip, seize (Ming 拿); converb -n, 'gripping' (verb, converb) [拿着] · also a- — to be, stay (Ming 住着) with -d- (plural-subject mark, uncertain) and -qun, imperative second person plural, 'you (all) stay' (verb, imperative) [住着]
glossary.nisčü: nis- — to fly; converb -čü, 'flying' (verb, converb after s; Ming 飛) [飛着]
glossary.γar: γar — hand (noun; Ming 手) [手] · also the foreleg of an animal (Ming 前腳 'front leg')
glossary.tuγ̇uba: tuγ̇u- — to fall, alight (stem inferred; Ming 落); past -ba, 'fell, alighted' (verb, past tense) [落了]
glossary.ni-jen: -(n)i + -jen — accusative -(n)i followed by reflexive-possessive -(i)jen, as in žeġüdün-(n)i-jen, 'one's own dream' as object (case + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form; Ming 夢 自的行) [夢 自的行]
glossary.küġün-e: küġün — person, man (not köġün 'son'); dative -e, 'to a man, to someone' (noun + case; Ming 人行) [人行]
glossary.sara-ji: sara — moon; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'the moon' as object (noun + case; Ming 月行) [月行]
glossary.üžegden: üžeg- — to see, be seen (form uncertain); -den, passive participle or converb (uncertain); Ming 見 [見]
glossary.adqužu: adqu- — to grip, seize (Ming 拿); converb -žu, 'gripping' (verb, converb) [拿着]
glossary.γar-tur: γar — hand; dative-locative -tur, 'in the hand' (noun + case; Ming 手 + 裏) [手 裏]
glossary.baγ̇uba: baγ̇u- — to descend, come down (Ming 下); past -ba, 'came down' (verb, past tense) [下了] · also of a town 'took' (Ming 下了, as in Chinese 'bring a city down'); 'camped before it' is also possible (uncertain)
glossary.ambar: ambar — what, something (Ming 甚麽; sense uncertain; the word is not known elsewhere, and 'what' is the Ming's reading) [甚麽] · also 'how' (Ming 怎生) · also 'how' (Ming 怎), paired with ker in ker kigdelüġei … ambar bolγaγdaluγ̇ai, 'how … how …' [怎]
glossary.sai: sai — good, fine (adjective; Ming 好) [好] · also 'just now, only now' (Ming 恰纔, read against the usual sai 'good'), in aqa deġü-dür sai ižilidülčen büküi-dür, 'when brother and brother are only just growing used to each other'
glossary.üže: üže- — to see; the bare stem, written apart from its ending ġülümü (verb; Ming 見) [見]
glossary.ġülümü: -ġülümü — causative ending, 'let, make' (Ming 敎; form uncertain; written apart from üže-, so 'makes see, shows') [敎]
glossary.köġü-beġen: köġün — son; reflexive-possessive -beġen, 'one's own son' (noun + reflexive-possessive; the n of the stem drops before the ending; Ming 兒子(自的)行) [兒子 (自的)行]
glossary.irekü-je: ire- — to come; participle -kü + accusative -je, 'the one coming' as object (verb, participle + case; Ming 來的行) [來的 行]
glossary.üžegsen: üžeg- — to see, be shown (Ming 見); past participle -sen, 'seen, shown' (verb, past participle) [見了] · also read üže- 'see' + the past participle -gsen (the segmentation of §§80–86), 'seen' (Ming 見的)
glossary.kijad: Kijad — Kiyad, a clan (clan name; Ming 人氏 'of the clan'; apparently the plural of the published Kiyan) [人氏]
glossary.sülder: sülder — omen, sign, good fortune (noun; Ming 吉兆) [吉兆]
glossary.žaγ̇aγaγsan: žaγ̇a- — to tell, announce (Ming 吿); verb ending -γaγ- (causative or intensive; uncertain) + past participle -γsan, 'told, announced' (verb, participle) [吿了]
glossary.oṅgirad: Oṅgirad — the Ongirad, a people (proper name; Ming 人氏) [(人氏)]
glossary.erte: erte — early, in former times (adjective, adverb) [自在] · also 'beforehand, earlier' (Ming 在前) · also 'early' (Ming 早), as in manaγar erte, 'tomorrow early'
glossary.üdür-eče: üdür — day; ablative -eče, 'from the day, since the days of' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [前日子]
glossary.žeġe-jin: žeġe — sister's son, nephew; genitive -jin, 'of the nephew' (noun + case, -jin after a vowel) [外甥 的]
glossary.ökin-ü: ökin — girl, daughter; genitive -ü, 'of the daughter' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [女的]
glossary.öṅgeten: önge — colour, look; -ten, 'those having' (noun + plural possessive, front-vowel form; 'those having colour', uncertain) [顏色有的每]
glossary.ulus: ulus — realm, nation, people (noun) [國] · also (Ming 百姓 'the common people') 'people, subjects'
glossary.temečed: temeče- — to contend, struggle; converb -d, 'contending' (verb, converb) [爭]
glossary.ökid-i: ökin — girl; plural -d + accusative -i, 'the girls (object)' (noun + plural + case) [女子(每)行]
glossary.boluγsan-a: bol- — to become; past participle -γsan + dative-locative -a, 'on having become, when' (verb, participle + case) [做了(時)]
glossary.tergen-dür: tergen — cart; dative-locative -dür, 'in the cart' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [車裏]
glossary.unuγ̇ulžu: unu- — to ride, sit in; causative -γ̇ul-, converb -žu, 'making ride, seating' (verb, causative converb) [敎坐着] · also 'making mount' (Ming 敎騎着, 敎上着)
glossary.buγ̇ura: buγ̇ura — camel, stud camel (noun) [駱駝] · also Buγ̇ura, a place name, Buqura (Ming 地名 'place name')
glossary.kölgežü: kölge- — to yoke, harness; converb -žü, 'harnessing' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [駕着]
glossary.qataraγ̇ulžu: qatara- — to urge on, gallop; causative -γ̇ul-, converb -žu, 'making … gallop' (verb, causative converb; the Ming 點 'prod' is uncertain) [點着]
glossary.qatun: qatun — lady, queen, wife of a khan (noun) [娘子]
glossary.saγ̇urin-dur: saγ̇urin — seat, place; dative-locative -dur, 'in the seat' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [位裏]
glossary.saγ̇ulumu: saγ̇u- — to sit; causative -l-, finite present -umu, 'seats, makes sit' (verb, causative, present) [敎坐有來]
glossary.said: sain — good, fine (adjective; written sayid, the ending -d uncertain) [好]
glossary.ökidi: ökin — girl, daughter; plural -d, accusative (i), 'the daughters (object)', before the reflexive -jen that follows as the token jen (noun + plural + case; the (i) is Shiratori's) [女兒每(自的)行]
glossary.ösgežü: ösge- — to grow, bring up (stem inferred); converb -žü, 'bringing up' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [長着]
glossary.ölžigetei: ölžige — front-board of a cart; possessive -tei, 'having a front-board' (noun + possessive; the word of the pilot and §63) [車前有的]
glossary.öle: öle — dark blue-black (adjective or colour word) [黑靑]
glossary.öreġeleġeted: öreġeleġe- — to place side by side (stem uncertain); converb -d, 'placing side by side' (verb, converb) [邊傍]
glossary.saγ̇ulqui: saγ̇u- — to sit; causative -l-, participle -qui, 'the one who seats, seating' (verb, causative participle) [敎坐的]
glossary.erten-eče: erten — early, former time; ablative -eče, 'from the former time' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [自在前]
glossary.qalqatan: qalqa — shield; -tan, 'those having shields' (noun + plural possessive, back-vowel form) [團牌(有的)每]
glossary.öčilten: öčil — petition, report (Ming 奏事; stem uncertain); -ten, 'those having petitions' (noun + plural possessive, front-vowel form) [奏事的(每)]
glossary.man-u: man-u — our, of us (ba, genitive stem man- + -u, the possessor stands before or after its noun) [俺的]
glossary.qaraju: qara- — to look at, watch; finite present -ju, 'looks' (verb, present) [看有]
glossary.užegdejü: üže- — to see; passive -gde-, finite present -jü, 'is seen' (verb, passive, present) [看有]
glossary.ger-tür: ger — tent, home; dative-locative -tür, 'to the home' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [家 裏]
glossary.oduja: od- — to go; hortative -uja, 'let us go' (verb, hortative) [去來]
glossary.üžetügei: üže- — to see; optative -tügei, 'let him see, do see' (verb, optative) [看]
glossary.baγ̇ulba: baγ̇ul- — to dismount, alight (stem uncertain); past -ba, 'dismounted' (verb, past tense) [下馬了] · also 'to strip, remove (from command)' (Ming 削了 'pare away'; uncertain)
glossary.üžebesü: üže- — to see; conditional -besü, 'if one sees, when seen' (verb, conditional) [看呵]
glossary.geretei: gere — light, brightness; possessive -tei, 'having light' (noun + possessive) [光 有(的)]
glossary.γaltai: γal — fire; possessive -tai, 'having fire' (noun + possessive, back-vowel form) [(火)有(的)]
glossary.ökin-i: ökin — girl, daughter; accusative -i, 'the girl (object)' (noun + case) [女子行]
glossary.oin-duri: oin — mind, thought; dative-locative -dur, 'in the mind' (noun + case; the (i) is Shiratori's and belongs to the reflexive -(i)jan that follows as the token jan; Ming 心意 + 自的行) [心意 自的行]
glossary.oroγ̇ulba: oro- — to enter; causative -γ̇ul-, past -ba, 'made enter, brought in' (verb, causative, past) [敎入了]
glossary.neče: -(n)eče — ablative: than, from (front-vowel form; the token left after Temüžin-(n)eče, where the (n) is Shiratori's; Ming 處) (case suffix) [(兒名)處]
glossary.harbantai: harban — ten; possessive -tai, 'ten-having, ten years old' (numeral + possessive) [十歲(有的)]
