glossary.bosuγ̇ad: bos- — to rise; converb -uγ̇ad, 'having risen' (verb, converb; linking vowel + -γ̇ad) [起了]
glossary.ebür-türi: ebür — lap, bosom; dative-locative -tür with the bracketed i of -(i)jen, 'in (one's own) lap' (noun + case; the token left before -jen) [懷裏 自的行]
glossary.deġürbe: deġür- — to carry, load; past -be, 'loaded, carried' (verb, past tense) [駄了]
glossary.žasaba: žasa- — to prepare, set in order; past -ba, 'prepared' (verb, past tense) [整治了]
glossary.börte-üžin-e: Börte-Üžin — Börte-Üjin; dative-locative -e, 'to Börte-Üjin' (name + case, front-vowel form) [婦人名行]
glossary.dutaba: duta- — to be lacking, fall short; past -ba, 'was lacking' (verb, past tense) [闕了]
glossary.burqan: Burqan — Burqan, the holy mountain (mountain name) [山名] · also Burqan, a man's name (Ming 人名)
glossary.žüg: žüg — direction, side, place; after a name, 'toward' (noun used as a postposition) [處] · also žüg, 'each' (repeated: 'each each') (Ming 各 'each'), in the entrusting of the posts
glossary.niγ̇usu: niγu- — to hide (stem inferred from the Ming 要藏 'want to hide'); -su, probably the optative 'let me ...' (as in ögsü), so with keġen 'intending to hide' (verb; analysis uncertain) [要藏]
glossary.alaγ: alaγ — mottled, dappled, piebald (adjective) [花] · also Alaγ, a man's name, Alaq, one of Shirgügetü's sons (Ming 人名)
glossary.kölžü: köl- — to yoke, to harness (stem inferred from the Ming 駕着); converb -žü, 'harnessing' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [駕着]
glossary.teṅgeli: Teṅgeli — a river name (the Ming marks 河名); the same Han letters write teṅgeli, the cart's axle (Ming 車軸), so name and noun are not told apart by the letters (name or noun, uncertain) [河名]
glossary.ködölžü: ködöl- — to move, to set in motion (stem inferred from the Ming 動着); converb -žü, 'moving' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [動着]
glossary.horubaru-da: horubaru — half-dark, the dim time before day (Ming 尙昏時 'still dark'); dative-locative -da, 'in the half-dark' (noun + case) [尙昏時 行]
glossary.esergünēče: esergü — facing, against, to meet; ablative -ēče, 'from the front, from the opposite side' (adverb + case, long vowel) [迎自]
glossary.hergižü: hergi- — to circle, to wheel round (stem inferred from the Ming 旋着); converb -žü, 'circling' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [旋着]
glossary.temüžin-ü-ġei: Temüžin — Temüjin; genitive -ü + -ġei, 'one belonging to Temüjin' (name + case + suffix; the -ġei is uncertain, the Ming 的 only marks possession) [人名 的]
glossary.kirγara: kirγa- — to shear, to clip (stem inferred from the Ming 剃); ending -ra, 'in order to' (verb; analysis uncertain) [剃]
glossary.aiši: ai- — to come (compare aisu-, aisun); ending -ši, 'am coming, is coming' (verb, present; analysis uncertain, resting on the Ming 有) [來有] · also (uncertain) an imperative, 'come!', read from the bare Ming 來; the ending -ši cannot be decided from the Ming
glossary.bijü-ü: bü- — to be; present bijü, 'there is' + question particle -ü (Ming 麽) (verb + particle) [有麽]
glossary.kežige: kežige — how far, to what distance (Ming 幾遠; form uncertain) (adverb) [幾遠]
glossary.uqabi: uqa- — to know, to understand; past -bi, 'knew, understood' (verb, past tense; -bi a variant of -ba) [省]
glossary.irebi: ire- — to come; past -bi, 'came' (verb, past tense; -bi a variant of -ba) [來了]
glossary.čeriġüd: čerig — soldier; plural -d, 'soldiers' (noun + plural; the vowel is Shiratori's linking -ü-) [軍每]
glossary.qataraba: qatara- — to urge on, to gallop (Ming 點着去 'prod and go'; uncertain); past -ba, 'rode on' (verb, past tense) [點着去了]
glossary.hükeri: hüker — ox; the (i) is Shiratori's accusative-looking vowel before the reflexive -(i)jen, 'one's own ox' (noun; the token left before jen) [牛 自的行]
glossary.neġükü: neġü- — to move, to set off, to start; participle -kü, 'that sets off' (verb, participle) [起行]
glossary.quγus: quγu- — to break (stem uncertain; Ming 折 'snap'); ending -s, 'broke' (verb; the ending is uncertain) [折]
glossary.teṅgeli-ben: teṅgeli — cart-axle (Ming 車軸); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own axle' (noun + reflexive-possessive; the same letters write the river name elsewhere) [車軸 自的行]
glossary.quγuraγdažu: quγura- — to break (stem uncertain); passive -γda-, converb -žu, 'being broken' (verb, passive converb) [被折着]
glossary.jabuγadi: jabu- — to walk, to go on foot; converb -γad, 'having walked' with Shiratori's (i) before the token jar (verb, converb; the whole jabuγad(i)-jar is glossed 步行着 'on foot') [步行着]
glossary.oroja: oro- — to enter; hortative -ja, 'let us enter' (verb, first person plural) [入咱]
glossary.keġeldün: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü-, converb -n, 'saying to one another' (verb, converb) [相說]
glossary.daruča: daruča — at once, immediately, thereupon (Ming 隨卽) (adverb; form uncertain) [隨卽]
glossary.müd: müd — they (third-person plural; Ming 他每) (pronoun; the exact form is uncertain) [他每]
glossary.eke-ji: eke — mother; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'mother (object)' (noun + case) [母 行]
glossary.sundulaγ̇uldužu: sundula- — to lay across, to double up (stem uncertain; Ming 疊騎 'ride doubled'); causative -γ̇ul-, reciprocal-looking -du-, converb -žu, 'making ride doubled up' (verb, causative converb; the -du- is uncertain) [敎疊騎着]
glossary.köd: köl — foot, leg; plural köd, 'feet, legs' (noun + plural) [腳(每)]
glossary.čerbegelžeġülžü: čerbegel- — to hang down, to dangle (stem uncertain; Ming 垂着); with -že- (uncertain), causative -ġül-, converb -žü, 'letting dangle' (verb, causative converb) [垂着]
glossary.ireġed: ire- — to come; converb -ġed, 'having come' (verb, converb, perfective) [來了]
glossary.teġežü: teġe- — to load, to carry on a cart; converb -žü, 'loading' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [載着]
glossary.amu: a- — to be; amu 'is' (verb, present; cf. amui) [有] · also amu- 'to rest' (Ming 歇息), the stem alone with its optative ending on the next word (amu- suγai, 'may I rest')
glossary.čeriġüd-ün: čerig — soldier; plural -d + genitive -ün, 'of the soldiers' (noun + plural + case) [軍 每(的)]
glossary.üžedkün: üže- — to see, to look; ending -dkün, 'look!' (verb, imperative plural; analysis uncertain) [看]
glossary.qaγ̇alγatai: qaγ̇alγa — gate, door; -tai 'having', 'gated, with a gate' (noun + possessive; the Ming puts 門有的 in brackets) [(門有的)]
glossary.qatud-že: qatun — lady, queen; plural -d + particle že, 'indeed' (noun + plural + particle; Ming 也者 'so') [娘子(每)(也者︀)]
glossary.ima-ji: ima — him, her (pronoun; the stem is uncertain); accusative -ji, 'him (object)' (pronoun + case) [將他] · also the Ming 敎他 'cause him' (so perhaps 'make him …'; the stem ima is unclear)
glossary.tergen-eče: tergen — cart; ablative -eče, 'from the cart' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [車自]
glossary.čirčü: čir- — to drag, to pull; converb -čü, 'dragging' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [拖着]
glossary.žirin-i: žirin — two (of persons; Ming 兩箇); accusative -i, 'the two (object)' (numeral + case) [兩箇行]
glossary.sundulaγ̇ulžu: sundula- — to lay across, to double up (stem uncertain; Ming 疊騎); causative -γ̇ul-, converb -žu, 'making ride doubled' (verb, causative converb) [疊騎着]
glossary.temüžin-ü: Temüžin — Temüjin; genitive -ü, 'Temüjin's' (name + case, front-vowel form) [人名 的]
glossary.ča: -ča — ablative: from (short form of -ača; the token left after qoina- over a line break, 'from behind') [自]
glossary.qučiγ̇ulžu: qučiγ- — to circle, to go round (stem inferred from the Ming 繞着); causative -γ̇ul-, converb -žu, 'making go round, circling' (verb, causative converb) [繞着]
glossary.erüsün: erü- — to obtain, to get (stem inferred from the Ming 得); ending -sün (uncertain), here perhaps 'getting' (verb; analysis uncertain) [得] · also 'to seize, take by force' (Ming 奪), as in ami erüsün 'seize the life' (uncertain)
glossary.bulžiγ̇asu: bulžiγ- — to dodge, to slip away, to wriggle (Ming 躱閃); conditional -γ̇asu, 'if one dodges' (Ming 呵) (verb, conditional) [躱閃呵]
glossary.umubu: umu- — to sink, to be mired (stem inferred from the Ming 陷); ending -bu, 'sank' (verb, past; -bu a variant of -ba, uncertain) [陷]
glossary.čadqulaṅ: čadqulaṅ — dense, thick (the Ming 飽 'sated', 'full'; form uncertain) (adjective) [飽]
glossary.širγuγ̇asu: širγu- — to wriggle, to bore through (Ming 鑽); conditional -γ̇asu, 'if one wriggles' (Ming 呵) (verb, conditional) [鑽呵]
glossary.jadažuγ̇ui: jada- — to lack, to be unable (Ming 不能了); ending -žuγ̇ui, 'could not' (verb, past; -žuγ̇u with a final -i, uncertain) [不能了]
glossary.merkid: Merkid — the Merkid, a people (the -d is probably a plural) (people name) [種名]
glossary.uduid-merkid-ün: Uduid-Merkid — the Uduid Merkid, the Uduid clan of the Merkid (Ming 姓氏 'clan name'); genitive -ün, 'of the Uduid Merkid' (clan name + case) [姓氏 種名 的]
glossary.toγtoγ̇a: Toγtoγ̇a — Toqto'a, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.uwas-merkid-ün: Uwas-Merkid — the Uwas Merkid, the Uwas clan of the Merkid; genitive -ün, 'of the Uwas Merkid' (clan name + case) [姓氏 種名 的]
glossary.dair-usun: Dair-Usun — Dair-Usun, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.qaγ̇ad-merkid-ün: Qaγ̇ad-Merkid — the Qa'at Merkid, the Qa'at clan of the Merkid; genitive -ün, 'of the Qa'at Merkid' (clan name + case) [姓氏 種名 的]
glossary.qaγ̇atai-darmala: Qaγ̇atai-Darmala — Qa'atai-Darmala, a man's name (personal name, one two-part name) [人名]
glossary.erten-ü: erten — former time, long ago; genitive -ü, 'of former times, former' (noun + case) [在先的]
glossary.čiledü-dāča: Čiledü — Chiledü, a man's name; ablative -dāča, 'from Chiledü' (name + case; long vowel, uncertain) [人名 自]
glossary.abtalaγ̇ai: ab- — to take; passive -da- (written -ta-) + ending -laγ̇ai (uncertain), 'was taken' (verb, passive; the Ming 被要子 is the only evidence) [被要子]
glossary.ösen: ösü- — to repay, to avenge (stem uncertain; Ming 報); ending -n (converb or participle, uncertain) (verb) [報] · also read with the stem as printed, öse- (not ösü-), 'to repay' (Ming 報), ending -n, converb or participle (uncertain); it runs parallel to hači-jan aburan · also with the Ming 讐 'enmity' against hačiran 報 'repay' (teġün-i ösen hačiran, together 讐報 'repaying enmity'); the stem is öse- as printed, and here the word may lean toward the noun ösül 'enmity' (uncertain)
glossary.iregsed: ire- — to come; participle -gsed, 'those who have come' (verb, past participle, plural) [來了]
glossary.emes-i: eme — woman; plural -s + accusative -i, 'the women (object)' (noun + plural + case) [婦人每(行)]
glossary.hači-jan: hači — enmity, vengeance, a feud; reflexive-possessive -(i)jan, 'one's own feud' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [讐 自的行]
glossary.aburaba: abura- — to repay, to requite (Ming 報); past -ba, 'repaid' (verb, past tense) [報了]
glossary.keġel: keġe- — to say; -l- is the first half of the reciprocal -ldu-, split from dužu across a line break (token keġel-) (verb stem + extension) [共說]
glossary.dužu: -dužu — the second half of the reciprocal -ldu- + converb -žu, split from keġel- across a line break; together keġeldužu, 'saying to one another' (extension + converb) [着] · also split from saγ̇al- (the stem saγa- + -l-), together saγ̇al-dužu, 'milking together'
glossary.nača: -(n)ača — ablative: from (back-vowel form; the token left after Burqan-Qaldun-(n)-, 'from Burqan Qaldun') [山名 自] · also after Qaγan-(n)-, 'from the Qaγan' (ablative; the (n) is Shiratori's; the Ming 皇帝 行 writes 行, not 處) · also after Waṅ-Qān-(n)-, 'from Wang Qan' (Ming 處 'at the place of') · also after Qān-(n)- 'from the Qan' and Gür-Qān-(n)- 'from Gür-Qan' (ablative; Ming 處) [人名皇帝 處] · also after hodun-(n)-, comparative 'than' (ablative; Hodun-(n)ača olon γaltan, 'more fire-owners than the stars'; the Ming 星 行 marks the noun and does not gloss the ending) · also after Naiman-(n)-, 'from the Naiman' (ablative; Ming 種名 處) · also after marijan-(n)-, 'from the skin' (ablative; Ming 皮膚 行)
glossary.geid-türi: geid — homes (plural of ger); dative-locative -tür, 'to the homes'; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token before the reflexive -(i)jen (noun + case) [家裏每 自的行]
glossary.maγad: maγad — truly, really, firmly (Ming 實) (adverb) [實] · also with Ming 眞實 ('truly, really')
glossary.ažiraba: ažira- — to turn back, to go back (stem uncertain; Ming 囘去); past -ba, 'went back' (verb, past tense) [囘去了]
glossary.ažiraba-ju: ažira- — to turn back; past -ba + -ju (Ming 有 'is'; analysis uncertain) (verb, past + ending) [囘了 有]
glossary.büġčü-ü: büġ- — to lie hidden, to lie in ambush (stem inferred from the Ming 伏); -čü (converb or past, uncertain) + question particle -ü (Ming 麽) (verb + particle) [伏了]
glossary.amui: a- — to be; present -mui, 'is, there is' (verb, present tense) [有] · also Amui, a river's name (Ming 河名), in Amui müren (not the verb 'is')
glossary.uqaγ̇uta: uqa- — to know, to find out; uqaγ̇uta, 'to scout, to find out' (Ming 察探; ending uncertain) (verb) [察探]
glossary.daγaγ̇ulžu: daγa- — to follow; causative -γ̇ul-, converb -žu, 'making follow, having them follow' (verb, causative converb) [隨着]
glossary.merkid-i: Merkid — the Merkid, a people; accusative -i, 'the Merkid (object)' (people name + case) [種名(行)]
glossary.küṅgeġülžü: küṅge- — to be far (stem inferred from the Ming 離遠); causative -ġül-, converb -žü, 'keeping far off' (verb, causative converb) [離遠着]
glossary.ečeġü-ben: ečeġü — breast, front of the chest (Ming 胸前); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own breast' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [胸前 自的行]
glossary.möġeledčü: möġele- — to beat, to strike (stem inferred from the Ming 椎); converb -dčü, 'beating' (verb, converb; the d is unexplained) [椎着]
glossary.solanγa: solanγa — weasel (Ming 黃鼠狼 'yellow weasel') (noun) [黃鼠狼]
glossary.sonosqu-jin: sonos- — to hear, to listen; participle -qu + genitive -jin, 'of the hearing, of what is heard' (verb, participle + case) [聽 的]
glossary.ünen: ünen — ermine (Ming 銀鼠 'silver mouse') (noun) [銀鼠] · also 'truth, true' (adjective or noun; Ming 實 'real'), not the 'ermine' of other passages · also 'true, sincere' (Ming 眞誠)
glossary.üžekü-jin: üže- — to see; participle -kü + genitive -jin, 'of the seeing, of what is seen' (verb, participle + case) [見 的]
glossary.büdün: büdün — whole, entire, thick-bodied (Ming 本; sense uncertain) (adjective) [本]
glossary.beje-ġen: beje — body, person; reflexive-possessive -ġen, 'one's own body' (noun + reflexive-possessive, after a vowel stem) [身 自(的)行]
glossary.buruγ̇udun: buruγ̇u- — to hide, to slip away (stem inferred from the Ming 躱); ending -dun (converb, uncertain) (verb) [躱着]
glossary.bugija: bugija — hobble, a rope tying the horse's feet (Ming 韁繩絆蹄) (noun) [韁繩絆蹄]
glossary.buγu-jin: buγu — deer; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the deer' (noun + case) [鹿 的]
glossary.horimlažu: horim — path; -la- makes a verb, converb -žu, 'following the path' (noun-derived verb, converb) [徑依着]
glossary.burγasun: burγasun — elm switches, withes (Ming 楡條) (noun) [楡條]
glossary.gerlen: ger — tent, hut; -le- makes a verb, converb -n, 'making a hut' (noun-derived verb, converb) [做着]
glossary.γarulaγ̇a: γar- — to go out, to go up; linking vowel + -laγ̇a, 'went up' (verb, past narrative; ending uncertain) [上去來]
glossary.burqan-qaldun-a: Burqan-Qaldun — the holy mountain of the Mongols; dative-locative -a, 'at, to', here marking the one who acts in a passive sentence (name + case; the Ming 納 is the case mark) [山名 納]
glossary.böġesün-ü: böġesün — louse (Ming 虱子); genitive -ü, 'of a louse' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [虱子 的]
glossary.bolžiγ̇uldaba: bolžiγ- — to dodge, to slip away (stem uncertain); causative -γ̇ul-, passive -da-, past -ba, 'was made to slip away, was spared' (verb, causative passive past) [被躱閃過了]
glossary.γaγčaqan: γaγča — single, only, alone; ending -qan (Ming 自 'by oneself'; uncertain), 'alone' (adjective + ending) [獨自]
glossary.qairalan: qaira- — to cherish, to spare (stem uncertain; Ming 愛惜); -la- verb-maker, converb -n, 'sparing' (verb, converb) [愛惜]
glossary.qadaγai-jin: qadaγai — an animal's name (Ming 獸名; not identified); genitive -jin after a vowel (noun + case) [獸名 的]
glossary.qalγasun: qalγasun — split-open willow twigs (Ming 破開柳條的) (noun; analysis uncertain) [破開柳條的]
glossary.qaldun: Qaldun — Qaldun, the holy mountain (short name for Burqan-Qaldun) [山名]
glossary.qaldun-burqan-a: Qaldun-Burqan — the same holy mountain with the two names in the other order; dative-locative -a, 'at, to' (name + case) [山名 行]
glossary.qarča-jin: qarča — an ant? (the Ming has only (蟻的) in brackets, 'of an ant'; uncertain); genitive -jin after a vowel (noun + case) [(蟻的)]
glossary.qalqalaγdaba: qalqala- — to shield, to protect (Ming 遮護); passive -γda-, past -ba, 'was shielded' (verb, passive past) [被遮護 了]
glossary.ajuγ̇uldaba: aju- — to fear, to be afraid; causative -γ̇ul-, passive -da-, past -ba, 'was frightened' (verb, causative passive past) [被驚怕了]
glossary.burqan-qaldun-i: Burqan-Qaldun — the holy mountain of the Mongols; accusative -i, 'the mountain (object)' (name + case) [山名 行]
glossary.manaγar-büri: manaγar — morning; distributive -büri, 'every morning' (noun + distributive) [每早]
glossary.malijasuγai: maliya- — to sacrifice, to make an offering (stem inferred from the Ming 祭祀); optative -suγai, 'let me sacrifice, I will' (verb, optative, first person, back-vowel form) [祭祀]
glossary.öčisügei: öči- — to pray (stem inferred from the Ming 禱告); optative -sügei, 'let me pray, I will' (verb, optative, first person, front-vowel form) [禱吿]
glossary.uruγ-un: uruγ — offspring, descendants, lineage; genitive -un, 'of the lineage' (noun + case; Ming 子子) [子子]
glossary.uqatuγai: uqa- — to know, to understand; optative -tuγai, 'let it be known, let him know' (verb, optative, third person) [省着]
glossary.büse-ben: büse — belt, girdle; reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own belt' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [帶 自的行]
glossary.güžüġün-düri: güžüġün — neck; dative-locative -dür, 'at the neck'; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token before the reflexive -(i)jen (noun + case) [項 自的行]
glossary.erigeležü: erigele- — to hang (stem inferred from the Ming 掛着); converb -žü, 'hanging' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [掛着]
glossary.maqalai-ban: maqalai — cap, hat (Ming 帽子); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own hat' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [帽子 自的行]
glossary.seġežigeležü: seġežigele- — to hang (stem inferred from the Ming 掛着); converb -žü, 'hanging' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [掛着]
glossary.γari: γar — hand; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token left before the reflexive -(i)jan, 'one's own hand' (noun) [手 自的行] · also before the instrumental -jar: γar(i)-jar, 'with the hand' (Ming 手用; the (i) is Shiratori's)
glossary.ebčeġün-düri: ebčeġün — chest, breast; dative-locative -dür, 'at the chest'; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token before the reflexive -(i)jen (noun + case) [胸 自的行]
glossary.jesünte: jesün — nine; dative-locative -te, 'nine times' (numeral + case, front-vowel form; Ming 遍 'times') [九遍]
glossary.sögödčü: sögö- — to kneel (stem inferred from the Ming 跪); converb -dčü, 'kneeling' (verb, converb; the d is unexplained) [跪着]
glossary.sačuli: sačuli — libation, a sprinkled offering (Ming 灑奠; form uncertain) (noun) [灑奠]
glossary.öčiġüli: öčiġüli — prayer, invocation (Ming 禱祝; form uncertain) (noun) [禱祝︀]
glossary.keleležü: kele- — to speak, to say; -le- verb-maker, converb -žü, 'speaking' (verb, converb) [說着]
glossary.kereid-ün: Kereid — the Kereid, a people (the -d is probably a plural); genitive -ün, 'of the Kereid' (people name + case) [種名 的]
glossary.toγ̇oril: Toγ̇oril — To'oril, a man's name (personal name) [人名]

glossary.tuγ̇ula: Tuγ̇ula — the Tuγ̇ula river (river name) [河名]
glossary.merkid-te: Merkid — the Merkid, a people; dative-locative -te, 'to the Merkid' (people name + case, front-vowel form) [種名 行] · also (uncertain) marking the agent, 'by the Merkid'

glossary.büküi-dur: bü- — to be; participle -küi + dative-locative -dur, 'at the being, while being' (verb, participle + case, back-vowel form; Ming 有的 時分) [有的 時分]
glossary.aburažu: abura- — to rescue, to save (Ming 救; elsewhere 'repay'); converb -žu, 'saving' (verb, converb) [救着]
glossary.ögtügei: ög- — to give; optative -tügei, 'let him give, let it be given' (verb, optative, third person, front-vowel form) [與者︀]
glossary.üge-jin: üge — word, speech; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the word' (noun + case) [言語的]
glossary.nidoni: nidoni — last year (Ming 去年) (adverb) [去年]
glossary.ügüleleġe: ügüle- — to speak, to say; past -leġe, 'had said' (verb, past; Ming 來 + 麽 'did he say?' in a question) [說來麽] · also with the Ming 說來 and no 麽, 'had said' (not a question)
glossary.abčirarun: abčira- — to bring; converb of time -run, 'when bringing' (verb, converb) [將來時]
glossary.čaγ-un: čaγ — time; genitive -un, 'of the time, in the time' (noun + case) [時裏]
glossary.emüšgegdeġesü: emüs- — to wear, to put on (stem inferred from the Ming 穿); passive -gde-, conditional -ġesü, 'if it is worn' (Ming 呵) (verb, passive conditional) [被穿了呵]
glossary.bügüdgeldüžü: bügüd- — to gather (stem uncertain; Ming 收集); reciprocal -ldü- (the g between stem and ending is unexplained), converb -žü, 'gathering together' (verb, converb; the middle ending is uncertain) [相收集着]

glossary.čegerei-jin: čegerei — chest cavity (Ming 腔子); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the chest' (noun + case) [腔子 的]
glossary.bökörei: bökörei — kidney, loin (Ming 腰子); the token left before the genitive -jin in bököre(i)-jin (noun) [腰子 的]

glossary.bögše-dür: bögše — tip, point, end (Ming 尖兒); dative-locative -dür, 'at the tip' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [尖兒 裏]
glossary.keġeleġe: keġe- — to say; past -leġe, 'had said' (verb, past) [說來]
glossary.üge-düri: üge — word, speech; dative-locative -dür, 'in the word'; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token before the reflexive -(i)jen (noun + case) [言語 自的行]
glossary.kürün: kür- — to reach, to arrive; converb -n, 'arriving' (verb, converb) [到]
glossary.bügüde: bügüde — all, altogether (Ming 都) (adverb, quantifier) [都︀]
glossary.büreltele: bürel- — to be destroyed, to perish (stem inferred from the Ming 毀滅); -tele, 'until' (verb + postposition; 'until destruction') [直至毀滅]
glossary.qaltačižu: qaltači- — to break, to smash (stem inferred from the Ming 破); converb -žu, 'breaking' (verb, converb) [破着]
glossary.börte-ji: Börte — Börte (short for Börte-Üjin), a woman's name; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Börte (object)' (name + case) [婦人名 行]
glossary.qariγ̇ulžu: qari- — to turn back, to return; causative -γ̇ul-, converb -žu, 'sending back' (verb, causative converb) [囘着]
glossary.abčiraja: abčira- — to bring; hortative -ja, 'let us bring' (verb, first person plural) [將來]
glossary.deġü-de: deġü — younger brother; dative-locative -de, 'to the younger brother' (noun + case) [弟 行]
glossary.kelen: kelen — word, speech, language (noun) [言語] · also 'word, speech' (Ming 話)
glossary.qorqonaγ-žubur-a: Qorqonaγ-Žubur — Qorqonaq-Jubur, a place name; dative-locative -a, 'at, in' (name + case; Ming 地名) [地名(裏)]
glossary.endēče: ene — this; ablative -ēče, 'from here' (pronoun + case, long vowel; endē is the adverb 'here') [這裏(自)]
glossary.tümed: tümen — ten thousand, a tümen; plural -d, 'tümens' (numeral noun + plural) [萬每]
glossary.morilasu: mori — horse (morin); -la- makes a verb, optative -su, 'let me mount, I will mount' (noun-derived verb, optative, first person) [上馬]
glossary.žeġün: žeġün — left (hand or side; Ming 左) (adjective) [左] · also a man's name, Jegün (personal name; Ming 人名)
glossary.morilatuγai: mori — horse (morin); -la- makes a verb, optative -tuγai, 'let him mount' (noun-derived verb, optative, third person) [敎(上)馬]
glossary.bolžaγ̇an: bolža- — to appoint, to agree on a meeting (stem inferred; Ming 約會); ending -γ̇an (uncertain), 'appointment' (verb or noun) [約會]
glossary.žamuqa-dāča: Žamuqa — Jamuqa, a man's name; ablative -dāča, 'from Jamuqa' (name + case; long vowel, uncertain) [人名 處]
glossary.žamuqa-dur: Žamuqa — Jamuqa, a man's name; dative-locative -dur, 'to Jamuqa' (personal name + case, back-vowel form) [人名 行]
glossary.anda-da: anda — sworn brother, pledged friend; dative-locative -da, 'to the sworn brother' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [契合 行]
glossary.oro-ban: oro — place, seat, position (Ming 位; the same spelling as oro 'hollow of the chest'); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own place' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [位(自的行)]
glossary.bolγaγdaγ̇a: bol- — to become; causative -γa- + passive -γda- + past -γ̇a, 'was made into' (verb, causative passive past; the -γ̇a is uncertain) [被做了]
glossary.onor: onor — nock, the notch of an arrow (so read from onolaba; the Ming 扣子 is 'button, fastening') (noun) [(扣子)]
glossary.nigenten: nigen — one; -ten, a collective plural, 'those of one ...' (numeral + plural ending; compare -tan in Žaqaγambu-tan; uncertain) [一箇的(每)]
glossary.busutu: busutu — 'is it not so?' (rhetorical-question form; analysis uncertain, perhaps busu 'not, other' + -tu 'having') [不是有的麽]
glossary.ösüli: ösül — enmity, grievance to be repaid (noun; Ming 讐 'enmity'); the (i) before the reflexive is Shiratori's [讐 自的(行)]
glossary.ösekün: öse- — to repay (stem as printed in ösekün and ösen, so öse- rather than ösü-; Ming 報); participle -kün, 'how to repay' (verb, participle; uncertain, compare hačilaqun) [報]
glossary.ebüri: ebür — bosom, lap (noun; Ming 懷); the (i) before the reflexive is Shiratori's [懷 自的(行)] · also 'front, the near side' (Ming (前)行 in ebür(i)-jer), the same word
glossary.hemtüldeġe: hemtül- — to be halved (from hemte 'half'; Ming 被去了一半 'half taken away'); passive -de- (the form after l) + past -ġe, the front-vowel partner of -γ̇a in bolγaγdaγ̇a (verb, passive past; both endings uncertain) [被去了一半]
glossary.heligen-ü: helige — liver; stem-final -n- before the case, genitive -ü, 'of the liver' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [肝的]
glossary.hačilaqun: hači-la- — to requite, repay enmity (from hači 'enmity'); participle -qun, 'to repay' (verb, participle; uncertain) [報的]
glossary.ilegsen: ile- — to send; past participle -gsen, 'sent' (verb, participle) [去了的] · also ile- 'to send', past participle -gsen (Ming 敎來的)
glossary.ügülegsen: ügüle- — to speak, to say; past participle -gsen, 'spoken' (verb, participle) [說了的]
glossary.üges-i: üge — word, speech; plural -s + accusative -i, 'the words' as object (noun + plural + case) [言語每(行)]
glossary.žamuqa-da: Žamuqa — Jamuqa, a man's name; dative-locative -da, 'to Jamuqa' (personal name + case, back-vowel form) [人名 行] · also after a passive, naming the agent: 'by Jamuqa'
glossary.ečige-de: ečige — father; dative-locative -de, 'to the father' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [父 行]
glossary.kigdegsen-i: ki- — to do, to make; passive -gde- + past participle -gsen, 'what was done'; accusative -i (verb, passive participle + case; the passive leaves the doer open) [被做了的 行]
glossary.qamtudqu: qamtud- — to be together, to join (from qamtu 'together'; stem inferred; Ming 相合); participle -qu, 'joint' (verb, participle) [相合的]
glossary.deġü-dēče: deġü — younger brother; ablative -dēče, 'from the younger brother' (noun + case, front-vowel form, long vowel) [弟 自]
glossary.daġusugan: daġusu- — to finish, use up (stem inferred; Ming 敎盡 'cause to be finished'); causative -γa- (Ming 敎) + converb -n, 'having made an end' (verb, causative converb) [敎盡]
glossary.anda-ji: anda — sworn brother, pledged friend; accusative -ji after a vowel-final stem, 'the sworn brother' as object (noun + case) [契合 行]
glossary.öre: öre — heart, mind (noun) [心] · also 'aside, apart' (Ming 𠮠, sense uncertain), as in Žamuqa öre böldeidčü 'Jamuqa apart, alone'
glossary.ebedbe: ebed- — to hurt, to be sick; past -be, 'hurt' (verb, past) [痛了]
glossary.ebür: ebür — bosom, lap (noun; Ming 懷) [懷] · also 'front, the near side' (Ming 前), the same word, as in Burqan-Qaldun-u ebür
glossary.hemterebe: hemtere- — to be halved (from hemte 'half'; stem inferred; Ming 半了); past -be, 'became half' (verb, past) [半了]
glossary.helige: helige — liver (noun; Ming 肝), seat of kinship in the paired bosom and liver [肝]
glossary.uduid: Uduid — the Uduid, a Merkid clan (Ming 姓氏 'clan name') [姓氏]
glossary.uwas: Uwas — the Uwas, a Merkid clan (Ming 姓氏 'clan name') [姓氏]
glossary.ülüdkežü: ülüdke- — to destroy, wipe out (stem inferred; Ming 殘滅 'leave remnants and destroy'); converb -žü, 'destroying' (verb, converb) [殘滅着]
glossary.üžin-börte-jen: Üžin-Börte — Üjin-Börte, a woman's name (one two-part name); reflexive-possessive -jen, 'one's own Üjin-Börte' (personal name + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form) [婦人名]
glossary.aburaja: abura- — to save, to rescue (Ming 救; compare aburan, Ming 報, perhaps the same verb, uncertain); hortative -ja, 'let us save' (verb, hortative, first person plural) [救咱]
glossary.qaγ̇ad-merkid-i: Qaγ̇ad — the Qa'at, a Merkid clan (Ming 姓氏 'clan name'), with Merkid, the people; accusative -i, 'the Qa'at Merkid' as object (name + name + case; the compound is printed as one word, then split with the hyphen carried over) [姓氏 種名 行]
glossary.börte-jüġen: Börte — Börte, a woman's name; reflexive-possessive -jüġen, 'one's own Börte' (personal name + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form) [婦人名 自行的]
glossary.qariγ̇ulun: qari- — to turn back, return; causative -γ̇ul- + converb -un, 'making return, giving back' (verb, causative converb) [囘着]
glossary.gölme: gölme — saddle-cloth (Ming 鞍韂 'saddle and saddle-cloth') (noun) [鞍韂]
glossary.dabšiqui-dur: dabši- — to slap, to beat (stem inferred from the Ming 拍); participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'at the slapping, when slapped' (verb, participle + case, back-vowel form) [拍 時]
glossary.köġürge-jin: köġürge — drum; genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem (the j is Shiratori's glide), 'of the drum' (noun + case) [鼓的]
glossary.kökideg: köki- — to startle (stem inferred; Ming 輕驚動 'easily startled'); habitual participle -deg, 'one who is easily startled' (verb, participle; uncertain) [輕驚動的]
glossary.nuγ̇ura: Nuγ̇ura — Nu'ura, a place name (Ming 地名) [地名]
glossary.dabčitu: dabči — lid, cover (stem inferred; Ming 葢子 'lid'); possessive -tu, 'having a lid' (noun + possessive) [葢子有的]
glossary.qor: qor — quiver (noun; Ming 箭筒 'arrow case') [箭筒] · also qor, 'loss, damage' (Ming 折損 'to break, lose'), in olon-(n)ača olon … čüġen-(n)eče čüġen qor, 'from many many … loss'; the same spelling as qor 'quiver', taken as a different word · also 'harm, injury' (Ming 害)
glossary.darbalžaqui-dur: darbalža- — to shake, to rattle (stem inferred from the Ming 搖閃); participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'at the rattling, when rattled' (verb, participle + case, back-vowel form) [搖閃 時]
glossary.daižiγči: daiži- — to turn against, to rebel (stem inferred; Ming 反); agent noun -γči, 'one who turns against, rebel' (verb, agent noun) [反的]
glossary.orqon: Orqon — the Orqon, a river (Ming 水名) [水名]
glossary.seleṅge: Seleṅge — the Selenge, a river (Ming 水名) [水名]
glossary.talγun: Talγun — Talqun, a place name (Ming 地名) [地名]
glossary.aral-a: aral — island, river-islet (Ming (洲) 'islet'); dative-locative -a, 'on the islet' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [(洲)行]
glossary.qamqa: qamqa — a steppe plant, Ming 蓬 'fleabane, tumbleweed' (noun) [蓬]
glossary.keisküi-dür: keis- — to blow, of the wind (stem uncertain; Ming 風刮); participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'at the blowing, when it blows' (verb, participle + case, front-vowel form) [風刮 時]
glossary.temečegči: temeče- — to contend, to strive (stem inferred; Ming 爭); agent noun -gči, 'one who contends' (verb, agent noun) [爭的]
glossary.qaraži: Qaraži — Qaraji, a place name (Ming 地名) [地名]
glossary.dötelen: dötelen — straight on, directly (adverb; Ming 超直 'leaping straight'; analysis uncertain) [超直]
glossary.kilqo: Kilqo — the Kilqo, a river (Ming 河名) [河名]
glossary.kiṅgüs: kiṅgüs — across, crosswise (Ming 橫斷 'cutting across'; analysis uncertain) [橫斷]
glossary.saqal-bajan: Saqal-Bajan — Saqal-Bajan (Ming 猪鬃草 'boar-bristle grass'; saqal 'beard', bajan 'rich'; a place or a plant, uncertain) [猪︀鬃草]
glossary.sal: sal — raft (noun; Ming 筏子) [筏子]
glossary.toγtoγ̇a-jin: Toγtoγ̇a — Toqto'a, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem, 'of Toqto'a' (personal name + case) [人名 的]
glossary.erkin: erkin — essential, vital, principal (Ming 緊要的 'important') (adjective) [緊要的]
glossary.eġede: eġede — door, doorway, door-frame (noun; Ming here 帳房骨子 'tent-frame' and 門框 'door-frame'; the exact sense is uncertain) [帳房骨子]
glossary.embürü: embür- — to collapse, fall in (stem inferred; Ming 塌了); converb -ü, 'collapsing' (verb, converb; the ending is uncertain) [塌了]
glossary.ečültele: ečül- — to be finished, used up (stem inferred; Ming 盡絕); converb -tele, 'until ...' (verb, converb) [盡絕了]
glossary.qutuγ: qutuγ — fortune, blessing (Ming 福神的 'of the fortune-spirit') (noun) [福︀神︀的] · also 'blessing' with the Ming 神︀ ('spirit'), in nendüġüd qutuγ keġežü 'calling them my good fortunes and my blessing'
glossary.quγ̇uru: quγ̇ur- — to break, snap (stem inferred; Ming 折了); converb -u, 'breaking' (verb, converb; the ending is uncertain) [折了]
glossary.qotola: qotola — all, altogether (Ming 都行) (adverb) [都︀行]
glossary.boltala: bol- — to become; converb -tala, 'until it becomes' (verb, converb) [到了]
glossary.qaraγ̇atu: qaraγ̇a — a far view (stem inferred from qara- 'to look'; Ming 遠看見的 'seen from afar'); possessive -tu, 'having' (noun + possessive; could also be read 'far-seeing') [遠看(見)的]
glossary.tuki: tuki — standard, banner (so read; the Ming 英頭 is 'hero-head' and the stem is uncertain); the (i) before the reflexive is Shiratori's [英頭 自的行]
glossary.sačuba: saču- — to sprinkle a libation, to sacrifice (stem inferred; Ming 祭了也); past -ba, 'sacrificed' (verb, past) [祭了也]
glossary.buγa-jin: buγa — bull (Ming 强牛 'strong ox'); genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem, 'of the bull' (noun + case) [强牛 的]
glossary.arasuni: arasun — skin, hide (noun; Ming 皮子); the (i) before the instrumental -jar is Shiratori's [皮子敎]
glossary.bürigsen: büri- — to cover, to stretch over (stem inferred; Ming 幔了的); past participle -gsen, 'covered' (verb, participle) [幔了的]
glossary.bürkiren: bürkiren — booming, drumming (sound word; Ming 鼕鼕 'boom-boom'; perhaps bürkire- + converb -n) [鼕鼕]
glossary.daγ̇utu: daγ̇u — voice, sound (noun; Ming 聲); possessive -tu, 'having a sound' [聲有的]
glossary.köġürge-ban: köġürge — drum (noun; Ming 鼓); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own drum' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [鼓 自的行]
glossary.deledbe: deled- — to beat, to strike (stem inferred; Ming 打了也); past -be, 'beat' (verb, past) [打了也]
glossary.qurduni: qurdun — fast; a fast horse (Ming 快馬); the (i) before the reflexive is Shiratori's [快馬 自的行]
glossary.qataṅγu: qataṅγu — steel-hard, hardened (adjective; Ming 鋼硬 'hard as steel') [鋼硬]
glossary.deġeli: deġel — robe, coat (noun; Ming 衣裳); the (i) before the reflexive is Shiratori's [衣裳 自的行]
glossary.emüsbe: emüs- — to put on, to wear; past -be, 'put on' (verb, past; Ming 穿了也) [穿了也]
glossary.žida-ban: žida — spear, lance (Ming 鎗); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own spear' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [鎗 自的行]
glossary.bariba: bari- — to take hold of, to grasp; past -ba, 'took hold of' (verb, past; Ming 拿了也) [拿了也]
glossary.qadqurasutu: qadqurasu — (stem unclear; Ming 有挑皮的 'having a lifted skin'; some kind of arrow-head, uncertain); possessive -tu, 'having' [有挑皮的]
glossary.sumuni: sumun — arrow (noun; Ming 箭); the (i) before the reflexive is Shiratori's [箭 自的行]
glossary.onolaba: onola- — to nock, to fit to the string (from onor 'nock'; Ming 扣了); past -ba, 'nocked' (verb, past) [扣了也]
glossary.qaγ̇ad: Qaγ̇ad — the Qa'at, a Merkid clan (Ming 姓氏 'clan name'); here the first half of Qaγ̇ad-Merkid-tür, the hyphen carried over from the line [姓氏]
glossary.merkid-tür: Merkid — the Merkid, a people; dative-locative -tür, 'against the Merkid, at the Merkid' (people name + case, front-vowel form) [(種名) 行]
glossary.qadquldun: qadqu- — to fight, skirmish (stem inferred; Ming 厮殺 'fight'); reciprocal -ldu- ('one another') + converb -n, 'fighting one another' (verb, reciprocal converb) [厮殺︀]
glossary.morilaja: mori — horse (morin); -la- makes a verb: to ride; hortative -ja, 'let us mount' (noun-derived verb, hortative, first person plural) [上馬咱]
glossary.hüker-ün: hüker — ox; genitive -ün, 'of the ox' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [牛的]
glossary.arasu-bar: arasu — skin, hide (Ming 皮子; the final n of arasun is absent, uncertain); instrumental -bar, 'with the hide' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [皮子 敎]
glossary.ödgen: ödgen — dull, thick, of a sound (Ming 濁 'muddy, turbid'; analysis uncertain) [濁]
glossary.qur: qurdun — fast; a fast horse (Ming 快馬); the first half, the word being cut across two printed tokens, qur- / dun(i)-jan (adjective or noun, split word) [快馬]
glossary.duni: -dun — the second half of qurdun, the word being cut across qur- / dun(i)-jan (the token left after qur-; the (i) before the reflexive is Shiratori's); the Ming 自的行 glosses the half with the reflexive (noun, split word) [自的行]
glossary.hüdesütü: hüdesü — thong, stitching of hide (stem inferred; Ming 皮穿來的 'threaded with hide'); possessive -tü, 'having' (front-vowel form) [皮穿來的]
glossary.qujagi: qujag — armour, mail-coat (noun; Ming 甲); the (i) before the reflexive is Shiratori's [甲 自的行]
glossary.oṅgitu: oṅgi — haft, handle (stem inferred; Ming 抦 'handle'); possessive -tu, 'having a handle' [抦有的]
glossary.üldü-beġen: üldü — sword, scimitar (Ming 環刀 'ring-sword'); reflexive-possessive -beġen, 'one's own sword' (noun + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form) [環刀 自的行]
glossary.onortu: onor — nock, the notch of an arrow; possessive -tu, 'having a nock' (noun + possessive; Ming 扣子 有的) [扣子 有的]
glossary.uduid-merkid-tür: Uduid — the Uduid, a Merkid clan (Ming 姓氏), with Merkid, the people; dative-locative -tür, 'against the Uduid Merkid' (name + name + case, front-vowel form) [姓氏 行]
glossary.üküldüje: ükü- — to die (stem uncertain; read from the Ming 捨死 'give up life'); reciprocal -ldü- (Ming 厮殺 'fight') + hortative -je, 'let us fight to the death' (verb, reciprocal hortative, first person plural; uncertain) [捨死厮殺︀咱]
glossary.morilarun: mori — horse (morin); -la- makes a verb: to ride; converb of time -run, 'when mounting' (noun-derived verb, converb, back-vowel form) [上馬時]
glossary.daγ̇ariγ̇ad: daγ̇ari- — to pass by, to go past (Ming 經過); converb -γ̇ad, 'having passed' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [經過]
glossary.botoqan-boγ̇orži-da: Botoqan-Boγ̇orži — Botoqan-Boqorji, a place name (one two-part name); dative-locative -da, 'at Botoqan-Boqorji' (place name + case, back-vowel form) [地名 行]
glossary.bolžalduja: bolža- — to appoint, to agree on a meeting (stem inferred; Ming 約會; compare bolžal, bolžaγ̇an); reciprocal -ldu- + hortative -ja, 'let us fix a meeting between us' (verb, reciprocal hortative, first person plural) [約會咱]
glossary.anda-jin: anda — sworn brother, pledged friend; genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem, 'of the sworn brother' (noun + case) [契合 的]
glossary.ulus-ača: ulus — people, realm; ablative -ača, 'from the people' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [百姓 裏]
glossary.tümen: tümen — ten thousand, a tümen (numeral noun; Ming 萬) [萬] · also a division of ten thousand households (Ming 萬戶)
glossary.bolžal: bolžal — appointment, meeting (noun; Ming 約會) [約會]
glossary.neiledüje: neile- — to join, to come together (Ming 相合); reciprocal -dü- (written without the l of -ldü-; uncertain) + hortative -je, 'let us join one another' (verb, reciprocal hortative, front-vowel form) [相合咱]
glossary.žamuqa-jin: Žamuqa — Jamuqa, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem, 'of Jamuqa' (personal name + case) [人名 的]
glossary.temüžin-e: Temüžin — Temüjin, a man's name; dative-locative -e, 'to Temüjin' (personal name + case) [人名 行] · also with Ming (人)名 行, 'to Temüjin'
glossary.kürgebe: kürge- — to bring to, to deliver (kür- 'reach' made causative; uncertain); past -be, 'delivered' (verb, past) [送到了]
glossary.kelüren-ü: Kelüren — the Kelüren, a river (Ming 河名); genitive -ü, 'of the Kelüren' (river name + case, front-vowel form) [河名 的]
glossary.žorin: žori- — to aim at, to point towards (Ming 指着); converb -n, 'pointing' (verb, converb) [指着]
glossary.žailan: žaila- — to turn aside, to avoid (stem inferred; Ming 躱 'hide, dodge'); converb -n, 'turning aside' (verb, converb) [躱]
glossary.tana: Tana — the Tana, a stream (Ming 河名) [河名]
glossary.γorqon-a: γorqon — small stream (Ming (小)河); dative-locative -a, 'at the stream' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [(小)河 行]
glossary.žaqaγambu: Žaqaγambu — Jaqa Gambu, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.tümedi: tümen — ten thousand, a tümen; plural -d, 'tümens'; the (i) before the instrumental -jer is Shiratori's (numeral noun + plural; Ming 萬(每)敎) [萬(每)敎]
glossary.γorqon-u: γorqon — small stream; genitive -u, 'of the stream' (noun + case) [小河 的]
glossary.ail-qaraqana-da: Ail-Qaraqana — A'il-Qaraqana, a place name (one two-part name); dative-locative -da, 'at A'il-Qaraqana' (place name + case, back-vowel form) [地名 行]
glossary.neilen: neile- — to join, to come together (Ming 相合); converb -n, 'joining' (verb, converb) [相合]
glossary.qamtudču: qamtud- — to be together, to join (from qamtu 'together'; stem inferred; Ming 相合); converb -ču, 'joining' (verb, converb) [相合着]
glossary.kürbesü: kür- — to reach, arrive; conditional converb -besü, 'if, when arriving' (verb, converb; Ming 到呵) [到呵] · also a personal name, Kürbesü, the mother of Tayang Qan (Ming 人名)
glossary.kürčüġüi: kür- — to reach, arrive; perfect -čüġüi, 'has arrived' (front-vowel form after r; verb, perfect) [到有]
glossary.žaqaγambu-tan-u: Žaqaγambu — Jaqa Gambu, a man's name; -tan, 'and his company, and those with' (Ming 等) + genitive -u, 'of Jaqa Gambu and his company' (personal name + plural + case) [人名 等的]
glossary.čeriġüd-i: čerig — soldier, army; plural -üd + accusative -i, 'the troops' as object (noun + plural + case) [軍每 行]
glossary.čeriġüdi: čerig — soldier, army; plural -üd; the (i) before the reflexive -jen is Shiratori's (noun + plural; Ming 軍(每)) [軍(每) 自的行] · also čeriġüd(i)-jer: čerig 'soldier, army' + plural -üd + instrumental -(i)jer, 'with the troops' (the (i) is Shiratori's; Ming 軍(每)領着 'leading the troops') [軍(每)領着]
glossary.baižuγ̇ui: bai- — to stand, to stop; perfect -žuγ̇ui, 'has stood, stands' (Ming 有) (verb, perfect) [立有]
glossary.žaqaγambu-tan: Žaqaγambu — Jaqa Gambu, a man's name; -tan, 'and his company, and those with' (Ming 等) (personal name + plural) [人名 等]
glossary.žasaγ̇ad: žasa- — to prepare, set in order; converb -γ̇ad, 'having prepared' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [整治了]
glossary.kürülčežü: kürülče- — to come together (from kür- 'reach'; stem inferred; Ming 相到); converb -žü, 'coming together' (verb, converb) [相到着]
glossary.tanildužu: tani- — to know, to recognise; reciprocal -ldu- ('each other') + converb -žu, 'recognising one another' (verb, reciprocal converb) [相認着]
glossary.boroγ̇an: boroγ̇an — storm, snowstorm (Ming 風雪 'wind and snow') (noun) [風雪]
glossary.bolžal-dur: bolžal — appointment, meeting; dative-locative -dur, 'at the appointment' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [約會 裏]
glossary.qural-dur: qural — gathering, assembly (Ming 聚會); dative-locative -dur, 'at the gathering' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [聚會 裏]
glossary.qožidaja: qožida- — to fall behind, to be late (from qožid 'behind'); hortative -ja, 'let us fall behind' (verb, hortative, first person plural) [落後咱]
glossary.keġeldüleġei: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü- ('together') + past -leġei, 'have said' (Ming 來; verb, reciprocal past; the ending's force is uncertain) [共說來麽] · also with Ming 共說來 (without 麽)
glossary.andaγartan: andaγar — oath, sworn pledge (stem inferred from anda; Ming 做誓 'make an oath'); -tan, 'those with' (Ming 每) (noun + plural; uncertain) [做誓 有的每]
glossary.že-dēče: že — the word of assent, 'yes' (Ming 應許 'assent'); ablative -dēče, 'from the assent' (particle + case, long vowel; uncertain) [應許 行]
glossary.qožidaγsan-i: qožida- — to fall behind, to be late; past participle -γsan, 'the one who fell behind' + accusative -i (verb, participle + case) [落後了的 行]
glossary.žerge-dēče: žerge — rank, row, line (Ming 班列); ablative -dēče, 'from the rank' (noun + case, front-vowel form, long vowel) [班列 裏]
glossary.γarγaja: γar- — to go out; causative -γa- + hortative -ja, 'let us put out, let us drive out' (Ming 敎出去咱; verb, causative hortative, first person plural) [敎出去咱]
glossary.qodukaqu-ji: qoduka- — to punish, to fine (stem inferred; Ming 罰); participle -qu + accusative -ji, 'the punishing' as object (verb, participle + case) [罰的 (行)]
glossary.čimarlaqu-ji: čimar-la- — to blame, to reproach (from čimar; Ming 怪); participle -qu + accusative -ji, 'the blaming' as object (verb, participle + case) [怪的 (行)]
glossary.medetügei: mede- — to know; optative -tügei, 'let him know' (verb, optative, front-vowel form) [知者︀] · also mede- — here 'to manage, take charge', optative 'let him manage' (Ming 敎管者︀)
glossary.bolžal-un: bolžal — appointment, meeting; genitive -un, 'of the appointment' (noun + case) [約會 的]
glossary.čimar: čimar — reproach, blame (noun; Ming 怪) [怪]
glossary.ügüleldüžü: ügüle- — to speak, to say; reciprocal -ldü- ('together') + converb -žü, 'speaking together' (verb, reciprocal converb, front-vowel form) [共說着]
glossary.botoqan-boγ̇oržin-ača: Botoqan-Boγ̇orži — Botoqan-Boqorji, a place name; stem-final -n- before the case ending, ablative -ača, 'from Botoqan-Boqorji' (place name + case, back-vowel form) [地名自]
glossary.ketülüġed: ketül- — to cross over (water), to ford; converb -üġed, 'having crossed' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [渡了]
glossary.toγtoγ̇a-beki-jin: Toγtoγ̇a-Beki — Toqto'a Beki, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Toqto'a Beki' (one two-part name + case) [人名 的]
glossary.daγ̇arin: daγ̇ari- — to strike against, collide (stem inferred from the Ming 撞; compare daγ̇arižu 'passing by'); converb -n, 'colliding' (verb, converb) [撞] · daγ̇ari- also 'to pass along, go by', converb -n (Ming 經過 'pass through'; the Ming reading here differs from 撞 'strike')
glossary.daγ̇uliba: daγ̇uli- — to plunder, to seize (Ming 據 'seize'); past -ba, 'seized' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [據了]
glossary.qokiratala: qokira- — to be wiped out, used up (stem inferred; Ming 罄絕 'exhausted'); terminal converb -tala, 'until ... is exhausted' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [罄絕]
glossary.toγtoγ̇a-beki-ji: Toγtoγ̇a-Beki — Toqto'a Beki, a man's name; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Toqto'a Beki (object)' (one two-part name + case; Ming 行) [人名 行]
glossary.kebteġed: kebte- — to lie down, to sleep; converb -ġed, 'having lain down' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [睡着]
glossary.kürkü-ji: kür- — to reach, arrive; participle -kü + accusative -ji, 'the one arriving (object)' (verb, participle + case; Ming 到的行) [到的 行]
glossary.žiγačin: žiγa — fish (stem inferred from the Ming 打魚 'catch fish'); agent suffix -čin, 'fisher, those dealing with fish' (noun + agent suffix; Ming 的每 'the ones') [打魚的每]
glossary.buluγačin: buluγa(n) — sable (the final n drops before -čin); agent suffix -čin, 'sable-hunters' (noun + agent suffix; Ming 的每 'the ones') [捕貂鼠的每]
glossary.göreġülüčin: göreġül — wild game (stem inferred from the Ming 野獸 'wild beasts'); agent suffix -čin, 'hunters of game' (noun + agent suffix; Ming 的每 'the ones') [捕野獸的每]
glossary.talbiγsad: talbi- — to set down, to let go, to set loose; past participle -γsad with plural -d, 'those who were set ...' (verb, participle, plural) [放來的]
glossary.dülin: düli- — to press on without halting, to travel double stages (stem inferred; Ming 兼行); converb -n, 'pressing on' (verb, converb) [兼行]
glossary.kürgen: kürge- — to bring to, to deliver (kür- 'reach' made causative; uncertain); converb -n, 'bringing' (verb, converb) [送到] · also with Ming 送 ('bring, send'), kelen kürgen 'bringing word'
glossary.odčuγ̇ui: od- — to go; past -čuγ̇ui, 'went' (verb, past; the ending is uncertain, compare ažuγ̇u) [去了]
glossary.barγužin: Barγužin — Barqujin, a place name (Ming 地名) (place name) [地名]
glossary.bejesi: beje — body, person (noun); plural -s (Ming 每; uncertain), the (i) before the reflexive-possessive -jen being Shiratori's; so 'one's own persons' (noun + plural, reading from the Ming gloss and the context) [身子(每)自的行] · also before -jer: öġer-ün bejes(i)-jer, 'in one's own persons' (Ming 親身(每)敎 'in person'), the (i) being Shiratori's
glossary.dutaγ̇an: dutaγ̇a- — to flee, to run away; converb -n, 'fleeing' (verb, converb) [逃]
glossary.buruγ̇udčuγ̇ui: buruγ̇u- — to hide, to slip away (stem inferred; Ming 躱); past -dčuγ̇ui, 'hid, slipped away' (verb, past; the ending is uncertain, compare odčuγ̇ui) [躱了]
glossary.dürbežü: dürbe- — to hurry, to flee in haste (stem inferred; Ming 忙走); converb -žü, 'hurrying' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [忙走着]
glossary.jabuqun: jabu- — to walk, to go about, to travel; participle -qun, 'the one going' (verb, participle; the ending is uncertain, Ming 行的) [行的]
glossary.darulčažu: darulča- — to follow close behind (stem inferred; Ming 緊隨; perhaps from daru- 'press'); converb -žu, 'following closely' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [緊隨着] · here Ming 相壓着, 'pressing upon one another' (darulča- as a reciprocal-like 'press on one another'; converb -žu, back-vowel form)
glossary.daγ̇ulin: daγ̇uli- — to plunder, to seize (Ming 擄掠); converb -n, 'plundering' (verb, converb) [擄掠]
glossary.talan: tala- — to plunder, to pillage (stem inferred; the Ming 擄掠 stands over the pair daγ̇ulin talan); converb -n, 'pillaging' (verb, converb) [着]
glossary.uṅšižu: uṅši- — to call out, to call (stem inferred; Ming 喚); converb -žu, 'calling out' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [喚着]
glossary.učiražu: učira- — to meet, to come upon; converb -žu, 'meeting' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [遇着]
glossary.börte-üžin: Börte-Üžin — Börte-Üjin, a woman's name (one two-part name; Ming 婦人名) [婦人名]
glossary.dürbekün: dürbe- — to hurry, to flee in haste (stem inferred; Ming 忙走); participle -kün, 'the ones hurrying' (verb, participle; the ending is uncertain) [忙着行的]
glossary.büžüġüi: bü- — to be; past -žüġüi, 'there was, there were' (verb, past; front-vowel partner of -žuγ̇ui, uncertain; Ming 有來) [有來]
glossary.baγ̇uγ̇ad: baγ̇u- — to come down, to descend; converb -γ̇ad, 'having come down' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [下了]
glossary.žiluγ̇a: žiluγ̇a — bridle-rein (noun; Ming 轡繩) [轡繩]
glossary.čilbür: čilbür — halter-rein, lead-rope (noun; Ming 韁繩) [韁繩]
glossary.barižuγ̇ui: bari- — to take hold of, to grasp; past -žuγ̇ui, 'took hold of' (verb, past, back-vowel form; the ending is uncertain) [拿了]
glossary.saraγ̇ur: saraγ̇ur — moonlit, moonlight (from sara 'moon'; Ming 月明 'moon bright') (adjective or noun; the exact word class is uncertain) [月明]
glossary.teberildün: teberi- — to embrace, to clasp; reciprocal -ldü- 'each other' + converb -n, 'embracing one another' (verb, reciprocal converb) [相抱]
glossary.tusulčaba: tusulča- — to come upon suddenly, to rush together (stem uncertain; Ming 猛到了); past -ba, 'came upon' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [猛到了]
glossary.erikü: eri- — to seek; participle -kü, 'what is sought, to seek' (verb, participle) [尋的]
glossary.keregi: kereg — need, use, business (noun); the (i) before the reflexive-possessive -jen is Shiratori's, so 'one's own need' (noun + reflexive-possessive; Ming 用 自的行) [用 自的(行)]
glossary.olba: ol- — to find, to get; past -ba, 'found, got' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [得了]
glossary.dülije: düli- — to press on without halting (stem inferred; Ming 兼行); hortative -je, 'let us press on' (verb, hortative, front-vowel form) [兼行咱]
glossary.baγ̇uja: baγ̇u- — to come down, to descend; hortative -ja, 'let us come down' (verb, hortative, back-vowel form) [(下)咱] · baγ̇u- also 'to dismount, to camp', hortative -ja 'let us camp' (Ming 下) [下咱]
glossary.aisuqui-ji: aisu- — to come; participle -qui + accusative -ji after a vowel, 'the coming one (object)' (verb, participle + case; Ming 來的行) [來的 行]
glossary.sandurču: sandur- — to scatter, to spread out (stem inferred; Ming 漫散); converb -ču after r, 'scattering' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [(漫)散着]
glossary.aisuqui: aisu- — to come; participle -qui, 'coming, the one coming' (verb, participle) [來的]
glossary.žoluγaldužu: žoluγa- — to meet, to come upon (as the published žoluγažu); reciprocal -ldu- 'each other' + converb -žu, 'meeting one another' (verb, reciprocal converb, back-vowel form) [相遇 着]
glossary.aburaγsan: abura- — to rescue, to save (stem inferred; Ming 救); past participle -γsan, 'the one who was rescued, saved' (verb, participle) [救了的]
glossary.türün: türün — at first, in the beginning (Ming 初) (adverb) [初]
glossary.toγtoγ̇a-beki: Toγtoγ̇a-Beki — Toqto'a Beki, a man's name (one two-part name; Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.žaγ̇ud: žaγ̇ud — hundred, plural form, 'hundreds' (numeral + plural -d; Ming 百每) [百(每)]
glossary.üdür-ün: üdür — day (noun); genitive -ün, 'of the day' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [日的] · also 'in the day' (Ming 日裏), the -ün read as locative
glossary.jeke-čiledü-dēče: Jeke-Čiledü — Yeke-Chiledü, a man's name (one two-part name; the first husband of Högelün); ablative -dēče, 'from Yeke-Chiledü' (name + case, front-vowel form with a long ē; Ming 行) [人名行]
glossary.jesügei-baγ̇atur-a: Jesügei-Baγ̇atur — Yesügei Ba'atur, a man's name (one two-part name; Temüjin's father); dative-locative -a, here the agent after a passive, 'by Yesügei Ba'atur' (name + case, back-vowel form) [人名行]
glossary.abtalai: ab- — to take; passive -ta- (the form after b), past -lai, 'was taken, was seized' (verb, passive past; the past ending is uncertain, compare the published abtalaγ̇ai; Ming 被要了) [被要了]
glossary.teġün-i: teġün — that (the stem of tere before a case ending); accusative -i, 'that (object)' (demonstrative + case) [那的行]
glossary.hačiran: hačira- — to repay enmity (from hači 'enmity', as the published hači-la- 'repay enmity'; Ming 報 'repay'); converb -n, 'repaying' (verb, converb) [報]
glossary.qučiγulqui: qučiγ- — to circle, to go round (stem inferred); causative -ul- + participle -qui, 'making go round, encircling' (verb, causative participle; Ming 繞了) [繞了]
glossary.dur: -dur — dative-locative: at, in (case suffix, back-vowel form; the token left after a hyphen; Ming 時 'time', 'at the time of') [時]
glossary.erüsčü: erü- — to obtain, to get (stem inferred; Ming 得); (-s-, uncertain) + converb -čü after a consonant, 'getting' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [得着]
glossary.čiledü-jin: Čiledü — Chiledü, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Chiledü' (personal name + case) [人名的]
glossary.čilger-bökö-de: Čilger-Bökö — Chilger-Bökö, a man's name (one two-part name); dative-locative -de, 'to Chilger-Bökö' (name + case, front-vowel form; Ming 行) [人名 行]
glossary.asaraγ̇uluγsan: asara- — to keep, to take in (Ming 收繼 'take in by levirate'); causative -γ̇ul- + past participle -γsan, 'the one who was made to take in' (verb, causative participle; reading rests largely on the Ming gloss) [收繼了]

glossary.čilger-bökö: Čilger-Bökö — Chilger-Bökö, a man's name (one two-part name; Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.daižižu: daiži- — to turn against, to turn hostile (from dain 'enemy'; Ming 反); converb -žu, 'turning hostile' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [反走着]
glossary.kereġe: kereġe — raven, crow (noun; Ming 老烏 'old crow') [老烏]
glossary.qalisu-körišü: qalisu-körišü — scraps and hides (Ming 殘皮 'remnant hide'; the compound is not analysed) [殘皮]
glossary.toγuraγ̇u: toγuraγ̇u — cormorant (noun; Ming 鷀䳓); before a case ending it takes -n-, as in toγuraγ̇un-i [鷀䳓]
glossary.idesü: ide- — to eat; optative -sü, 'let me eat, I will eat' (verb, optative, first person, front-vowel form) [要喫]
glossary.žešin: žešin — longing, hope (noun; Ming 想望) [想望]
glossary.γatar: γatar — outward appearance (noun; Ming (外貌); uncertain) [(外貌)]
glossary.čilger: Čilger — Chilger, a man's name (the first part of Chilger-Bökö; personal name) [人名]
glossary.qatun-üžin-dür: Qatun-Üžin — Lady Üjin, i.e. Börte-Üjin (qatun 'lady' + üjin; Ming 娘子 'lady'); dative-locative -dür, 'to the lady' (title + name + case, front-vowel form) [娘子 行]
glossary.qalqu: qalqu — provoking, meddling (Ming 惹 'provoke'; the stem is uncertain) [惹]
glossary.γudaγ̇u: γudaγ̇u — calamity, disaster (noun; Ming 禍) [禍︀]
glossary.qaraču: qaraču — commoner (qara 'black' + -ču; Ming 下民 'lowly people') (noun) [下民]
glossary.maγ̇u: maγ̇u — bad, evil (adjective; a variant of maγ̇ui) [歹]
glossary.teriġün-düri: teriġün — head (noun); dative-locative -dür + reflexive-possessive -jen, with the (i) Shiratori's, 'to one's own head' (noun + case + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form; Ming 頭 自的行) [頭 自的行]
glossary.kürtekü: kürte- — to be about to reach (kür- 'reach' + -te-; uncertain; Ming 將到); participle -kü, 'about to arrive' (verb, participle) [將到]
glossary.qoroqun: qoroqu- — to hold in the mouth, to clench in the teeth (Ming 刁 'hold in the mouth'; the stem is uncertain); converb -n, 'holding in the mouth' (verb, converb) [刁着] · also qoroqu- 'to waste, spend' (Ming 費 'spend'; uncertain), converb or participle
glossary.qaraṅγu: qaraṅγu — dark (adjective; Ming 黑暗 'dark', and once 暗) [黑暗]
glossary.qabčal: qabčal — narrow place, defile (noun; Ming 窄狹處) [窄狹處]
glossary.širγusu: širγu- — to push through, to squeeze, to creep in; ending -su, probably the optative 'let me ...' (verb; the ending is uncertain; Ming 鑽入 'bore into') [鑽入]
glossary.qalqa: qalqa — shield (noun; Ming 團牌 'round shield') [團牌] · also the Qalqa, a river (Ming 河名 'river name'), a proper name and not the 'shield'; with genitive -jin, 'of the Qalqa'
glossary.boldaqu-ju: bol- — to become, to be; -da- (a passive-like derivation, unclear; Ming 被做) + participle -qu + ending -ju (Ming 有 'is'; uncertain) (verb, participle + ending; analysis uncertain, reading from the Ming gloss alone) [被做的有]
glossary.quladu: Quladu — a bird, so named in the Ming (鳥名 'bird name'); the exact species is unknown (bird name) [鳥名]
glossary.šibaγ̇un: šibaγ̇un — bird (noun; Ming 鳥) [鳥] · also with Ming 鷹 'hawk', in šibaγ̇un metü, 'like a hawk' (the bird named is a hawk)
glossary.küčügen-e: küčügen — small, little (adjective; the Ming 小鼠 'small mouse' reads it with quluγana); dative-locative -e, 'to the small one' (adjective + case; Ming 行) [小鼠(行)]
glossary.qun: qun — swan (noun; Ming 天鵝) [天鵝]
glossary.toγuraγ̇un-i: toγuraγ̇u — cormorant (noun; Ming 鷀䳓); stem-final -n- before the case ending, accusative -i, 'the cormorant (object)' (noun + case) [鷀䳓 行]
glossary.qunar: qunar — dress, clothing (Ming (服裝); uncertain) [(服裝)]
glossary.quntuγtai: quntuγ — fortune (a variant of qutuγ; Ming 福); possessive -tai, 'having fortune, fortunate' (noun + possessive, back-vowel form) [福︀ 有的] · also Quntuγtai, Quntuqtai, a woman's name, a daughter of Toqto'a (Ming 女名) [女名]
glossary.sutai: su — fortune, glory, majesty (so read from the Ming 福, uncertain); possessive -tai, 'having glory, fortunate' (noun + possessive, back-vowel form) [福︀有的]
glossary.üžin-i: üžin — lady (a title set after a woman's name, here standing alone); accusative -i, 'the lady (object)' (noun + case; Ming 婦名行) [婦名行]
glossary.qurijažu: qurija- — to gather up, to collect (stem inferred; Ming 收拾); converb -žu, 'gathering' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [收拾着]
glossary.qokir: qokir — filthy, foul (adjective; Ming (汚穢)) [(汚穢)]
glossary.qokimai: qokimai — withered, dried up (adjective; Ming 枯乾) [枯乾]
glossary.qorγosun-u: qorγosun — sheep-dung pellets (noun; Ming 羊糞塊); genitive -u, 'of sheep dung' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [羊糞塊的]
glossary.qaratu: qara — black (adjective); -tu, an ending (uncertain; the Ming gives only 黑) [黑]
glossary.qabčal-a: qabčal — narrow place, defile (noun; Ming 窄狭處); dative-locative -a, 'in, into the defile' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [窄狭處(行)]
glossary.amin-a: amin — life (noun); dative-locative -a, 'to, for the life' (noun + case, back-vowel form; Ming 性命行) [性命 行]
glossary.qorijaγ̇an: qorijaγ̇an — enclosure, courtyard, fence (noun; Ming 院子) [院子]
glossary.daižin: daiži- — to turn against, to turn hostile (from dain 'enemy'; Ming 反); converb -n, 'turning hostile' (verb, converb) [反]
glossary.dutaγ̇ažuγ̇u: dutaγ̇a- — to flee, to run away; past -žuγ̇u, 'fled' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [迯走了]
glossary.qaγ̇atai-darmala-ji: Qaγ̇atai-Darmala — Qa'atai-Darmala, a man's name (one two-part name); accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Qa'atai-Darmala (object)' (name + case; Ming 行) [人名 行]
glossary.erüsbe: erü- — to obtain, to get (stem inferred; Ming 得); (-s-, uncertain) + past -be, 'got' (verb, past, front-vowel form) [得了]
glossary.γatasun: γatasun — board, plank (noun; Ming 板) [板]
glossary.emüsgežü: emüsge- — to put on, to wear (Ming 帶; the stem is uncertain); converb -žü, 'wearing' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [帶着]
glossary.qaldun-burqan: Qaldun-Burqan — Burqan Qaldun, the holy mountain, the two parts in reverse order (mountain name; Ming 山名); before a case ending it takes (n), as in Qaldun-Burqan-(n)a [山名 行]
glossary.žoriγ̇ulba: žori- — to point at, to head toward (Ming 指着行; the stem is uncertain); causative -γ̇ul- + past -ba, 'made head toward, sent' (verb, causative past, back-vowel form) [指着行了]
glossary.žaγ̇aγdažu: žaγ̇a- — to tell, to instruct (stem inferred; Ming 吿); passive -γda- + converb -žu, 'being told' (verb, passive converb, back-vowel form) [吿着]
glossary.egüden-ber: egüden — door, gate (noun); instrumental -ber, 'by, through' (case; uncertain: the Ming 裏 'in' is the only evidence, and the published eġü-ber, žeġü-ber show the ending) (noun + case) [門 裏]
glossary.oroqu-luγ̇a: oro- — to enter, to come in; participle -qu + -luγ̇a, 'when entering, as soon as ... enters' (verb, participle + ending; the ending is uncertain, Ming 呵 'if, when') [去 呵]
glossary.nabdarqai: nabdarqai — ragged, tattered (adjective; Ming 破衣 'torn clothes') [破衣]
glossary.nekei: nekei — sheepskin (noun; Ming 羊皮) [羊皮]
glossary.deġeltei: deġel — garment, coat (noun); possessive -tei, 'having a coat, coated' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [衣有的]
glossary.γaruγ̇ad: γar- — to go out; converb -uγ̇ad, 'having gone out' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [出了]
glossary.γadan-a: γadan — outside (noun); dative-locative -a, 'to, at the outside' (noun + case, back-vowel form; Ming 外行) [外行]
glossary.bolžuγ̇u: bol- — to become, to be; past -žuγ̇u, 'has become' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [每做了]
glossary.keġegdemüi: keġe- — to say; passive -gde- + present -müi, 'is said, is called' (verb, passive present) [被說有]
glossary.tübežü: tübe- — to be paired, matched (stem inferred; Ming 配); converb -žü, 'matching' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [配着]
glossary.siγui-hoi-dur: siγui-hoi — dense wood, thicket (Ming 密林; the compound is as Shiratori prints it); dative-locative -dur, 'in, into the thicket' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [密林 裏]
glossary.sirγužuγ̇u: širγu- — to push through, to squeeze, to creep in (printed sirγu-); past -žuγ̇u, 'crept in' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [鑽入了]
glossary.erižü: eri- — to seek; converb -žü, 'seeking' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [尋着]
glossary.oldalai: ol- — to find, to get; -da- (passive, uncertain; Ming 得) + past -lai, 'was found, got' (verb, past; the endings are uncertain, compare abtalai) [得有來]
glossary.merkidai: Merkid — the Merkid, a people; -ai, an ending (uncertain; perhaps 'a Merkid man') (people name; Ming 種名) [種名] · also the first half of a horse's name, Merkidai-Čaγaγ̇an (Ming 馬名), split at the line end
glossary.jasutu: jasu — bone (noun; Ming 骨頭; also 'lineage'); possessive -tu, 'having bones' (noun + possessive, back-vowel form) [骨頭的]
glossary.abčira: abčira- — to bring along (ab- 'take' plus a second verb; form uncertain); here the bare stem, 'bring!' (verb, imperative; Ming 將來) [將來]
glossary.γodolidqu: γodoli- — to shoot with a blunt-headed arrow (stem inferred; Ming 𩪛頭射); (-d-, uncertain; Ming 敎 'cause') + participle -qu, 'to be shot' (verb, participle; reading rests largely on the Ming gloss) [敎𩪛頭射]
glossary.qučilduγsad: qučil- — to encircle (stem uncertain); -du- 'together, mutually' + past participle -γsad with plural -d, 'those who encircled together' (verb, participle, plural) [相圍繞了的]
glossary.keistele: keis- — to scrape (stem inferred; Ming 刮); -tele, 'as if, like' (verb + ending; compare the published keisgen and hünesü-ġer keisgen 'scraped off'; the ending is uncertain, Ming 般) [刮般]
glossary.ülidgebe: ülid- — to destroy, to make extinct (stem inferred; Ming 殄絕; compare ülüdgebe); -ge- (uncertain; perhaps causative, as in the Ming 敎) + past -be, 'destroyed' (verb, past, front-vowel form) [殄絕了]
glossary.hülegsed: hüle- — to remain, to be left over (stem inferred; Ming 餘剩); past participle -gsed with plural -d, 'those who remained' (verb, participle, plural, front-vowel form) [餘剩的]
glossary.ebürikün: ebüri- — to hold to the bosom, to embrace (from ebür 'bosom'; Ming 懷抱); participle -kün, 'what is to be embraced' (verb, participle; the ending is uncertain, Ming 可 'fit to') [可懷抱的]
glossary.metüs-i: metü — like, as (postposition); plural -s (Ming 每) + accusative -i, 'the likes (object)' (postposition + plural + case) [般每 行]
glossary.ebüridbe: ebüri- — to hold to the bosom, to embrace (from ebür 'bosom'; Ming 懷抱); (-d-, uncertain) + past -be, 'embraced' (verb, past, front-vowel form) [懷抱了]
glossary.egüden-dür: egüden — door, gate; here 'household' (noun); dative-locative -dür, 'into the household' (noun + case, front-vowel form; Ming 門裏) [門裏]
glossary.oroγ̇uldaqun: oro- — to enter, to come in; causative -γ̇ul- + participle -daqun, 'what is to be brought in' (verb, causative participle; the ending is uncertain, Ming 的) [入的]
glossary.egüden-düri: egüden — door, gate; here 'household' (noun); dative-locative -dür + reflexive-possessive -jen, with the (i) Shiratori's, 'into one's own household' (noun + case + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form; Ming 門 自的行) [門 自的行]
glossary.büširin: büšire- — to be thankful, to feel gratitude (stem inferred; Ming 知感); converb -n, 'being grateful' (verb, converb) [知感]
glossary.nököčegdežü: nököče- — to be a companion (from nökör 'companion'); passive -gde- + converb -žü, 'being made a companion' (verb, passive converb, front-vowel form) [被做伴着]
glossary.teṅgiri: teṅgiri — Heaven, sky (noun; Ming 天) [天]
glossary.küčü: küčü — strength, power (noun; Ming 氣力) · also Küčü, a boy's name (Ming 人名) [氣力]
glossary.nemegdežü: neme- — to add (stem inferred; Ming 添); passive -gde- + converb -žü, 'being added' (verb, passive converb, front-vowel form) [被添着]
glossary.erketü: erke — power, authority (noun); possessive -tü, 'having power, mighty' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [威勢有的]
glossary.teṅgiri-de: teṅgiri — Heaven, sky (noun); dative-locative -de, 'to Heaven' (noun + case, front-vowel form; Ming 行) [天行]
glossary.etügen-e: Etügen — Etügen, the Earth (read from the Ming 地, with eke 'mother'); dative-locative -e, 'to Etügen' (name + case, front-vowel form; Ming 行) [地行]
glossary.hačitu: hači — enmity, vengeance (noun; Ming 讐報 'requital'); possessive -tu, 'having vengeance' (noun + possessive, back-vowel form) [讐報]
glossary.hoγtorγou: hoγtorγou — empty, void (adjective; a variant of hoγtorγu) [空]
glossary.hemtelbe: hemte — half (noun); -l- makes a verb (uncertain) + past -be, 'halved, made lacking' (verb, past, front-vowel form; Ming 敎闕 'cause to lack') [敎闕了]
glossary.ülüdgebe: ülüd- — to bring to an end, to abolish (stem inferred; Ming 敎廢 'cause to be abolished'); -ge- (uncertain; perhaps causative, as in the Ming 敎) + past -be, 'abolished' (verb, past, front-vowel form) [敎廢了]
glossary.hülegsed-i: hüle- — to remain, to be left over (stem inferred; Ming 餘剩); past participle -gsed with plural -d, accusative -i, 'those who remained (object)' (verb, participle, plural + case) [餘剩的(行)]
glossary.anu: an-u — their (back-vowel companion of in-ü, the third-person genitive placed after its noun) (pronoun, genitive; Ming 他的) [他的]
glossary.arbilaba: arbila- — to seize, to take captive (stem inferred; Ming 據要); past -ba, 'seized' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [據要了]
glossary.busalγažu: busal- — to be ruined, scattered (stem inferred; Ming 毀亂 'ruin and confuse'); causative -γa- + converb -žu, 'causing to be ruined' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form) [敎毀亂着]
glossary.ičuja: ič- — to withdraw, to retreat (stem inferred; Ming 退); linking vowel -u- (uncertain) + hortative -ja, 'let us withdraw' (verb, hortative, back-vowel form) [退咱]
glossary.uduid-merkid: Uduid-Merkid — the Uduid Merkid, the Uduid clan of the Merkid (clan name; Ming 姓(名)) [姓(名)]
glossary.dürberün: dürbe- — to hurry, to flee in haste (stem inferred; Ming 忙走); converb of time -rün, 'when hurrying' (verb, converb) [忙走時]
glossary.maqalaitu: maqalai — cap, hat (noun; Ming 帽兒); possessive -tu, 'having a cap, capped' (noun + possessive, back-vowel form) [帽兒有的]
glossary.maral-un: maral — doe, hind (noun; Ming 母鹿); genitive -un after a consonant, 'of the doe' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [母鹿的]
glossary.γodun: γodun — hoof-skin, hoof (noun; Ming 蹄皮) [蹄皮]
glossary.γudusutu: γudusu — boot (noun; Ming 靴子); possessive -tu, 'having boots, booted' (noun + possessive, back-vowel form) [靴子 有的]
glossary.ičigin-žarγaγ: ičigin-žarγaγ — 'powder-skin', a fine dressed skin (Ming 粉皮; the compound is not analysed) [粉皮]
glossary.žalγaγsan: žalγa- — to join, to splice (Ming 接); past participle -γsan, 'the one that was joined' (verb, participle) [接了的]
glossary.deġeltü: deġel — garment, coat (noun); possessive -tü, 'having a coat, coated' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [衣裳 有的]
glossary.köġüken-i: köġü — son, child (noun); diminutive -ken, 'little son, small child' (Ming 小兒); accusative -i, 'the little child (object)' (noun + diminutive + case) [(小兒)行]
glossary.qočoruγsan-i: qočor- — to be left behind, to be abandoned (compare qočorba; Ming 抛下 'cast down'); past participle -uγsan, 'the one that was left' + accusative -i, 'the abandoned one (object)' (verb, participle + case) [抛下的 行] · also with the Ming 後了的 行 'the one left behind (object)'
glossary.olžu: ol- — to find, to get; converb -žu, 'finding' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [得着]
glossary.soqa: soqa — present, gift of courtesy (noun; Ming 人事) [人事]
glossary.čorγan: čorγan — a word of unknown sense, apparently paired with ger 'house' (stem uncertain; no Ming gloss) [no Ming gloss]
glossary.soγoliγ̇ulžu: soγoli- — to fall over, be overturned (stem inferred; with the causative, Ming 推倒 'knock down'); -γ̇ul-: causative: cause to ...; -žu: converb: -ing (back-vowel form) [推倒着]
glossary.čoγtai: čoγ — a woman's headdress (Ming 固姑 'gugu', a transcription rather than a translation; the sense is from outside the Ming; stem uncertain); -tai: possessive: having (back-vowel form) [固姑]
glossary.arbilažu: arbila- — to seize, to take captive (stem inferred; Ming 據; compare arbilaba); -žu: converb: -ing (back-vowel form) [據着]
glossary.orqan: Orqan — the Orqon, a river (river name) [河名]
glossary.talqun-aral-ača: Talqun-Aral — Talqun-Aral, the island of Talqun, a place name (place name); -ača: ablative: from (back-vowel form) [地名 自]
glossary.ičurun: ič- — to withdraw, retreat (stem inferred; Ming 退); -urun: converb of time: linking vowel -u- (uncertain) + -run, 'when, as ...-ing' (Ming 時) [退時]
glossary.qorqonaγ-žubur: Qorqonaγ-Žubur — Qorqonaq-Jubur, a place name (place name) [地名]
glossary.ičuba: ič- — to withdraw, retreat (stem inferred; Ming 退); -uba: past: linking vowel -u- (uncertain) + -ba (back-vowel form) [退了]
glossary.gerü-ber: gerü — back, behind (stem inferred; Ming 背後); -ber: instrumental: by, along (Ming 依着) [背後 依着]
glossary.hökörtü-žubur: Hökörtü-Žubur — Hökörtü-Jubur, a place name (place name) [地名]
glossary.qačaγ̇uratu-subčid: Qačaγ̇uratu-Subčid — Qacha'uratu Subchid, a place name (place name) [地名]
glossary.hulijatu: Hulijatu — first half of the place name Hulijatu-Subčid, continued on the next word (place name; Ming 地 'place') [地]
glossary.subčid: Subčid — Subchid, second half of the place name Hulijatu-Subčid (place name; Ming 名 'name') [名]
glossary.abalaγ̇ad: abala- — to hunt in a drive (stem inferred; Ming 打圍); -γ̇ad: converb: having ...-ed (back-vowel form) [打圍了]
glossary.bolulčaγsani: bolulča- — to do together (bol- 'become' with a reciprocal; stem inferred); -γsan: past participle: ...-ed (the one that was); -(i): accusative (the (i) is Shiratori's) [共 做了的 自的行]
glossary.duradulučan: duradulu- — to call to mind together (from dura- 'remember', as in duradču; stem inferred); -čan: converb: -ing (uncertain) [共想着]
glossary.tuṅγuldužu: tuṅγul- — to renew (stem inferred; Ming 重新); -du-: together, mutually; -žu: converb: -ing (back-vowel form) [共重新着]
glossary.amaralduja: amara- — to love, be fond of (Ming 相親愛); -ldu-: reciprocal: each other; -ja: hortative: let us ... (back-vowel form) [相親愛 咱]
glossary.bolulčarun: bolulča- — to do together (bol- 'become' with a reciprocal; stem inferred); -run: converb of time: when, as ...-ing (Ming 時) [共做 時]
glossary.γuraltuγ: γuraltuγ — roe deer (Ming 麅子; form unclear) [麅子]
glossary.šiγ̇a: šiγ̇a — a game bone, 'knucklebone' (Ming 髀石 'thigh-stone'; the sense 'knucklebone' is from outside the sources, as in siγ̇a-jin) [髀石]
glossary.čeṅgültügtü: čeṅgül- — to pour, cast (metal) (stem inferred; Ming 銅灌); -tügtü: participle ending, 'cast' (uncertain) [銅灌的]
glossary.mölsün-dür: mölsün — ice; -dür: dative-locative: at, in (front-vowel form) [冰上]
glossary.siγ̇alžaqui-dur: siγ̇alža- — to play knucklebones (from šiγ̇a; stem inferred); -qui: participle: ...-ing; -dur: dative-locative: at; 'when' (back-vowel form) [打髀石的 時]
glossary.alaṅgir: alaṅgir — (Ming 木做的 'made of wood'; sense uncertain) [木做的]

glossary.žadaran-ača: Žadaran — the Jadaran, a clan name (clan name; Ming 種名); -ača ablative: from (back-vowel form) [種名處]
glossary.mulqalqu: Mulqalqu — Mulqalqu, a man's name (personal name) [人名]

glossary.šilegü: šilegü — two-year-old, of two years (adjective; Ming 二歲) [二歲]
glossary.irge: irge — wether, castrated ram (noun; Ming 羯羊) [羯羊] · also 'people' (Ming 百姓), a form of irgen, as in tede irge ičuγaγad 'those people, having turned back'
