glossary.qasar-luγ̇a: Qasar — Qasar, a man's name (personal name); -luγ̇a comitative: with, together with (back-vowel form; Ming 一同) [人名 一同]
glossary.üldüs: üldü — knife, sword (stem inferred; Ming 刀); -s plural: swords [刀每]
glossary.aγsažu: aγsa- — to wear, carry at the belt (stem inferred; Ming 帶 'wear, carry'); -žu converb: -ing (back-vowel form) [帶着]
glossary.küčürgekün-i: küčürge- — to parade one's strength, to vaunt (stem inferred; Ming 氣力逞 'show off strength'); -kün participle ending: 'one who ...' (Ming 每 'those'; uncertain); -i accusative: marks the object [氣力逞每 行]
glossary.güžüġüd: güžüġün — neck, nape (noun; Ming 項頸); -d plural: necks [項頸每]
glossary.kingüridkün: kingüri- — to cut through, sever (stem inferred; Ming 截斷); -dkün imperative-optative of plural address: 'you all ...' (Ming (您)每; uncertain) [截斷(您)每]
glossary.omor-γaqun-i: omor-γaqun — those who parade their courage, the bold (Ming 雄勇逞的 'one who shows off valour'; the parts uncertain; compare küčürgekün); -i accusative: marks the object [雄勇逞的 行]
glossary.omoriγ̇ud: omoriγ̇ud — chests (plural; Ming 胷每; stem uncertain) [胷每]
glossary.oṅlažidqun: oṅla- — to stab, pierce (stem inferred; Ming 刺殺); -židqun imperative-optative of plural address: 'you all ...' (compare jabudqun) (Ming (您)每; the -ži- is uncertain) [(刺殺︀您每)]
glossary.qaraldai-toquraγ̇un: Qaraldai-Toquraγ̇un — Qaraldai-Toqura'un, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.barituγai: bari- — to take hold of, seize; -tuγai optative: 'let them ...' (Ming 敎 'let') [敎拿] · also Ming 把者 'let them seize' [把者]
glossary.aγtačin: aγta — gelding (noun); -čin agent suffix: one who looks after ... (Ming 籠馬人 'the one who ropes the horses') [籠馬人]
glossary.qutu: Qutu — Qutu, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.moriči: Moriči — Morichi, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.aduγ̇u: aduγ̇u — herd of horses (noun; Ming 馬羣) [馬羣] · also 'herd, livestock' (Ming 頭口 'head of stock, beasts'), with ideġen 'food'
glossary.aduγ̇ulatuγai: aduγ̇ula- — to herd, to pasture; -tuγai optative: 'let them ...' (Ming 者 'let') [牧放者︀]
glossary.argai-qasar: Argai-Qasar — Arqai-Qasar, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.taγai: Taγai — Taqai, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.qola-jin: qola — meaning not known from these sources (the Ming gives only (箭名的) 'of an arrow name'); -jin genitive: of (after a vowel) [(箭名的)]
glossary.qoγ̇očaγ: qoγ̇očaγ — an arrow name (Ming 箭名) [箭名]
glossary.oira-jin: oira — near, close (the glossary's oira, Ming 近; here the Ming gives only 箭名(的) 'of an arrow name', so the sense is uncertain); -jin genitive: of (after a vowel) [箭名(的)]
glossary.odora: odora — an arrow name (Ming 箭名) [箭名]
glossary.baγ̇atur: baγ̇atur — hero, brave warrior (a title following a name; Ming 勇士) [勇士]
glossary.qurijaldusu: qurija- — to gather up, tidy (stem inferred; Ming 收拾); -ldu- reciprocal: 'together, jointly' (Ming 共); -su optative: 'let me ...' (back-vowel form) [共收拾]
glossary.keriġe: keriġe — crow, raven (noun; Ming 老鴉) [老鴉]
glossary.γadaγ̇un: γadaγ̇un — outside, outer (Ming 在外) [在外] · also 'by the outside, round the outside' (Ming 經外面 'passing by the outer way')
glossary.bükün-i: bü- — to be; -kün participle ending: 'those who are' (Ming 有的; uncertain); -i accusative: marks the object [有的 行]
glossary.qarmaldusu: qarma- — to gather in, collect (stem inferred; Ming 收聚); -ldu- reciprocal: 'together, jointly' (Ming 共); -su optative: 'let me ...' (back-vowel form) [共收聚]
glossary.nembeġe: nembeġe — cover, covering (noun; Ming 葢 'cover') [葢]
glossary.nemürleldün: nemürle- — to cover (stem inferred from nembeġe; Ming 葢); -ldü- reciprocal: 'together, jointly' (Ming 共); -n converb: -ing [共葢]
glossary.sorisu: sori- — to try, test (stem inferred; Ming 試); -su optative: 'let me ...' (Ming 試我 'let me try') [試我]
glossary.gerisge: gerisge — wind-screen, shelter (noun; Ming 遮風 'shield against wind') [遮風]
glossary.ger-žüg: ger — house, tent; žüg direction, side, place; after a noun, 'toward' (the postposition žüg, as after names; Ming 家處 'to the house') [家處]
glossary.gerisgeleldün: gerisgele- — to shelter, to screen (from gerisge; stem inferred; Ming 遮護); -ldü- reciprocal: 'together, jointly' (Ming 共); -n converb: -ing [共遮護]
glossary.eberi: eber — horn (noun); -(i)jen reflexive-possessive follows as the token jen, 'its own' (the (i) is Shiratori's, here the accusative as in köġün(i)-jen in the glossary, and belongs to that ending; Ming 角 + 自的行) [角 自的行]
glossary.terge: terge — cart (noun; the first half of tergeġür 'cart-track', cut at a line end in Shiratori's text; the whole word is tergeġür; Ming 車) [車] · also Terge, a man's name (Ming 人名), a separate word from 'cart'
glossary.ġüri: ġür — track, road (noun; the second half of terge-ġür 'cart-track', cut at a line end); the (i) is Shiratori's and belongs to the instrumental -(i)jer that follows as the token jer, 'along' (Ming 路 + 依着) [路依着]
glossary.keleleg: kele- — to speak, say (from kelen 'word', as in the glossary's kelelegsen; stem inferred); -le- verb-former (uncertain); -g- the first part of the past participle -gsen (compare töre-gsen), cut after the g at a line end; the rest follows as sen-i (verb stem + participle, split; Ming 說來的 'what has been said') [說來的]
glossary.ali: Ali- — Ali-, the first half of the place name Ali-Qaraqana, cut at a line end (printed Ali-, but the Han 阿亦勒 reads Ail-, as in Ail-Qaraqana elsewhere; place name) [地名] · also which, what (interrogative pronoun; Ming 那箇), a different word from the place-name Ali-
glossary.teġü: teġü- — to be ruined, to break down (verb stem inferred; Ming 敎壞 'cause to ruin'); the first half of teġü-reġülšü, cut at a line end, the causative and optative following as the token reġülšü [敎壞]
glossary.sübeġetei: Sübeġetei — Sübegetei, a man's name (personal name; the first half of Sübeġetei-Baγ̇atur, cut at a line end; the title baγ̇atur 'hero' follows) [人名]
glossary.amuγ̇ulba: amu- — to be at peace, at rest (stem inferred from the Ming 安 'peace'); causative -γ̇ul- + past -ba, 'caused to rest, set at ease' (verb, causative past) [敎安了]
glossary.sedkil-dür: sedkil — heart, mind; dative-locative -dür, 'in the heart' (noun + case, front-vowel form; Ming 裏) [心 裏]
glossary.žirüge: žirüge — heart (a second word for 'heart', beside sedkil; the same as žürüge) (noun) [心]
glossary.čeġeži: čeġeži — breast, bosom (noun; Ming 胷懷) [胷懷]
glossary.baiγsaγ̇ar: bai- — to stand, to be set up (stem inferred from the Ming 立); past participle -γsan + instrumental -ar, 'because of having stood, set up' (verb, participle + case; the split of the ending is uncertain; Ming 上頭 'on account of') [立了的上頭]
glossary.aqalažu: aqa — elder brother, elder; verb-forming -la-, converb -žu, 'being the elder, acting as head' (noun-derived verb, converb; Ming 爲長) [爲長着]
glossary.ülü-ü: ülü — not; followed by -ü, a particle of question (uncertain; the Ming puts its 麽 on the next word) (negative particle + particle) [不]
glossary.aqun: a- — to be, to dwell; ending -qun (uncertain; the Ming 住麽 reads it as a question, 'will you dwell?'; in §126 the Ming has 過的 'pass the time') (verb, ending uncertain) [住麽] · also with the Ming 有的 'being' (jaγ̇utan aqun, 'what-having being'): a- 'be' + -qun, participle-like, uncertain
glossary.nemežü: neme- — to add, to increase; converb -žü, 'adding' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [添着]
glossary.igeġegdeġesü: igeġe- — to protect, to help (stem inferred from the Ming 護助); passive -gde-, conditional -ġesü, 'if (one) is helped, protected' (verb, passive conditional, front-vowel form) [被護助呵]
glossary.anda-ača: anda — sworn brother, pledged friend (Ming 契合); ablative -ača, 'from the sworn brother' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [(契合)處] · also 'from the sworn brother' with the Ming 契合 行, where 行 stands for the ablative
glossary.nököčešü: nököče- — to be a companion (from nökör; stem inferred); -šü, an ending of exhortation (uncertain; the Ming 做伴我 'be a companion to me'), 'let ... be companions' (verb, ending uncertain) [做伴我]
glossary.ötögüs: ötögü(n) — old man, elder; plural -s, 'elders' (noun + plural) [老的每]
glossary.ölže: ölže — good fortune, blessing (noun; the first part of ölže-ten, split by the line break) [吉慶]
glossary.ten: -ten — possessive plural, 'those having' (plural of -tü/-tai; here joined to ölže-, 'those having blessing') [有的(每)]
glossary.boluγ̇užai: bol- — to become; ending -uγ̇užai (uncertain; the Ming 做麽 reads it as a question, 'shall (they) become?') (verb, ending uncertain) [做麽]
glossary.tüšibe: tüši- — to entrust, to commit to (Ming 委付); past -be, 'entrusted' (verb, past, front-vowel form) [委付了]
glossary.tan-i: tan- — you (plural polite; stem of ta before a case ending); accusative -i, 'you' as object (pronoun + case) [您行]
glossary.qān-dur: qān — ruler, khan (the short form beside qaγan); dative-locative -dur, 'to the qan' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝 行]
glossary.daγai: Daγai — Daqai, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.bolγaqu: bol- — to become; causative -γa- + future participle -qu, 'to be made into, to be made' (verb, causative participle) [敎做了]
glossary.qā: qā — qaγan, sovereign (a contracted form of qaγan; plural qād) (noun, title) [皇帝]
glossary.eje-ben: eje — counsel, consultation, agreement (Ming 商量); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own counsel' (noun + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form) [商量自的(行)]
glossary.ebdedkün: ebde- — to break, to destroy; -dkün, prohibitive/imperative, second person plural, 'you (pl.) ...' (verb, ending uncertain; the Ming 您 'you') [壞您]
glossary.žaṅgi-ban: žaṅgi — bond, knot (Ming 結了的 'tied'); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own bond' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [結了的 自的行]
glossary.taludqun: talu- — to untie, to loosen (stem inferred from the Ming 解); -dqun, imperative, second person plural (verb, ending uncertain) [解了您]
glossary.žaqa-ban: žaqa — collar (Ming 衣領); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own collar' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [衣領 自的行]
glossary.tamtuludqun: tamtulu- — to tear (stem inferred from the Ming 扯); -dqun, imperative, second person plural (verb, ending uncertain) [扯了您]
glossary.iležü: ile- — to send, to go (the Ming glosses 去着 'going'); converb -žü, 'sending, going' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [去着] · also 'causing to go, sending' (Ming 敎去着)
glossary.arγai-qasar: Arγai-Qasar — Arqai-Qasar, a man's name (personal name; Arγai 'Arqai' with Qasar) [人名]
glossary.ileġesü: ile- — to send (the Ming glosses 去 'go'); conditional -ġesü, 'if (one) sends' (verb, conditional, front-vowel form) [去呵]
glossary.sübeġesečižü: sübeġe — hollow of the flank, waist (Ming 腰窩); verb stem seči- 'to stab at' (inferred from the Ming 戮), converb -žü, 'stabbing at the waist' (noun + verb stem, converb; stem uncertain) [腰窩戮着]
glossary.qadqužu: qadqu- — to thrust in, to stab (Ming 插); converb -žu, 'thrusting in' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [插着]
glossary.qaγačaγ̇ulba: qaγača- — to part, to separate; causative -γ̇ul- + past -ba, 'caused to part, parted (them)' (verb, causative past) [敎離了]
glossary.qaγačaγ̇ulun: qaγača- — to part, to separate; causative -γ̇ul- + converb -un, 'causing to part' (verb, causative converb, after a consonant) [敎離了]
glossary.üges-türi: üge — word, speech; plural -s, dative-locative -tür, with Shiratori's (i), 'in the words' (noun + plural + case; the token left before -jen, 'in one's own words'; Ming 言語(每)裏) [言語(每)裏自的行]
glossary.amγ̇ulžu: amu- — to be at peace, at rest (stem inferred from the Ming 安 'peace'); causative -γ̇ul- + converb -žu, 'setting at ease' (here written amγ̇ul-, the u dropped) (verb, causative converb) [敎安着]
glossary.saiqatur: saiqan — good, fine (stem uncertain); -tur, adverbial ending (uncertain; the Ming 好好的), 'well, nicely' (adjective + adverbial ending) [好好 的]
glossary.ügüdkün: ög- — to give (as in ögün and ögüġed; Shiratori prints ügü-); -dkün, imperative, second person plural, 'give, you (pl.)' (verb, ending uncertain; Ming 與您) [與您]
glossary.taičar: Taičar — Taichar, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.žalama-jin: Žalama — Jalama, a mountain name (Ming 山名); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Jalama' (place name + case) [山名的]
glossary.ölegei-bulaγ-a: Ölegei-Bulaγ — Ölegei-Bulaq, a place name (bulaγ 'spring'); dative-locative -a, 'at, to' (place name + case, back-vowel form) [地名(行)]
glossary.saγ̇ari-keġer-e: Saγ̇ari-Keġer — Sa'ari-Ke'er, a place name (Ming 地名); dative-locative -e, 'at, to' (place name + case, front-vowel form) [地名 行]
glossary.bükü: bü- — to be; participle -kü, 'being, that is' (the Ming 有的) (verb, participle) [有的]
glossary.žüči-darmala-jin: Žüči-Darmala — Jüchi-Darmala, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Jüchi-Darmala' (personal name + case) [人名的]
glossary.deġermedüre: deġermed- — to plunder, to raid (Ming 搶劫, from deġerme); linking vowel -ü- + -re, purposive 'in order to plunder' (verb, purposive; ending uncertain) [搶劫]
glossary.žüči-darmala: Žüči-Darmala — Jüchi-Darmala, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.aduγ̇u-ban: aduγ̇u(n) — herd, horse-herd (an n-stem noun; Ming 馬羣); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own herd' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [馬羣 自的行]
glossary.nöködi: nökör — companion; plural -d with Shiratori's (i), 'companions' (noun + plural; the token left before -jen, 'one's own companions'; Ming 伴當每) [伴當每 自的行]
glossary.žürüge: žürüge — heart (the same word as žirüge) (noun) [心]
glossary.jadaγdažu: jada- — to be unable, to lack the strength (stem inferred from the Ming 不敢); passive -γda- + converb -žu, 'being unable' (verb, passive converb; the Ming 被 marks the passive) [被不敢着]
glossary.aduγ̇un-u-γ̇an: aduγ̇u(n) — herd, horse-herd; genitive -u + reflexive-possessive -γ̇an, 'of one's own herd' (noun + case + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form; Ming 馬羣 自的行) [馬羣 自的行]
glossary.kižiγ̇ar-a: kižiγ̇ar — edge, border (noun); dative-locative -a, 'at the edge' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [邊行]
glossary.morin-u-γ̇an: morin — horse; genitive -u + reflexive-possessive -γ̇an, 'of one's own horse' (noun + case + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [馬 自的(行)]
glossary.helige-beri: helige — (uncertain: the Ming 伏臥 'lying prone'; elsewhere helige means 'liver'); instrumental -ber with Shiratori's (i), 'prone' (the token left before -jen; noun + case, analysis uncertain) [伏臥]
glossary.taičar-un: Taičar — Taichar, a man's name; genitive -un after a consonant, 'of Taichar' (personal name + case, back-vowel form) [人名 的]
glossary.niruγ̇u: niruγ̇u — spine, backbone (Ming 脊梁) (noun) [脊梁]
glossary.alaγ̇ad: ala- — to kill; converb -γ̇ad, 'having killed' (verb, converb of completed action, back-vowel form) [(殺︀)了]
glossary.taičar-i: Taičar — Taichar, a man's name; accusative -i, 'Taichar' as object (personal name + case) [人名行]
glossary.alaγdaba: ala- — to kill; passive -γda- + past -ba, 'was killed' (verb, passive past) [被殺︀了]
glossary.alaγ̇iγ̇ud: Alaγ̇iγ̇ud — the Alaqiqud, a mountain name (Ming 山名; the -d is a plural) [山名]
glossary.turqaγ̇udi: Turqaγ̇ud — the Turqaqud, a mountain name (Ming 山名; the -d is a plural) with Shiratori's (i); the token left before -jar, 'along, by way of the Turqaqud' (place name + case; Ming 依着) [(山名)依着]
glossary.dabažu: daba- — to cross over, to pass (verb); converb -žu, 'crossing' (back-vowel form; Ming 越過) [越過着]
glossary.qaγan-dur: qaγan — qan, sovereign, emperor; dative-locative -dur, 'to the qan' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝 行]
glossary.aisai: ai- — to come (stem uncertain); -sai, ending of the present, 'is coming' (verb, ending uncertain; the Ming 來也) [來也]
glossary.ikires-eče: Ikires — the Ikires, a people (Ming 種名); ablative -eče, 'from the Ikires' (people name + case, front-vowel form) [種名處]
glossary.mülke-totaγ: Mülke-Totaγ — Mülke-Totaq, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.boroldai: Boroldai — Boroldai, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.külelkü-de: Külelkü — a place name (Ming 地名; compare Kürelkü, printed with r, perhaps the same); dative-locative -de, 'at' (place name + case, front-vowel form) [地名 行]
glossary.medeġed: mede- — to know; converb -ġed, 'having known' (verb, converb of completed action, front-vowel form) [知了]
glossary.küreġed: küreġe(n) — ring of tents, circle camp (as küreġen, kürejen; Ming 圈子); plural -d, 'rings of tents' (noun + plural) [圈子每]
glossary.γurban-kü: γurban — three; -kü, particle 'also, indeed' (Ming 也), 'three too' (numeral + particle; the force is uncertain) [三也]
glossary.dalan-balžud-ta: Dalan-Balžud — Dalan-Baljut, a place name (Ming 地名); dative-locative -ta, 'at' (place name + case, after a consonant, back-vowel form) [地名行]
glossary.baildužu: bai- — to stand; reciprocal -ldu- + converb -žu, 'standing against one another, joining battle' (verb, reciprocal converb; Ming 對戰) [對戰着] · also with Ming 立着 'standing', in naγ̇ur baildu baildužu, 'standing in array'
glossary.ködülgegdežü: ködülge- — to set in motion, to drive off (stem uncertain; Ming 推動); passive -gde- + converb -žü, 'being driven off' (verb, passive converb, front-vowel form) [被推動着]
glossary.onon-u: Onon — the Onon, a river (Ming 河名); genitive -u, 'of the Onon' (river name + case) [河名 的]
glossary.čerene: Čerene — Cherene, a place name (Ming 地名) [地名]
glossary.qabčiγaj-a: qabčiγai — narrow place, gorge, defile (Ming 狹處); dative-locative -a, 'in the gorge' (noun + case, after -i with the glide j) [狹處(行)]
glossary.qorba: qor- — to take shelter, to hide (Ming 躱); past -ba, 'hid' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [躱了]
glossary.čerene-de: Čerene — Cherene, a place name; dative-locative -de, 'at, to Cherene' (place name + case, front-vowel form) [地名 行]
glossary.qorγaba: qor- — to take shelter, to hide; causative -γa- + past -ba, 'caused to hide, sheltered (them)' (verb, causative past) [敎躱了]
glossary.qarirun: qari- — to return, to turn back; converb of time -run, 'when returning' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [囘時]
glossary.činos-un: Činos — the Chinos, a clan name (Ming 地名); genitive -un, 'of the Chinos' (clan name + case, back-vowel form) [地名的]
glossary.toγoγ̇od: toγoγ̇a — cauldron, pot (Ming 鍋); plural -d, 'cauldrons' (noun + plural) [鍋每]
glossary.bučalγažu: bučal- — to boil (Ming 滾); causative -γa- + converb -žu, 'causing to boil, boiling (them)' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form) [敎滾着]
glossary.neġüdei-čaγaγ̇an-uγ̇a-jin: Neġüdei-Čaγaγ̇an-Uγ̇a — Negüdei-Chaqa'an-Uqa, a man's name (a three-part personal name); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Negüdei-Chaqa'an-Uqa' [人名的]
glossary.hoγtolžu: hoγtol- — to cut off (stem inferred from the Ming 斷); converb -žu, 'cutting off' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [斷着]
glossary.morin-u: morin — horse; genitive -u, 'of the horse' (noun + case) [馬的]
glossary.seġül-dür: seġül — tail; dative-locative -dür, 'at, by the tail' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [尾 行]
glossary.uruγ̇ud-un: Uruγ̇ud — the Uruqud, a people (Ming 種名); genitive -un, 'of the Uruqud' (people name + case, back-vowel form) [種名的]
glossary.žürčedei: Žürčedei — Jürchedei, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.uruγ̇udi: Uruγ̇ud — the Uruqud, a people; with Shiratori's (i), 'the Uruqud' as object (the token left before -jan, 'one's own Uruqud'; people name + accusative; Ming 一種 自的行) [一種 自的行] · also the token left before the instrumental -jar, 'with the Uruqud' (Ming 領着 'leading')
glossary.uduriduγ̇ad: udurid- — to lead, to take at the head (Ming 領); linking vowel + converb -γ̇ad, 'having led' (verb, converb of completed action, back-vowel form) [領了]
glossary.moṅγud-un: Moṅγud — the Mongqud, a people (Ming 種名); genitive -un, 'of the Mongqud' (people name + case, back-vowel form) [種名(的)]
glossary.qujuldar: Qujuldar — Qujuldar, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.moṅγudi: Moṅγud — the Mongqud, a people; with Shiratori's (i), 'the Mongqud' as object (the token left before -jan, 'one's own Mongqud'; people name + accusative; Ming 一種 自的行) [一種 自的行]
glossary.qoṅγodadai: Qoṅγodadai — the Qongqotadai, a clan name (Ming 種姓) [種姓(名)]
glossary.köġüd-lüġe-ben: köġün — son; plural -d, comitative -lüġe, reflexive-possessive -ben, 'together with one's own sons' (noun + plural + case + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form) [兒子 一同自的行]
glossary.edün: edün — these (plural of ene; Ming 這些每) (demonstrative pronoun) [這些每]
glossary.ör: ör — self, own (printed ör-, probably for ö'er, the line break splitting the word; Ming 自己) [自己]
glossary.türi: -tür — dative-locative: at, in (front-vowel form), with Shiratori's (i); the token left before -jen, 'in one's own' (case suffix; Ming 裏(自的)行) [裏(自的)行]
glossary.taiču-tan: Taiču — Taichu, a man's name; -tan, 'and those with him' (personal name + group suffix; uncertain, the Ming 等 'and others') [(人)名(等)]
glossary.onan-nu: Onan — the Onon, a river (Ming 河名); genitive -nu (the n belongs to the spelling of the stem), 'of the Onon' (river name + case) [河名 的]
glossary.qurimlaja: qurimla- — to hold a feast (from qurim 'feast'; Ming 做筵席); -ja, hortative 'let us ...' (Ming 咱; ending uncertain) (verb, hortative) [做筵席咱]
glossary.qurimlarun: qurimla- — to hold a feast (from qurim 'feast'); converb of time -run, 'when holding a feast' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [筵席時]
glossary.höġelun: Höġelün — Högelün, a woman's name (personal name; spelled here -lun) [(母)名]
glossary.qasar-a: Qasar — Qasar, a man's name; dative-locative -a, 'to Qasar' (personal name + case, back-vowel form) [人名 行]
glossary.sača-beki-de: Sača-Beki — Sacha-Beki, a man's name; dative-locative -de, 'to Sacha-Beki' (personal name + case, front-vowel form) [人名 行]
glossary.teriġülen: teriġüle- — to take as head, to begin with (from teriġü 'head'); converb -n, 'heading, beginning with' (verb, converb) [爲頭]
glossary.tüsürge: tüsürge — jar, large vessel (Ming 甕) (noun) [甕] · also 'banquet, drinking-party' (Ming 酒局 'wine office'; the sense of tüsürge-jin; uncertain), as in jeke tüsürge barin atuγai 'let them stay to hold the great banquet'
glossary.tüsürčüġüi: tüsür- — to pour out (Ming 傾); past -čüġüi, 'poured' (verb, past ending, front-vowel form) [傾了]
glossary.sača-beki-jin: Sača-Beki — Sacha-Beki, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Sacha-Beki' (personal name + case) [人名 的]
glossary.ebegei-ji: Ebegei — Ebegei, a woman's name; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Ebegei' as object (personal name + case) [人名 行]
glossary.tüsürküi-jin: tüsür- — to pour out; participle -küi, 'which was poured' + genitive -jin, 'of the pouring, of what was poured' (verb, participle + case) [傾了 的]
glossary.qorižin: Qorižin — Qorijin, a woman's name (personal name) [婦人名]
glossary.quγ̇určin: Quγ̇určin — Qughurchin, a woman's name (personal name) [婦人名]
glossary.nama: nama — me (the oblique stem of bi 'I', as in nama-ji; here with no ending, the Ming 行 reading it as 'for me') (pronoun) [我行]
glossary.tüsürüjü: tüsür- — to pour out; -üjü, ending of the present, 'is pouring' (verb, ending uncertain; the Ming 傾有) [傾有]
glossary.baγ̇urči: baγ̇urči — cook, steward of the food (Ming 厨子) (noun) [厨子]
glossary.šikiγ̇ur-i: Šikiγ̇ur — Shikiur, a man's name; accusative -i, 'Shikiur' as object (personal name + case) [人名 行]
glossary.ašigižuγ̇ui: ašigi- — to beat, to strike (stem inferred from the Ming 打); past -žuγ̇ui, 'beat' (verb, past ending, back-vowel form) [打了]
glossary.ašigiγ: ašigi- — to beat, to strike; the first part of the passive -γ(da)-, split by the line break (verb stem + passive, first half) [被打]
glossary.dažu: -da- — the rest of the passive -γda-, split by the line break: be ...ed; with converb -žu, 'being beaten' (passive suffix + converb, second half) [着]
glossary.šikiγ̇ur: Šikiγ̇ur — Shikiur, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.üküküi-jin: ükü- — to die; participle -küi, 'dying' + genitive -jin, 'of the dying, of the death' (verb, participle + case) [死 的]
glossary.ašigiγdaqui: ašigi- — to beat, to strike; passive -γda- + participle -qui, 'being beaten, being struck' (verb, passive participle; the Ming 的) [被打的]
glossary.uilažuγ̇ui: uila- — to weep, to cry (Ming 哭); past -žuγ̇ui, 'wept' (verb, past ending, back-vowel form) [哭了]
glossary.bain: bai- — to stand, stay; converb -n, 'standing' (verb, converb) [立]
glossary.žürkin-eče: Žürkin — the Jurkin, a Mongol clan (clan name); ablative -eče, 'from the Jurkin' (clan name + case, front-vowel form) [種(名)行]
glossary.žasan: žasa- — to prepare, set in order; converb -n, 'arranging' (verb, converb) [整治]
glossary.kilüġese-eče: kilüġese — place of dismounting (stem uncertain; read from the Ming 下馬處); ablative -eče, 'from the dismounting-place' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [下馬處]
glossary.qadagidai: Qadagidai — Qadagidai, a clan name (clan name) [種(名)]
glossary.qulaγuγsan-i: qulaγu- — to steal (stem inferred from the Ming 偷); past participle -γsan, 'who has stolen, which was stolen'; accusative -i (verb, participle + case) [偷了的 行]
glossary.küġü-ben: küġün — man, person (küġü- before a suffix); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own' (noun + reflexive-possessive; Ming 人 自的行) [人 自的行]
glossary.qoimasču: qoimas- — to shield, protect (stem uncertain; read from the Ming 護); converb -ču, 'shielding' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [護着]
glossary.nasuda: nasuda — as usual, as always (adverb; read from the Ming 如常; uncertain) [如常]
glossary.abaldurun: abal- — to grapple, wrestle (stem inferred from the Ming 相搏); -du- reciprocal, 'one another' (uncertain); converb of time -run, 'when grappling' (verb, converb) [相搏]
glossary.qanču-ban: qanču — sleeve (noun); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form; Ming 袖 自的行) [袖 自的行]
glossary.ničügün: ničügün — bare, naked (adjective; Ming 赤裸) [赤裸]
glossary.jabuqu: jabu- — to walk, go about; participle -qu (verb, participle; the Ming gives 行 alone) [行]
glossary.mültülügsen: mültül- — to strip off, pull off; past participle -ügsen, 'stripped, bared' (verb, participle, front-vowel form) [脫了的]
glossary.üldü-ġer: üldü — sabre, sword (Ming 環刀, 'ring-sword'); instrumental -ġer, 'with a sabre' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [敎環刀]
glossary.čabčižuγ̇u: čabči- — to chop, cut down (stem inferred from the Ming 砍); past -žuγ̇u, 'cut' (verb, past, back-vowel form; the ending is uncertain) [砍了]
glossary.čabčiγdažu: čabči- — to chop, cut down (stem inferred from the Ming 砍); passive -γda-; converb -žu, 'being cut' (verb, passive converb, back-vowel form) [被砍着]
glossary.jeṅgeren: jeṅgere- — to come (stem uncertain; read from the Ming 來); converb -n, 'coming' (verb, converb) [來]
glossary.čuburiγ̇ulžu: čuburi- — to trickle, flow in drops (stem inferred from the Ming 溜); causative -γ̇ul-; converb -žu, 'letting trickle' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form) [敎溜着]
glossary.jabuqui-ji: jabu- — to walk, go about; participle -qui + accusative -ji (after a vowel), 'the going' (verb, participle + case; Ming 行的 行) [行的 行]
glossary.seġüder-tür: seġüder — shade, shadow (noun); dative-locative -tür, 'in the shade' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [影 裏]
glossary.dotorāča: dotor — inside, interior (noun); ablative -āča, 'from inside' (the long vowel runs the stem vowel into -ača) [裏處]
glossary.kigden: ki- — to do, make; passive -gde-; converb -n, 'being done' (verb, passive converb) [被做]
glossary.kēküi-dür: keġe- — to say; participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'at the saying, when saying' (printed with long ē for keġe-; verb, participle + case; Ming 說時) [說時]
glossary.mer: mer — wound, injury (noun; stem read from the Ming 傷) [傷]
glossary.deġü-dür: deġü — younger brother (noun); dative-locative -dür, 'to the younger brother' (noun + case, front-vowel form; Ming 弟 行) [弟 行]
glossary.maγ̇uγalin: maγ̇uγa- — to blame, find fault (from maγ̇u 'bad'; the stem is a guess from the Ming 怪); -lin ending, 'one another' (reciprocal converb; uncertain) [相怪]
glossary.bolulčaγ̇užai: bol- — to become; -ulča- reciprocal or 'together' (uncertain); apprehensive -γ̇užai, 'lest, for fear that' (back-vowel form; read from the Ming 恐) [恐做]
glossary.alžaqu: alža- — to hinder, be in the way (stem inferred from the Ming 礙事); participle -qu, 'hindering' (verb, participle) [礙事]
glossary.ilaγ̇ari: ilaγ̇a- — to excel, be better (stem inferred from the Ming 較好); ending -ri (uncertain) [較好]
glossary.ižilidülčen: ižili- — to become used to (stem inferred from the Ming 慣熟); -dül- reciprocal, 'one another' (uncertain); -čen ending (uncertain; participle?) [慣熟]
glossary.qorumud: qorumud — for a while, meanwhile (adverb; read from the Ming 且; the -d is unexplained) [且]
glossary.idqaγ̇asu: idqa- — to urge, persuade (stem inferred from the Ming 勸); conditional -γ̇asu, 'if, when' (verb, conditional, back-vowel form; Ming 呵) [勸呵] · also idqa- — here 'to admonish, caution' (Ming 勸當呵)
glossary.modun-u: modun — tree, wood (noun); genitive -u, 'of the tree' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [木的]
glossary.itügesün: itügesün — leather tub or vat (word and ending uncertain; read from the Ming 皮桶的) [皮桶的]
glossary.büleġüd: büleġü — churn-pole, plunger for beating mare's milk (read from the Ming 撞馬乳椎); plural -d (noun + plural) [撞馬乳椎]
glossary.suγučižu: suγuči- — to pull out, draw out (stem inferred from the Ming 抽出); converb -žu, 'pulling out' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [抽出着]
glossary.ašigilaldužu: ašigi- — to beat, strike (stem inferred from the Ming 打); -la- verb-maker (uncertain); -ldu- reciprocal, 'one another'; converb -žu, 'fighting one another' (verb, converb) [厮打着]
glossary.žürkin-i: Žürkin — the Jurkin, a Mongol clan (clan name); accusative -i, 'the Jurkin' as object (name + case; Ming 人名 行) [人名 行]
glossary.ilaγču: ilaγ̇a- — to excel, overcome (stem inferred from the Ming 勝); converb -ču, 'overcoming' (verb, converb, back-vowel form; printed ilaγču) [勝着]
glossary.žokilduja: žoki- — to be fitting, agree (stem inferred from the Ming 和); -ldu- reciprocal, 'one another'; hortative -ja, 'let us …' (verb, hortative, first person plural; Ming 商和咱) [商和咱]
glossary.keġegdežü: keġe- — to say; passive -gde-; converb -žü, 'being told' (verb, passive converb, front-vowel form) [被說着]
glossary.ičuγ̇ažu: ič- — to withdraw, retreat (stem inferred); causative -uγ̇a-; converb -žu, 'sending back' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form) [退着]
glossary.elčileldün: elči — envoy; -le- verb-maker, reciprocal -ldü-, 'to and fro'; converb -n, 'going to and fro as envoys' (noun-derived verb, converb; Ming 使臣往來) [使臣往來]
glossary.kitad: Kitad — the Khitans, a people (people name; the -d is probably a plural) [契丹] · here the Jin state and its people (Ming 金國), the Khitan name carried over to the Jurchen empire
glossary.megüžin-seġültü-ten: Megüžin-Seġültü — Megüjin-Se'ültü, a Tatar man's name (personal name); -ten, 'and those having …, and the like' (name + possessive plural; Ming 人名等) [人名等]
glossary.eje-düri: eje — counsel, consulting (stem unknown; read from the Ming 商量); dative-locative -dür, 'in counsel'; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token before the reflexive -(i)jen: 'in one's own counsel' (noun + case) [商量 自的行]
glossary.oroγdarun: oro- — to enter; passive -γda-; converb of time -run, 'when entered, when coming in' (verb, passive converb; Ming 見入) [見入]
glossary.waṅgiṅ-žaṅsijaṅ-a: Waṅgiṅ-Žaṅsijaṅ — Wang-Jing Chancellor, a man's name (Chinese Wangjing, chancellor; personal name); dative-locative -a, 'to Wang-Jing Chancellor' (name + case, back-vowel form) [人名行]
glossary.saγ̇ara: saγ̇a- — to doubt, hesitate (stem inferred from the Ming 疑); ending -ra (uncertain) [疑]
glossary.iležüġüi: ile- — to send; past ending -žüġüi, 'sent' (verb, past, front-vowel form; uncertain) [去了] · also 'went' (ile- as 'to go', uncertain; compare ileġed)
glossary.waṅgiṅ-žaṅsijaṅ: Waṅgiṅ-Žaṅsijaṅ — Wang-Jing Chancellor, a man's name (Chinese Wangjing, chancellor; personal name) [人名]
glossary.megüžin-seġültü: Megüžin-Seġültü — Megüjin-Se'ültü, a Tatar man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.ulža: Ulža — Ulja, a river (water name) [水名]
glossary.selte: selte — with, bringing along (word uncertain; read from the Ming 帶) [帶] · also 'together with, including' (Ming 連) [連]
glossary.türižü: türi- — to push, drive (stem inferred from the Ming 推動); converb -žü, 'driving, pushing' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [推動着]
glossary.medebe: mede- — to know; past -be, 'learned, got to know' (verb, past tense, front-vowel form; Ming 知了) [知了]
glossary.ebüges: ebüge — grandfather, forefather (read from the Ming 祖宗); plural -s, 'forefathers' (noun + plural) [祖︀宗]
glossary.ečiges-i: ečige — father (noun); plural -s, 'fathers'; accusative -i, 'the fathers' as object (noun + plural + case; Ming 父親(每)行) [父親(每)行]
glossary.öšiten: öši — grudge, feud (read from the Ming 讐); possessive plural -ten, 'those having a feud, feuding' (noun + possessive plural; Ming 讐有的(每)) [讐有的(每)]
glossary.qanalγa-dur: qanalγa — occasion, opportunity (stem unknown; read from the Ming 機會); dative-locative -dur, 'at the occasion' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [機會 裏]
glossary.qamsaja: qamsa- — to join, combine (stem inferred from the Ming 併); hortative -ja, 'let us join' (verb, hortative, first person plural; Ming 併咱) [併咱]
glossary.qān-u: qān — ruler, sovereign, khan (title, the short form beside qaγan); genitive -u, 'of the Qan' (title + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝的]
glossary.keġemüi: keġe- — to say; present -müi, '… says, it is said' (verb, present; Ming 說有) [說有]
glossary.elčin: elčin — envoy, messenger (noun; Ming 使臣) [使臣]
glossary.čerigi: čerig — soldier, army (noun); the (i) is Shiratori's, the token before the reflexive -(i)jen: 'one's own troops' [軍 自的行] · also the token left in čerig(i)-jer, 'with the army' (the (i) is Shiratori's; Ming 軍(依着))
glossary.čiγ̇ulγažu: čiγ̇ul- — to gather, assemble (stem inferred from the Ming 聚); causative -γa-; converb -žu, 'making gather' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form) [敎聚着]
glossary.igtünežü: igtüne- — to hasten, go quickly toward (stem unknown; read from the Ming (赴着), the brackets are the glossator's); converb -žü (verb, converb, front-vowel form; uncertain) [(赴着)]
glossary.žürukin-e: Žürukin — the Jurkin, a Mongol clan (clan name; a spelling of Žürkin); dative-locative -e, 'to the Jurkin' (name + case, front-vowel form) [種名 行]
glossary.iregdeküi-eče: ire- — to come; passive -gde-, participle -küi, ablative -eče, 'from the being-come-to' (verb, passive participle + case, front-vowel form; Ming 被來的 行) [被來的 行]
glossary.eġüsčü: eġüsge- — to begin, set out, set going; converb -čü, 'setting out' (verb, converb, front-vowel form; printed eġüsčü) [起着]
glossary.waṅgiṅ-žaṅsijaṅ-luγ̇a: Waṅgiṅ-Žaṅsijaṅ — Wang-Jing Chancellor, a man's name (personal name); comitative -luγ̇a, 'together with Wang-Jing Chancellor' (name + case, back-vowel form) [人名一同]
glossary.qamsan: qamsa- — to join, combine (stem inferred from the Ming 併); converb -n, 'joining' (verb, converb) [併]
glossary.ulža-jin: Ulža — Ulja, a river (water name); genitive -jin, 'of the Ulja' (after a vowel; name + case) [水名 的]
glossary.qusutu-šitüġen: Qusutu-Šitüġen — Qusutu-Shitügen, a place name (place name; Ming 地名) [地名]
glossary.naratu: Naratu — Naratu, a place name, the first half of Naratu-Šitüġen, broken at a line end in the print (place name; Ming 地) [地]
glossary.šitüġen-e: Šitüġen — Shitügen, the second half of the place name Naratu-Šitüġen; dative-locative -e, 'at, to' (place name + case, front-vowel form; Ming 名行) [名行]
glossary.megüžin: Megüžin — Megüjin, the first element of Megüžin-Seġültü used alone, before teriġüten 'and those' (personal name; Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.qorγa: qorγa — fort, stockade (noun; read from the Ming 寨子) [寨子]
glossary.qorγalaγsad-i: qorγala- — to hold a fort (qorγa 'fort' with -la- verb-maker); past participle plural -γsad, 'those who have held'; accusative -i (verb, participle + case; Ming 寨子把了的(每)行) [寨子把了的(每)行]
glossary.megüžin-seġültü-ji: Megüžin-Seġültü — Megüjin-Se'ültü, a Tatar man's name (personal name); accusative -ji (after a vowel), 'Megüjin-Se'ültü' as object (name + case; Ming 人名 行) [人名 行]
glossary.qorγan-ača: qorγan — fort (probably a form of qorγa; noun); ablative -ača, 'from the fort' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [寨子處]
glossary.ölegei: ölegei — cradle (noun; read from the Ming 搖車) [搖車]
glossary.tanatu: tana — large pearl (read from the Ming 大珠); possessive -tu, 'having, with' (noun + possessive, back-vowel form) [大珠有的]
glossary.künžile: künžile — quilt, coverlet (noun; read from the Ming 被) [被]
glossary.abulaγ̇ai: ab- — to take; past ending -ulaγ̇ai, 'took' (verb, past; ending uncertain, read from the Ming 要了來) [要了來]
glossary.alaba: ala- — to kill; past -ba, 'killed' (verb, past tense, back-vowel form) [殺︀了]
glossary.alažuγ̇ui: ala- — to kill; past ending -žuγ̇ui, 'killed' (verb, past, back-vowel form; uncertain) [殺︀了]
glossary.žaγ̇ud-quri: Žaγ̇ud-quri — Ja'ud-quri, an official title (title; Ming (官名), 'an official's name') [(官名)]
glossary.toγ̇oril-a: Toγ̇oril — To'oril, a man's name (personal name); dative-locative -a, 'to To'oril' (name + case, back-vowel form) [人名 行]
glossary.waṅ: Waṅ — Wang, a title (Chinese wang 'prince'; title; Ming 王) [王]
glossary.waṅgiṅ-žaṅsijaṅ-un: Waṅgiṅ-Žaṅsijaṅ — Wang-Jing Chancellor, a man's name (personal name); genitive -un, 'of Wang-Jing Chancellor' (name + case, back-vowel form, after a consonant) [人名 的]
glossary.nereidügseġer: nere- — to name (nere 'name'); -id- verb-former (uncertain); past participle -ügse(n) with instrumental -ġer, 'because of having named, by the naming' (verb, participle + case; the final n is lost before -ġer, uncertain; Ming 名了的上頭) [名了的上頭]
glossary.qamsažu: qamsa- — to join, combine (stem inferred from the Ming 併); converb -žu, 'joining' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [併着]
glossary.alaγsan: ala- — to kill; past participle -γsan, 'having killed, which has killed' (verb, participle) [殺︀了的]
glossary.qān-a: qān — ruler, sovereign, khan (title, the short form beside qaγan); dative-locative -a, 'to the Qan' (title + case, back-vowel form) [皇帝行]
glossary.kibe: ki- — to do, make; past -be, 'did, made' (verb, past tense, front-vowel form) [做了]
glossary.tusa-ji: tusa — use, help, benefit (noun); accusative -ji (after a vowel), 'the service' as object (noun + case; Ming 濟的行) [濟的行]
glossary.öčisü: öči- — to report to a superior (stem inferred from the Ming 奏); -sü optative, first person: 'let me, I shall' (verb, optative; uncertain) [奏]
glossary.eġün-eče: eġün — this one (demonstrative pronoun, the oblique stem of ene); ablative -eče, 'than this' (pronoun + case, front-vowel form; Ming 比這箇行) [比這箇行]
glossary.nemeküi-ji: neme- — to add; participle -küi + accusative -ji (after a vowel), 'the adding' as object (verb, participle + case; Ming 添的 行) [添的 行]
glossary.čaotao: čaotao — Chaotao, an official rank (Chinese zhaotao; Ming 官) [官]
glossary.ögkü-ji: ög- — to give; participle -kü + accusative -ji (after a vowel), 'the giving' as object (verb, participle + case; Ming 與的 行) [與的 行]
glossary.qubijaldužu: qubi — share, portion (stem read from the Ming 分); -ja- verb-maker (uncertain); -ldu- reciprocal, 'among themselves'; converb -žu, 'sharing out' (noun-derived verb, converb, back-vowel form; Ming 共分着) [共分着]
glossary.abulčažu: ab- — to take; -ulča- reciprocal or 'together' (uncertain); converb -žu, 'taking together' (verb, converb, back-vowel form; Ming 共要着) [共要着]
glossary.qorγalaγsan: qorγala- — to hold a fort (qorγa 'fort' with -la- verb-maker); past participle -γsan, 'who has held a fort' (verb, participle; Ming 寨子把了的) [寨子把了的]
glossary.naratu-šitüġen-e: Naratu-Šitüġen — Naratu-Shitügen, a place name (place name); dative-locative -e, 'at Naratu-Shitügen' (name + case, front-vowel form; Ming 地名(行)) [地名(行)]
glossary.baγ̇uγsan: baγ̇u- — to descend, come down; here 'settle in, camp'; past participle -γsan, 'who has settled' (verb, participle; Ming 下來的) [下來的]
glossary.talaqui-dur: tala- — to plunder, raid (stem inferred from the Ming 搶); participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'at the plundering, when plundered' (verb, participle + case, back-vowel form; Ming 搶 時) [搶 時]
glossary.üčüken: üčüken — small, little (adjective; Ming 小) [小]
glossary.gegsen-i: geg- — to leave behind, cast aside (stem inferred from the Ming 撇); past participle -sen, 'who was left behind'; accusative -i (verb, participle + case) [撇了的 行]
glossary.olžuγ̇ui: ol- — to find, get; past ending -žuγ̇ui, 'got' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [得了]
glossary.eġemeg: eġemeg — hoop, circlet (word uncertain; read from the Ming 圈的) [圈的]
glossary.dörebčitü: dörebči — ring (read from the Ming 環子); possessive -tü, 'having, with' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [環子 有的]
glossary.daži: daži — gold, or a gold-worked stuff (word and sense uncertain; the Ming glosses only 金 'gold') [金]
glossary.torγan: torγan — silk (read from the Ming 紵絲) [紵絲]
glossary.buluγa-γ̇ar: buluγa — sable (read from the Ming 貂鼠皮); instrumental -γ̇ar, 'with, by' (noun + case, back-vowel form; Ming (用)) [貂鼠皮(用)]
glossary.dotorlaγsan: dotor — inside, lining (noun); -la- verb-maker, 'to line'; past participle -γsan, 'which has been lined' (noun-derived verb, participle; Ming 做裏兒的) [做裏兒的]
glossary.heligebčitü: heligebči — bib, belly-cover (read from the Ming 兜肚); possessive -tü, 'having, with' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [兜肚 有的]
glossary.soγa: soγa — gift, present (noun; read from the Ming 人事, 'courtesy, gift') [人事]
glossary.küġün-ü: küġün — man, person (noun); genitive -ü, 'of a man' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [人的]
glossary.ažuγ̇u-že: a- — to be; past ažuγ̇u, 'there was, he was' (the ending -žuγ̇u, uncertain); particle -že, 'indeed, so' (verb, past + particle; Ming 有(來)也者︀) [有(來)也者︀]
glossary.žirγoduγ̇ar: žirγoduγar — sixth (ordinal numeral; Ming 第六) [第六]
glossary.šikigen-quduqu: Šikigen-Quduqu — Shikigen-Quduqu, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.aγ̇uruγ: aγ̇uruγ — rear camp, where the old, the young and the baggage stayed (noun; Ming 老小營, 'camp of old and young') [老小營]
glossary.hariltu: Hariltu — a lake (water name; Ming gives only 水名) [水名]
glossary.naγ̇ur-a: naγ̇ur — lake (noun; Ming 海子 'sea-child') + dative-locative -a, 'at the lake' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [海︀子行]
glossary.aγ̇uruγ̇ud-tur: aγ̇uruγ — rear camp, where the old, the young and the baggage stayed (noun; Ming 老小營) + plural -ud (the printed aγ̇uruγ̇ud has -ud after γ) + dative-locative -tur, 'in the rear camps' (noun + plural + case, back-vowel form) [老小營(每)裏]
glossary.qosoruγsan-i: qosoru- — to be left behind (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 落後); past participle -γsan 'who has been left behind' + accusative -i (verb, participle + case; uncertain) [落後的 行]
glossary.žürkin: Žürkin — the Jurkin, a Mongol clan (clan name; Žürukin is a variant spelling) [種名]
glossary.haran-u: haran — common people, men (noun) + genitive -u, 'of the people' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [人的]
glossary.tonožuγ̇ui: tono- — to strip, plunder (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 剝脫); past ending -žuγ̇ui, 'stripped' (verb, past, back-vowel form; uncertain) [剝脫了]
glossary.qosoruγsad: qosoru- — to be left behind (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 落後); -γsad, plural past participle, 'those who were left behind' (verb, participle, plural) [落後的每]
glossary.žaγ̇abasu: žaγ̇a- — to tell, report (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 吿); conditional-temporal -basu, 'if, when told' (verb, conditional, back-vowel form) [吿呵]
glossary.sonosuγ̇ad: sonos- — to hear, listen (verb); -uγ̇ad, converb of completed action, 'having heard' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [聽了]
glossary.kiliṅlažu: kiliṅla- — to be angry (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 怒); converb -žu, 'being angry' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [怒着]
glossary.qurimlaqui: qurim — feast, banquet (noun) + verb-maker -la- 'to feast' + participle -qui, 'feasting, feast-time' (noun + verb-maker + participle; printed 'qurimlaqui- dur', Shiratori's hyphen breaking the word before dur) [筵席]
glossary.müd-kü: müd — they (third-person plural; Ming 他每; analysis uncertain) + kü, particle 'also, even' (pronoun + particle; uncertain) [他每 也]
glossary.ašigiba: ašigi- — to strike, beat (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 打); past -ba, 'struck' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [打了]
glossary.čabčiba: čabči- — to cut, chop (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 砍); past -ba, 'cut down' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [砍了]
glossary.kigten: kig — resentment, grievance (noun; stem inferred from the Ming 怨) + possessive plural -ten, 'those having a grievance' (noun + possessive, plural, front-vowel form; uncertain) [怨有的(每)]
glossary.ese-kü: ese — not (negative of the past) + kü, particle 'also, even' (negative + particle; uncertain) [不曾 也]
glossary.iregdebe: iregde- — to break, be broken, or ire- 'come' with a passive -gde- (verb; stem and sense uncertain); past -be (verb, passive past, front-vowel form) [破來了]
glossary.daisun-dur: daisun — enemy (noun) + dative-locative -dur, 'against the enemy, as an enemy' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [敵 行]
glossary.daisun: daisun — enemy (noun) [敵] · also Ming 反 'turned against, rebel', in daisun bolun, 'becoming an enemy'
glossary.bolulaγ̇i: bolu- — to become, be made (verb; as in boluba, boluγ̇ad) + -laγ̇i, past 'became, has become' (the back-vowel partner of -leġei in büleġei; Ming 了; uncertain) (verb, past; uncertain) [做了]
glossary.žürkin-dür: Žürkin — the Jurkin, a Mongol clan (clan name) + dative-locative -dür, 'against, to the Jurkin'; also 'in, among the Jurkin' (name + case, front-vowel form) [種(名) 行]
glossary.ködöġe-aral-ün: Ködöġe-Aral — a place (place name; Ming gives only 地名; aral 'island, river-meadow') + genitive -ün, 'of Ködöġe-Aral' (name + case, front-vowel form after l) [地名 的]
glossary.dolγ̇an-boldaγ̇ud-ta: Dolγ̇an-Boldaγ — a place (place name; Ming gives only 地名; perhaps 'seven hills') + plural -ud + locative -ta, 'at the Dolγ̇an-Boldaγs' (name + plural + case, back-vowel form) [地名 行]
glossary.teletü: Teletü — a place (place name; Ming gives only 地名) [地名]
glossary.güjičežü: güjiče- — to overtake, catch up (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 趕上); converb -žü, 'overtaking' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [趕上着] · also 'chasing, pursuing' (Ming 趕上着), as in the sons and brothers giving chase
glossary.sača: Sača — Sacha, a man's name (short for Sača-Beki; personal name) [人名] · also sača, 'alike, equally' (Ming 一般), a word of likeness in Inancha-Bilge's phrase (meaning uncertain)
glossary.üges-tür: üge — word, speech (noun) + plural -s + dative-locative -tür, 'in the words' (noun + plural + case, front-vowel form after s) [言語每 裏]
glossary.kürge: kürge- — to bring to, deliver (verb; kür- 'reach' made causative; uncertain); here a bare stem, perhaps an imperative (verb stem) [敎到]
glossary.ügesi: üge — word, speech (noun) + plural -s + the bracketed i of üges(i)-jen, the linking vowel before the reflexive -jen (noun + plural + linking vowel; as Shiratori divides it) [言語每自的行]
glossary.mederežü: mede- — to know (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 敎知); -re- verbal suffix (uncertain; the Ming has 敎 'cause'); converb -žü, 'making known' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [敎知着]
glossary.tüšižü: tüši- — to stretch out (the neck) (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 伸頸); converb -žü, 'stretching out' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [伸頸着] · also tüši- — to entrust, appoint (Ming 委付着), converb -žü, 'entrusting' (verb, converb) [委付着]
glossary.medereġülžü: mede- — to know (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 敎知); -re- verbal suffix (uncertain); causative -ġül-; converb -žü, 'making known' (verb, causative converb, front-vowel form) [敎知着]
glossary.üġes-tür: üge — word, speech (noun) + plural -s + dative-locative -tür, 'in the words' (noun + plural + case, front-vowel form; a spelling of üges-tür) [言語每 裏]
glossary.büteġežü: büteġe- — to complete, bring about (verb; Ming 完備; stem uncertain); converb -žü, 'completing' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [完備着]
glossary.gebe: ge- — to cast aside, abandon (verb; Ming 撇; perhaps a short form of gedkü-; uncertain); past -be, 'cast aside' (verb, past, front-vowel form) [撇了]
glossary.büteġed: büteġe- — to complete, bring about (verb; Ming 完備; stem uncertain); -ġed, converb of completed action, 'having completed' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [完備了]
glossary.žürkin-ü: Žürkin — the Jurkin, a Mongol clan (clan name) + genitive -ü, 'of the Jurkin' (name + case, front-vowel form) [種(名)的]
glossary.ködölgeküi-dür: ködöl- — to move (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 動); causative -ge- 'set in motion'; participle -küi; dative-locative -dür, 'at the time of setting in motion' (verb, causative participle + case, front-vowel form) [敎動 時]
glossary.telegetü: Telegetü — a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名; printed 'Telegetü- Bajan-u', joined with the next word) [人名]
glossary.bajan-u: bajan — rich (adjective; Ming 富的, also used as a name element) + genitive -u, 'of the rich one' (adjective + case, back-vowel form) [富的]
glossary.küġün-uγ̇a: Küġün-Uγ̇a — a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.čilaγ̇un-γaiči: Čilaγ̇un-Γaiči — Chila'un-Gaichi, a man's name (personal name; Γaiči a title, perhaps 'cattle-herd'; uncertain) [人名]
glossary.žebke: Žebke — Jebke, a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.ažuγ̇ui: a- — to be, to remain (verb); past ending -žuγ̇ui, 'was, remained' (verb, past, back-vowel form; uncertain) [有來]
glossary.muqali: Muqali — a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.buqa: Buqa — a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名] · also buqa, 'bull' (Ming 强牛 'strong ox'), a common word and not the name, as in γurban buqa, 'three bulls'
glossary.köġudi: köġü — son (noun; a spelling of köġün) + plural -d, with the bracketed (i) of köġud(i)-jer(i)-jen, Shiratori's linking vowel (noun + plural; as Shiratori divides it) [兒子每 自的行]
glossary.jeri: -jer — instrumental, 'with' (suffix, case; the bracketed (i)s of köġud(i)-jer(i)-jen are Shiratori's; compare köġüd(i)-jer-en, 'with one's own sons') [兒子每 自的行]
glossary.aγ̇ulžažü: aγ̇ulža- — to have an audience, be received, wait on a lord (verb; Ming 拜見 'pay respects'); converb -žü, 'waiting on' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [拜見着]
glossary.bosoγa-jin: bosoγa — threshold (noun; Ming 門限) + genitive -jin, 'of the threshold' (noun + case, after a vowel) [門限的]
glossary.bosoγa-dāča: bosoγa — threshold (noun; Ming 門限) + ablative -dāča, 'from the threshold' (noun + case, back-vowel form; Shiratori's long ā) [門限 行]
glossary.hoγtol: hoγtol- — to cut (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 割); here a bare stem, perhaps an imperative (verb stem; uncertain) [割]
glossary.emčü: emčü — one's own, private (adjective; Ming 梯已, 'personal'), so 'private slave' [梯已]
glossary.heilüġešü: heilüġe- — to leave, depart (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 離); conditional -šü, 'if one leaves' (verb, conditional; Ming 呵, form uncertain) [離了呵]
glossary.edkežü: edke- — to cut out (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 割); converb -žü, 'cutting out' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [割着]
glossary.gedkün: gedkü- — to cast aside, abandon (verb; Ming 撇); converb -n, 'casting aside' (verb, converb) [撇] · also ge- 'to cast aside, throw away' (Ming 棄了; reading uncertain) + imperative second person plural -dkün, 'cast (him) aside' (Ming 您)
glossary.tüṅge: Tüṅge — Tüngge, a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名] · Tüṅge, a stream (river name; Ming (河名)), as in Tüṅge γorqan 'the Tünge little river' [(河名)]
glossary.qaši: Qaši — Qashi, a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.bosoγa: bosoγa — threshold (noun; Ming 門限) [門限]
glossary.oduγ̇asu: od- — to go (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 去); conditional -uγ̇asu, 'if one goes' (verb, conditional, back-vowel form; Ming 呵) [去呵]
glossary.tasulžu: tasul- — to cut off, sever (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 斷); converb -žu, 'cutting off' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [斷着]
glossary.örgen: örgen — wide, broad (adjective; Ming 寬) [寬]
glossary.öġere: öġere — other, otherwise, different (adjective or adverb; Ming 別) [別] · also 'apart, separately' (Ming 𠮠)
glossary.miderižü: mideri- — to kick (verb; stem inferred from the Ming 踢); converb -žü, 'kicking' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [踢着]
glossary.žebke-ji: Žebke — Jebke, a man's name (personal name) + accusative -ji, 'Jebke' as object (name + case, after a vowel; Shiratori's -ji) [人名]
glossary.boroγ̇ül: Boroγ̇ül — Boroqul, a boy's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名; a spelling of Boroγ̇ul) [人名]
glossary.aγ̇ulžan: aγ̇ulža- — to have an audience, be received, be presented (verb; Ming 拜見); converb -n, 'being presented' (verb, converb) [拜見]
glossary.oldaγsan: ol- — to find, get (verb; compare olba, 'got') + -da- (verbal suffix, function unclear; compare bol-da-ba; uncertain) + -γsan, past participle 'that has been gotten' (verb, participle; Ming 得了的) [得了的]
glossary.šigigen-qutuqu: Šigigen-Qutuqu — Shigigen-Qutuqu, a boy's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.boroγ̇ul: Boroγ̇ul — Boroqul, a boy's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.dörben-i: dörben — four (numeral) + accusative -i, 'the four' as object (numeral + case) [四箇 行]
glossary.bolγaquju: bol- — to become (verb); causative -γa-; participle -qu 'that will …'; interrogative particle -ju (Ming 麽; uncertain) (verb, causative participle + question particle; uncertain) [得做麽]
glossary.bolurun: bol- — to become (verb); -urun, converb of time, 'when becoming' (verb, converb; Ming 做的) [做的]
glossary.ökin-balaqaγ: Ökin-Balaqaγ — Ökin-Balaqaq, a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名; earlier parts print Ökin-Barqaγ) [人名]
glossary.sorqatu-žürki: Sorqatu-Žürki — Sorqatu-Jurki, a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.irgen-ü-ġen: irgen — people, subjects (noun) + linking vowel -ü- + reflexive-possessive -ġen, 'one's own people' (noun + reflexive-possessive; Shiratori's division) [百姓 自的行]
glossary.ilγažu: ilγa- — to pick out, separate (verb; Ming 揀); converb -žu, 'picking out' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [揀着]
glossary.helige-dür: helige — liver (noun; Ming 肝; elsewhere eligen) + dative-locative -dür, 'in the liver' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [肝行]
glossary.šülšütü: šülšü — gallbladder, courage (noun; Ming 膽; stem uncertain) + possessive -tü, 'courage-having' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [膽 有的]
glossary.heregei-dür: heregei — thumb (noun; Ming 大拇指; stem uncertain) + dative-locative -dür, 'on the thumb' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [大拇指 行]
glossary.hončitan: hončitan — able to shoot arrows (adjective; Ming 能發箭的; analysis uncertain) [能發箭的]
glossary.duγ̇uraṅ: duγ̇uraṅ — full (adjective; Ming 滿; compare düġüreṅ) [滿]
glossary.žirügetü: žirüge — heart (noun) + possessive -tü, 'heart-having' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [心有的]
glossary.düġüreṅ: düġüreṅ — full (adjective; Ming 滿; compare duγ̇uraṅ) [滿]
glossary.aγ̇urtan: aγ̇ur — spirit, fierce energy (noun; Ming 剛氣; stem uncertain) + possessive plural -tan, 'those having spirit' (noun + possessive, plural, back-vowel form) [剛氣]
glossary.tutum: tutum — each, every one (pronoun or adjective; Ming 各各) [各各] · also 'each time, every turn' (Ming 每遍), as in toγ̇oriqui tutum 'each time they wheel' · also with Ming 每裏 'each', after qari: min-u qari tutum, 'each of my bands'
glossary.erdemüdten: erdem — skill, accomplishment (noun) + plural -üd + possessive plural -ten, 'those having skills' (noun + plural + possessive, front-vowel form) [技能 有(的每)]
glossary.bökös: bökö — strong, sturdy (adjective; Ming 壯) + plural -s, 'the strong' (adjective + plural) [壯] · also bökö 'wrestler, strongman' (Ming 力士) with plural -s, 'the wrestlers'
glossary.küčüten-i: küčü — strength (noun) + possessive plural -ten + accusative -i, 'those having strength' as object (noun + possessive + case, front-vowel form) [氣力有的(每) 行]
glossary.šülšüten: šülšü — gallbladder, courage (noun; Ming 膽; stem uncertain) + possessive plural -ten, 'those having courage' (noun + possessive, plural, front-vowel form) [膽 有的(每)]
glossary.omoγtan: omoγ — pride, daring (noun; Ming 勇; stem uncertain) + possessive plural -tan, 'those having daring' (noun + possessive, plural, back-vowel form) [勇 有的(每)]
glossary.žürkimes: žürkimes — (those) whom none can withstand (Ming 無人能敵每), the word that explains the name Žürkin; analysis uncertain [(無人能敵每)]

glossary.hurbažu: hurba- — to turn over, upset (stem inferred from the Ming 翻); converb -žu, '-ing' (back-vowel form) (verb, converb) [翻着]
glossary.jabun: jabu- — to go, travel; converb -n, '-ing' (verb, converb) [行]
glossary.nuras-tur: nura — gully, ditch (stem read from the Ming 溝); -s: plural; dative-locative -tur, 'in' (back-vowel form) (noun, plural + case) [溝 裏]
glossary.γuladu: γuladu- — to fall, topple over (stem uncertain; the first half of γuladu-γ̇ad, split at the line end) (verb, stem, first half of a split word; uncertain) [倒]

glossary.taγ̇alaγdaba: taγ̇ala- — to love, favour (stem inferred from the Ming 愛); passive -γda-, 'be …ed'; past -ba, '-ed' (back-vowel form) (verb, passive past tense) [被愛了]
glossary.keġeldüġed: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü-, 'together'; converb of completed action -ġed, 'having …ed' (front-vowel form) (verb, reciprocal converb) [共說了]
glossary.butaražuγ̇ui: butara- — to scatter, break up (stem inferred from the Ming 潰散); -žuγ̇ui: past ending (back-vowel form; uncertain) (verb, past; uncertain) [潰散了]
glossary.altai-jin: Altai — the Altai mountains; genitive -jin, 'of' (after a vowel) (place name + genitive) [地名的] · also with Ming 山名的 ('of the mountain-named'), 'of the Altai' (Altai-jin ölkes, 'the foot of the Altai')
glossary.uluγ-taγ: Uluγ-Taγ — Uluq-Taq, a place name (taγ perhaps 'mountain'; uncertain) (place name) [地名]

glossary.temečen: temeče- — to contend, struggle (as in temečed; Ming 爭); converb -n, 'struggling' (verb, converb) [爭]
glossary.šisgis: Šisgis — Shisgis, a place name (place name) [地名]
glossary.öġeri: öġer — own, self; the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel, the token left before the reflexive -jen (noun, uncertain) [(自己)自(的行)]

glossary.daγ̇uliγ̇ad: daγ̇uli- — to plunder, seize (as elsewhere; Ming 搶); converb -γ̇ad, 'having plundered' (verb, converb) [搶了]
glossary.butalaγdažu: butala- — to scatter, rout (stem inferred); passive -γda-, converb -žu, 'being scattered' (verb, passive converb) [潰散着]
glossary.nekebe: neke- — to pursue (stem inferred from the Ming 追襲); past -be, 'pursued' (verb, past) [追襲了]

glossary.ulus-turi: ulus — people, realm; dative-locative -tur, 'to'; the (i) after it is Shiratori's, the token left before -jan (noun + case) [百姓 裏自的行]

glossary.ködölgeġed: ködöl- — to move, set out; causative -ge-, converb -ġed, 'having set in motion' (verb, causative converb) [動了]
glossary.onan-u: Onan — the Onon, a river; genitive -u, 'of' (back-vowel form) (river name + genitive) [河(名)的]
glossary.činaži: činaži — that side, yonder (adverb; the ending -ži is not clear) [那廂]
glossary.edeġed: edeġed — one side, this part (stem uncertain, perhaps related to ede 'these'; Ming 一邊) (noun or adverb, uncertain) [一邊]
glossary.hüleġüd: hüleġüd — the rest, the remainder (stem uncertain; Ming 多餘) (noun, uncertain) [多餘]
glossary.tulastan: tulas — square shield (Ming 方牌, 'square tablet'; uncertain); possessive plural -tan, 'those having shields' (noun + possessive) [方牌 有的每]
glossary.taičiγ̇ud-luγ̇a: Taičiγ̇ud — the Taichi'ud, a clan; comitative -luγ̇a, 'with' (back-vowel form) (name + comitative) [種(名) 和他]
glossary.qadqulduba: qadqu- — to fight, strike; reciprocal -ldu-, 'one another'; past -ba, 'fought' (verb, reciprocal past) [厮殺︀]
glossary.egerün: eger- — to turn over, reverse (stem inferred from the Ming 翻覆); converb -ün, 'turning' (verb, converb, linking vowel) [翻覆]
glossary.qadqulduγsan: qadqu- — to fight, strike; reciprocal -ldu-; past participle -γsan, 'that which (they) fought', i.e. 'where they had fought' (verb, reciprocal participle) [厮殺︀的]

glossary.čeriγ̇üd-lüġe-ben: čerig — soldier, troops; plural -üd; comitative -lüġe, 'with' (front-vowel form); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own' (noun + plural + comitative + reflexive) [軍每 自的行]
glossary.küreġeležü: küreġele- — to camp in a ring, make a circle camp (Ming 札營); converb -žü, 'camping' (verb, converb) [札營着]
glossary.qonolduba: qono- — to spend the night, lodge; reciprocal -ldu-, 'together'; past -ba (verb, reciprocal past) [共宿了]
glossary.qadqulduγ̇an-dur: qadqu- — to fight; reciprocal -ldu-; noun-maker -γ̇an, 'a fighting, a battle'; dative-locative -dur, 'in, at' (back-vowel form) (verb noun + case) [厮殺︀的陣 裏]
glossary.sužijasu-ban: sužijasu — the vein of the neck (Ming 項頸脉); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own' (back-vowel form) (noun + reflexive-possessive) [項頸脉 自的(行)]
glossary.šilür: šilür- — to be wounded (stem inferred from the Ming 被傷); printed with a hyphen, the word runs on to težü across the line (verb stem, first half of a split word) [被傷]
glossary.težü: -te- — ending of a split word, completing šilür-te-žü; perhaps the passive -te- (compare ögteġei in the glossary; the Ming 被 stands on the first half); converb -žü, 'being' (verb ending, converb) [着]

glossary.amduriγdarun: amduri- — to be flustered, alarmed (stem inferred from the Ming 荒忙); passive -γda-; converb of time -run, 'when being alarmed' (verb, passive converb) [被荒忙 時]
glossary.šingeġülün: šingeġül- — to sink, set (stem inferred; Ming 落後, 'fall behind'); converb -n (verb, converb) [落後]
glossary.böglegsen: bögle- — to clog, stop up, clot (stem inferred from the Ming 塞); past participle -gsen, 'that which has clotted' (verb, participle) [塞了的]

glossary.sakildužu: sakil- — to guard, keep watch (stem inferred; Ming 守); reciprocal -du-, 'together'; converb -žu, 'keeping watch' (verb, reciprocal converb) [相守着]

glossary.asqaγ̇ad: asqa- — to spit out, vomit, cast away (Ming 吐); converb -γ̇ad, 'having spat out' (verb, converb) [吐了]
glossary.nögčiġešü: nögči- — to pass, go by (stem inferred from the Ming 過); conditional -ġešü, 'if, when' (printed with š) (verb, conditional) [過呵]
glossary.dotora-γ̇an: dotora — inside, within; reflexive-possessive -γ̇an, 'one's own' (after a vowel) (noun + reflexive-possessive) [內 自的(行)]
glossary.sergüžü: sergü- — to wake, rouse oneself; converb -žü, 'waking' (verb, converb) [醒着]
glossary.qaγču: qaγču — dry, having dried (converb; stem uncertain; Ming 乾) (converb or adjective, uncertain) [乾]
glossary.undaγ̇asumu: undaγ̇a- — to be thirsty (stem inferred from the Ming 渴); -su- stem-extender (uncertain); present -mu, 'is thirsty' (verb, present) [渴有]

glossary.dotoγ̇aži: dotoγ̇aži — drawers, trousers (Ming 袴); printed with a hyphen, first half of dotoγ̇aži-tu split at the line end (noun, first half of a split word) [袴]

glossary.čurama-ničügün: čurama-ničügün — stark naked (Ming 赤裸); čurama perhaps an intensifier, uncertain (adjective) [赤裸]
glossary.baiqun: bai- — to stand; participle ending -qun (Ming 立着; form uncertain) (verb, participle or converb) [立着]

glossary.kürelegsen: küreġele- — to camp in a ring (compare küreġeležü; printed here without the ġ, kürelegsen for küreġelegsen; Ming (下)營); past participle -gsen, 'that which has camped' (verb, participle) [(下)營了的]
glossary.esüġüd: esüg — mare's milk; plural -üd, 'the mare's milk' (noun + plural) [馬妳子每]
glossary.geġüdi: geġü — mare (stem uncertain; Ming 騍馬); plural -d; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token left before the reflexive -jen (noun + plural) [騍馬(每)自的行]
glossary.olun: ol- — to find, get (Ming 得); converb -un, 'finding' (verb, converb, linking vowel) [(得)]
glossary.büriġetei: büriġe — vessel, container (stem inferred from the Ming); possessive -tei, 'having a vessel' (noun + possessive) [器︀中盫來的]
glossary.odorun: od- — to go (Ming 去); converb of time -orun (linking vowel -o- + -run), 'when going' (verb, converb) [去時]
glossary.igeġebe: igeġe- — to protect, help (stem inferred from the Ming 護助); past -be (verb, past) [護助了]
glossary.büriġetü-ji: büriġe — vessel, container; possessive -tü, 'having'; accusative -ji (after a vowel), 'the one having a vessel' as object (noun + possessive + accusative) [器︀中盫來有的 行]

glossary.amužu: amu- — to rest, pause (Ming 歇息); converb -žu, 'resting' (verb, converb) [歇息着]
glossary.üžu: ü- — to drink; converb -žu, 'drinking' (verb, converb) [飮着]

glossary.namurγan: namurγan — mire, mud (Ming 陷泥) (noun) [陷泥]
glossary.bolumu: bol- — to become, be done; present -umu (linking vowel + -mu), 'is' (verb, present) [做有]

glossary.alžijaqui-ača: alžija- — to be apart, separated (stem inferred from the Ming 離); participle -qui; ablative -ača, 'from' (back-vowel form) (verb, participle + ablative) [離了的行]

glossary.andurižu: anduri- — to be flustered (compare amduri-; Ming 荒); converb -žu, 'being flustered' (verb, converb) [荒着]

glossary.aldaγ̇ulžu: alda- — to lose, let slip; causative -γ̇ul-; converb -žu, 'letting slip' (verb, causative converb) [敎脫了着]

glossary.qaṅqaγsan: qaṅqa- — to be parched, dried up (Ming 枯渴); past participle -γsan, 'that which has dried up' (verb, participle) [枯渴了的]
glossary.elüssügei: elüs- — to reach, catch up with (stem uncertain; Ming 趕上); optative -sügei, 'may it, let it' (verb, optative) [趕上]
