glossary.qailažu: qaila- — to call out, cry out; converb -žu, 'calling out' (verb, converb) [喚着]
glossary.uilaba: uila- — to weep; past -ba, 'wept' (verb, past) [哭了]
glossary.üġüleġešü: ügüle- — to tell, say; conditional -ġešü, 'when/if (he) said' (verb, conditional) [說呵]
glossary.qadaγ̇an-dur: Qadaγan — Qada'an, a woman's name; dative-locative -dur, 'to, at Qada'an' (personal name + case) [女名 行]
glossary.teberildübe: teber- — to meet, greet (perhaps 'embrace'; uncertain); reciprocal -ildü-, past -be, 'met one another' (verb, reciprocal, past) [相見了]
glossary.ičuγaγ̇ad: ičuγa- — to drive back; converb of completed action -γad, 'having driven back' (verb, converb) [退了]
glossary.qadaγ̇an-i: Qadaγan — Qada'an, a woman's name; accusative -i, 'Qada'an (object)' (personal name + case) [(女)名 行]
glossary.dergečen: dergečen — side by side, together; the ending cannot be analysed (adverb; form unclear) [並]
glossary.saγ̇ulba: saγu- — to sit; causative -l-, past -ba, 'seated (her)'; the Ming gives only 'sat' (verb, causative, past) [坐了]
glossary.žebe: Žebe — Jebe, a man's name (personal name) [人名] · also žebe, 'weapon, gear' (noun; Ming 器械 'arms, equipment'), as in qor numu qujaγ žebe 'quivers, bows, armour and weapons'; not the man's name
glossary.tödöge-jin: Tödöge — Tödöge, a man's name; genitive -jin (after a vowel), 'of Tödöge' (personal name + genitive) [人名的]
glossary.aγsad: a- — to be; past participle -γsad with plural -d, 'those who were, being' (verb, participle, plural) [有 的(每)]
glossary.sorγan-šira-ji: Sorγan-Šira — Sorqan-Shira, a man's name; accusative -ji (after a vowel), 'Sorqan-Shira (object)' (personal name + case) [人名 行]
glossary.güžügün-deki: güžügün — neck, nape; -deki, 'that which is on', 'on the neck' (noun + adjectival locative) [項頸行的]
glossary.mudun-i: mudu(n) — wood, timber; accusative -i, 'the wood (object)'; also the cangue as 'heavy wood' (noun + case) [木頭 行]
glossary.köser-e: köser — ground, earth; dative-locative -e, 'onto the ground' (noun + case; the stem is read from the Ming 地) [地行]
glossary.oγ̇oγ̇uluγsan: oγo- — to throw down, cast off; causative -γul-, participle -γsan, 'who/which had cast down' (verb, causative participle) [撇下的]
glossary.žaqa-daki: žaqa — collar, neckband; -daki, 'that which is on the collar' (noun + adjectival locative) [衣領 上的]
glossary.žailaγ̇uluγsan: žaila- — to avoid, dodge; causative -γul-, participle -γsan, 'who/which had made (him) avoid' (verb, causative participle) [敎躱了的]
glossary.udaba: uda- — to be late, delay; past -ba, 'was late' (verb, past) [遲了]
glossary.bölen: bölen — being present, at hand (the Ming 見在); the form is unclear (adverb or participle; uncertain) [見在]
glossary.jaγ̇araqu: jaγara- — to hurry (stem inferred from the Ming 忙); participle -qu, '(should) hurry' (verb, participle) [忙]
glossary.urid: urid — before, first, formerly (adverb; the base of urida) [先]
glossary.nojad: nojan — noble, lord; plural -d, 'the nobles' (noun + plural) [官人每] · also nojan — officer, commander, as in 'the officers' (Ming 官每); plural -d
glossary.qočoruγsan: qočor- — to be left behind; participle -γsan, 'who/which had been left behind' (verb, participle) [落後的]
glossary.ideġen-i: ideġen — food, fodder (the Ming 喫食 does not say which); accusative -i (noun + case) [喫食 行]
glossary.keisgekün: keisge- — to scatter, blow away; participle -kün, here read 'would scatter, was likely to' (the Ming 廢了 'ruined'); the force of -kün is uncertain (verb, participle) [廢了]
glossary.qaγan-duri: qaγan — qan, sovereign; dative-locative -dur with reflexive link (i), 'with/at one's own qahan'; the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel before -jan (noun + case) [皇帝 行自的]
glossary.iquri: iquri- — to shift position (Ming 相挪); first half of iquri- γaldun, split across a line; the word and its division are uncertain [相挪]
glossary.γaldun: γaldun — pressing on, closing up (Ming 趲); second half of the word split after iquri-; form unclear [趲]
glossary.žibšijelülčen: žibšije- — to put in order, array; reciprocal -lül- (Ming 相 'one another'), converb -čen; the division of the ending is uncertain (verb, reciprocal converb) [相整搠]
glossary.nirγ̇un: nirγun — ridge, spine of a range (noun) [嶺脊]
glossary.žebelekü: žebele- — to fight; participle -kü, '(of) fighting' (verb, participle) [戰的]
glossary.qula-jin: qula — bay horse; genitive -jin (after a vowel), 'of the bay horse' (noun + genitive) [黃馬 的]
glossary.aman-niriġü: aman niriġü — collarbone (Ming 鎖子骨 for the compound; aman 'mouth', niriġü uncertain; front-vowel spelling) (noun compound) [鎖子骨]
glossary.quγu: quγu — broken (Ming 折); stem or part of speech uncertain (adjective or verb stem) [折]
glossary.qarblaγ̇a: qarbu- — to shoot an arrow; verbal -la-, past -γa, 'shot (it)' (verb, past; the analysis is uncertain) [射來]
glossary.üküġüldeġešü: ükü- — to die; causative -ġül-, passive -de- (after l; the analysis is mine), conditional -ġešü, 'if (one) were made to die' (verb, causative passive conditional; uncertain) [敎死呵]
glossary.halaγan-u: halaγan — palm of the hand; genitive -u, 'of the palm' (noun + genitive) [手掌的]
glossary.höġežü: höġe- — to rot, fester; converb -žü, 'rotting' (verb, converb) [爛着]
glossary.qočorsu: qočor- — to be left behind; first-person optative -su (Ming 我), 'I would be left behind' (verb, optative) [落後我]
glossary.sojurγaγdaγ̇asu: sojurγa- — to show favour; passive -γda-, conditional -γasu, 'if favoured, if shown grace' (verb, passive conditional) [被恩賜呵]
glossary.emüne: emüne — front, before, in front of (adverb or noun) [前行]
glossary.usun-i: usun — water; accusative -i, 'the water (object)' (noun + case) [水行]
glossary.hoγtoru: hoγtor- — to cut across; converb -u, 'cutting across' (verb, converb) [橫斷]
glossary.kür: kür- — to reach, arrive; the bare stem (verb, bare stem; force uncertain) [到]
glossary.keġegsen: keġe- — to say; participle -gsen, 'what was said' (verb, participle) [說的] · also with Ming 說來的 ('what was said')
glossary.keġürü: keġür- — to smash (compare čaγur-, qamqar-); converb -ü, 'smashing' (verb, converb) [碎]
glossary.qal: qal — unresolved word, perhaps a command or particle (Ming 惹); I cannot place it (uncertain) [惹]
glossary.keġegsen-dür: keġe- — to say; participle -gsen + dative-locative -dür, 'when (it) was said' (verb, participle + case; -dür as a time marker) [說了的 行]
glossary.jabuγsan: jabu- — to go; participle -γsan, 'who had gone' (verb, participle) [行了的]
glossary.alaγsani: ala- — to kill; participle -γsan + accusative (i), 'what was killed (object)'; the (i) is Shiratori's, before reflexive -jan (verb, participle + case) [殺︀了的 自的行]
glossary.daisurγaγsani: daisurγa- — to turn enemy, rebel; participle -γsan + accusative (i), 'what was done (object)'; the (i) is Shiratori's, before reflexive -jan (verb, participle + case) [反做了的 自的行]
glossary.miγ̇užu: niγu- — to hide (printed miγu-, but the Ming character 你 reads ni-); converb -žu, 'hiding' (verb, converb; spelling uncertain) [藏着]
glossary.kele-ben: kele — tongue, speech; reflexive possessive -ben, 'his own speech' (after a vowel) (noun + reflexive possessive) [話 自的行] · also with Ming (舌)自的行 ('own speech')
glossary.bučažu: buča- — to conceal; converb -žu, 'concealing' (verb, converb) [諱着]
glossary.aju: aju- — to fear, be afraid; bare stem used as a finite verb, 'fears' (verb; the ending is uncertain) [怕有]
glossary.munda: munda — on the contrary, rather (Ming 卻) (adverb) [卻]
glossary.buča: buča- — to conceal; bare stem used as a finite verb (verb) [隱諱]
glossary.žiγ̇an: žiγa- — to tell, report; converb -n, 'telling' (verb, converb) [吿]
glossary.nököčeltü: nököčel — companionship; possessive -tü, 'companion-having, fit to be a companion' (noun + possessive) [可做伴的]
glossary.žirγoγ̇adai: Žirγoγadai — Jirgo'adai, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.qula-ji: qula — bay horse; accusative -ji (after a vowel), 'the bay horse (object)' (noun + case) [黃馬 行]
glossary.aman-niruγ̇u: aman niruγu — collarbone (Ming 鎖子骨 for the compound; aman 'mouth', niruγu uncertain; back-vowel spelling) (noun compound) [鎖子骨]
glossary.qarbuγsan-u: qarbu- — to shoot an arrow; participle -γsan + genitive -u, 'of the one shot' (verb, participle + genitive; the Ming splits 射了 的) [射了 的]
glossary.žebeleje: žebele- — to fight; hortative -je, 'let us fight' (verb, hortative) [戰咱]
glossary.taičiγ̇ud-ača: Taičiγud — the Taichi'ud, a people; ablative -ača, 'from the Taichi'ud' (name + case) [種(名)處]
glossary.nököčegsen: nököče- — to be a companion; participle -gsen, 'who had been a companion' (verb, participle) [做伴來的]
glossary.taičiγ̇utai: Taičiγud — the Taichi'ud; -tai, 'with, having' (uncertain; the Ming gives only the people's name) (name + comitative or possessive; uncertain) [種(名)]
glossary.küġün-i: küġün — person, man; accusative -i, 'the persons (object)' (noun + case) [人行]
glossary.qoton-orčaṅ: Qotun-Orčaṅ — Qotun-Orchang, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.quduγ̇udar-tan: Quduγudar — Qudu'udar, a man's name; -tan, 'and the like, and others' (personal name + plural of association) [人名等]
glossary.kiduba: kidu- — to kill off, exterminate; past -ba, 'killed off' (verb, past) [盡殺︀了]
glossary.ködölgežü: ködöl- — to move, set out; causative -ge-, converb -žü, 'making move, setting in motion' (verb, causative converb) [敎動着]
glossary.qubaqaja: Qubaqaja — Qubaqaja, a place name (place name) [地名]
glossary.übülžebe: übül — winter; verbal -že-, past -be, 'spent the winter, wintered' (noun-derived verb, past) [住冬了]
glossary.ničügüd-baγ̇arin-u: Ničügüd-Baγ̇arin — the Nichügüd-Ba'arin, a clan; genitive -u, 'of the Nichügüd-Ba'arin' (clan name + case, back-vowel form after a consonant) [種(名)的]
glossary.širġüġetü: Širġüġetü — Shirgügetü, a man's name (personal name; Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.najaγ̇a: Najaγ̇a — Naya'a, a man's name (personal name; Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.hoilažu: hoila- — to go into the forest, take to the woods (hoi 'forest' + verb-forming -la-); converb -žu, 'taking to the forest' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [入林着]
glossary.öštü: öš — grudge, enmity; possessive -tü, 'grudge-having, bearing a grudge' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [讐有的]
glossary.morilan: mori- — to ride, mount (from mori 'horse', verb-forming -la-); converb -n, 'mounting' (verb, converb; the stem is derived from mori 'horse', read from the Ming) [上馬]
glossary.tarqutai-ji: Tarqutai — Tarqutai, a man's name; accusative -ji, 'Tarqutai (object)' (name + case, -ji after a vowel; Ming 行 marks the object) [人名行]
glossary.tarqutai-kiriltuγ-i: Tarqutai-Kiriltuγ — Tarqutai-Kiriltuq, a man's name (Tarqutai with the by-name Kiriltuq); accusative -i, 'Tarqutai-Kiriltuq (object)' (name + case, -i after a consonant; the Ming 行 is bracketed in one occurrence) [人名(行)]
glossary.tarqutai-kiriltuγ-un: Tarqutai-Kiriltuγ — Tarqutai-Kiriltuq, a man's name; genitive -un, 'of Tarqutai-Kiriltuq' (name + case, -un after a consonant) [人名的]
glossary.deġü-ner-i: deġü — younger brother; plural -ner, accusative or dative -i, 'the younger brothers (object)' (noun + plural + case, front-vowel form; the Ming 行 marks the object, but the -i is not fully explained here) [兄弟 每行]
glossary.bosun: bosu- — to rise, get up (stem inferred from the Ming 起); converb -n, 'rising' (verb, converb) [起]
glossary.aγtalan: aγta — gelding; verb-forming -la-, 'to sit astride, ride' (aγtala-); converb -n, 'sitting astride' (noun-derived verb, converb; the stem is read from the Ming 騎) [騎]
glossary.qāni: qān — ruler, khan (short form beside qaγan); the (i) is the accusative -i, 'one's own qan (object)', Shiratori's bracketed vowel left before the reflexive-possessive -(i)jan that follows as the token jan (title + case; the Ming 皇帝自的行 includes the reflexive) [皇帝自的行]
glossary.γardaba: γarda- — to lay a hand on, set hand to (from γar 'hand'; stem read from the Ming 下手); past -ba, 'laid a hand on, did' (verb, past tense) [下手了]
glossary.alaγ̇asu: ala- — to kill; conditional -γ̇asu, 'if (one) kills' (verb, conditional, back-vowel form) [殺︀呵]
glossary.alaqu-kü: ala- — to kill; future participle -qu + closing particle -kü, 'will kill' (verb, participle + particle; the Ming 也 marks the sentence-ending -kü) [殺︀了也]
glossary.alaγdaqu-kü: ala- — to kill; passive -γda-, future participle -qu, closing particle -kü, 'will be killed' (verb, passive participle + particle) [被殺︀]
glossary.üküküi-düri: ükü- — to die; participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'in dying, at the dying' (verb, participle + case); the (i) is Shiratori's bracketed vowel left before the reflexive-possessive -(i)jen that follows as the token jen, 'in one's own dying' (the Ming 死 自的行 includes the reflexive) [死 自的行]
glossary.dere: dere — cushion, back-pad (noun; the Ming 墊背 'cushion for the back' suggests a companion taken in death) [墊背]
glossary.abun: ab- — to take; converb -un, 'taking' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [要]
glossary.üküšü: ükü- — to die; first-person optative -šü, 'let me die' (verb, optative; the -šü ending is read from the Ming 死我) [死我]
glossary.kituγai-jar-an: kituγai — knife; instrumental -jar, reflexive-possessive -an, 'with one's own knife' (noun + case + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form after a vowel) [刀子 自的行]
glossary.quγulara: quγula- — to cut through, sever, cut in two (stem read from the Ming 割折); converb -ra, 'to cut through, on the point of cutting' (verb, converb of purpose) [割折]
glossary.qailižu: qaili- — to call out, hail, cry out; converb -žu, 'crying out' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [呌着]
glossary.kelelerün: kele- — to speak, say; converb of time -rün, 'when saying, as (he) spoke' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [說]
glossary.ükügsen: ükü- — to die; past participle -gsen, 'one who has died, the dead' (verb, past participle) [死了的]
glossary.jakiγ̇užai: jaki- — to do what, to do (ya- 'what' + ki- 'do'); future participle -γu + sentence ending -žai, 'what will (one) do?' (interrogative verb, participle + ending; the -žai is unglossed in the Ming and read as a question) [做甚]
glossary.alaγ̇ai: ala- — to kill; third-person optative -γ̇ai, 'let him kill' (verb, optative; read so, the ending is not explained by the Ming) [殺︀] · also a- 'to be' + past -laγ̇ai, 'had been' (Ming 有來; not ala- 'kill'; uncertain)
glossary.qaridqun: qari- — to return, turn back; plural imperative -dqun, 'you (all) turn back!' (verb, imperative; the Ming 囘去 once reads 囘您) [囘去]
glossary.alaqu: ala- — to kill; future participle -qu, 'will kill' (verb, participle; here standing as a finite 'will kill') [殺︀]
glossary.surγaγ̇asu: surγa- — to teach, train (causative of sur- 'learn'); conditional -γ̇asu, 'if (one) teaches' (verb, conditional, back-vowel form) [敎訓呵]
glossary.surqu: sur- — to learn; participle -qu, 'one who learns' (verb, participle) [學的]
glossary.sona: sona — new, fresh (adjective; Ming 新) [新]
glossary.üriġe: üriġe — a three-year-old (of an animal) (noun/adjective; Ming 三歲) [三歲]
glossary.daγ̇aγan: daγ̇aγan — two-year-old colt (noun; Ming 二歲駒) [二歲駒]
glossary.surγaqu: surγa- — to teach, train; participle -qu, 'one who teaches, one who is training' (verb, participle) [敎的]
glossary.surγan: surγa- — to teach, train; converb -n, 'teaching' (verb, converb) [敎]
glossary.sujin: sujin — training, discipline (noun; Ming 訓; the form is not analysed) [訓]
glossary.jabulaγ̇a: jabu- — to go, walk about; past -laγ̇a, 'went, kept going' (verb, past tense; the -laγ̇a is the back-vowel partner of -leġe) [行來]
glossary.üküġülsü: ükü- — to die; causative -ġül-, 'make die, kill'; first-person -sü, 'let me / if I' (verb, causative optative; Ming 敎死呵我) [敎死呵我]
glossary.üküġülün: ükü- — to die; causative -ġül-, 'make die, put to death'; converb -n, 'putting to death' (verb, causative converb) [敎死]
glossary.jadaqu-ju: jada- — to be unable; participle -qu + converb -ju used as a finite verb, 'is unable' (verb, participle + converb as predicate) [不能有]
glossary.oi: oi — sense, understanding, nature (noun; Ming 性情 'nature, character') [性情]
glossary.seṅterežü: seṅtere- — to open up, be cleared (stem inferred from the Ming 開豁); converb -žü, 'opening, clearing' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [開豁着]
glossary.üküġülkü: ükü- — to die; causative -ġül-, 'put to death'; future participle -kü, 'will put to death' (verb, causative participle, front-vowel form) [敎死]
glossary.ileġüžei: ile- — to go away, leave (also 'send'); apprehensive -ġüžei, 'lest (one) …, for fear that (one) go' (verb, apprehensive; the ending is read from the Ming 恐 'fear') [去了恐]
glossary.qailaba: qaili- — to call out, hail; past -ba, 'called out' (verb, past tense) [呌了]
glossary.jakikün: jaki- — to do what, to do (ya- 'what' + ki- 'do'); future participle -kün, 'what shall (one) do?' (interrogative verb, participle) [做甚] · also jaki- 'to do what', future participle -kün (Ming 怎做)
glossary.qarija: qari- — to return, turn back; hortative -ja, 'let us turn back' (verb, hortative; Ming 囘咱) [囘咱]
glossary.ireküi-dür: ire- — to come; participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'at the coming, when (they) came' (verb, participle + case, front-vowel form; Ming 時) [來 時]
glossary.najaγ̇a-tan: Najaγ̇a — Naya'a, a man's name; -tan, 'and others, etc.' (name + plural-like suffix 'and company'; Ming 等) [人名 等]
glossary.heilügsed: heilü- — to part from, separate (stem inferred from the Ming 離); past participle plural -gsed, 'those who had parted' (verb, past participle, plural) [離了的每]
glossary.qutuqul-nuγ̇u-da: Qutuqul-Nuγ̇u — Qutuqul-Nu'u, a place-name; locative -da, 'at Qutuqul-Nu'u' (place name + case, back-vowel form; Ming 地名行) [地名行]
glossary.bidan-i: bida — we, us (inclusive); stem extension -n + accusative -i, 'us (object)' (pronoun + case; Ming 咱行) [咱行] · also, with the Ming 俺行 as well as 咱行; the Ming alternates 俺 and 咱 for this inclusive form
glossary.tus: tus — own, proper, rightful (tus qān 'one's own true lord'; adjective; Ming 正主 'the rightful lord') [正主]
glossary.γardažu: γarda- — to lay a hand on, set hand to; converb -žu, 'having laid a hand on' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [下手着]
glossary.tusi: tus — own, rightful; the (i) is Shiratori's bracketed vowel (read as accusative) left before the reflexive-possessive -(i)jan that follows as the token jan, 'one's own rightful (lord, object)' (adjective + case; the Ming 正主自的行 includes the reflexive) [正主自的行]
glossary.itegelten: itegel — reliance, trust; possessive -ten (read as a variant of -tü/-tai; uncertain), 'trust-having, reliable' (noun + possessive; Ming 倚附的) [中倚附的]
glossary.nököčel: nököčel — companionship, a comrade (noun, from nökör 'companion'; Ming 做伴) [做伴]
glossary.γardaγsad: γarda- — to lay a hand on, set hand to; past participle plural -γsad, 'those who had laid a hand on' (verb, past participle, plural) [下手的每]
glossary.mököriġüldekün: mököri- — to cut down, behead; causative -ġül-, passive -de-, future participle -kün, 'one who is to be cut down' (verb, causative passive participle; the passive -de- is read as in earlier parts) [斬了]
glossary.mököriġüldekün-üġü: mököri- — to cut down, behead; causative -ġül-, passive -de-, future participle -kün, question particle -üġü, 'are we to be cut down?' (verb, participle + question particle; Ming 麽) [被斬了麽]
glossary.ögüre: ög- — to give; linking vowel ü + converb -re, 'in order to give' (verb, converb of purpose; Ming 與) [與]
glossary.aisulaγ̇ai: aisu- — to come (Ming 來; relation to ire- uncertain); past -laγ̇ai, 'came, have come' (verb, past; the final -i is read so, compare -laγ̇a and -leġe) [來了]
glossary.tebčin: tebčin — giving up, abandoning, letting go (noun/verbal noun; Ming 捨 'give up'; form not analysed) [捨]
glossary.üküġülkün: ükü- — to die; causative -ġül-, 'put to death'; future participle -kün, 'shall (we) put to death' (verb, causative participle) [敎死]
glossary.büširen: büširen — in truth, faithfully, sincerely (adverb; Ming 信實) [信實] · also converb of büšire- 'to trust, be grateful', 'trusting, being grateful' (Ming 知感) [知感]
glossary.keġeje: keġe- — to say; hortative -je, 'let us say' (verb, hortative, first person plural; same value as -ja) [說咱]
glossary.najaγ̇a-jin: Najaγ̇a — Naya'a, a man's name; genitive -jin, 'of Naya'a' (name + case, -jin after a vowel) [人名的]
glossary.žöbšijeldüžü: žöb — right, proper; verb-forming -ši-, 'approve'; reciprocal -ldü-; converb -žü, 'approving together' (adjective-derived verb, converb, front-vowel form; Ming 共說是着) [共說是着]
glossary.quduqul-nuγ̇u-dāča: Quduqul-Nuγ̇u — Quduqul-Nu'u, a place-name (a variant spelling of Qutuqul-Nuγ̇u); ablative -dāča, 'from Quduqul-Nu'u' (place name + case, back-vowel form with long vowel) [地名處]
glossary.üküġülküi: ükü- — to die; causative -ġül-, 'put to death'; participle -küi, 'shall (we) put to death' (verb, causative participle, front-vowel form) [敎死]
glossary.uruγi: uruγ — clan, kin, descendants; the (i) is Shiratori's bracketed vowel left before the instrumental -(i)jar that follows as the token jar, 'with one's whole clan' (noun, with the (i) joined to the case that follows; Ming 一族) [一族]
glossary.mököriġül: mököri- — to cut down, behead; causative -ġül-, 'put to death' (verb stem; the word is split at the line break and completed by the next token dekün) [被斬]
glossary.dekün: -dekün — the end of mököriġül-dekün: passive -de- + future participle -kün, 'one who is to be cut down' (verb endings, split from the stem by the line break; no Ming gloss of its own) [no Ming gloss]
glossary.jadaγsan: jada- — to be unable; past participle -γsan, 'one who could not' (verb, past participle) [不能了的]
glossary.najaγ̇a-ji: Najaγ̇a — Naya'a, a man's name; accusative -ji, 'Naya'a (object)' (name + case, -ji after a vowel; Ming 行) [人名 行]
glossary.sojurγaba: sojurγa- — to show favour, bestow a grace (stem read from the Ming 恩賜); past -ba, 'showed favour' (verb, past tense) [恩賜了]
glossary.tersüd-te: Tersüd — Tersüd, a place-name; locative -te, 'at Tersüd' (place name + case, front-vowel form after a consonant; Ming 地名行) [地名 行]
glossary.nököčere: nököče- — to be a companion, accompany (from nökör 'companion'); converb -re, 'as a companion, in order to accompany' (verb, converb) [做伴]
glossary.iregsen-dür: ire- — to come; past participle -gsen + dative-locative -dür, 'when (he) had come' (verb, participle + case, front-vowel form; Ming 時) [來了 時]
glossary.qadquldura: qadqul- — to fight, clash (Ming 厮殺); reciprocal -du-; converb -ra, 'in order to fight each other' (verb, reciprocal converb of purpose) [厮殺︀]
glossary.ičuγ̇aba: ičuγ̇a- — to cause to retreat, drive back (Ming 敎退); past -ba, 'drove back' (verb, causative past) [敎退了]
glossary.tübegen: Tübegen — the Tübegen, a clan name (people name; Ming 姓) [姓]
glossary.toṅγaid: Toṅγaid — the Tongqaid, a clan (people name; the -d is probably plural; Ming 姓(名)) [姓(名)]
glossary.ireġüleġei: ire- — to come (the stem looks like ire- + causative -ġü-, but the Ming reads plain 'come'); past -leġei, 'came' (verb, past; a variant of -leġe with final -i) [來了來]
glossary.waṅ-qaγan: Waṅ-Qaγan — Wang Qahan, ruler of the Kereid (a title, Chinese wang 'prince' + qaγan, borne as a name here; Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.sai-bar: sai — good; instrumental -bar, 'with, in the manner of' (adjective + case, 'well'; Ming 好行) [好行]
glossary.el: el — peace, order, a realm at peace (noun; Ming 治平) [治平]
glossary.alduγsan-dur: aldu- — to live together (stem inferred from the Ming 共住); past participle -γsan + dative-locative -dur, 'when (they) lived together' (verb, participle + case, back-vowel form) [共住 時]
glossary.qān-luγ̇a: qān — ruler, khan (short form beside qaγan); comitative -luγ̇a, 'with the qan' (title + case, back-vowel form; Ming 和) [皇帝 和]
glossary.keġeldüküi: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü-; participle -küi, 'that said to one another, mutually declared' (verb, reciprocal participle, front-vowel form) [共說]
glossary.qurčaqus-buiruγ: Qurčaqus-Buiruγ — Qurchaqus-Buiruq, a man's name (one two-part name; Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.alaqu-jin: ala- — to kill; participle -qu + genitive -jin, 'of the killing' (verb, participle + case, -jin after a vowel; used as 'on account of having killed') [殺︀的]
glossary.gür: Gür — Gür, a name or title (here Gür Qan; Ming 人名; the Mongol meaning is unclear) [人名] · also gür, adjective 'all, whole, universal' (e.g. gür ulus 'all the people'; Ming 普)
glossary.abaγa-luγ̇a-ban: abaγa — paternal uncle; comitative -luγ̇a + reflexive-possessive -ban, 'together with one's own uncle' (noun + case + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form; Ming 叔叔 一同 自的行) [叔叔 一同自的行]
glossary.bulγa: bulγa — revolt, rebellion (noun; Ming 反) [反] · also 'turmoil, fighting' (Ming 厮殺 'slaughter')
glossary.haraγ̇un: Haraγ̇un — Hara'un, a mountain name (Ming 山名) [山名]
glossary.širγuγ̇ulažu: širγuγ̇ula- — to crowd together, assemble (stem inferred from the Ming 共攢); converb -žu, 'massing together' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [共攢着]
glossary.žaγ̇un: žaγ̇un — hundred (numeral; the Ming 百 is bracketed) [(百)]
glossary.öġer-türi: öġer — own, self; dative-locative -tür, 'to one's own' (pronoun/adjective + case); the (i) is Shiratori's bracketed vowel left before the reflexive-possessive -(i)jen that follows as the token jen (the Ming 自己 (自的)行 includes the reflexive) [自己 (自的)行]
glossary.iregdežü: ire- — to come; passive -gde-; converb -žü, 'having been come to' (verb, passive converb, front-vowel form; the passive turns 'he came to' into 'he who was come to') [被來着]
glossary.qān-i: qān — ruler, khan (short form beside qaγan); accusative -i, 'the qan (object)' (title + case, -i after a consonant; Ming 行) [皇帝行]
glossary.qašin: Qašin — Qashin, a place-name (Ming 地名) [地名] · also the Qashin as a people or land (Ming 種名 'kind, tribe')
glossary.orγa: orγa — household, hearth (noun; Ming 人烟 'smoke of dwellings') [人烟]
glossary.ögügšen-ü: ög- — to give; linking vowel ü + past participle -gšen + genitive -ü, 'of what was given, of the giving' (verb, participle + case, front-vowel form) [與了 的]
glossary.bolulčaqu: bolulča- — to join together, do together (stem inferred; Ming 共做); participle -qu, 'what is done together' (verb, participle) [共做了的]
glossary.erke-qara: Erke-Qara — Erke-Qara, a man's name, Wang Qan's younger brother (one two-part name; erke 'power' + qara 'black' is only a guess) (personal name) [人名]
glossary.aqa-daγ̇an: aqa — elder brother; dative-locative -da, here naming who does the act, + reflexive-possessive -γ̇an, 'by his own elder brother' (noun + case + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [兄 自的行]
glossary.buruγ̇udču: buruγ̇ud- — to flee, hide, take cover (stem uncertain; Ming 逃躱 'flee and hide'); converb -ču, 'fleeing' (verb, converb after a consonant) [逃躱着]
glossary.inanča: Inanča — Inancha, a name or title borne by the Naiman ruler (the Ming says only 'a name'; meaning unknown) (personal name) [人名]
glossary.balaγad: balaγad — towns, cities (a plural in -d; no singular is seen in this text) (noun, plural) [城子每] · the plural of balaγasun 'town' (seen in balaγad-tur and balaγad-turi, Ming 城子每)
glossary.bitun: bitu- — to go along, skirt (stem uncertain); converb -n, 'going along' (verb, converb; the Ming 沼 'marsh' glosses it here, which looks like a misprint for 沿着 as at bitužu — uncertain) [沼]
glossary.qara-kitad-un: Qara-Kitad — the Black Khitan, a people; genitive -un after a consonant, 'of the Black Khitan' (name + case, back-vowel form) [種(名)的]
glossary.oduγsan: od- — to go; past participle -uγsan (linking u after a consonant), 'who had gone' (verb, participle) [去了]
glossary.uiγud-un: Uiγud — the Uighurs, a people; genitive -un after a consonant (name + case, back-vowel form) [種(名)的]
glossary.taṅγud-un: Taṅγud — the Tangut, a people; genitive -un after a consonant (name + case, back-vowel form) [種(名)的]
glossary.imaγ̇ad: imaγan — goat (the Ming writes the animal with a rare character, 𦍩䍽, the same as at ešige, so 'sheep or goat' is not excluded); plural -d, 'goats' (noun + plural) [𦍩䍽每]
glossary.širgüġeležü: širgüġele- — to hold fast, keep confined (stem uncertain; Ming 拘 'detain'); converb -žü, 'keeping' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [拘着]
glossary.saγ̇al: saγa- — to milk (Ming 共擠 'milk together'); the token is the first half of saγ̇al-dužu, split at the line end: the stem saγa- plus the -l- of the reciprocal -ldu-, whose -du- is the next token dužu (verb stem + extension, split word) [共擠]
glossary.temeġen-ü: temeġen — camel; genitive -ü, 'of the camel(s)' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [駱馳 的]
glossary.qanažu: qana- — to pierce, prick (stem inferred from the Ming 刺着); converb -žu, 'piercing' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [刺着]
glossary.küseġür: Küseġür — Küseġür, a lake (Ming 海子名 'lake name'; meaning of the name unknown) (place name) [海︀子名]
glossary.uridu: uridu — formerly, before (adverb, a variant of urida) [在前]
glossary.luγ̇a: -luγ̇a — comitative: with, together with (back-vowel form; printed after a hyphen, so Qān-luγ̇a 'with the Qan'; Ming 同 'with') (case suffix) [同] · also after anda- (anda- luγ̇a, 'with the anda'; the hyphen is the printer's, at the line end; Ming 一同 'together with')
glossary.josu-γ̇ar: josu — custom, proper way, rule; instrumental -γ̇ar, 'by the custom, according to' (noun + case, back-vowel form; Ming 理 依着 'following the principle') [理 依着] · also josu — custom, proper way, rule (Ming 道理 'reason, the right way'), with instrumental -γ̇ar, 'by the custom, according to' [道理 依着]
glossary.taγai-baγ̇atur: Taγai-Baγ̇atur — Taqai-Ba'atur, a man's name (baγ̇atur 'hero, brave man', here a title or epithet; Ming 人名 勇士) (personal name + title) [人名 勇士]
glossary.sükegei-žeġün: Sükegei-Žeġün — Sükegei-Jegün, a man's name (one two-part name) (personal name) [人名]
glossary.ileġed: ile- — to send, make go (Ming 敎去了 'caused to go'); converb -ġed, 'having sent' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [敎去了] · also where the Ming has 去了 'went' without 敎: ile- 'to go' or 'to send', uncertain which [去了]
glossary.teriġün-eče: teriġün — head, source, beginning (Ming 源頭 'source'); ablative -eče, 'from the head of' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [源頭 處]
glossary.öleščü: öles- — to be hungry, starve (stem uncertain; Ming 飢); converb -čü, 'starving' (verb, converb after a consonant, front-vowel form) [飢着]
glossary.turužu: turu- — to grow thin, waste (stem inferred from the Ming 瘦); converb -žu, 'growing thin' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [瘦着]
glossary.qubčir-i: qubčir — levy, contribution, tax (Ming 科歛 'a levy'); accusative -i, 'the levy' as object (noun + case, after a consonant) [科歛(行)]
glossary.qubčižu: qubči- — to levy, gather in (Ming 歛 'collect'); converb -žu, 'levying' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [歛着] · also Ming 打着 'striking': in gölmi γubčiγ̇ur bolžu siġüžü qubčižu, perhaps 'netting' (uncertain) [打着] · also with Ming 收拾 'gather up, collect': irge … qubčižu, 'levying (men)'
glossary.oroγ̇ulžu: oro- — to enter; causative -γ̇ul-, converb -žu, 'making enter, bringing in' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form; Ming 敎入着) [敎入着] · also ‘making surrender’ (Ming 敎投降着) [敎投降着]
glossary.žerge-ġer: žerge — rank, order, row; instrumental -ġer, 'in order, in turn' (noun + case, front-vowel form; Ming 依 次 'by order') [依 次]
glossary.qubaqaja-ji: Qubaqaja — Qubaqaja, a place name; accusative -ji after a vowel (place name + case; Ming 地名 行) [地名 行]
glossary.ügeġü: ügeġü — lacking, poor (adjective; sense from the Ming 窮 'poor, destitute') [窮] · also without, not having (Ming 無), where the sense is 'not being'
glossary.hümegei: hümegei — stinking, foul (adjective; sense from the Ming 臭 only, so uncertain) [臭︀]
glossary.eburidčü: ebürid- — to hold in the bosom, harbour (stem uncertain; from ebür 'bosom'? Ming 懷着 'cherishing'); converb -čü (verb, converb after a consonant, front-vowel form; a spelling of ebüridčü) [懷着]
glossary.jabuju: jabu- — to walk, go about; -ju is the converb -žu written with j, standing as a finite 'is going about' (uncertain; the Ming 有 'is' supports a finite sense) (verb) [行有]
glossary.deġü-ji: deġü — younger brother; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'the younger brother' as object (noun + case) [弟行]
glossary.qara-kitad-tur: Qara-Kitad — the Black Khitan, a people; dative-locative -tur, 'to the Black Khitan' (name + case, back-vowel form) [種(名) 裏]
glossary.žobaγ̇amu: žobaγ̇a- — to afflict, cause hardship (Ming 敎辛苦 'make toil'; stem uncertain); present -mu, 'afflicts' (verb, present tense) [敎辛苦有]
glossary.eġün-i: eġün — this one (the oblique stem of ene before case endings); accusative -i, 'this one' as object (pronoun + case) [這箇 行]
glossary.kikün: ki- — to do; future participle -kün, 'shall do' (verb, participle; in ker kikün 'how shall (we) do'; the Ming 怎飮 uses 飮 'drink' only to write the sound kün) [怎飮] · also ki- 'to do', future participle -kün, 'shall (we) do' (Ming 做咱)
glossary.nasutu-ji: nasu — years of age; possessive -tu 'having' + accusative -ji, 'the one having years, the aged' as object (noun + possessive + case; Ming 歲(有的)行) [歲(有的)行]
glossary.ešige: ešige — hide of a sheep or goat, sheepskin (noun; the Ming writes the animal with the rare character 𦍩䍽, which shows no age, so 'lamb' is not in the Ming) [𦍩䍽]
glossary.seleṅge-jin: Seleṅge — the Selenge, a river; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the Selenge' (river name + case) [河名 的]
glossary.aγ̇ur: aγ̇ur — mortar, pounding-mill (noun; Ming 碓, a treadle pestle-mill; elsewhere aγ̇ur(i)-jan before the reflexive means 'breath, rage', where the sense differs) [碓]
glossary.nödübe-kü: nödü- — to pound, work a mill (uncertain: the Ming 儔 'companion' is no verb of pounding); past -be, 'worked'; emphatic -kü, 'indeed' (Ming 也) (verb, past + particle) [儔了 也]
glossary.ažai: Ažai — Ajai, a man's name, the Tatar ruler (personal name) [人名]
glossary.temeġedi: temeġen — camel; plural -d, accusative (i), 'camels (object)', before the reflexive jen that follows as the token jen (noun + plural + case; the (i) is Shiratori's; Ming 駱駝(每)自的行) [駱駝(每)自的行]
glossary.adulaγ̇ulun: adula- — to herd, pasture (Ming 牧放); causative -γ̇ul-, converb -n, 'having (him) herd' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form) [敎牧放]
glossary.qoniči: qoniči — shepherd, sheep-herder (perhaps qonin 'sheep' + agent -či; Ming 牧羊的) (noun) [牧羊(的)]
glossary.horγužu: horγu- — to flee (stem uncertain; Ming 逃着); converb -žu, 'fleeing' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [逃着]
glossary.sartaγ̇ul-un: Sartaγ̇ul — the Muslims of Central Asia, Sarta'ul (Ming 囘囘 'Muslims'); genitive -un after a consonant (people name + case) [囘囘的]
glossary.čui: Čui — the Chu, a river (Ming 河名 'river name') (river name) [河名]
glossary.daičin: daičin — war, hostility (noun; sense from the Ming 反 'revolt', uncertain) [反]
glossary.uiγ̇ud-un: Uiγud — the Uighurs, a people; genitive -un after a consonant (name + case; a spelling with γ̇ of uiγud-un) [種(名)的]
glossary.taṅγ̇ud-un: Taṅγud — the Tangut, a people; genitive -un after a consonant (name + case; a spelling with γ̇ of taṅγud-un) [種(名)的]
glossary.bitužu: bitu- — to go along, skirt (stem uncertain; Ming 沿着 'going along'); converb -žu (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [沿着]
glossary.jaburun: jabu- — to walk, go about; converb of time -run, 'while going about' (verb, converb; Ming 行時) [行時]
glossary.saγ̇ažu: saγa- — to milk (Ming 擠 'press, milk'); converb -žu, 'milking' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [擠着]
glossary.idežü: ide- — to eat; converb -žü, 'eating' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [喫着]
glossary.soqor: soqor — blind (adjective; Ming 瞎, which may also mean one-eyed) [瞎] · also Soqor, a man's name (the Ming marks it 人名 here, not 'blind')
glossary.qaliγ̇un: qaliγ̇un — a horse colour (adjective; Ming 黑髮尾黃 'black mane, yellow tail'; exact sense uncertain) [黑髮尾黃]
glossary.köġün-dür: köġün — son (not küġün 'person'); dative-locative -dür, 'to the son' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [兒行]
glossary.jabuγsani: jabu- — to walk, go about; past participle -γsan, accusative (i), 'what (he) had done on his travels (object)', before the reflexive jan that follows as the token jan (verb, participle + case; the (i) is Shiratori's; Ming 行了的 自的行) [行了的 自的行]
glossary.umartažu: umarta- — to forget; converb -žu, 'forgetting' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [忘了着]

glossary.γaqai: γaqai — pig (noun; Ming 猪兒) [猪︀兒]
glossary.qardakidai: Qardakidai — a people or clan name (Ming 種人) [種人]

glossary.qačiγ̇un-beki: Qačiγ̇un-Beki — Qachi'un-Beki, a man's name (beki, a title of rank, uncertain) (personal name) [人名]

glossary.urtu-jin: urtu — long; genitive -jin, 'of the long' (adjective + case; Ming 長 的) [長 的]

glossary.qara-da: qara — black; dative-locative -da, 'in the black' (adjective + case; Ming 黑行) [黑行]

glossary.žoban: žoban — toil, hardship (noun; Ming 生受) [生受]

glossary.küčügürtei-buiruγ: Küčügürtei-Buiruγ — Küchügürtei-Buiruq, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.soquγ-usun-ača: Soquγ-Usun — Soqoq-Usun, a water name; ablative -ača, 'from' (place name + case) [水名處]
glossary.dabaγ̇ulun: daba- — to cross over a pass; causative -γ̇ul-, 'make cross'; converb -un, '-ing' (with linking vowel) (verb, causative, converb) [越過]
glossary.uriṅγu: Uriṅγu — the Urungu, a river (water name) [水名]
glossary.kičil-baši: Kičil-Baši — Kichil-Bash, a lake name (place name) [海︀子名]
glossary.moqudγažu: moqudγa- — to drive to the end (Ming 窮極着; the stem is uncertain); converb -žu, '-ing' (verb, converb) [窮極着]
glossary.abuγ̇ai-že: ab- — to take; past -uγ̇ai (linking vowel + -γ̇ai; uncertain); -že, assertion particle 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [要了也者︀]
glossary.baidaraγ-balčir-e: Baidaraγ-Balčir — Baidaraq-Balchir, a place name; dative-locative -e, 'to, at' (place name + case) [地名處]
glossary.baiduqui-dur: bai- — to stand; reciprocal -du- (uncertain); participle -qui, 'the …-ing'; dative-locative -dur, 'at, in' (verb, participle + case; Ming 對陣時 'at facing in battle') [對陣時]
glossary.bödölbe-že: bödöl- — to move, set off (Ming 動了; printed b-, for ködöl-); past -be, '-ed'; -že, assertion particle 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [動了 也者︀]
glossary.boldarun: bol- — to become; passive -da-, 'be …-ed'; converb of time -run, 'when …-ing' (verb, passive, converb) [被做時]
glossary.ködöldežü: ködöl- — to move; passive -de-, 'be …-ed'; converb -žü, '-ing' (front-vowel form) (verb, passive, converb) [被動着]
glossary.keġere: Keġere — Ke'ere, the second half of the place name Saγ̇ari-Keġere (place name) [名]
glossary.baγ̇uba-že: baγ̇u- — to descend, dismount, make camp; past -ba, '-ed'; -že, assertion particle 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [下了 也者︀]
glossary.qudu: Qudu — Qutu (Qudu), a man's name (personal name; Ming (兒)名) [(兒)名]
glossary.orγa-bari: orγ̇a — household (Ming 人煙 'smoke'); instrumental -bar, 'with, by means of', plus Shiratori's bracketed (i) (noun + case) [人烟 自的連]
glossary.ködölžüġüi-že: ködöl- — to move; past -žüġüi (front-vowel form of -žuγ̇ui), '…-ed'; -že, assertion particle 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [動了 也者︀]
glossary.kögseġü-sebraγ-a: Kögseġü-Sebraγ — Kökse'ü-Sabraq, a man's name (printed Sebraγ); dative-locative -a, 'to, at'; with a passive verb it names the doer, 'by' (personal name + case) [人名(行)]
glossary.orγa-ban: orγ̇a — household (Ming 人煙 'smoke'); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own' (noun + reflexive) [人烟自的(行)]
glossary.külüġü: külüġü — hero, champion; the stem, split from -d by Shiratori's hyphen or brackets (noun) [傑]
glossary.di: -d — plural, with Shiratori's bracketed (i), perhaps the accusative; the token left before -jen, 'one's own' (the Ming 自的行 covers the reflexive) (plural + case) [(每)自的行]
glossary.külüġüd-ün: külüġü — hero, champion; plural -d; genitive -ün, 'of' (front-vowel form, after d) (noun + plural + case) [傑(每)的]
glossary.ögüġesü: ög- — to give; conditional converb -üġesü, 'if, when' (linking vowel ü + -ġesü) (verb, converb) [與呵] · also an auxiliary after a converb of speech, 'telling, having given' (Ming 與呵 'if given'), where the sense of giving is slight (uncertain)
glossary.čimadba: čimad- — to blame, find fault; past -ba, '-ed' (verb, past) [怪責了]
glossary.čimarun: čimar — blame, reproach, displeasure; genitive -un, 'of' (back-vowel form, after r) (noun + case) [怪責]
glossary.josun-dur: josun — rule, principle, ground; dative-locative -dur, 'at, in' (noun + case) [道理行]
glossary.qubari-quri: Qubari-Quri — a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.idürgen: Idürgen — a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.nögöži-ji: nögöži — the second one(s); accusative -ji, marks the object (after a vowel) (numeral + case) [第二 行]
glossary.ai: ai — alas (interjection; the Ming gives only a sign of panting, so the sense is a guess) [(發喘)] · also with Ming (嘆聲), a sigh, 'alas'
glossary.soiluγ: soiluγ — a second cry printed beside ai (interjection; sense uncertain) [(發喘)]
glossary.qaγačaqu-ju: qaγača- — to part, separate; participle -qu + -ju, which after a participle the Ming marks with 麽, 'is (it) parting?' (verb, participle + question particle; as -ju in §§154-157 and §§165-168; uncertain) [分離的 麽]
glossary.töre-dēče: töre — custom, order, what is right (Ming 道理 'principle'); ablative -dēče, 'from' (noun + case, written with Shiratori's long ē) [道理 行]
glossary.hirižekü-jü: hiriče- — to part from, be estranged (written hiriže-); participle -kü + -jü, 'is parting' (verb, participle + particle; the Ming has 有 'is' and no 麽, so it may be a question or a plain statement, uncertain) [分離 有]
glossary.üile-dēče: üile — deed, affair, business; ablative -dēče, 'from' (noun + case, written with long ē) [勾當 行]
glossary.hiričebe: hiriče- — to part from, be estranged; past -be, '-ed' (verb, past) [分離了]
glossary.čisu-ban: čisun — blood (the n lost before the ending); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own blood' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form after a vowel) [血自的(行)]
glossary.γarγaγdasu: γar- — to go out; causative -γa- + passive -γda- + optative -su, 'let it be brought out' (verb, causative passive optative; Ming 者我) [被出者︀我]
glossary.andaγažü: andaγa- — to swear (brotherhood), take an oath (from anda 'sworn brother'; the Ming 說誓 'say an oath'; stem uncertain); converb -žü, 'swearing' (verb, converb) [說誓着]
glossary.sigi-quruγ̇un-u-γ̇an: sigi quruγ̇un — small finger, little finger (sigi from the Ming 小 'small', uncertain; quruγ̇un 'finger'); genitive -u + reflexive-possessive -γ̇an, 'of one's own' (noun + case + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [小 指 自的(行)]
glossary.toli: toli — part of the finger, perhaps the tip (the Ming 指彈 'flicking the finger'; sense uncertain) (noun) [指彈]
glossary.onuči: onuči — notch-cutter, perhaps 'one that cuts a notch' (the Ming 剜箭扣 'cutting an arrow-notch'; uncertain) (noun) [剜箭扣]
glossary.kituγai-bar: kituγai — knife; instrumental -bar, 'with a knife' (noun + case, back-vowel form after a vowel) [刀敎]
glossary.daγtai-dur: daγtai — small birch-bark pail (the Ming 樺皮小桶; stem uncertain); dative-locative -dur, 'in' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [樺皮小桶 裏]
glossary.köġün-e: köġün — son; dative-locative -e, 'to (my) son' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [子行]
glossary.ečige-dēče: ečige — father; ablative -dēče, 'from (the) father' (noun + case, written with long ē) [父行]
glossary.bosγsan: bos- — to rise, set out; participle -γsan, 'the one who has risen' (verb, participle) [起身的]
glossary.žüṅ: žüṅ — cup, goblet (noun) [鍾] · also omen, sign (Ming 先兆), as in žüṅležü 'foretelling'; a different word from the cup
glossary.uγ̇uqu: uγ̇u- — to drink; participle -qu, 'the drinking' (verb, participle) [飮]
glossary.uγdarun: uγ̇u- — to drink (as in uγ̇uqu); passive -γda- (the u of the stem lost, 'be drunk, be served') + converb -run, 'when/while being served' (verb, passive converb; the analysis is from the Ming 被飮 and is uncertain) [被飮的]
glossary.naidaba-že: naida- — to envy, resent (Ming 妒 'be jealous'); past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [妒了也者︀]
glossary.baradqun: bara- — to finish, drain (stem inferred from the Ming 飮了 'drunk up'); -dqun, the plural-command ending, which the Ming reads here as a converb 'having ...-ed'; a command ('drain it!') cannot be ruled out (verb; uncertain) [飮了着]
glossary.kedüi-že: kedüi — how much, how many (adverb); assertion particle -že, 'indeed' [幾多(也者︀)]
glossary.ileġü-ü: ileġü — openly, face to face (adverb; the Ming 對面; uncertain); -ü an ending of uncertain force, the Ming glosses none [對面]
glossary.gesü: ge- — to want, mean to (the Ming 要弃 'wish to cast away'; the stem may be a form of keġe- 'say'; uncertain); optative -sü, 'let me, I will' (verb, optative) [要弃]
glossary.keġeleġei: keġe- — to say; -leġei, past ending of a question, 'did (you) say?' (verb, past question; the Ming 說來麽) [說來麽] · also without 麽 (Ming 說來), a plain past, 'said' (uncertain)
glossary.žüqažü-u: žüqa- — to face, deal with, set against (the Ming 對付 'cope with'; stem uncertain); converb -žü + -u, an ending of uncertain force (as -ü in ileġü-ü) (verb, converb) [對付着]
glossary.qučar-i: Qučar — Quchar, a man's name; accusative -i, marks the object (name + case) [人名(行)]
glossary.bol: bol- — to become, be; the bare stem is a command, 'become!' (verb, imperative) [做]
glossary.bolba-že: bol- — to become, be; past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed', 'agreed to be, became' (verb, past + particle; Ming 肻做了 'agreed to be') [肻做了 也者︀]
glossary.altan-i: Altan — Altan, a man's name; accusative -i, marks the object (name + case) [人名行]
glossary.qān-lu: qān — qan, sovereign; -lu, a particle after Qān (the Ming 但 'only, just'; uncertain) (noun + particle) [皇帝 但]
glossary.aγsa: aγsa- — to go about, travel (stem inferred from the Ming 往來 'going and coming'; the first half of aγsa-γ̇ar, split by the printer) (verb) [往來的]
glossary.γ̇ar: -γ̇ar — instrumental: by, along, following (case suffix, back-vowel form; the second half of aγsa-γ̇ar and the ending in boγ̇ol(i)-γ̇ar, 'as a slave'; Ming 依着 'following') [依着]
glossary.deġe: deġe — above, upper (adverb or noun; the first half of deġere-eče, split by the printer) [上]
glossary.re-eče: -re-eče — -re, an ending of position, 'on the ... side' (uncertain) + ablative -eče, 'from' (the second half of deġe-re-eče, 'from above'; case suffix, front-vowel form) [處]
glossary.boludqun: bolu- — to become, be; -dqun, ending of the plural command, 'you (all) become!' (verb, plural command) [做您]
glossary.jadaba-že: jada- — to be unable, fail (here after a converb: 'unable to bring (it) about'; the exact sense is uncertain); past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [不能了 也者︀]
glossary.jadažü: jada- — to be unable (Ming 不能着), after a verb or noun 'unable to ...'; converb -žu written -žü here though the stem is back-vowel (verb, converb; uncertain) [不能着]
glossary.jabuba-že: jabu- — to walk, go about; past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle; Ming 行了 也者︀) [行了 也者︀]
glossary.qaγ̇ulγaγdaγ̇asu: qaγ̇ul- — to drive, rush (stem inferred from the Ming 奔 'run'); causative -γa- + passive -γda- + conditional -γ̇asu, 'if (it) is made to rush' (verb, conditional; the stack of endings is a guess from the Ming) [敎奔呵]
glossary.daγ̇uliqui-dur: daγ̇uli- — to seize, plunder (stem inferred from the Ming 據 'seize'); participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'at the time of seizing' (verb, participle + case; Ming 時 'time') [據 時]
glossary.ögüġei: ög- — to give; -üġei, ending of the speaker's intention, 'I will give' (verb; uncertain) [與]
glossary.büleġe-že: bü- — to be; past -leġe, 'there was, used to' + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle; Ming 有來) [有來 也者︀]
glossary.oraγ̇a: oraγ̇a — wild, open (adjective; the Ming 野; uncertain) [野]
glossary.uturaγ̇uldaγ̇asu: utura- — to go out and ring (a hunt) (stem inferred from the Ming 出圍 'go out to encircle'); causative -γ̇ul-, passive -da- (uncertain), conditional -γ̇asu, 'if (the hunt) is made to go out' (verb, conditional; the stack is a guess) [敎出圍呵]
glossary.qada-jin: qada — cliff, crag; genitive -jin, 'of the cliff' (noun + case, after a vowel) [崖的]
glossary.gun: gun — mountain crag (the Ming 山崖; uncertain) (noun; printed Gun-(n)u, the token left before -(n)u) [山崖的]
glossary.saitur: saitur — well, properly (adverb; from sain 'good') [好生]
glossary.ögüdkün: ög- — to give; -üdkün, ending of the plural command, 'you (all) give!' (verb, plural command; the front-vowel form of -dqun) [與您]
glossary.keġegdeġüžei: keġe- — to say; passive -gde- + -ġüžei, 'lest ...' (verb, passive + lest-ending; Ming 恐 'lest', 'lest it be said') [恐說被]
glossary.čaγ̇ud-quri-jin: Čaγ̇ud-quri — Chaud-quri, an office or title (Ming 官名 'name of an office'); genitive -jin, 'of' (title + case, after a vowel) [官名的]
glossary.keġeġülüdkün: keġe- — to say; causative -ġül- (the Ming 被說 reads it 'be told') + -üdkün, plural command, 'you (all) cause to be said / have it said' (verb, causative plural command) [被說您]
glossary.müred-ün: müren — river; plural -d + genitive -ün, 'of the rivers' (noun + plural + case, front-vowel form) [河(每)的]
glossary.baγ̇uludqun: baγ̇u- — to settle, halt, camp; causative -γ̇ul- (written -ul-) + -dqun, plural command, 'you (all) make camp!' (verb, causative plural command) [敎下營]
glossary.tumbinai: Tumbinai — Tumbinai, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.oγda: Oγda — Oqda, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.boγ̇oli: boγ̇ol — bondman, slave; the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel before the instrumental -γ̇ar, 'as a slave' (noun; the Ming reads 行, so the case is uncertain) [奴婢 行]
glossary.bilažu: bila- — to seize, carry off as plunder (stem inferred from the Ming 擄); converb -žu, 'seizing' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [擄着]
glossary.irebe-že: ire- — to come; past -be + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle; Ming 來了 也者︀) [來了 也者︀]
glossary.boγ̇ol-un: boγ̇ol — bondman, slave; genitive -un, 'of a slave' (noun + case, after a consonant) [奴婢的]
glossary.sübegei: Sübegei — Sübegei, a man's name (a son's name; personal name) [子名]
glossary.kököčü-kirsaγ̇an: Kököčü-Kirsaγ̇an — Kököchü-Kirsa'an, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.kököčü-kirsaγ̇an-u: Kököčü-Kirsaγ̇an — Kököchü-Kirsa'an, a man's name; genitive -u after n, printed without Shiratori's usual (n) (name + case) [人名的]
glossary.jegei-quṅtaγar: Jegei-Quṅtaγar — Jegei-Qungtaqar, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.jegei-quṅtaγar-un: Jegei-Quṅtaγar — Jegei-Qungtaqar, a man's name; genitive -un after a consonant (name + case) [人名的]
glossary.ulus-ud: ulus — people, subjects; plural -ud (noun + plural) [百姓(每)]
glossary.žüšüridün: žüšüri- — to flatter, fawn (stem inferred from the Ming 諂佞); -dün, an ending probably a converb (verb; uncertain) [諂佞]
glossary.medeġülkün: mede- — to manage, rule (Ming 管); causative -ġül- + -kün, ending of a command (uncertain), 'have (it) managed' (verb, causative command) [敎管]
glossary.borγai-jin: borγai — high ancestor, great-great-grandfather (Ming 高祖); genitive -jin, 'of' (noun + case, after a vowel) [高祖︀ 的]
glossary.elinčüġ-ün: elinčüg — great-grandfather (Ming 曾祖); genitive -ün, 'of' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [曾祖︀的]
glossary.eġüden-ü: eġüden — door; genitive -ü, 'of the door' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [門的]
glossary.ilekü-ji: ile- — to send; participle -kü + accusative -ji, 'the sending (of)' (verb, participle + case, after a vowel) [去的 行]
glossary.sačaγ̇u: sačaγ̇u — alike, equally (adverb; the Ming 一般 'the same') [一般]
glossary.oroγdaqui-jača: oro- — to enter; passive -γda- + participle -qui + ablative -jača, 'from the being entered into' (verb, passive participle + case, after a vowel; Ming (被)入) [(被)入 行]
glossary.hüldebe-že: hülde- — to drive off, chase away (stem inferred from the Ming 趕); past -be + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [趕了 也者︀]
glossary.žoboγ̇an: žoboγ̇a- — to suffer hardship; with the Ming 敎 'cause', 'to trouble (someone)' (stem inferred from the Ming 生受; reading uncertain); converb -n, 'troubling' (verb, converb) [敎生受]
glossary.üde: üde — evening, late (adverb; the Ming 晩) [晩]
glossary.manaγar-i: manaγar — morning, early (the Ming 早); accusative -i (the Ming 行; uncertain) (noun + case) [早行] · also with the Ming 明早行, 'tomorrow (morning)' [明早行]
glossary.sergüġežü: sergüġe- — to dispel, soothe (the Ming 消解 'dissolve, relieve'; stem uncertain); converb -žü, 'soothing' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [消解着]
glossary.üjen-ü: üjen — old, former (the Ming 舊; uncertain); genitive -ü, 'of the old' (adjective + case, front-vowel form) [舊的]
glossary.sedkili: sedkil — heart, mind; the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel before the reflexive -jen, 'one's own heart' (noun) [心 自的行]
glossary.talbin: talbi- — to put down, let go; converb -n, 'letting go' (verb, converb) [放]
glossary.ečige-ji: ečige — father; accusative -ji, 'the father (object)' (noun + case, after a vowel) [父 行]
glossary.žoboγ̇ažu: žoboγ̇a- — to suffer hardship (the Ming 生受 'suffer', without the 敎 of žoboγ̇an; uncertain); converb -žu, 'suffering' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [生受着]
glossary.alγasaγ̇ul: alγasa- — to part, split, divide (Ming 分); causative -γ̇ul, the bare stem a command, 'make (it) part!' (verb, causative imperative) [敎分了]
glossary.nököd-i: nökör — companion, follower; plural -d (nököd) + accusative -i, 'the companions (object)' (noun + plural + case) [伴當(每)行]
glossary.qojari: qojar — two; the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel before the instrumental -jar, 'by the two' (numeral; Ming 兩箇(依著︀)) [兩箇(依著︀)]
glossary.bariγ̇ulužu: bari- — to hold, take; causative -γ̇ul- + converb -užu (-žu after a linking u), 'making (them) hold' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form) [敎把着]
glossary.keli: keli — when, at any time (adverb; the Ming 幾時 'when'; uncertain) [幾時]
glossary.kiduγ̇ači: kiduγ̇ači — one fond of killing, a killer (noun; the Ming 好殺的; stem uncertain) [好殺︀的]
glossary.böġe: böġe — shaman (noun; the Ming 師公 'shaman'; here in a saying whose sense is unclear) [師公]
glossary.sartaγčin: Sartaγčin — Sartaqchin, a Muslim or a Muslim group (the Ming 囘囘; sense uncertain) [囘囘]
glossary.qonin-u: qonin — sheep; genitive -u, 'of a sheep' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [羊的]
glossary.žübčižü: žübči- — to attach, continue, join on (the Ming 續 'continue'); converb -žü, 'joining on' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [續着]
glossary.üges-ün: üge — word; plural -s + genitive -ün, 'of the words' (noun + plural + case, front-vowel form) [言語每的]
glossary.arγas: arγa — means, plan, scheme (Ming 計量 'calculation'); plural -s, 'schemes' (noun + plural) [計量]
glossary.uqaγdaba: uqa- — to understand, perceive (Ming 覺); passive -γda- + past -ba, 'was perceived' (verb, passive past) [可覺了]
glossary.qadqulduγ̇an-u: qadqu- — to slay; reciprocal -ldu- + noun of action -γ̇an (uncertain) + genitive -u, 'of the fighting' (verb noun + case, back-vowel form) [厮殺︀的]
glossary.teriġüd: teriġün — head, chief, first; plural -d, 'the heads, the first things' (noun + plural) [頭每]
glossary.tuγ: tuγ — standard, banner (noun; Ming 旄纛) [旄纛]
glossary.bosγadq̇un: bos- — to rise; causative -γa- + -dqun, plural command, 'you (all) raise!' (verb, causative plural command) [立起您]
glossary.tarγulaγ̇uludqun: tarγula- — to grow fat (from tarγun 'fat'; stem inferred from the Ming 肥); causative -γ̇ul- + -(u)dqun, plural command, 'you (all) fatten!' (verb, causative plural command) [敎肥了您]
glossary.qariqui-dur: qari- — to return; participle -qui + dative-locative -dur, 'at the time of returning' (verb, participle + case, back-vowel form; Ming 時) [囘時]

glossary.jaγ̇utan: jaγ̇u(n) — what (the -n drops before the ending) (pronoun); possessive plural -tan, 'those having what' (pronoun + possessive plural) [甚麽(有的)每]
glossary.moṅγol-dur: Moṅγol — the Mongols (people); dative-locative -dur, 'to, among' (name + case, back-vowel form) [達達 行]
glossary.niγ̇udqun: niγu- — to conceal, hide (stem inferred from the Ming 隱慝; the glossary has niγu-); -d, an ending going with a plural subject (uncertain, as in abčiradqun), imperative -qun, '(you all) hide!' (verb, imperative, second person plural) [(隱慝您)]
glossary.idγaγ̇uluγ̇ad: idγa- — to urge, persuade (stem inferred from the Ming 勸); -γ̇ul- (a causative form, but read by the Ming as passive 被), converb -γ̇ad, 'having been urged' (verb, causative/passive converb) [被勸了]
glossary.torbi-taši: Torbi-Taši — Torbi-Tashi, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.öṅgüd-ün: Öṅgüd — the Önggüd, a people; genitive -ün, 'of' (name + genitive, front-vowel form) [種名的]
glossary.alaquši-digid-quri-da: Alaquši-Digid-Quri — Alaqush-Digit-Quri, a man's name (personal name); dative-locative -da, 'to' (name + case, back-vowel form) [人名行]
glossary.alaquši-digid-quri: Alaquši-Digid-Quri — Alaqush-Digit-Quri, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.juγunan: Juγunan — Juqunan, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.elči-jeri: elči — envoy, messenger (noun); instrumental -jer (front-vowel form of -jar) with Shiratori's bracketed (i), which the reader keeps in the token, 'by means of the envoy' (noun + case; uncertain; the Ming 自的行 belongs to the reflexive that follows) [使臣 自的行]
glossary.čin-ü: či — you (pronoun; the genitive stem is čin-); genitive -ü, 'of you, your' (pronoun + genitive) [你的]
glossary.iremüi: ire- — to come; present -müi, 'comes' (verb, present) [來有]
glossary.sereġülžü: sere- — to be aware, be on guard (stem inferred from the Ming 省); causative -ġül-, converb -žü, 'making aware, warning' (verb, causative converb, front-vowel form) [敎省着]
glossary.abdaγ̇užai: ab- — to take; passive -da-, apprehensive -γ̇užai, 'lest (one) be taken' (verb, passive apprehensive; Ming 恐 'for fear that') [恐被要了]
glossary.temeġen-keġer-i: Temeġen-Keġer — Teme'en-Ke'er, a place name (name); accusative -i (name + case) [地名行]
glossary.abakažu: abaka- — to hold a circle hunt (stem inferred from the Ming 圍獵; compare aba); converb -žu, 'hunting in a circle' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [圍獵着]
glossary.tülkin-čeġüd-i: Tülkin-Čeġüd — Tülkin-Che'üd, a place name (name); accusative -i (name + case) [地名行]
glossary.qomorču: qomor- — to close in, encircle (stem inferred from the Ming 圍合); converb -ču, 'closing in' (verb, converb, back-vowel form after r) [圍合着]
glossary.alaquši-digid-quri-jin: Alaquši-Digid-Quri — Alaqush-Digit-Quri, a man's name (personal name); genitive -jin, 'of' (after a vowel) (name + genitive) [人名 的]
glossary.kelen-dür: kelen — word, speech, news (noun); dative-locative -dür, 'in, at' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [話 裏]
glossary.keġeldüġesü: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü-, conditional -ġesü, 'if / when (they) said to one another' (verb, reciprocal conditional) [共說呵]
glossary.keġeldüžüġüi: keġe- — to say; reciprocal -ldü-, past narrative -žüġüi, 'said to one another' (verb, reciprocal past narrative) [共說了]
glossary.ödčigin: Ödčigin — Ödchigin, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.šiltaγdaqu: šiltaγda- — to make an excuse, plead (stem inferred from the Ming 推辭); participle -qu (verb, participle) [推辭]
glossary.tarγud: tarγu — fat (adjective; stem inferred from the Ming 肥); plural -d, 'the fat ones' (adjective + plural) [肥每]
glossary.saγ̇uγdaqu: saγ̇u- — to sit; -γda- (passive or potential, uncertain), participle -qu, 'to be sat on, fit to sit' (verb, participle) [可坐]
glossary.ere-de: ere — man, husband (noun); dative-locative -de, 'to, for' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [男子 行]
glossary.numun: numun — bow (noun; Ming 弓弩 'bow and crossbow'; the printer's hyphen at a line end is dropped from the token) [弓]
glossary.lüġe-ben: lüġe — with, together with (postposition); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own' (postposition + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form) [一同自的行]
glossary.jasun-luγ̇a: jasun — bone (noun); comitative -luγ̇a, 'with' (noun + case) [骨頭 一同]
glossary.jeketü: jeke — great, big (adjective); possessive -tü, 'having greatness, big' (adjective + possessive) [大有的]
glossary.abuγ̇asu: ab- — to take; conditional -uγ̇asu, 'if / when (one) takes' (verb, conditional, back-vowel form) [要呵]
glossary.berkedü-ü: berkedü — hard, difficult (adjective; Ming 難); question particle -ü, 'is it hard?' (adjective + question particle) [難︀麽]
glossary.žoγsažu: žoγsa- — to rest (stem inferred from the Ming 歇息); converb -žu, 'resting' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [歇息着]
glossary.qočoruγ̇užai: qočoru- — to fall behind, be left behind (stem inferred from the Ming 落後); apprehensive -γ̇užai, 'lest (one) fall behind' (verb, apprehensive; Ming 麽 'might … not?') [落後麽]
glossary.eġürežü: eġüre- — to empty (stem inferred; the Ming glosses it in brackets); converb -žü, 'emptying' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [(空着)]
glossary.etüged-tür: etügen — earth, ground, land (the glossary has the name Etügen, 'the Earth'; the Ming 處 says 'place'); plural -d (uncertain, the Ming does not mark it); dative-locative -tür, 'in, at' (noun + plural + case, front-vowel form after d) [處裏]
glossary.qorura: qoru- — to shelter, take refuge (stem inferred from the Ming 躱避); converb of purpose -ra, 'in order to shelter' (verb, converb, as in abura) [躱避]
glossary.γaruγ̇užai: γar- — to go up, go out (stem inferred from the Ming 上去); apprehensive -uγ̇užai, 'lest (one) go up' (verb, apprehensive; Ming 麽) [上去麽]
glossary.üġüleġülžü: üġüle- — to speak (a spelling of ügüle-); causative -ġül-, converb -žü, 'making (someone) speak' (verb, causative converb, front-vowel form) [敎說着]
glossary.nojan-u: nojan — noyan, lord, officer; genitive -u, 'of the lord' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [官人的]
glossary.abžiγa-köteger-eče: Abžiγa-Köteger — a place name (Abjiya-Köteger); ablative -eče, 'from' (name + case) [地名處]
glossary.keltegei-qada: Keltegei-Qada — a place name (Keltegei-Qada; qada may be 'cliff' but the Ming glosses only the whole name) (name) [地名]
glossary.toγ̇a-ban: toγa — number, count; reflexive-possessive -ban, 'their own count' (noun + reflexive-possessive) [數自的行]
glossary.toγ̇olaldužu: toγola- — to count; -ldu-, joint action, 'together'; converb -žu, 'counting together' (verb, reciprocal/joint, converb) [共數着]
glossary.minγalažu: miṅγala- — to make a thousand, form into thousands (from miṅγan); converb -žu, 'making a thousand' (verb, converb) [千做着]
glossary.miṅγan-u: miṅγan — thousand; genitive -u, 'of the thousand' (numeral/noun + case) [千的]
glossary.žaγ̇un-u: žaγun — hundred; genitive -u, 'of the hundred' (numeral/noun + case) [百的]
glossary.harban-u: harban — ten; genitive -u, 'of the ten' (numeral/noun + case) [十的]
glossary.čerbin-i: čerbi — cherbi, an office or rank (meaning of the title not known); the stem's linking -n- and accusative -i, 'the cherbi (object)' (noun + case) [官名 行]
glossary.ögele-čerbi: Ögele-Čerbi — Ögele-Cherbi, a man's name with the office title čerbi (personal name + title; the meaning of čerbi is not known) [人名 官名]
glossary.tolun-čerbi: Tolun-Čerbi — Tolun-Cherbi, a man's name with the office title čerbi (personal name + title; the meaning of čerbi is not known) [人名 官名]
glossary.bučaran-čerbi: Bučaran-Čerbi — Bucharan-Cherbi, a man's name with the office title čerbi (personal name + title; the meaning of čerbi is not known) [人名 官名]
glossary.miṅγalan: miṅγala- — to make a thousand; -n, converb 'having made' (verb, converb; reading of -n uncertain) [千做了]
glossary.žaγ̇ulan: žaγula- — to make a hundred (from žaγun); -n, converb 'having made' (verb, converb; reading of -n uncertain) [百做了]
glossary.harbalan: harbala- — to make a ten (from harban); -n, converb 'having made' (verb, converb; reading of -n uncertain) [十做了]
glossary.kebteġül: kebteġül — night guard, those who lie down (from kebte-, 'to lie down'; Ming 宿衞) (noun) [宿衞]
glossary.turγaγ̇ud: turγaγ — guard of the day watch, 'day guard' (an inference; the Ming 散班 is 'scattered shift', once 宿衞 'night guard', taken as a slip); plural -d, 'the day guards' (noun + plural) [散班(每)]
glossary.oroγ̇ulurun: oro- — to enter; causative -γul-, 'make enter, admit'; converb -urun, 'when, as (admitting)' (verb, causative, converb) [(敎)入時]
glossary.miṅγad-un: miṅγan — thousand, here 'thousand-commander'; plural -d; genitive -un, 'of the thousand-commanders' (noun + plural + case; Ming 千戶每的) [千戶每的]
glossary.žaγ̇ud-un: žaγun — hundred, here 'hundred-commander'; plural -d; genitive -un, 'of the hundred-commanders' (noun + plural + case; Ming 百戶每的) [百戶每的]
glossary.nojad-un: nojan — noyan, lord; plural -d; genitive -un, 'of the lords' (noun + plural + case) [官人每的] · also nojan — officer, commander; plural -d; genitive -un, 'of the officers' (Ming 官每的)
glossary.utu: utu — 'just so, in that manner' (the stem is not known; uncertain, taken from the Ming 只那般) (adverb/particle?) [只那般]
glossary.duru-jin: duru — bare, plain (uncertain; the Ming 白身 is 'a person without rank'); genitive -jin, 'of the commoner' (noun/adjective + case, after a vowel) [白身(的)]
glossary.erdemten: erdem — skill, accomplishment; -ten, plural of -tü, 'those having skill' (noun + possessive plural) [技能有的(每)]
glossary.šil: šil — looks, appearance, manner (uncertain; Ming 模樣) (noun) [模樣]
glossary.saitan: sain — good (analysis uncertain); -tan, plural of -tu, 'those having (good)', compare erdemten (adjective + possessive plural) [好的每]
glossary.arγai-qasar-i: Arγai-Qasar — Arqai-Qasar, a man's name; accusative -i, 'Arqai-Qasar (object)' (personal name + case; Ming 人名 行) [人名行]
glossary.miṅγalatuγai: miṅγala- — to make a thousand; optative -tuγai, 'let him/them make a thousand' (verb, optative) [千做者︀]
glossary.qadqulduγ̇an: qadqul- — to fight (stem read from the Ming); -ldu-, joint action, 'each other'; -γan, a participle (reading uncertain) 'fighting one another' (verb, reciprocal, participle) [厮殺︀的]
glossary.qadquldutuγai: qadqul- — to fight; -ldu-, 'each other'; optative -tuγai, 'let them fight one another' (verb, reciprocal, optative; the Ming 敎斷殺︀ has a causative sense, not shown in the form) [敎斷殺︀者︀]
glossary.turγaγ: turγaγ — guard of the day watch, 'day guard' (an inference; the Ming 散班 is 'scattered shift') (noun, bare stem) [散班] · also turγaγ, ‘guard, attendant’ (Ming 侍衞), as in turγaγ boltuγai, ‘let him be a guard’ [侍衞]
glossary.ögöle-čerbi: Ögöle-Čerbi — Ögöle-Cherbi, a man's name with the office title čerbi (personal name + title; perhaps the same man as Ögele-Čerbi, the spelling differs; uncertain) [人名 官名]
glossary.qudus-qalčan-luγ̇a: Qudus-Qalčan — Qudus-Qalchan, a man's name; comitative -luγa, 'together with Qudus-Qalchan' (personal name + case, back-vowel form; Ming 一同) [人名 一同]
glossary.oorčin: qor-či-n — 'quiver-bearers, archers': qor 'quiver' (inferred from the Ming), -či agent, -n plural (uncertain); printed Oorčin, read as a slip for qorčin (noun + agent + plural) [帶弓箭的]
glossary.egüdeči: egüde(n) — door; -či, agent, 'door-keeper' (noun + agent suffix; Ming 把門的每) [把門的每]
glossary.kešig: kešig — turn of duty, watch, shift (noun; Ming 直班) [直班] · also kešig — portion, share, paired with qubi in qubi kešig (Ming 子) · also 'the guard' (Ming 宿衞) · also kešig — the night guard's turn of duty, 'night-guard shift' (kešig-ün, kešiglegsed in the rules of the night watch; Ming 班)
glossary.šiṅgekü-jin: šiṅge- — to sink, set (of the sun); participle -kü; genitive -jin, 'of the setting' (verb + participle + case, after a vowel; reading of the Ming 落的 uncertain) [落的]
glossary.kebteġül-e: kebteġül — night guard; dative-locative -e, 'to the night guard' (noun + case, front-vowel form; Ming 行) [宿衞 行]
glossary.aγtas-turi: aγta — gelding; plural -s; dative-locative -tur, 'at, among the geldings', the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel before a reflexive-possessive (noun + plural + case; Ming 騸馬每 自的行) [騸馬每 自的行]
glossary.qonotuγai: qono- — to pass the night; optative -tuγai, 'let them pass the night' (verb, optative) [宿者︀]
glossary.kebteküni: kebte- — to lie down; participle -kün, 'one who lies down'; the (i) before reflexive-possessive -jen 'one's own' is Shiratori's; the (i) may also be an accusative (uncertain) (verb + participle) [臥的每 自的行]
glossary.kebteġülžü: kebte- — to lie down; causative -ġül-, 'make lie down'; converb -žü, 'making lie down' (verb, causative, converb) [敎臥着]
glossary.baiquni: bai- — to stand; participle -qun, 'one who stands'; the (i) before reflexive-possessive -jan 'one's own' is Shiratori's and may be an accusative (uncertain) (verb + participle) [立的每 自的行]
glossary.kešiglen: kešig — turn of duty; verbal -le-, 'take a turn'; converb -n, 'taking turns' (noun > verb, converb) [輪直着]
glossary.baiγ̇ultuγai: bai- — to stand; causative -γul-, 'make stand, set'; optative -tuγai, 'let them set (to stand)' (verb, causative, optative) [敎立者︀]
glossary.qorčin: qor-či-n — 'quiver-bearers, archers': qor 'quiver' (inferred from the Ming), -či agent, -n plural (uncertain) (noun + agent + plural) [帶弓箭的]
glossary.ideġesü: ide- — to eat; conditional -ġesü, 'if/when (they) eat' (verb, conditional, front-vowel form) [喫呵]
glossary.egüdečin: egüdeči — door-keeper (egüden 'door' + -či agent); plural -n, 'door-keepers' (noun + plural; Ming 把門的每) [把門的每]
glossary.mör-türi: mör — post, duty, place of office (Ming 軄分); dative-locative -tür, 'at one's post'; the (i) before reflexive-possessive -jen is Shiratori's (noun + case) [軄分 自的行]
glossary.jabutuγai: jabu- — to go, walk about; optative -tuγai, 'let them go' (the Ming 敎 'cause' suggests 'let them make go'; uncertain) (verb, optative) [敎行者︀]
glossary.saγ̇urin-duri: saγurin — seat, sitting-place (from saγu-, 'to sit'); dative-locative -dur, 'at one's seat'; the (i) before reflexive-possessive -jan is Shiratori's (noun + case; Ming 坐位) [坐位 自的行]
glossary.saγ̇utuγai: saγu- — to sit; optative -tuγai, 'let them sit' (the Ming 敎 'cause' is not shown in the form) (verb, optative) [敎坐者︀]
glossary.üdüri: üdür — day; the (i) before reflexive-possessive -jen is Shiratori's linking vowel (perhaps an accusative), 'one's own day(s)' (noun; Ming 日 自的行) [日 自的行] · also before -jer (Ming 日裏 'within the day'), the (i) being Shiratori's linking vowel
glossary.daγ̇usčü: daγus- — to come to an end, be used up; converb -čü (the form after an -s stem), 'having ended' (verb, converb) [盡了着]
glossary.qonoldužu: qono- — to pass the night; -ldu-, joint action, 'together'; converb -žu, 'passing the night together' (verb, joint, converb) [共宿着]
glossary.jeġüdgeldüžü: jeġüdge- — to replace, relieve (stem inferred from the Ming 替換); -ldü-, 'each other'; converb -žü, 'relieving one another' (verb, reciprocal, converb) [替換着]
glossary.čerbi: čerbi — cherbi, an office or rank (meaning of the title not known) (noun) [官名]
glossary.baγ̇atud: baγatur — brave man, hero; plural -d, 'brave men' (noun + plural; the -ur drops before -d) [勇士每]
glossary.keltegei-qada-dāča: Keltegei-Qada — a place name; ablative -dāča, 'from' (long ā; with an added d) (name + case; Ming 地名處) [地名處]
glossary.quiluγana: quiluγana — rat, mouse (noun; the Ming 鼠兒 'little rat'; the form is Shiratori's reading, uncertain whether it is a name) [鼠兒]
glossary.tergel-e: tergel — light, ray (uncertain); dative-locative -e, 'in the light of' (noun + case, front-vowel form; Ming 光 行) [光行]
glossary.sačuγ̇ad: sača- — to sprinkle, make an offering (inferred from the Ming 祭祀 'sacrifice'); converb -γad, 'having sacrificed' (verb, converb) [祭祀了]
glossary.saγ̇ari-keġer-i: Saγari-Keġer — Sa'ari-Keger, a place name ('the Sa'ari steppe'?, uncertain); accusative -i, 'Sa'ari-Keger (object)' (name + case; Ming 地名行) [地名行]
glossary.qaṅγar-qan-u: Qaṅγar-Qan — Qanghar-Qan, a mountain name; genitive -u, 'of Qanghar-Qan' (name + case; Ming 山名的) [山名的]
glossary.terġü-de: terġü — head, front, forefront (uncertain); dative-locative -de, 'at the head of' (noun + case, front-vowel form; Ming 頭行) [頭行]
glossary.hüldeldüžü: hülde- — to chase, pursue; -ldü-, 'each other'; converb -žü, 'chasing one another' (verb, reciprocal, converb) [相逐着]
glossary.šiṅγula: šiṅγula — white, grey (uncertain; Ming 白) (adjective) [白]
glossary.maγ̇uqan: maγu — bad, poor; diminutive -qan, 'a poor little one' (adjective + diminutive; Ming 歹) [歹]
glossary.emeġeltü-ji: emeġel — saddle; -tü, 'having', 'saddled'; accusative -ji (noun + possessive + case; Ming 鞍子 有的行) [鞍子 有的行]
glossary.abtažuγ̇ui: ab- — to take; passive -ta-, 'be taken'; -žuγui, past of a reported fact, 'was taken' (verb, passive, past; Ming 被要了有) [被要了有]
glossary.toridčü: torid- — to halt, stay (stem uncertain; Ming 止); converb -čü, 'halting' (verb, converb) [止着]
glossary.duradγarun: duradγa- — to remind, bring up, mention (stem uncertain; Ming 提說); converb -run, 'when/as (he) brought up' (verb, converb) [提說]
glossary.bidan-lu: bida — we (inclusive); the pronoun's linking -n- and -lu, 'only, just' (uncertain) (pronoun + particle; Ming 咱但) [咱但]
glossary.čadtala: čad- — to be full, sated; -tala, 'until', 'until full' (verb, terminal converb) [喫飽]
glossary.delgen: delgen — spread out, wide, broad (adverb; Ming 展開) [展開]
glossary.γali: γal — fire; the (i) before instrumental -jar is Shiratori's linking vowel, 'with fire' (noun; Ming 敎火 'make fire') [敎火] · also γal(i)-jan, 'one's own fire' (γal 'fire' with Shiratori's linking vowel before the reflexive -jan; Ming 火 自的行) [火自的行]
glossary.oγžadγaja: oγžadγa- — to give a false alarm (stem inferred from the Ming 虛驚); hortative -ja, 'let us give a false alarm' (verb, hortative) [虛驚]
glossary.hülürigeġültele: hülürige- — to be dazed (stem inferred from the Ming 幌惚); causative -ġül-, 'make dazed'; -tele, 'while, until' (verb, causative, terminal converb) [幌惚間]
glossary.čadumu-že: čad- — to be full, sated; -umu, present, 'is' (uncertain); the particle že, emphatic (uncertain) (verb + particle; Ming 飽有 也者︀) [飽有 也者︀]
glossary.čadγan: čad- — to be full; causative -γa- (inferred from the Ming 敎 'cause'), 'make full'; converb -n, 'having filled' (verb, causative, converb) [敎飽了]
glossary.qaraγ̇ul-i: qaraγul — scout, sentry, lookout; accusative -i, 'the scouts (object)' (noun + case; Ming 哨望的 行) [哨望的 行]
glossary.daručažu: daruča- — to press hard, pursue closely (stem inferred from the Ming 緊逐); converb -žu, 'pressing hard' (verb, converb) [緊逐着] · here also read daru- + -ča- 'together, jointly', 'following together' (Ming 相隨着; uncertain)
glossary.neileġülün: neile- — to join, meet; causative -ġül-, 'make join'; converb -n, 'bringing together' (verb, causative, converb) [敎相合]
glossary.samaγ̇ui-dur: samaγui — confusion, disorder; dative-locative -dur, 'in confusion' (noun + case; Ming 亂 裏) [亂 裏]
glossary.qadqulduγ̇asu: qadqul- — to fight; -ldu-, 'each other'; conditional -γasu, 'if/when (they) fight one another' (verb, reciprocal, conditional) [厮殺︀呵]
glossary.bolqu-ju: bol- — to be, become, do; participle -qu; -ju, a question particle (uncertain), 'will it be?' (verb + participle + particle; Ming 中 麽有) [中 麽有]
glossary.duradγaγ̇asu: duradγa- — to remind, bring up, mention (stem uncertain; Ming 提說); conditional -γasu, 'if/when (he) brought it up' (verb, conditional) [提說呵]
glossary.tüleġülüdkün: tüle- — to burn; causative -ġül-, 'make burn'; -d-, plural-subject mark (uncertain); imperative -kün, second person plural (front-vowel form of -qun), 'you all make burn' (verb, causative, imperative) [敎燒您]
glossary.čeriġüd-te: čeri — army, soldiers (compare čerig); plural -ġüd; dative-locative -te, 'to the soldiers' (noun + plural + case, front-vowel form; Ming 軍每行) [軍每行] · also dative-locative -te marking the agent of a passive, 'by the soldiers' (Ming 被軍每)
glossary.tuṅγaba: tuṅγa- — to hand on, proclaim, pass the word (stem uncertain; Ming 傳); past -ba, 'passed on' (verb, past) [傳了]
glossary.tüleġülbe: tüle- — to burn; causative -ġül-, 'make burn'; past -be, 'had burned' (verb, causative, past) [敎燒了]
glossary.hodun: hodun — star; here written with a case ending apart (hodun-(n)ača, ablative 'than the stars') (noun; Ming 星 行) [星 行]
glossary.γaltan: γal — fire; -tan, plural of -tu, 'those having fire' (noun + possessive plural; Ming 火(有的)每) [火(有的)每]
glossary.maγ̇utu: maγu — bad, poor; -tu, 'having', 'poor ones' (adjective + possessive; Ming 歹(有的)) [歹(有的)]
glossary.šiṅγulaqan: šiṅγula — white, grey (uncertain); diminutive -qan, 'whitish, little white' (adjective + diminutive; Ming 白小) [白小]
glossary.bütetele: büte- — to be complete, fill up (Ming 塞滿); -tele, 'until, so that', 'until full' (verb, terminal converb) [塞滿]
glossary.baγ̇uluγ̇a: baγu- — to go down, alight, camp; past -luγa, a reported fact, 'came down, camped' (verb, past; Ming 下了來) [下了來]
glossary.üdür-tür: üdür — day; dative-locative -tür, 'by day, in the daytime' (noun + case, front-vowel form; Ming 日裏) [日裏]
glossary.ündürün: ündür- — to increase, add (stem uncertain; Ming 增添); converb -ün, 'increasing' (verb, converb) [增添]
glossary.qaraγ̇ul-un: qaraγul — scout, lookout, guard; genitive -un, 'of the scouts' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [哨望的]
glossary.qaṅγai-jin: Qaṅγai — the Qanghai, a place; genitive -jin, 'of' (after a vowel) (place name + case; written with a dotted ṅ; the Ming gives only 地名 'place name') [地名 的]
glossary.qačir: Qačir — Qachir, a river (river name; the printed hyphen after it joins it to usun) [水名]
glossary.usun-a: usun — water, river; dative-locative -a, 'at, in' (noun + case) [水行]
glossary.küčülüg: Küčülüg — Küchülüg, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.köġün-düri: köġün — son; dative-locative -dür, 'to'; the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel before the reflexive jen, 'to one's own son' (noun + case + linking vowel) [子 自的行]

glossary.qaγačaqui: qaγača- — to part, separate; participle -qui, 'the parting' (verb, participle) [離的]

glossary.nidun: nidün — eye (noun; the Ming writes 眼 with the reflexive 自的行; here nidun-(n)i-jen, 'one's own eye', with accusative -(n)i) [眼 自的行]
glossary.hirmes: hirmes — turning, a turn (the word as printed; stem unknown, the Ming 轉 'turn, revolve') (verb form or noun, uncertain) [轉] · also 'blink of an eye' (noun; Ming 瞬眼 'blink'), as in hirmes ülü kin 'not doing a blink, without a blink'
glossary.qadquγdaγ̇asu: qadqu- — to pierce, stab; passive -γda-, conditional -γasu, 'if (it is) pierced' (verb, passive conditional) [被刺呵]
glossary.qaltaril: qaltaril — avoidance, evasion, dodging (noun, perhaps from qaltari- 'to slip, slide', as in qaltariγ̇uluγ̇ad; uncertain) [避]
glossary.qataṅgin: qataṅgin — hard, stubborn, firm (adjective, from qata- 'hard'; compare qataṅγu 'steel-hard'; written with a dotted ṅ) [剛硬]
glossary.qamtudγ̇asu: qamtud- — to join together, be joined (from qamtu 'together'); conditional -γasu, 'if joined' (verb, conditional; uncertain) [相合呵]
glossary.seküġülün: sekü- — to draw back, roll back (stem inferred from the Ming 卷退; uncertain); causative -ġül-, converb -ün, 'making draw back' (verb, causative converb; uncertain) [卷退]
glossary.žibšiġerčü: žibšiġe- — to put in order, array, make ready (stem inferred from the Ming 整搠 and the printed žibšiġer-; compare žibšije-); converb -rčü, 'arranging' (verb, converb; uncertain) [整搠着]
