glossary.ölkes: ölkes — foot of a mountain, the lower slopes (noun; uncertain) [山下]
glossary.kerel: kerel — quarrel, fight, strife (noun, from kere- 'to quarrel') [鬪]
glossary.kerežü: kere- — to quarrel, fight; converb -žü, 'fighting' (verb, converb) [鬪着]
glossary.biqardaγ̇ulun: biqarda- — to be weary, worn out (stem uncertain); causative -γul-, converb -un, 'making weary' (verb, causative converb) [敎疲乏]
glossary.asγaja: asγa- — to pour, pour out; hortative first person -ja, 'let us pour' (verb, hortative; stem uncertain) [注咱]
glossary.an-a: an-a — again, moreover (analysis uncertain; perhaps the oblique stem an- with -a) (adverb or particle, uncertain) [又]
glossary.jadarun: jada- — to be unable, fail, be weak; converb of time -run, 'when unable, being unable' (verb, converb) [不能時]
glossary.qaγ̇āča: qaγa — where; ablative -ača, 'from where' (interrogative + case; analysis uncertain, long ā written for the contraction; Ming 那裏行) [那裏行]
glossary.oluṅkin: oluṅkin — the greater part, most, the many (from olon 'many'; written with a dotted ṅ; uncertain) [多半]
glossary.eme-jin: eme — woman, wife; genitive -jin, 'of the woman' (noun + case, after a vowel) [婦人的]
glossary.čiġeküi: čiġe- — to pass water, make water (stem inferred from the Ming 尿處); participle -küi, 'the place of passing water' (verb, participle; uncertain) [尿處]
glossary.kürdün-ü: kürdün — cart-wheel (the Ming 車腳 'cart foot' suggests the wheel or its rim; uncertain); genitive -ü, 'of the cart-wheel' (noun + case) [車腳的]
glossary.tuγul-un: tuγul — calf (noun); genitive -un, 'of the calf' (noun + case) [犢的]
glossary.belžiġel-dür: belžiġel — grazing, pasture, eating of grass (Ming 喫草; noun, uncertain); dative-locative -dür, 'at, to' (noun + case) [喫草行]
glossary.kürügsen: kür- — to reach, arrive; past participle -ügsen, 'the one who has reached' (verb, participle) [到了的]
glossary.elčin-eče: elčin — envoy, messenger (noun); ablative -eče, 'from, by' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [使臣行]
glossary.eberetele: ebere- — to be in pain, ache (Ming 痛; stem uncertain); terminal -tele, 'until aching' (verb, terminal converb; uncertain) [痛]
glossary.bertetele: berte- — to be hurt, wounded (Ming 傷; stem uncertain); terminal -tele, 'until hurt' (verb, terminal converb; uncertain) [傷]
glossary.iležüküi: ile- — to send (as in ilebe, Ming 敎去了), or 'go' (uncertain which); past -žüküi (cf. -žüġüi), 'sent' (verb, past; ending uncertain) [去了有]
glossary.emečilegden: emečile- — to treat as a woman, make a woman of (from eme 'woman'); passive -gde-, converb -n, 'being made a woman' (verb, passive converb; uncertain) [被做婦人]
glossary.küčütü: küčü — strength, power (noun); possessive -tü, 'strong, having strength' (noun + possessive suffix, front-vowel form) [氣力 有的]
glossary.omoγtu: omoγ — bravery, pride, valour (noun); possessive -tu, 'brave, having bravery' (noun + possessive suffix, back-vowel form) [勇有的]
glossary.kürülčeküi: kürülče- — to meet, come together (from kür- 'reach'; reciprocal -lče-); participle -küi, 'the meeting' (verb, participle) [到的]
glossary.alalduqui: ala- — to kill; reciprocal -ldu-, participle -qui, 'the killing each other' (verb, reciprocal participle) [相殺︀的]

glossary.talbituγai: talbi- — to let go, put down, leave; optative -tuγai, 'let him leave' (verb, optative) [放了者︀]
glossary.kürülčen: kürülče- — to meet, come together; converb -n, 'meeting' (verb, converb) [相到]
glossary.üžeġülüleġe: üže- — to see; causative -ġül-, past -leġe (as in büleġe), 'showed, caused to see' (verb, causative, past) [敎見來]

glossary.medegsen: mede- — to know; past participle -gsen, 'having known' (verb, past participle) [知道了]

glossary.žasaγ̇ulqu: žasa- — to order, put in order, govern; causative -γul-, participle -qu, 'one who will have things ordered' (verb, causative participle) [敎整治]

glossary.čerig-ün: čerig — soldier, army (noun); genitive -ün, 'of the army' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [軍的]
glossary.žasal: žasal — rule, regulation, order, discipline (noun, from žasa- 'to order') [法度]

glossary.turluγ: turluγ — sense unknown; the Ming gives no gloss; it stands beside Tayang like an epithet (word, uncertain) []

glossary.usun-ača: usun — water, river; ablative -ača, 'from, along' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [水行]
glossary.tamir: Tamir — the Tamir, a river (river name) [水名]
glossary.orqon-i: Orqon — the Orqon, a river; accusative -i, marks the object (river name + case) [河名行]
glossary.naqu: Naqu — Naqu, a mountain name (place name; the Ming gives only 山名 'mountain name') [山名]
glossary.qormai: qormai — skirt, hem; of a mountain, its foot (noun; Ming 裙 'skirt') [裙]
glossary.čakirmaγ̇ud: Čakirmaγ̇ud — Chakirma'ud, a place name (place name; the Ming gives only 地名) [地名]
glossary.kürgeġesü: kürge- — to bring to, deliver (kür- 'reach' made causative; uncertain); conditional -ġesü, 'if (one) brings to' (verb, conditional, front-vowel form) [送到呵]
glossary.bolumn-že: bol- — to become, be; present ending -umn (shape uncertain) + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb + particle) [做有 也者︀]
glossary.žasarun: žasa- — to arrange, put in order; converb of time -run, 'when arranging' (verb, converb) [整治時]
glossary.qaraγana: qaraγana — thicket, clump (noun; Ming 叢草般 'like a clump of grass'; stem uncertain) [叢草般]
glossary.jorčil: jorči- — to go, set out (verb stem; stem inferred from Ming 行); -l, verbal ending of uncertain force (verb; uncertain) [行]
glossary.baildu: bai- — to stand; reciprocal -ldu-, 'one another' (verb; the Ming 陣 'battle line' points to a noun sense, 'the standing-off, array'; uncertain) [陣]
glossary.šiγ̇uči: šiγ̇uči — chisel (noun; Ming 鑿子般 'chisel-like') [鑿子般]
glossary.qadqulduγ̇a: qadqu- — to fight, strike; reciprocal -ldu-, 'one another'; -γ̇a, ending of uncertain force (optative or nominal) (verb; uncertain) [厮殺︀]
glossary.žasaγ̇ulba: žasa- — to arrange, put in order; causative -γ̇ul-, 'cause to'; past -ba, '-ed' (verb, causative, past) [敎整治了]
glossary.nojan-i: nojan — lord, commander (noun); accusative -i, marks the object (noun + case) [官人行]
glossary.kötöd: kötö — a led horse, one that follows on the lead (stem uncertain; compare kötöl 'led, following' in the glossary; Ming 從馬 'following horses'); plural -d, 'led horses' (noun + plural; uncertain) [從馬(每)]
glossary.čakirmaγ̇ud-ača: Čakirmaγ̇ud — Chakirma'ud, a place name; ablative -ača, 'from, at' (place name + case, back-vowel form) [地名處]
glossary.aγ̇ula-jin: aγ̇ula — mountain; genitive -jin, 'of' (after a vowel) (noun + case) [山 的]
glossary.kižin: kižin — along, alongside (postposition or adverb; Ming 緣着 'following along'; uncertain) [緣着] · also Ming 㳂 ‘along’ [㳂]
glossary.neiletele: neile- — to join, come together; terminal converb -tele, 'right up to, until' (verb, converb; Ming 相合) [相合]
glossary.kürküi-ji: kür- — to reach, arrive; participle -küi, 'the one that reaches'; accusative -ji, after a vowel (verb, participle + case) [到的 行]
glossary.naiman-luγ̇a: Naiman — the Naiman, a people; comitative -luγ̇a, 'together with' (people name + case; Ming 種名 'name of a kind' + 一同 'together') [種名 一同]
glossary.ireldüžü: ire- — to come; reciprocal -ldü-, 'together'; converb -žü, 'coming together' (verb, reciprocal, converb, front-vowel form) [共來着]
glossary.jaγ̇ud: jaγ̇ud — what, whichever, all sorts of; plural (pronoun, plural; Ming 甚麽每; uncertain) [甚麽每]
glossary.qoton-dur: qoton — enclosure, pen, yard (noun; Ming 圈子); dative-locative -dur, 'in, at' (noun + case) [圈子 裏]
glossary.noγais-i: noγai — dog (noun); plural -s; accusative -i, marks the object (noun + plural + case) [狗(每)行]
glossary.miqa-γ̇ar: miqa — meat, flesh (noun); instrumental -γ̇ar, 'with, by means of' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [肉敎]
glossary.težiġežü: težiġe- — to feed, rear (Ming 養); converb -žü, 'feeding' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [養着]
glossary.ginžiležü: ginži — iron chain (Ming 鐵索); verb-forming -le-, 'to chain'; converb -žü, 'chaining' (noun + verb-former + converb) [鐵索]
glossary.širemün: širemün — raw copper (noun; Ming 生銅 'raw copper') [生銅]
glossary.maṅlaitan: maṅlai — forehead (noun; Ming 額顱); possessive plural -tan, 'those having' (noun + possessive plural; written with a dotted ṅ) [額顱有的(每)]
glossary.qošiγ̇utan: qošiγ̇u — beak, muzzle (noun; Ming 觜); possessive plural -tan, 'those having' (noun + possessive plural) [觜 有的(每)]
glossary.šibüge: šibüge — awl, bodkin (noun; Ming 錐子 'awl') [錐子]
glossary.keleten: kele — tongue (noun); possessive plural -ten, 'those having' (noun + possessive plural, front-vowel form) [舌 有的(每)]
glossary.öreten: öre — heart (noun; stem inferred from the Ming 心); possessive plural -ten, 'those having' (noun + possessive plural, front-vowel form) [心有的(每)]
glossary.minaγ̇atan: minaγ̇a — whip (noun; Ming 做鞭 'made as a whip'); possessive plural -tan, 'those having' (noun + possessive plural) [做鞭 有的(每)]
glossary.šiġüderi: šiġüder — dew (noun; Ming 露; stem uncertain); accusative -i (noun + case; uncertain) [露]
glossary.jabud: jabu- — to go; plural -d, 'those who go' (verb, plural participle) [行每]
glossary.ided: ide- — to eat; plural -d, 'those who eat' (verb, plural participle) [喫每]
glossary.kürülčekü: kürülče- — to meet, come together (from kür- 'reach'; reciprocal -lče-, here written -ülče-; Ming 相到); participle -kü, 'the meeting, the one that meets' (verb, reciprocal, participle; uncertain) [相到的]
glossary.künesüled: künesü — provisions for a journey (Ming 行糧 'marching grain'); verb-forming -le-, 'make into'; plural -d, 'those who do' (noun + verb-former + plural) [做行糧]
glossary.ginži-ben: ginži — iron chain (Ming 鐵索); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own' (front-vowel form, after a vowel) (noun + reflexive) [鐵索自的行]
glossary.mültüldežü: mültülde- — to slip free, be pulled off (stem inferred from the Ming 被脫); converb -žü, 'being pulled off' (verb, converb) [被脫着]

glossary.šilemelčen: šilemelče- — to drool, to covet (Ming 垂涎 'to slaver'); converb -n, 'drooling' (verb, converb) [垂涎着]
glossary.doromži-ača: doromži — lowly, inferior (Ming 下等 'low grade'); ablative -ača, 'from' (adjective + case; uncertain; once with the plural, Ming 下等每 行) [下等 處]
glossary.iqurižu: iquri- — to move, shift (Ming 挪; stem inferred from Ming); converb -žu, 'moving' (verb, converb) [挪着]
glossary.dujalžu: dujal- — to leap, exult (Ming 歡躍 'to leap with joy'); converb -žu, 'leaping' (verb, converb) [歡躍着]
glossary.toγ̇oriγažu: toγ̇oriγa- — to circle round (Ming 繞 'to go around'); converb -žu, 'circling' (verb, converb) [繞着]
glossary.aisqun-i: aisu- — to come (stem inferred from the Ming 來); participle plural -qun, 'the ones coming'; accusative -i (verb, participle + case; analysis uncertain, compare aisunqun) [來的每 行]
glossary.unuγan: unuγan — foal (noun; Ming 駒兒 'colt') [駒兒]
glossary.kököžü: köke- — to suck (Ming 咂; stem inferred); converb -žü, 'sucking' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [咂着]
glossary.torolun: torolun — nimbly, swiftly (Ming 疾靈 'quick and sprightly'; stem uncertain) (adverb; uncertain) [疾靈]
glossary.güjikü: güji- — to run (Ming 走; stem inferred); participle -kü, 'the one that runs' (verb, participle) [走的]
glossary.unuγad: unuγan — foal (noun); plural -d, 'foals' (noun + plural; the n drops before -d) [駒兒每]
glossary.toγ̇oriγan: toγ̇oriγa- — to circle round (Ming 繞); converb -n, 'circling' (verb, converb) [繞着]
glossary.židatu: žida — spear, lance (noun; Ming 鎗 'spear'); possessive -tu, 'having' (noun + possessive, back-vowel form) [鎗 有的]
glossary.žiγ̇užu: žiγ̇u- — to drive, chase (Ming 趕 'to drive off'; stem uncertain); converb -žu, 'driving' (verb, converb) [趕着]
glossary.tonoγčin: tonoγ — stripping, plunder (noun; Ming 剝脫 'to strip'); agent -čin, 'one who does' (noun + agent suffix) [(剝脫的)每]

glossary.unaγažu: una- — to fall; causative -γa-, 'make fall, fell, cut down'; converb -žu, 'felling' (verb, causative, converb) [砍倒着]
glossary.üb: üb — goods, property, spoil (noun; Ming 財物 'goods and property') [財物]

glossary.abuγčin: abu- — to take; agent -γčin, 'one who takes, taker' (verb, agent noun) [要的每]
glossary.keġegded: keġe- — to say; passive -gde-, 'be called, be said'; plural -d, 'those who' (verb, passive, plural participle) [被說的(每)]
glossary.dujalun: dujal- — to leap, exult (Ming 歡躍); converb -un, 'leaping' (verb, converb) [歡躍]
glossary.abarin: abari- — to climb (Ming 登; stem inferred); converb -n, 'climbing' (verb, converb) [登]
glossary.öjesegsen: öjese- — to be greedy, to crave (Ming 貪食 'greedy for food'; stem inferred); past participle -gsen, 'who has craved' (verb, past participle) [貪食的]
glossary.šilemelčežü: šilemelče- — to drool, to covet (Ming 垂涎); converb -žü, 'drooling' (verb, converb) [垂涎着]
glossary.qušiγ̇uražu: qušiγ̇ura- — to stick out the tip (Ming 出尖 'to put out a point'; stem inferred); converb -žu, 'sticking out' (verb, converb) [出尖着]
glossary.aisqun: aisu- — to come (stem inferred from the Ming 來); participle plural -qun, 'the ones coming' (verb, participle plural; analysis uncertain, compare aisunqun) [來的]
glossary.aisqu: aisu- — to come (stem inferred from the Ming 來); participle -qu, 'the one that comes' (verb, participle; uncertain) [來的]
glossary.kübčin: kübčin — whole, all, entire (Ming 全; adjective or adverb) [全]
glossary.širemü-ġer: širemün — raw copper (Ming 生銅); instrumental -ġer, 'with, of' (noun + case, front-vowel form; the final n drops before the ending) [敎生銅]
glossary.širegdegsen: širegde- — to be smelted, forged (Ming 煉來; stem uncertain); past participle -gsen, 'that has been smelted' (verb, passive participle; uncertain) [煉來的]
glossary.šibüge-de: šibüge — awl (Ming 錐子); dative-locative -de, 'at, in, to' (noun + case) [錐子 行]
glossary.qadququj-a: qadqu- — to stab, strike; participle -qu, 'the one that stabs'; dative-locative -a after a linking -j- (uncertain) (verb, participle + case) [刺的 行]
glossary.čölö: čölö — gap, opening, free space (noun; Ming 空隙 'a crack, a gap') [空隙]
glossary.temüri: temür — iron (noun; Ming 銕); the token is the printed temür(i)-, with Shiratori's bracketed linking vowel, before the instrumental -jer (noun + linking vowel; the Ming 鐵敎 glosses the whole word) [鐵敎]
glossary.dabtaγsan: dabta- — to fold, to layer (Ming 疊); past participle -γsan, 'that has been folded, layered' (verb, past participle) [疊到的]
glossary.tebene-de: tebene — large needle, packing needle (Ming 大針); dative-locative -de, 'at, in, to' (noun + case) [大針行]
glossary.aisu-lu: aisu- — to come (stem inferred from the Ming 來); -lu, ending of uncertain force (Ming 但 'only, but') (verb + ending; uncertain) [來有 但]
glossary.üžebe-jüġü: üže- — to see; past -be, '-ed'; question particle -jüġü, 'did (he) see?' (Ming 麽) (verb, past + particle; uncertain) [見了 麽]
glossary.ešige-jin: ešige — young ram, lamb (Ming 小羖); genitive -jin, 'of' (after a vowel) (noun + case) [小羖的]
glossary.γodu: γodu — hoof skin, the skin of the hoof (noun; Ming 蹄皮) [蹄皮]
glossary.hüleġülküi-eče: hüleġül- — to leave over, spare (Ming 剩下; stem inferred); participle -küi, 'the one that is left'; ablative -eče, 'from, than' (verb, participle + case, front-vowel form) [剩下的 行]
glossary.amsaγ̇ari: amsaγ̇ari — fearful, to be feared (Ming 可懼 'fearsome'; ending uncertain) (adjective or participle; uncertain) [可懼]
glossary.abarižu: abari- — to climb (Ming 登); converb -žu, 'climbing' (verb, converb) [登着]
glossary.baižuγ̇u: bai- — to stand, to halt; past narrative -žuγ̇u, 'stood' (verb, past; Ming 立了有) [立了有]
glossary.asaγurun: asaγ- — to ask (Ming 問); converb of time -urun, 'when asking' (verb, converb) [問時]
glossary.žužaγ̇an-a: žužaγ̇an — thick (Ming 厚 'thick'); dative-locative -a, 'in, at' (adjective + case) [厚行]
glossary.miqa-bar: miqa — meat, flesh (noun); instrumental -bar, 'with, by means of' (back-vowel form after a vowel, as in žida-bar) (noun + case) [肉敎]
glossary.alda: alda — fathom, the span of outstretched arms (noun; Ming 度 'measure') [度]
glossary.γunažin: γunažin — three-year-old (Ming 三歲 'three years'; analysis uncertain: from γurban 'three'?) (noun, numeral; uncertain) [三歲]
glossary.bodo: bodo — head of livestock, animal (noun; Ming 頭口 'livestock') [頭口]
glossary.idešitü: ide- — to eat; -ši, noun-forming 'food' (uncertain); possessive -tü, 'having' (verb + noun-former + possessive; uncertain) [喫食 有的]
glossary.qujaγ: qujaγ — armour, coat of mail (noun; Ming 甲 'armour') [甲]
glossary.emüsčü: emüs- — to wear (Ming 穿 'to put on, to wear'); converb -čü, 'wearing' (verb, converb) [穿着]
glossary.židgüġülžü: židgü- — to drag, pull (Ming 拽; stem uncertain); causative -ġül-, 'make drag'; converb -žü, 'dragging' (verb, causative, converb) [拽着]
glossary.aisu-že: aisu- — to come (stem inferred from the Ming 來); assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb + particle) [來 也者︀]
glossary.qortu: qor — quiver (noun); possessive -tu, 'having'; the Ming 帶弓箭的 reads 'bow-and-arrow-bearing' (noun + possessive, back-vowel form) [帶弓箭的]
glossary.qotola-ji: qotola — all, whole, every one (Ming 都); accusative -ji, after a vowel (pronoun, quantifier + case) [都︀ 行]
glossary.žalgiγ̇asu: žalgi- — to swallow (Ming 嚥); conditional -γasu, 'if (one) swallows' (verb, conditional, back-vowel form) [嚥呵]
glossary.qoγ̇olai-duri: qoγ̇olai — throat (noun; Ming 喉嚨); dative-locative -dur, 'in, at'; the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel before the reflexive -(i)jan, 'in one's own throat' (noun + case + linking vowel) [喉嚨 自的行]
glossary.tordaju: torda- — to be hindered, caught (Ming 被碍着 'being blocked'; stem uncertain); present -ju (shape uncertain; the Ming 着 would rather suggest a converb) (verb; uncertain) [被碍着]
glossary.emküġesu: emkü- — to gulp down (Ming 呑; stem inferred); conditional -ġesu, 'if (one) gulps down' (verb, conditional, front-vowel form) [呑呵]
glossary.žasaju: žasa- — to arrange, set right (Ming 點 'to tick off, to count'; sense uncertain); present -ju (shape uncertain) (verb; uncertain) [點有]
glossary.aγ̇urlaγ̇asu: aγ̇urla- — to be angry (Ming 怒; stem inferred); conditional -γasu, 'if (one) is angry' (verb, conditional) [怒(呵)]
glossary.aṅγuγ̇a: Aṅγuγ̇a — Angqu'a, the name of an arrow (arrow name; the Ming gives 箭名; written with a dotted ṅ) [箭名]
glossary.deližü: deli- — to draw (a bow) (Ming 拽 'to pull'; stem uncertain); converb -žü, 'drawing' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [拽着]
glossary.talbiγ̇asu: talbi- — to let go, loose, release (Ming 放); conditional -γasu, 'if (one) looses' (verb, conditional) [放呵]
glossary.ülgetele: ülge- — to pierce through (Ming 直穿; stem inferred); terminal converb -tele, 'right through' (verb, converb) [直穿了]
glossary.qarbuju: qarbu- — to shoot (Ming 射 'to shoot'); present -ju (shape uncertain) (verb; uncertain) [射有]
glossary.kereldügsen: kereldü- — to fight one another (Ming 相鬪; from kerel- 'to quarrel' with reciprocal -ldü-; uncertain); past participle -gsen, 'who has fought' (verb, reciprocal, past participle) [相鬪的]
glossary.ketüs: ketü- — to cross over (Ming 渡過 'to pass across'); the stem is inferred (compare ketül- 'cross over water' in the glossary) and the ending -s is uncertain (verb; uncertain) [渡過] · also 'crossing' (Ming 橫越着 'crossing over') [橫越着]
glossary.keibür: Keibür — Keibür, the name of an arrow (arrow name; the Ming gives 箭名) [箭名]
glossary.kelkitele: kelki- — to link up, join (Ming 直連; stem inferred); terminal converb -tele, 'right through, right up' (verb, converb) [直連了]
glossary.ülketele: ülge- — to pierce through (variant spelling of ülgetele; Ming 直穿); terminal converb -tele, 'right through' (verb, converb) [直穿了]
glossary.qarbuγ̇asu: qarbu- — to shoot (Ming 射); conditional -γasu, 'if (one) shoots' (verb, conditional) [射呵]
glossary.tatam: tata- — to pull, draw in (Ming 減了 'reduced'; analysis uncertain); -m, ending (uncertain) (verb; uncertain) [減了]
glossary.gürelkü: gürelkü — a kind of python (Ming 蟒名 'name of a python'; also perhaps a name; uncertain) (noun) [蟒名]
glossary.maṅγus: maṅγus — python (noun; Ming 蟒 'python'; written with a dotted ṅ) [蟒]
glossary.tende-eče: tende — there (adverb, of tere 'that'); ablative -eče, 'from, than' (adverb + case, front-vowel form) [自那 裏]
glossary.aγ̇la-jin: aγ̇ula — mountain (printed aγ̇la, a short spelling); genitive -jin, 'of' (after a vowel) (noun + case) [山的]
glossary.temečeje: temeče- — to compete, vie (Ming 爭 'to contend'); hortative -je, 'let us' (shape uncertain) (verb, hortative) [爭咱]
glossary.abaridqun: abari- — to climb (Ming 登); imperative plural -dqun, 'do (ye) …' (analysis uncertain) (verb, imperative) [登您]
glossary.nilqa: nilqa — young, small, the youngest (Ming 最少 'the least, the youngest') (adjective) [最少的]
glossary.heligetü: helige — liver (noun; Ming 肝); possessive -tü, 'having' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [肝 有的]
glossary.untaγči: unta- — to sleep (Ming 睡); agent -γči, 'one who sleeps' (verb, agent noun) [睡的]
glossary.oraj-a: oraj — evening (noun; Ming 晩 'late, evening'); dative-locative -a, 'in, at' (noun + case) [晩行]
glossary.bosuγči: bosu- — to rise, get up; agent -γči, 'one who rises' (verb, agent noun) [起的]
glossary.baruγ̇an-ača: baruγ̇an — multitude, crowd (noun; Ming 多處 'the many'); ablative -ača, 'from' (noun + case; uncertain) [多處]
glossary.qočoruju: qočor- — to be left behind (Ming 落後); present -ju (shape uncertain) (verb; uncertain) [落後]
glossary.baidal-ača: baidal — standing place, position (noun; from bai- 'to stand'; Ming 立處 'place of standing'); ablative -ača, 'from' (noun + case) [立處]
glossary.qočodajin: qočoda- — to be left behind (Ming 落後有); -jin, ending (uncertain, perhaps present or assertion; the Ming 有 'is' says it is not the genitive -jin) (verb; uncertain) [落後有]
glossary.horgil: horgil — crown, summit, top (noun; Ming 頂 'top of the head, summit') [頂]
glossary.γaruja: γar- — to go up, come out (Ming 上); hortative -ja, 'let us' (verb, hortative) [上咱]
glossary.üġüleġed: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb of completed action -ġed, 'having said' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [說了]
glossary.bölde: bölde — apart, separately (adverb; uncertain: the Ming gives only the rare character 𠮠, which glosses öġere 'apart' elsewhere; no stem offered) [𠮠]
glossary.idču: id- — to divide, to split off (stem inferred from the Ming 分着); converb -ču, 'splitting off' (verb, converb) [分着]
glossary.üküdġüžü: üküdġü- — to be dazed, bewildered (stem inferred from the Ming 昏着); converb -žü, 'being dazed' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [昏着]
glossary.ürġüžü: ürġü- — to be frightened (stem inferred from the Ming 驚着); converb -žü, 'being frightened' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [驚着]
glossary.alaγdažu: ala- — to kill; passive -γda-, converb -žu, 'being killed' (verb, passive converb, back-vowel form) [被殺︀着]
glossary.qadaγ̇uči: qadaγ̇uči — one on guard, a careful one (noun; perhaps an agent noun in -či; the stem is not certain; Ming 謹慎 'careful, cautious') [謹︀愼]
glossary.esergülekü: esergüle- — to face, to meet head-on, to oppose (stem inferred from the Ming 迎); participle -kü, 'that which …, to …' (verb, participle, front-vowel form) [迎的]
glossary.aγ̇ula-ji: aγ̇ula — mountain; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'the mountain (object)' (noun + case, back-vowel form; Ming 行) [山行]
glossary.büselgün: büselgün — ring, encirclement, 'surrounding' (noun; Ming 圍; stem uncertain) [圍]
glossary.buruγ̇uilan: buruγ̇uila- — to go astray, to slip away, to evade (stem inferred from the Ming 𧻞避着 'dodging, avoiding'); converb -n, 'evading' (verb, converb) [𧻞避着] · also Ming 逃: buruγ̇uila- 'to flee, evade'; converb -n, 'fleeing' (verb, converb) [逃]
glossary.ködölkün: ködöl- — to move, to set out; -kün, an ending of uncertain force forming a noun or plural participle, 'those moving' (verb + ending; Ming 每 'plural') [動每]
glossary.γuladču: γulad- — to fall, to drop (stem inferred from the Ming 墜着); converb -ču, 'falling' (verb, converb) [墜着]
glossary.deġere-ġen: deġere — above, upper, on top; reflexive-possessive -ġen, 'one's own', here 'on one another' (adverb + reflexive-possessive, after a vowel) [上(自的)行]
glossary.qutaγlaldužu: qutaγla- — to heap, to pile up (stem inferred from the Ming (堆積着)); reciprocal -ldu-, converb -žu, 'heaping on one another' (verb, reciprocal converb, back-vowel form) [(堆積着)]
glossary.hüšü-ben: hüšü — hair (Ming 髮); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own' (noun + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form, after a vowel) [髮自的行]
glossary.kemkerü: kemkerü — broken to pieces, crushed (adjective or converb; Ming 碎; stem uncertain, perhaps a converb in -ü) [碎]
glossary.unaldužu: una- — to fall; reciprocal/joint -ldu-, converb -žu, 'falling together' (verb, reciprocal converb, back-vowel form) [共倒着]
glossary.qunžiγ̇u: qunžiγ̇u — rotten wood (noun; the Ming gives it in brackets, (爛木); uncertain) [(爛木)]
glossary.baitala: baitala — right up to, until (adverb/postposition; Ming 直到; perhaps bai- 'stand' + -tala 'until'; uncertain) [直到] · also bai- — read 'to stand', baitala 'standing up to' (Ming 直立了) · here read as bai- 'to be, lie' + -tala, 'as if heaped' (Ming 堆般; uncertain)
glossary.üküldüžüġüi: ükü- — to die; reciprocal/joint -ldü-, past -žüġüi, 'died together' (verb, reciprocal past, front-vowel form) [共死了有]
glossary.aγsaγ̇ar: a- — to be, to dwell; participle stem -γsa-, instrumental -γ̇ar, 'while being' (verb, participle + instrumental, back-vowel form; Ming 住間) [住間]
glossary.güjičegderün: güjiče- — to chase, to overtake (stem inferred from the Ming 趕上); passive -gde-, converb of time -rün, 'when chased' (verb, passive converb, front-vowel form) [被趕上時]
glossary.tamir-a: Tamir — the Tamir, a river name (Ming 河名); dative-locative -a, 'at the Tamir' (place name + case, back-vowel form; Ming 行) [河名 行]
glossary.küreġeležüġü: küreġe — ring, circle, camp-circle; verb-forming -le-, 'to form a circle'; past -žüġü (= -žüġüi, printed without the i), 'formed a camp-circle' (noun + verb-forming + past, front-vowel form) [劄圈子有]
glossary.küreġen-düri: küreġen — ring, camp-circle; dative-locative -dür with Shiratori's linking (i), the token left before -jen, 'in one's own camp-circle' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [圈子 自的行]
glossary.ölgede: ölge — front, foot of a mountain (Ming 山前; stem uncertain); dative-locative -de, 'at the foot' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [山前(行)]
glossary.qurijaba: qurija- — to gather in, to assemble (stem inferred from the Ming 收; perhaps from quri- 'gather'); past -ba, 'gathered in' (verb, past) [收了]
glossary.tende-kü: tende — there, then; kü, emphatic particle 'also, indeed' (Ming 也) (adverb + particle) [那裏 也]
glossary.tajaṅ-un: Tajaṅ — Tayang, a man's name; genitive -un after a consonant, 'of Tayang' (personal name + case, back-vowel form) [人名的]
glossary.hünir: hünir — smell, breath (noun; Ming 氣息) [氣息]
glossary.qaradal-hužaγ̇ur-a: Qaradal-Hužaγ̇ur — Qaradal-Hužaγur, a place name; dative-locative -a, 'at' (place name + case, back-vowel form; Ming 行) [地名行]
glossary.toγtoγ̇a-beki-lüġe: Toγtoγ̇a-Beki — Toqto'a Beki (Toγtoγ̇a, a man's name, + beki, a title of rank); comitative -lüġe, 'with' (personal name + title + case, front-vowel form; Ming 一同) [人名 一同]
glossary.γoγ̇as-merkid-ün: Γoγ̇as-Merkid — the Qo'as Merkid (Γoγ̇as, a clan name, + Merkid, a people); genitive -ün after a consonant, 'of the Qo'as Merkid' (clan name + people name + case, front-vowel form) [姓(名) 種名 的]
glossary.qulan-qatun-i: Qulan-Qatun — Qulan Qatun (Qulan, a woman's name, + qatun, lady, wife of a khan); accusative -i after a consonant, 'Qulan Qatun (object)' (personal name + title + case; Ming 行) [女名 行]
glossary.üžeġülsü: üžeġül- — to present, to offer up (Ming 獻與; stem uncertain); optative first person -sü, 'let me offer' (verb, optative, front-vowel form) [獻與]
glossary.žedgügdežü: žedgü- — to withstand, to block, to obstruct (stem inferred from the Ming 當着); passive -gde-, converb -žü, 'being blocked' (verb, passive converb, front-vowel form) [當着]
glossary.najā: Najā — Naya'a, a man's name, a short writing of Najaγ̇a (personal name) [人名]
glossary.nojan-dur: nojan — noyan, lord, commander; dative-locative -dur, 'to the noyan' (noun + case, back-vowel form; Ming 行) [官人行]
glossary.üžeġülüje: üžeġül- — to present, to offer up; hortative -üje (linking vowel + -je), 'let us offer' (verb, hortative; Ming 咱) [共獻咱]
glossary.töridġežüġüi: töridġe- — to stop, to hold back (stem inferred from the Ming 止住); past -žüġüi, 'stopped' (verb, past, front-vowel form) [止住了有]
glossary.töridgerün: töridge- — to stop, to hold back (as printed, without the dot over g; the same stem as töridġe-); converb of time -rün, 'when stopping' (verb, converb) [止時]
glossary.samaγ̇ui: samaγ̇ui — disorderly, in confusion (adjective; Ming 亂的) [亂的]
glossary.aγ̇ulqu: a- — to be, to live; causative -γ̇ul-, participle -qu, 'that will make live' (verb, causative participle, back-vowel form; Ming 敎活) [敎活]
glossary.samaγ̇uraqu: samaγ̇ura- — to be in disorder, to run wild (Ming 亂了); participle -qu (future or habitual), 'will …' (verb, participle, back-vowel form) [亂了]
glossary.qatun-luγ̇a: qatun — lady, queen, wife of a khan; comitative -luγ̇a, 'with the lady' (noun + case, back-vowel form; Ming 一同) [娘子 一同]
glossary.najā-ji: Najā — Naya'a, a man's name (short writing of Najaγ̇a); accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Naya'a (object)' (personal name + case; Ming 行) [人名行]
glossary.tödeġežü: tödeġe- — to stop, to hold up (stem inferred from the Ming 止當着; perhaps related to töridġe-); converb -žü, 'holding up' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [止當着]
glossary.qataṅγuj-a: qataṅγuj — hard, stern, unyielding (Ming 剛硬; form uncertain); dative-locative -a used adverbially, 'with sternness' (adjective + case, back-vowel form; Ming 行) [剛硬 行]
glossary.maraγ̇an: maraγ̇an — closely, minutely (adverb; Ming 仔細) [仔細]
glossary.asaγču: asaγ- — to ask; converb -ču, 'asking' (verb, converb) [問着]
glossary.idγaluγ̇a: idγa- — to urge, to persuade (stem inferred from the Ming 勸); past -luγ̇a (as -laγ̇a; Ming 來), 'urged' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [勸來]
glossary.najaγ̇a-dāča: Najaγ̇a — Naya'a, a man's name; ablative -dāča with a long vowel, 'from, other than' (personal name + case, back-vowel form; the Ming 處 marks 'at the place of') [(人)名處]
glossary.čeriġüd-tür: čeri — army, soldiers; plural -ġüd; dative-locative -tür, 'to the soldiers' (noun + plural + case, front-vowel form; Ming 行) [軍每行]
glossary.samaγ̇u-dur: samaγ̇u — disorder, confusion (noun; Ming 亂); dative-locative -dur, 'in disorder' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [亂裏]
glossary.čeküi-dür: čeküi — raw, unripe, unfamiliar (Ming 生; sense and form uncertain); dative-locative -dür, 'in …' (noun or adjective + case, front-vowel form) [生裏]
glossary.oroqu-ju: oro- — to enter; participle -qu (future or habitual); -ju, an ending 'is' (Ming 有; as in bi-jü; uncertain) (verb, participle + ending) [入去有]
glossary.γai: γai — I wonder, who knows (particle; Ming 不知 'not known') [不知]

glossary.uduid-ta: Uduid — the Uduid, a clan of the Merkid (Ming 姓 'surname'); dative-locative -ta, 'by' (marks the agent of a passive) (clan name + case) [姓(名)(行)]
glossary.ajuγ̇uldalaγ̇a: aju- — to fear, be afraid (from the Ming 怕); causative -γ̇ul-, passive -da-, 'be made afraid' (Ming 被敎); past narrative -laγ̇a (Ming 來) (verb, causative passive past) [被敎怕來]
glossary.hiruγ̇ar-a: hiruγ̇ar — bottom, depth (Ming 底); dative-locative -a, 'at, to the bottom' (Ming 行) (noun + case, back-vowel form) [底行]
glossary.kürülčetügei: kürülče- — to come together (kür- 'reach' + -ül- + -če-, as in kürülčežü; here Ming 敎共到); optative third person -tügei, 'let … come together' (Ming 者) (verb, optative) [敎共到者︀]
glossary.üžüġüren: üžüġür — end, tip; -en, 'until, right to' (Ming 直到頭; uncertain) (noun + suffix) [直到頭]
glossary.čaγ̇uraγ̇ulba: čaγ̇ura- — to go out on campaign (stem inferred from the Ming 出征); causative -γ̇ul-, 'make go out'; past -ba (Ming 了) (verb, causative past; not čaγ̇ura- “crumble”, Ming 碎, of an earlier part) [敎出征了]

glossary.nöködtü: nökör — companion, follower; plural -d; -tü 'having', 'having companions' (noun + plural + possessive-adjective suffix) [伴當(每)有的]
glossary.taṅlu: Taṅlu — Tanglu, a mountain name (place name) [山名]
glossary.uγulža: uγulža — argali, wild mountain sheep (noun) [羱羊]
glossary.iderün: ide- — to eat; converb of time -rün, 'while eating' (verb, converb) [喫時]
glossary.idemü: ide- — to eat; present -mü, 'eats, is eating' (verb, present) [喫有]
glossary.uγulža-jin: uγulža — argali; genitive -jin after a vowel-final stem, 'of the argali' (noun + case) [羱羊 的]
glossary.abčiražuγ̇u: abčira- — to bring (to a person; stem from ab- 'take' plus a second element, analysis uncertain); past -žuγ̇u, 'brought' (verb, past, back-vowel form) [將着來了有]

glossary.noγosu: noγosu — duck, ducks (noun; the final -su may be a plural, uncertain) [鴨子]

glossary.boro-quladu: boro-quladu — a bird name (perhaps boro 'grey' plus quladu; the bird is not identified) (noun) [鳥名]
glossary.borčin-sono: borčin-sono — a kind of duck (name of a bird; analysis uncertain) (noun) [鴨名]
glossary.nekün: nekün — household servant, dependant (noun; the Ming gives 'person of the household') [(家)人]
glossary.budun: budun — the common people, folk (noun; the Ming 本 gives only 'root, own', sense by context) [本]
glossary.böšöžü: böšö- — to surround, close in on (stem inferred from the Ming 圍着); converb -žü, 'surrounding' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [圍着]
glossary.nemdežü: nemde- — to plot, scheme secretly against (stem inferred from the Ming 潛謀); converb -žü, 'plotting' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [潛謀着]

glossary.aγ̇uldaqu: aγ̇ulda- — to spare, let remain (causative sense from the Ming 敎存; stem uncertain); participle -qu, 'to be spared' (verb, participle) [敎存的]
glossary.nököčekü: nököče- — to be a companion, keep company (from nökör 'companion'); participle -kü, 'to be a companion' (verb, participle; front-vowel form) [做得伴]

glossary.γardaγsan: γarda- — to lay a hand on, set hand to; past participle -γsan, 'the one who laid a hand' (verb, participle, back-vowel form) [下手的]
glossary.mököriġülžü: mököri- — to cut down, behead; causative -ġül-; converb -žü, 'having had (him) beheaded' (verb, causative converb) [斬了着]
glossary.qamtudba: qamtud- — to come together, be joined (from qamtu 'together'; stem inferred); past -ba, 'came together' (verb, past) [相合下]
glossary.kilγun: kilγun — cart-shaft, shafts (noun; Ming 車轅 'the shaft of a cart') [車轅]

glossary.sedkimü: sedki- — to think, intend; present -mü, 'thinks' (verb, present) [想有]
glossary.umartaγsani: umarta- — to forget; past participle -γsan, 'what one had forgotten'; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token left before the reflexive -jan (verb, participle + linking vowel) [忘了的 自的行]
glossary.duradγaldužu: duradγa- — to remind, bring up, mention (stem uncertain; Ming 提說, as in duradγarun); reciprocal -ldu-; converb -žu, 'reminding one another' (verb, reciprocal converb; the division is uncertain) [共提說 着]
glossary.untaraγsani: untara- — to sleep, be asleep (stem uncertain, perhaps from unta- 'sleep'); past participle -γsan, 'one who has slept'; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token left before the reflexive -jan (verb, participle + linking vowel) [睡着的 自的行]
glossary.seriġülülečežü: seri- — to wake, be aware (variant spelling of sere-, as in sereġülžü; stem inferred from the Ming 覺省); causative -ġül- with linking ü; -lče-, 'together, one another'; converb -žü, 'waking one another' (verb, causative reciprocal converb; the division of the middle is uncertain) [共覺省着]
glossary.ölžetü: ölže — good fortune, felicity; -tü 'having', 'fortunate' (noun + possessive-adjective suffix) [吉慶]
glossary.qutuγtu: qutuγ — blessing, sacred luck; -tu 'having', 'blessed' (noun + possessive-adjective suffix) [吉慶 有的]
glossary.üküldüküi: ükü- — to die; reciprocal -ldü-; participle -küi, 'the dying together' (verb, reciprocal participle) [共捨死的]
glossary.žürüge-ben: žürüge — heart; reflexive-possessive -ben, 'one's own heart' (noun + reflexive-possessive, front-vowel form) [心 自的行]
glossary.ebedkü: ebed- — to ache, hurt (stem inferred from the Ming 痛); participle -kü, 'aching' (verb, participle) [痛的]
glossary.irgen-lüġe: irgen — people, nation; comitative -lüġe, 'with the people' (noun + case; front-vowel form of -luγ̇a as printed) [百姓 一同]
glossary.qalaqalžid-eled-te: Qalaqalžid-Eled — Qalaqaljid-Eled, a place name (Eled perhaps 'sands'); dative-locative -te, 'at' (place name + case) [地名行]
glossary.qadqulduqui-dur: qadqul- — to fight, clash (stem inferred); reciprocal -ldu-; participle -qui, 'the fighting'; dative-locative -dur, 'at the time of' (verb, participle + case) [厮殺︀的 時]
glossary.ügülegsed: ügüle- — to speak, say; past participle -gsen with plural -d, 'those who spoke, the things said' (verb, plural participle; Ming 說了的(每)) [說了的(每)]
glossary.üge-ġer: üge — word, speech; instrumental -ġer, 'by words, with words' (noun + instrumental, front-vowel form) [言語裏]
glossary.üküġülžü: ükü- — to die; causative -ġül-; converb -žü, 'having put to death' (verb, causative converb) [敎死着]
glossary.ajuγ̇uluγsani: aju- — to fear (stem inferred from the Ming 敎怕); causative -γ̇ul-, 'frighten'; past participle -γsan, 'those frightened'; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token left before the reflexive -jan (verb, causative participle + linking vowel) [敎怕來的]
glossary.adalidγatuγai: adalidγa- — to liken, compare, make an example (from adali 'like'; stem inferred); optative -tuγai, 'let it be' (verb, optative) [敎比方者︀]
glossary.bolžuγ̇ui-že: bol- — to become, be; past -žuγ̇ui, 'was'; -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + assertion particle; Ming 做了有來 也者) [做了有來 也者︀]

glossary.umartaqu: umarta- — to forget; participle -qu, 'to be forgotten, forgettable' (verb, participle) [忘的]
glossary.qaγaldažu: qaγalda- — to share out, divide (stem uncertain) ; converb -žu, 'dividing' (verb, converb) [分着]

glossary.köndöledü-de: köndölen — one at the side, bystander (Ming 傍人); köndöledü is an uncertain form; -de dative-locative marking the agent of a passive, 'by' (noun + case; analysis uncertain) [被傍人行]
glossary.kökiġüldežü: kökiġülde- — to be incited, egged on (kökiġül- causative-like; stem uncertain); converb -žü, 'being incited' (verb, passive/medial converb) [挑唆着]

glossary.qadquγdažu: qadqu- — to strike, stab, slay (Ming 戮); passive -γda-, converb -žu, 'being struck down' (verb, passive converb) [戮着]
glossary.qadaγatu: qadaγa — weight, pressing importance (Ming 緊要); -tu 'having', 'of weight, important' (noun + possessive-adjective suffix; form uncertain) [緊要 有的]
glossary.üġüleldüleġe: ügüle- — to speak; reciprocal -ldü- ('together') + past -leġe, 'spoke together, said to one another' (verb, reciprocal past, front-vowel form) [共說來]
glossary.niγ̇uri: niγ̇ur — face (Ming 面皮 'face-skin'); the linking (i) is Shiratori's, before a following reflexive -jan (noun + linking vowel) [面皮 自的行]
glossary.qaγ̇uldaqui-ača: qaγ̇ulda- — to be flayed, peeled (Ming 被剝; stem uncertain); participle -qui + ablative -ača, 'from/because of being flayed' (verb, participle + case, back-vowel form) [被剝的 行]
glossary.qalidun: qalidun — close, near, intimate (adjective; meaning from Ming 親近) [親近]
glossary.anda-ijan: anda — sworn brother, pledged friend; reflexive-possessive -ijan, 'one's own' (noun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [契合 自的行]

glossary.sedkiltü: sedkil — heart, mind; -tü 'having', 'hearted, minded' (noun + possessive-adjective suffix) [心有的]
glossary.nököčeldübe: nököče- — to be a companion, keep company; reciprocal -ldü- ('together') + past -be, 'became companions to one another' (verb, reciprocal past) [作伴了]
glossary.toγoriγai: toγoriγai — round, all around, in a circle (adjective or adverb; Ming 圓; form uncertain) [圓]
glossary.tübšidgebe: tübšidge- — to pacify, bring to peace (Ming 敎平, 'cause to be level'); past -be (verb, causative, past tense, front-vowel form) [敎平了]
glossary.tutum-i: tutum — each, every one (see tutum; Ming 每); accusative -i (pronoun/adjective + case; the Ming 行 marks the object) [每行]
glossary.qamtudγaba: qamtudγa- — to join together, unite (from qamtu 'together'); past -ba, 'united' (verb, past tense, back-vowel form) [合併了]
glossary.žoriba: žori- — to aim at, point out, destine; past -ba, 'pointed, destined' (verb, past tense) [指了]
glossary.delegei: delegei — the earth, the world (Ming 天下 'under heaven') (noun) [天下]

glossary.žubaγ̇aqu: žubaγ̇a- — to trouble, cause distress (Ming 敎生受, 'make suffer'); participle -qu, 'that causes distress' (verb, causative participle) [敎生受]
glossary.žaqa-jin: žaqa — edge, collar (Ming 領); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the collar' (noun + case) [領的]
glossary.böġešün: böġešün — vermin, a crawling pest, perhaps a louse (Ming 蟲子 'insect') (noun; sense uncertain) [䖝子]
glossary.žagiṅ-ün: žagiṅ — lower hem, under-flap of a coat (Ming 底襟); genitive -ün, 'of the hem' (noun + case) [底襟 的]
glossary.arbin: arbin — wide, broad (Ming 寬廣) (adjective) [寬廣]
glossary.emegetü: emegen — old woman, grandmother (Ming 婆婆); -tü 'having', 'with an old woman' (noun + possessive-adjective suffix) [婆婆 有的]
glossary.alus-i: alus — beyond, across (uncertain; see alus; Ming 隔越 'to separate, pass over'); accusative -i (adverb or noun + case; analysis uncertain) [隔越(行)]
glossary.alžiγ̇as: alžiγ̇as — error, mistake, going astray (Ming 差 'wrong') (noun) [差]

glossary.alaγ̇ulurun: ala- — to kill; causative -γ̇ul-, converb -run (with linking u), 'when having (someone) killed' (verb, causative converb, back-vowel form) [敎殺︀時]
glossary.γarγan: γar- — to come out; causative -γa-, converb -n, 'bringing out, letting out' (verb, causative converb) [敎出]

glossary.ölüg: ölüg — dead, a dead one, corpse (Ming 死) (adjective or noun) [死]
glossary.etügen-dür: etügen — earth, ground; dative-locative -dür, 'on the ground' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [地行]
glossary.eġüre: eġüre — long (of time), for a long time (Ming 久) (adverb) [久]
glossary.igežü: ige- — to help, protect (Ming 護助); converb -žü, 'protecting' (verb, converb) [護助着]
glossary.hirüġer: hirüġer — blessing, prayer for long life (Ming 祝壽) (noun) [祝︀壽]
glossary.boluju-že: bol- — to be, become; -ju present ending, as in boluju + emphatic particle -že, 'is, indeed' (verb, present + particle) [做有 也者︀]
glossary.törülkitü: törülki — inborn nature, birth; -tü 'having', 'of such nature, born so' (noun + possessive-adjective suffix; Ming 生像有的) [生像有的]

glossary.sülder-e: sülder — might, awesome power (Ming 威靈); dative-locative -e, 'by the might of' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [威靈行]

glossary.umartan: umarta- — to forget; converb -n, 'forgetting' (verb, converb) [忘了]

glossary.surdaqu: surda- — to be learned from (sur- 'learn' + -da-; Ming 可學); participle -qu, 'worth learning, to be learned' (verb, participle) [可學的]
glossary.üküġülüje: ükü- — to die; causative -ġül-, hortative -je, 'let us put (him) to death' (verb, causative hortative, front-vowel form) [敎死咱]
glossary.tölge-dür: tölge — omen, divination (Ming 卦); dative-locative -dür, 'in the omen' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [卦裏]
glossary.oromui: oro- — to enter, go in (Ming 入); present -mui, 'enters' (verb, present tense) [入有]
glossary.siltaγ̇an: siltaγ̇an — reason, cause, pretext (Ming 緣故) (noun) [緣故]
