glossary.ašiγ-temür: Ašiγ-Temür — Ashiq-Temür, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.alčiγ: Alčiγ — Alchiq, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.gerijesi: gerije — keepsake, token to remember by (Ming 遺念 'memento'); plural -s; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token left before reflexive -jen (noun + plural) [遺念 自的行]
glossary.inžes-eče-ġen: inže — dowry attendant; plural -s + ablative -eče + reflexive-possessive -ġen, 'from one's own dowry attendants' (noun + plural + case + reflexive) [從嫁(每)自的行]
glossary.baγ̇urči-jan: baγ̇urči — cook, steward of the food (Ming 厨子); reflexive-possessive -jan, 'one's own cook' (noun + reflexive) [厨子 自的行]
glossary.žaγ̇un-i: žaγ̇un — hundred; accusative -i, 'a hundred (object)' (numeral + case) [百行]
glossary.abuγ̇a: abu- — to take, ask for (Ming 要); past -γ̇a, 'took' (verb, past) [要了]
glossary.ibaγa-ji-jan: Ibaγa — Ibaqa, a woman's name; accusative -ji + reflexive-possessive -jan, 'one's own Ibaqa (object)' (personal name + case + reflexive) [夫人名 自的行]
glossary.qubilaj-a: Qubilai — Qubilai, a man's name; dative-locative -a, written -ja after i, 'to Qubilai' (personal name + case) [人名行]
glossary.küčütü-jin: küčütü — strong, having strength (küčü 'strength' + possessive -tü); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the strong one' (adjective + case) [氣力有的(的)]
glossary.bökö-jin: bökö — wrestler, strong man (Ming 力士); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the wrestler' (noun + case) [力士 的]
glossary.sübegetei: Sübegetei — a man's name (the same man as Sübeġetei, the spelling differing) (personal name) [人名]
glossary.noγasi: noγai — dog; plural -s; the (i) is Shiratori's, the token left before reflexive -jan, 'one's own dogs' (noun + plural) [狗每自的行]
glossary.sedkigsen-dür: sedki- — to think; past participle -gsen + dative-locative -dür, 'when (one) thought' (verb, participle + case) [想了的 行]
glossary.žoriγ̇ulžu: žori- — to point out, aim at (Ming 指; the glossary's žori-, as in žoriγ̇ulba); causative -γ̇ul- + converb -žu, 'making point, directing' (verb, causative converb) [敎指着]
glossary.kemkelün: kemkel- — to smash (stem inferred; Ming 撞碎 'smash'); converb -ün, 'smashing' (verb, converb) [撞碎]
glossary.qada: qada — cliff, crag (Ming 崖) (noun) [崖] · also Qada, a man's name (Ming 人名)
glossary.qaγalun: qaγal- — to break open (stem inferred; Ming 撞破 'smash open'); converb -un, 'breaking open' (verb, converb) [撞破]
glossary.čilaγ̇un-i: čilaγ̇un — stone; accusative -i, 'the stone (object)' (noun + case) [石行]
glossary.čeġülün: čeġül- — to crush (stem inferred; Ming 碎 'broken to bits'); converb -ün, 'crushing' (verb, converb) [碎]
glossary.nitulun: nitul- — to cut off (stem inferred; Ming 斷絕 'cut off'); converb -un, 'cutting off' (verb, converb) [斷絕]
glossary.aba-že: a- — to be, to dwell; past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'was, indeed' (verb, past + particle) [有來 也者︀]
glossary.žoriγsan: žori- — to point out, aim at (Ming 指); past participle -γsan, 'the one pointed out' (verb, past participle) [指來的]
glossary.urida-γ̇an: urida — before, in front (Ming 前面); reflexive-possessive -γ̇an, 'in one's own front' (adverb + reflexive) [前面 自的行]
glossary.baiγ̇uluγ̇asu: bai- — to stand; causative -γ̇ul-, 'make stand' + conditional converb -γ̇asu, 'if (one) makes stand' (verb, causative conditional) [敎立呵]
glossary.amuqu: amu- — to be at ease, rest (Ming 安); participle -qu, 'being at ease' (verb, participle) [安]
glossary.bedüġün-ü: Bedüġün — Bedüün, a man's name; genitive -ü, 'of Bedüün' (personal name + case) [人名的]
glossary.možirγaγ-un: možirγaγ — crooked, perverse (Ming 抝的 'obstinate'; uncertain); genitive -un (adjective + case) [(抝的)]
glossary.čima-luγ̇a: či — you; comitative -luγ̇a on the oblique stem čima-, 'together with you' (pronoun + case) [你一同]
glossary.jabuγdaqu: jabu- — to go, act; passive -γda- + participle -qu, 'to be acted on' (Ming 可行 'it may go'; analysis uncertain) (verb, passive participle) [可行]
glossary.bedüġün-i: Bedüġün — Bedüün, a man's name; accusative -i, 'Bedüün (object)' (personal name + case) [人名 行]
glossary.genigedei: Genigedei — the Genigedei, a people (Ming 種名) (people name) [種名]
glossary.qunan-a: Qunan — Qunan, a man's name; dative-locative -a, 'to Qunan' (personal name + case) [人名 行]
glossary.nojad-ta: nojan — noyan, lord; plural -d + dative-locative -ta, 'to the lords' (noun + plural + case) [官人(每)行]
glossary.dodai: Dodai — a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.doqolqu-tan: Doqolqu — a man's name; plural possessive -tan, 'Doqolqu and his like' (Ming 等 'and so on'; uncertain) (personal name + plural possessive) [人名 等]
glossary.čerbin-e: čerbi — cherbi, an office or rank (Ming 官名 'office name'; meaning of the title not known); dative-locative -n-e with linking -n-, 'to the cherbi' (noun + case) [官名 行]
glossary.neġüküi-dür: neġü- — to move camp; participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'when moving camp' (verb, participle + case) [起時]
glossary.ünžigsen: ünži- — to stay, halt (Ming 住; uncertain); past participle -gsen (verb, past participle) [住了]
glossary.ünžiküi-dür: ünži- — to stay, halt (uncertain); participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'when halting' (verb, participle + case) [休時]
glossary.neġügsen: neġü- — to move camp; past participle -gsen, 'the one who has moved' (verb, past participle) [起了]
glossary.küġün-lüġe: küġün — man, person; comitative -lüġe, 'together with a man' (noun + case) [人 一同]
glossary.žübčigsen: žübči- — to be at ease, make peace (Ming 安; uncertain); past participle -gsen (verb, past participle) [安來的]
glossary.öšitü: öši — enmity, grudge (Ming 讐 'enemy, feud'; stem uncertain); possessive -tü, 'having enmity' (noun + possessive) [讐有的]
glossary.üiledkün: üiled- — to do, act; imperative -kün, plural 'you (pl.) do' (Ming 做事您) (verb, imperative) [做事您]
glossary.genigesi: Geniges — the Genigesid, a people (Ming 種名); the (i) is Shiratori's linking vowel, the token left before reflexive -jen (people name) [種名 自的行]
glossary.teriġüležü: teriġü — head; verb-maker -le-, converb -žü, 'being at the head' (Ming 爲頭) (noun-derived verb, converb) [爲頭着]
glossary.žuči-jin: Žüči — Jüchi, a son's name; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Jüchi' (personal name + case) [子名 的]
glossary.usun-ebügen: Usun-Ebügen — a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.üžegseni: üže- — to see; past participle -gsen with Shiratori's (i), the token left before reflexive -jen, 'what one has seen' (verb, participle) [見來的 自的行]
glossary.niγ̇un: niγu- — to hide (Ming 隱諱 'hide, conceal'); converb -n, 'hiding' (verb, converb) [隱諱]
glossary.sonosuγsani: sonos- — to hear; past participle -uγsan with Shiratori's (i), the token left before reflexive -jan, 'what one has heard' (verb, participle) [聽了的 自的行]
glossary.qabčiγun: qabčiγun — conceal, hide (Ming 藏匿每; formation uncertain) (verb or noun; uncertain) [藏匿每]
glossary.želme-de: Želme — Jelme, a man's name; dative-locative -de, 'to Jelme' (personal name + case, front-vowel form) [人名 行]
glossary.kürege-ben: kürege — bellows, literally 'wind box' (Ming 風匣); reflexive-possessive -ben, 'his own bellows' (noun + possessive) [風匣 自的行]
glossary.ölegei-te-eče: ölegei — cradle (Ming 搖車); the form carries an unexplained -te- and the ablative -eče, 'from the cradle' (noun + case; the -te- is uncertain) [搖車 自的行]
glossary.nelke: nelke — swaddling-cloth, a baby's wrapping (Ming 褯衣) (noun) [褯衣]
glossary.nököčegšeġer: nököče- — to be a companion (stem from the Ming 倣伴); ending -gšeġer, 'ever since' (verb, converb?; the ending is uncertain) [倣伴以來]
glossary.egüden-ü: egüden — door (Ming 門子, which can also mean a doorkeeper); genitive -ü, 'of the door' (noun + case) [門子的]
glossary.töreküi-lüġe: töre- — to be born; participle -küi with comitative -lüġe, 'together with being born, at birth together' (verb, participle + case) [生時 一同]
glossary.öšküi-lüġe: ös- — to grow (the stem's s is printed š before k); participle -küi with comitative -lüġe, 'together at growing' (verb, participle + case) [長時 一同]
glossary.hužaγ̇urtu: hužaγ̇ur — root, origin (Ming 根源); -tu 'having', 'having a root' (noun + possessive) [根源 有(的)]
glossary.aldaγ̇asu: alda- — to incur a penalty, be at fault (Ming 罰, 'penalty, fine'; sense uncertain); conditional -γ̇asu, 'if (one) incurs' (verb, conditional) [罰呵]
glossary.ereġü-dür: ereġü — guilt, offence (Ming 罪); dative-locative -dür, 'in guilt' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [罪裏]
glossary.tolun-a: Tolun — Tolun, a man's name (probably the Tolun-Čerbi of §§191–193); dative-locative -a, 'to Tolun' (personal name + case) [人名 行]
glossary.miṅγa: miṅγa — thousand (numeral; a short form of miṅγan, which is also the thousand-man unit) [千]
glossary.qurijaldun: qurija- — to gather (stem inferred from the Ming 收集); reciprocal-collective -ldu- 'together' with converb -n, 'gathering together' (verb, converb) [共收集]
glossary.öröle: öröle — single, alone (sense uncertain; the Ming has only 隻, 'single, one of a pair') (adjective?) [隻]
glossary.žigtüldüžü: žigtü- — to pull, drag (stem inferred from the Ming 拽; analysis uncertain); reciprocal-collective -ldü- 'together' with converb -žü, 'pulling together' (verb, converb) [共拽着]
glossary.qurijalduγsan: qurija- — to gather (stem inferred); reciprocal-collective -ldu- with past participle -γsan, 'having gathered together' (verb, participle) [共收集了的]
glossary.oluγsan: olu- — to obtain, get; past participle -γsan, 'obtained' (verb, participle) [得了的]
glossary.žüġegseni: žüġe- — to set, place (Ming 置; stem inferred); past participle -gsen, followed by Shiratori's bracketed (i), a linking vowel before the instrumental -jer, 'those set in place' (verb, participle; uncertain) [置來的]
glossary.turuqan-dur: Turuqan — Turuqan, a man's name; dative-locative -dur, 'to, with Turuqan' (personal name + case, back-vowel form) [人名 行]
glossary.baγ̇urči-da: baγ̇urči — cook (Ming 厨子); dative-locative -da, 'to the cook' (noun + case, after a vowel) [厨子 行]
glossary.toquraγ̇ud: Toquraγ̇ud — the Toqura'ud, a clan (Ming 姓; 'surname, clan'); -d plural (clan name) [姓(名)]
glossary.möṅgetü-kijan-u: Möṅgetü-Kijan — Möngetü-Kiyan, a man's name; genitive -u, 'of Möngetü-Kiyan' (personal name + case) [人名 的]
glossary.budan-dur: budan — fog, mist (Ming 霧); dative-locative -dur, 'in the fog' (noun + case) [霧 裏]
glossary.toγ̇oriba-že: toγ̇ori- — to get lost, go astray (stem inferred from the Ming 迷); past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [迷了也者︀]
glossary.bulγa-dur: bulγa — turmoil, rebellion, disorder (Ming 反亂); dative-locative -dur, 'in turmoil' (noun + case) [反亂 裏]
glossary.qaγačaba-že: qaγača- — to part, leave, be separated; past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle) [離了 也者︀]
glossary.nobšildužü: nobši- — to be wet (from noitan 'wet'; stem inferred from the Ming 濕); reciprocal-collective -ldu- 'together' with converb -žü, 'being wet together' (verb, converb; uncertain) [共濕着]
glossary.köbšildüžü: köbši- — to be cold (stem inferred from the Ming 寒); reciprocal-collective -ldü- 'together' with converb -žü, 'being cold together' (verb, converb; uncertain) [共寒着]
glossary.keġeġesü: keġe- — to say; conditional -ġesü, 'if, when (he) says', closing a quotation (verb, conditional) [說呵]
glossary.soγ̇oṅγuluγ̇asu: soγ̇oṅγul- — to choose (stem inferred from the Ming 揀; the Ming 敎 'cause' suggests a causative); conditional -uγ̇asu, 'if (one) lets choose' (verb, conditional; uncertain) [敎揀呵]
glossary.bajaγ̇ud: Bajaγ̇ud — the Baja'ud, a people (Ming 種, 'kind, race'); -d plural (people name) [種(名)]
glossary.tutum-dur: tutum — each, every (Ming 每; sense uncertain); dative-locative -dur, 'in each' (adjective/noun + case) [每裏]
glossary.bura: bura — scattered, spread about (Ming 漫) (adjective or converb stem; uncertain) [漫]
glossary.tara: tara- — to disperse, scatter (Ming 散); the bare stem, set beside bura as a rhyming pair (verb stem; uncertain) [散]
glossary.deġü-ġen: deġü — younger brother; reflexive-possessive -ġen, 'one's own younger brother' (noun + possessive) [弟自的行]
glossary.čiγ̇ulγasuγai: čiγ̇ul- — to gather, assemble (stem inferred from the Ming 聚); causative -γa- with first-person optative -suγai, 'let me cause to gather' (verb, causative + optative) [敎完聚我]
glossary.eteġed: eteġed — side, flank (Ming 邊); stem uncertain, -d may be a plural or part of the stem (noun; uncertain) [邊]
glossary.tügeġerün: tügeġe- — to give out, distribute (Ming 給散); converb of time -rün, 'when giving out' (verb, converb of time) [給散時]
glossary.baiγsan: bai- — to stand; past participle -γsan, 'one who stood' (verb, participle) [立(了)的]
glossary.saγ̇uγsan-a: saγ̇u- — to sit; past participle -γsan with dative-locative -a, 'to the one who sat' (verb, participle + case) [坐(了)的行]
glossary.dutaγ̇ulun: duta- — to lack, be short; causative -γ̇ul-, 'make lack'; converb -un, 'letting lack' (verb, causative + converb) [敎缺了]
glossary.žergelegsen: žergele- — to line up, rank (from žerge 'row'; stem inferred from the Ming 列); past participle -gsen, 'one lined up' (verb, participle) [列了的]
glossary.esegsen-e: ese — not (of a past action); with -gsen and dative-locative -e, 'to those who have not' (negative + participle + case; analysis uncertain) [不曾的(行)]
glossary.tügeġeġeü: tügeġe- — to give out, distribute; conditional written -ġeü, 'if' (probably a variant or slip for -ġesü; left as printed) (verb, conditional) [給散呵]
glossary.qučin: qučin — to choke, be hoarse (Ming 澁噎, 'rough and choked'); form and word class uncertain (verb or noun) [澁噎]
glossary.amuju: amu- — to be at rest, at ease; converb -ju used as a main verb, 'is at ease' (verb, converb; analysis uncertain) [安有]
glossary.tügeġedkün: tügeġe- — to give out, distribute; -d- plural or polite element with imperative -kün, 'give out (you two)' (verb, imperative, second person plural polite; both elements uncertain) [給散您]
glossary.saγ̇urun: saγ̇u- — to sit; converb of time -run, 'when sitting' (verb, converb of time) [坐時]
glossary.tüsürge-jin: tüsürge — banquet, drinking-party (Ming 酒局, 'wine office'; sense uncertain); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the banquet' (noun + case; uncertain) [酒局 的]
glossary.basaγ̇alažu: basaγ̇ala- — to judge, reckon, take account (Ming 知料; stem inferred, sense uncertain); converb -žu, 'taking account' (verb, converb; uncertain) [知料着]
glossary.saγ̇udqun: saγ̇u- — to sit; -d- plural or polite element with imperative -qun, 'sit (you)' (verb, imperative, second person plural polite; uncertain) [坐您]
glossary.tolum-tan-luγ̇a: Tolun — Tolun, a man's name (printed Tolum before t); -tan 'and the like' (Ming 等, uncertain) and comitative -luγ̇a, 'together with Tolun and the like' (personal name + collective + case) [人名等 一同]
glossary.tüblen: tüblen — in the middle, facing north (Ming 面北居中, 'facing north, in the centre'); stem and form uncertain (adverb?; uncertain) [面北居中]
glossary.žiγ̇ažu: žiγ̇a- — to tell, announce; converb -žu, 'telling' (verb, converb) [吿着]
glossary.boroγul-a: Boroγul — Boroqul, a man's name; dative-locative -a, 'to Boroqul' (name + case) [人名行]
glossary.köser-eče: köser — ground, earth (stem read from the Ming 地); ablative -eče, 'from the ground' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [地行]
glossary.dürüžü: dürü- — to cast, throw, take in (stem inferred from the Ming 投; uncertain); converb -žü, '…ing' (verb, converb) [投着]
glossary.küžüġün-eče: küžüġün — neck, nape (Ming 項頸); ablative -eče, 'from the neck' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [項頸行]
glossary.sačaγ̇un: sačaγ̇u — alike, equally; ending -n, adverbial (uncertain) (adverb) [齊每] · also 'alike, equal' (Ming 齊等) [齊等]
glossary.egemēče: egem — shoulder (stem inferred from the Ming 肩甲); ablative -ēče, 'from the shoulder' (written with a long vowel) (noun + case) [肩甲行]
glossary.ere-lüġe: ere — man, male; comitative -lüġe, 'together with a man' (noun + case) [男子 一同]
glossary.köġüd-ü-ġen: köġün — son; plural -d, then -ü- (a linking vowel before the reflexive-possessive after the plural -d; not a genitive), + reflexive-possessive -ġen, 'one's own sons' (noun + plural + reflexive) [兒子每自的(行)]
glossary.man-a: ba — we, exclusive (oblique stem man-; Ming 俺, against 咱 for the inclusive bida); dative-locative -a, 'to us' (pronoun + case) [俺行]
glossary.težiġebe-že: težiġe- — to rear; past -be, front-vowel form, + assertion particle -že, 'indeed, surely' (verb, past + particle) [養了也者︀]
glossary.težiġegsen: težiġe- — to rear; past participle -gsen, 'that has reared', 'the having reared' (verb, participle) [養了的]
glossary.hači-ban: hači — requital, repayment (Ming 囘報; compare hači 'enmity' [讎]); reflexive-possessive -ban after a vowel, 'one's own' (noun + reflexive) [囘報自的行]
glossary.qariγ̇lba: qariγ̇l- — to repay, requite (stem inferred from the Ming; compare qari- 'return'); past -ba (verb, past tense) [囘報了]
glossary.nököčeldüžü: nököče- — to be a companion; -ldü- joint action, 'together'; converb -žü, '…ing' (verb, converb) [伴當着]
glossary.ajan-dur: ajan — campaign, march out (Ming 出征); dative-locative -dur, 'on campaign' (noun + case) [出征 裏]
glossary.qonoγ̇ulba-že: qono- — to pass the night; causative -γ̇ul-, 'make stay the night'; past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed, surely' (verb, causative past + particle) [敎宿了 也者︀]
glossary.šitüġeleldüžü: šitüġe- — to resist, oppose (stem inferred from the Ming 抗拒); -leldü- reciprocal, 'one another' (division uncertain); converb -žü, '…ing' (verb, converb) [相抗拒着]
glossary.kišiten: kiši — grievance, wrong (stem inferred from the Ming 寃); possessive plural -ten, 'those having a grievance' (noun + possessive plural) [寃有的每]
glossary.doraidaγ̇ulžu: doraida- — to subdue, crush (stem inferred from the Ming 壓服); causative -γ̇ul-; converb -žu, '…ing' (verb, causative converb) [壓服下了着]
glossary.kisan: kisa- — to avenge, requite (stem inferred from kisal and the Ming 報); ending -n, converb or participle (uncertain) (verb) [報]
glossary.ülidgen: ülidgen — utterly, completely (Ming 盡絕 'wholly cut off'; stem uncertain) (adverb, uncertain) [盡絕]
glossary.qargil-šira: Qargil-Šira — Qargil-Shira, a man's name, a Tatar (personal name) [(人)名]
glossary.oγ̇určaγ: oγ̇určaγ — robber, brigand (Ming 劫賊) (noun) [劫賊]
glossary.ölöčü: ölö- — to be hungry (stem inferred from the Ming 饑); converb -čü, '…ing' (verb, converb) [饑着]
glossary.eke-dür: eke — mother; dative-locative -dür, 'to, at the mother' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [母行]
glossary.ger-te: ger — tent, home; dative-locative -te, 'in the home' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [家裏]
glossary.eriġülšün: eri- — to seek; -ġülšün, ending of one who seeks (uncertain; Ming 尋的) (verb, ending uncertain) [尋的]
glossary.alaγun-a: alaγun — place behind the door (Ming 門後; stem uncertain); dative-locative -a, 'behind the door' (noun + case) [門後行]
glossary.tului: Tului — Tolui (printed Tului), a boy's name; Chinggis's son (personal name) [(兒)名]
glossary.γadanača: γadana — outside (stem read from the Ming 自外); ablative -ča, short form of -ača, 'from outside' (noun + case) [自外]
glossary.γargil-šira: Qargil-Šira — Qargil-Shira, a man's name; printed here with Γ, the same man (personal name) [(人)名]
glossary.suγ̇u-duri: suγ̇u — armpit (stem inferred from the Ming 肘腋); dative-locative -dur, 'at, under', followed by Shiratori's (i) before the reflexive -jan, which stands as its own token, 'under one's own armpit' (noun + case) [肘腋 裏自的行]
glossary.qabčižu: qabči- — to clamp, press (stem inferred from the Ming 夾); converb -žu, 'clamping' (verb, converb) [夾着]
glossary.kituγai-ban: kituγai — knife; reflexive-possessive -ban after a vowel, 'one's own knife' (noun + reflexive) [刀自的行]
glossary.temtelžü: temtel- — to whet, rub (stem inferred from the Ming 磨); converb -žü, '…ing' (verb, converb) [磨着]
glossary.žuγulun: žuγul- — to draw out, pull out (stem inferred from the Ming 抽); converb -un, '…ing' (verb, converb) [抽]
glossary.boroγul-un: Boroγul — Boroqul, a man's name; genitive -un, 'of Boroqul' (name + case) [(人)名的]
glossary.altani: Altani — Altani, a woman's name; wife of Boroqul here (personal name) [婦人名]
glossary.keġeküi-lüġe: keġe- — to say; participle -küi + comitative -lüġe, 'together with the saying', i.e. at the very moment (verb, participle + case) [纔說 間]
glossary.udaγ̇araldun: udaγ̇ar- — to follow (stem inferred from the Ming 隨); -ldu- joint action, 'together'; converb -n, '…ing' (verb, converb) [共隨卽]
glossary.γarulčažu: γar- — to go out; -ulča- joint action, 'together' (division uncertain); converb -žu, '…ing' (verb, converb) [共出着]
glossary.γargil-šira-jin: Qargil-Šira — Qargil-Shira, a man's name (printed with Γ); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Qargil-Shira' (name + case) [(人)名的]
glossary.šibilger: šibilger — probably a braid or lock of hair; the Ming 練︀推 gives no sense, so this is from context only (uncertain) (noun) [練︀推]
glossary.tataqui-luγ̇a: tata- — to pull; participle -qui + comitative -luγ̇a, 'together with the pulling', i.e. while pulling (verb, participle + case) [扯 有間]
glossary.aldažuγ̇ui: alda- — to slip away, lose (Ming 脫 'slip off'); past ending -žuγ̇ui, back-vowel form (uncertain) (verb, past tense) [脫了有來]
glossary.želen: želen — food, something prepared to eat (Ming 做喫的; uncertain) (noun) [做喫的]
glossary.altani-jin: Altani — Altani, a woman's name; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Altani' (name + case) [(婦人)名的]
glossary.daγ̇un-dur: daγ̇un — sound, voice, cry; dative-locative -dur, 'at the sound' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [聲裏]
glossary.nudurγaši-jan: nudurγaši — fist (Ming 拳頭); reflexive-possessive -jan after a vowel, 'one's own fist' (noun + reflexive) [拳頭 自的行]
glossary.hulaγ̇adažu: hulaγ̇ada- — to redden, be red (stem inferred from the Ming 紅); converb -žu, '…ing' (verb, converb) [紅着]
glossary.γargil-šira-ji: Qargil-Šira — Qargil-Shira, a man's name (printed with Γ); accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Qargil-Shira' as object (name + case) [人名行]
glossary.süke-ber: süke — axe; instrumental -ber, 'with an axe' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [斧子敎]
glossary.žuldu: žuldu — first credit, foremost merit (Ming 頭功) (noun) [頭功]
glossary.temečeldüġešü: temeče- — to contend, vie (stem inferred from the Ming 爭); -ldü- reciprocal, 'one another'; conditional -ġešü, 'if, when' (Ming 呵) (verb, conditional) [相爭呵]
glossary.man-u-γ̇ai: ba — we, exclusive (stem man-; Ming 俺); genitive -u, 'of us' + -γ̇ai, a particle of emphasis or possession (uncertain; Ming 俺的 'ours') (pronoun + case + particle) [俺的]
glossary.sonosuγ̇asu: sonos- — to hear; conditional -uγ̇asu, 'if, when' (Ming 呵) (verb, conditional) [聽的呵]
glossary.irekün: ire- — to come; ending -kün (uncertain; Ming 來每) (verb, ending uncertain) [來每]
glossary.žuγuluγsan: žuγul- — to draw out; past participle -γsan, 'that has drawn' (verb, participle) [抽了的]
glossary.iretele: ire- — to come; terminative converb -tele, 'until, while' (verb, converb) [來(間)]
glossary.boroγul-dur: Boroγul — Boroqul, a man's name; dative-locative -dur, 'to, for Boroqul' (name + case) [人名行]
glossary.tului-jin: Tului — Tolui (printed Tului), a boy's name; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Tolui' (name + case) [人名的]
glossary.kereid-luγ̇a: Kereid — the Kereid, a people (Ming 種(名)); comitative -luγ̇a, 'together with the Kereid' (name + case) [種(名) 一同]
glossary.qalqalžid: Qalqalžid — Qalaqaljid, the name of the sands (place name) [沙磧名]
glossary.sužiγ̇asu-ban: sužiγ̇asu — nape vein, neck pulse (Ming 頂脈, no 呵, so a noun although the ending looks like the conditional -γ̇asu; stem uncertain); reflexive-possessive -ban after a vowel, 'one's own' (noun + reflexive) [頂脈 自的行]
glossary.tusdaγ̇asu: tusda- — to be struck, hit (stem inferred from the Ming 被中); conditional -γ̇asu, 'if, when' (verb, conditional) [被中呵]
glossary.unaγ̇asu: una- — to fall; conditional -γ̇asu, 'if, when' (verb, conditional) [倒了呵]
glossary.buγ̇uldužu: buγu- — to come down, dismount; -ldu- joint action, 'together'; converb -žu, '…ing' (verb, converb) [共下着]
glossary.qaγuγsan: qaγu- — to congeal, clot (stem inferred from the Ming 凝定); past participle -γsan, 'that has clotted' (verb, participle) [凝定的]
glossary.morin-dur: morin — horse; dative-locative -dur, 'on the horse' (noun + case) [馬行]
glossary.jadaqu-ji: jada- — to be unable; participle -qu + accusative -ji after a vowel, 'the being unable' as object (verb, participle + case) [不得行]
glossary.ogödei-jin: Ögödei — Ögödei, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Ögödei' (name + case) [人名的]
glossary.teberižü: teberi- — to embrace (stem inferred from the Ming 抱); converb -žü, 'embracing' (verb, converb) [抱着]
glossary.žabaži-jar: žabaži — lips, edge of the mouth (Ming 口脗; stem uncertain); instrumental -jar after a vowel, 'with the mouth' (noun + case) [口脗(行)]
glossary.težiġen: težiġe- — to rear; ending -n, participle (uncertain; Ming 養來的) (verb, participle) [養來的]
glossary.žobaγsan: žoba- — to toil, suffer (stem inferred from the Ming 生受); past participle -γsan, 'that has suffered' (verb, participle) [生受了的]
glossary.darbaγ̇an: darbaγ̇an — beckoning, a signal (Ming 招; stem uncertain) (noun) [招]
glossary.urija-dāča: urija- — to call, summon (Ming 喚); -dāča, ablative or similar, written with a long vowel; the Ming has 行 (uncertain) (verb + ending) [喚行]
glossary.demēče: deme- — to answer (stem inferred from the Ming 應); ablative -ēče, written with a long vowel (verb + ending; uncertain how the case sits on a verb) [應行]
glossary.qožidaba-že: qožida- — to lag behind, fall behind (stem inferred from the Ming 落後); past -ba + assertion particle -že, 'indeed, surely' (verb, past + particle) [落後了也者︀]
glossary.urugi: urug — family, kin (Ming 族; compare uruγ 'offspring'); the token urugi is urug with Shiratori's bracketed (i), the linking vowel before the reflexive -jan, which stands as its own token (noun) [族 自的行]
glossary.ebügen-e: ebügen — old man; dative-locative -e, 'to the old man' (noun + case) [老人行]
glossary.qabčin: qabčin — hiding, concealment (Ming 匿; stem uncertain; whether related to the qabči- 'clamp' of qabčižu is unclear) (noun or verb ending; uncertain) [匿]
glossary.uqaγsan: uqa- — to understand; past participle -γsan, 'what one has understood' (verb, participle) [省了的]
glossary.sedkigseni: sedki- — to think (stem inferred from the Ming 想); past participle -gsen with Shiratori's (i), the token left before reflexive -jen, 'what one has thought' (verb, participle) [想了的 自的行]
glossary.beki: beki — beki, a title of rank (noun) [官名]
glossary.bolqui: bol- — to become; participle -qui, 'that becomes' (verb, participle) [做的]
glossary.baγ̇arin: Baγ̇arin — Ba'arin, a people (Ming 種名) (name) [種名]
glossary.aqa-jin: aqa — elder brother; genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the elder brother' (noun + case) [長的]
glossary.deġere-eče: deġere — above, upper; ablative -eče, 'from above' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [自 上]
glossary.takižu: taki- — to serve, wait on (stem inferred from the Ming 侍奉); converb -žu, 'serving' (verb, converb) [侍奉着]
glossary.neġegsen: neġe- — to open; past participle -gsen, 'that has opened' (verb, participle) [開了的]
glossary.önöčid-ün: önöči — solitary one, forlorn (Ming 孤獨; stem uncertain; compare önečin 'orphan', Ming 孤); plural -d + genitive -ün, 'of the forlorn' (noun + plural + case) [孤獨(每)的]
glossary.čaγan-γoγ̇a-jin: Čaγan-Γoγ̇a — Chagan-Go'a, a man's name (here the father of Narin-To'oril); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Chagan-Go'a' (personal name + case) [人名的]
glossary.narin-toγ̇ori: Narin-Toγ̇oril — Narin-To'oril, a man's name; the first part, whose last letter -l stands at the head of the next line (Narin-Toγ̇ori- / l-a) (personal name; split by the printing) [人名]
glossary.l-a: -l + -a — the last letter of Narin-Toγ̇oril, completing the name, then dative-locative -a, 'to' (name-end + case; token left after the line break) [行]
glossary.čaγan-γoγ̇a: Čaγan-Γoγ̇a — Chagan-Go'a, a man's name (here the father of Narin-To'oril; perhaps čaγan 'white' + the name element γoγ̇a, cf. Qo'a) (personal name) [人名]
glossary.kičiġežü: kičiġe- — to take care, be careful (Ming 謹愼 'careful'); converb -žü, 'taking care' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [謹︀愼着]
glossary.alaγdaluγ̇a: ala- — to kill; passive -γda-; past -luγ̇a, 'was killed' (verb, passive past) [被殺︀了來]
glossary.abtuγai: ab- — to take, receive; optative -tuγai, 'let him receive' (verb, optative, third person) [受者︀]
glossary.neküs: Neküs — the Nekus, a clan name (the Ming gives only 種(名), 'a clan'); ending in -s, perhaps a plural (clan name; identity uncertain) [種(名)]
glossary.buratara: buratara — scattered, dispersed (Ming 漫散; stem not analysed, perhaps a converb) (verb form; uncertain) [漫散]
glossary.čiγ̇ulγa: čiγ̇ul- — to gather, assemble (stem inferred from the Ming 聚); causative -γa-, 'make gather' (verb stem + causative; the first part of čiγ̇ulγa-suγai, cut at the line end, the ending -suγai being the next token) [敎(聚)]
glossary.sorγan-šira-da: Sorγan-Šira — Sorqan-Shira, a man's name; dative-locative -da, 'to Sorqan-Shira' (personal name + case, back-vowel form) [人名行]
glossary.naitažu: naita- — to envy, be jealous (stem inferred from the Ming 嫉妒); converb -žu, 'envying' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [嫉妒着]
glossary.bariγ̇asu: bari- — to seize, take hold of; conditional -γ̇asu, 'if, when (one) seizes' (verb, conditional; Ming 呵) [拿了呵]
glossary.naitaγdamu: naita- — to envy, be jealous (stem inferred from the Ming 嫉妒); passive -γda-; present -mu, 'is envied' (verb, passive present) [被嫉妒 有]
glossary.asaraγ̇ulžu: asara- — to lift, raise up, rear (Ming 擡擧; here 'tend, bring up'); causative -γ̇ul-; converb -žu, 'having (someone) tend (him)' (verb, causative converb) [敎擡擧着]
glossary.udaγ̇an-a: udaγ̇an — slow, late; dative-locative -a, 'late, after a delay' (adjective as adverb + case, back-vowel form) [遲行]
glossary.taγ̇alaqun: taγ̇ala- — to like, be fond of (stem inferred from the Ming 愛); ending -qun uncertain, Ming 每 suggests a plural/participial 'those who like' (verb + uncertain ending) [愛每]
glossary.darqalasu: darqala- — to be free, at liberty (stem inferred from the Ming 自在); optative -su, 'let me be free' (verb, first-person optative) [自在我]
glossary.seleṅge-ji: Seleṅge — the Selenge, a river (the Ming says only 地名, 'place name'); -ji, case ending (Ming 行), 'at, on' (place name + case; the exact case uncertain) [地名 行]
glossary.darqaladqun: darqala- — to be free, at liberty; -dqun, polite plural imperative, 'be free (you all)' (verb, imperative; Ming 您) [自在您]
glossary.aldal-dur: aldal — penalty, fine, fault; dative-locative -dur, 'into a penalty, in a fine' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [罰裏]
glossary.qandaqu: qanda- — to be full, fulfilled (stem uncertain; the sense is the Ming 滿立); participle -qu (verb, participle; doubtful) [滿立的]
glossary.dataγ̇ui-ban: dutaγ̇u — lacking, wanting (from duta- 'to lack'; printed dataγ̇u-) + -i, an ending of uncertain force (perhaps the accusative, perhaps part of the stem); reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own lack' (adjective/participle + ending + reflexive-possessive) [缺少 自的行]
glossary.γuiqun: γui- — to ask for, claim (Ming 索); ending -qun, uncertain, before böġesü 'if you ask' (verb + uncertain ending) [索的每]
glossary.keleledkün: kelele- — to speak, tell (kele 'tongue' + verb-former); -dkün, polite plural ending, 'speak, tell (you all)'; after bu, 'do not tell' (verb, polite plural imperative; Ming 您) [說您]
glossary.oġer-ün: öġer — own, self; genitive -ün after r, 'of one's own' (pronoun + case; spelled oġer here) [自己(的)]
glossary.öġesüd: öġesün — oneself, self; plural -d, 'selves, themselves' (pronoun + plural, the final -n dropped before -d) [自每]
glossary.dutaγ̇u-juγ̇an: dutaγ̇u — lacking, wanting (from duta- 'to lack'); reflexive-possessive -juγ̇an, 'one's own lack' (adjective/participle + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form after a vowel) [缺少的 自的行]
glossary.γuidqun: γui- — to ask for, claim (Ming 索); -dqun, polite plural imperative, 'ask (you all)' (verb, imperative) [索您]
glossary.darqad: darqan — a free man (Ming 自在 'free, at ease'); plural -d, 'the free ones' (noun + plural; any technical sense of darqan is not in these sources) [自在每]
glossary.darqalarun: darqala- — to be free, make free; converb of time -run, 'when making free' (verb, converb of time; Ming 敎 'cause') [敎自在時]
glossary.tödege-ji: Tödege — Tödöge, a man's name; -ji read as genitive (Ming 的; the form is uncertain) (personal name + case) [人名 的]
glossary.ažuγ̇ui-že: a- — to be; past -žuγ̇ui, 'was'; particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, past + particle; Ming 有來 也者) [有來 也者︀]
glossary.najaγ̇a-da: Najaγ̇a — Naya'a, a man's name; dative-locative -da, 'to Naya'a' (personal name + case, back-vowel form) [人名 行]
glossary.širgötü: Širgötü — Shirgötü, a man's name; -tü looks like the 'having' suffix, but taken here as part of the name (personal name; analysis uncertain) [人名]
glossary.tan-luγ̇a: ta — you (plural, polite), oblique stem tan-; comitative -luγ̇a, 'together with you' (pronoun + case) [您 一同]
glossary.tarqutai: Tarqutai-Kiriltuγ — Tarqutai-Kiriltuq, a man's name; the first half, broken at the line end (Tarqutai- / Kiriltug-i) (personal name; Ming 人) [人]
glossary.kiriltug-i: Kiriltuγ — Kiriltuq, the second half of the name Tarqutai-Kiriltuγ (printed Kiriltug); accusative -i, 'Tarqutai-Kiriltuq (object)' (personal name + case) [名行]
glossary.najaγ̇a-bilžiγ̇ur: Najaγ̇a-Bilžiγ̇ur — Naya'a-Biljiur, a man's name (the second element perhaps an epithet; sense unknown) (personal name) [人名]
glossary.tarqutai-kiril: Tarqutai-Kiril — Tarqutai-Kiril-, first part of the name Tarqutai-Kiriltuq, broken at the line end after Kiril- (personal name; split by the printing) [人名]
glossary.tug-i: -tug + -i — the end of the name Kiriltuq (Tarqutai-Kiril-tug), completing it; accusative -i, 'object' (name-end + case) [行]
glossary.γartažu: γarta- — to lay hands on (from γar 'hand'; stem inferred from the Ming 下手 'set hand to'); converb -žu, 'laying hands (on)' (verb, converb) [下手着]
glossary.γartaγsad: γarta- — to lay hands on (from γar 'hand'; stem inferred); past participle -γsan, plural -d, 'those who laid hands' (verb, participle + plural) [下手的每]
glossary.itegegdekün: itege- — to trust, rely on (stem inferred from the Ming 倚仗); passive -gde-; ending -kün uncertain, Ming 每 (verb, passive + uncertain ending) [倚仗每]
glossary.keġegdekün: keġe- — to say; passive -gde-, 'be said, be called'; ending -kün uncertain, Ming 每 (verb, passive + uncertain ending) [被說每]
glossary.sedkižüġüi: sedki- — to think; past narrative -žüġüi, 'thought, had thought' (verb, past) [想了有]
glossary.üile-dür: üile — work, deed, matter; dative-locative -dür, 'in the matter, on the job' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [勾當 裏]
glossary.tüšije: tüši- — to entrust, set on, appoint (stem inferred from the Ming 委付); optative -je, 'let me entrust' (verb, first-person optative) [委付咱]
glossary.medeġülbe: mede- — to know; here 'to have charge of'; causative -ġül-, past -be, 'had (him) manage' (verb, causative past) [敎管了]
glossary.tüb-ün: tüb — middle, centre; genitive -ün, 'of the centre, central' (noun + case) [中的]
glossary.oluγsad: ol- — to get, find; past participle -γsan, plural -d, 'those (men) got' (verb, participle + plural) [得了的(每)]
glossary.žüġegseġeri: žüġe- — to set in place, arrange (stem inferred from the Ming 置); -gseġer(i), a past-participle-like form whose ending I have not analysed, the (i) before the reflexive -jen being bracketed in the print (verb, participle; analysis uncertain) [置了的 自的行]
glossary.qoniči-da: qoniči — shepherd (qoni 'sheep' + agent -či); dative-locative -da, 'to the shepherd' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [牧羊的 行]
glossary.bügdeġül-i: bügdeġül — an unknown word (Ming 理沒; sense uncertain); accusative -i (noun? + case; doubtful) [理沒行]
glossary.modoči-da: modoči — carpenter (mod 'wood' + agent -či); dative-locative -da, 'to the carpenter' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [木匠 行]
glossary.datuγdažu: datuγda- — to be short, lacking, 'be lacked' (stem inferred from the Ming 被缺着; cf. dutaγ̇u 'lacking', from duta-; the vowels differ); converb -žu (verb, passive converb; analysis uncertain) [被缺着]
glossary.žüki-jer: žüki — right, proper, fitting (Ming 正); -jer, instrumental-shaped ending, 'by, according to' (adjective + case; Ming 依着) [正 依着]
glossary.nököčelüġe: nököče- — to be a companion (from nökör; cf. nököčežü); past ending -lüġe, uncertain, Ming 來, as in keġeleġei (verb, past; doubtful) [做伴來]
glossary.baiγ̇ululčaγsad: baiγ̇ul- — to set up, found, make stand (bai- 'stand', causative -γ̇ul-); -lča- 'together'; past participle plural -γsad, 'those who together founded' (verb, causative, reciprocal, participle plural) [共立了的每]
glossary.žobolduγsad-i: žobo- — to suffer, endure hardship; -ldu- 'together'; past participle plural -γsad + accusative -i, 'those who together endured hardship (object)' (verb, reciprocal participle plural + case) [共生受了的每 行]
glossary.harbad-un: harban — ten; plural -d + genitive -un, 'of the tens', here 'of the ten-commanders' (numeral + plural + case) [十每的]
glossary.tümeležü: tümele- — to form into ten-thousands (from tümen); converb -žü, 'making ten-thousands' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [萬做着]
glossary.tümed-ün: tümen — ten thousand; plural -d + genitive -ün, 'of the ten-thousands' (numeral noun + plural + case, front-vowel form) [萬每的]
glossary.ögtekün: ög- — to give; passive -te- (as in ögteġei) + participle -kün (as in irekün), 'what may be given' (verb, passive participle; reading uncertain) [可與的每]
glossary.metüs-e: metü — like, as (postposition used as a noun, 'sort, kind'; stem uncertain); plural -s + dative-locative -e, 'to the likes of' (postposition + plural + case) [般每行]
glossary.bolqun-a: bol- — to become, be (Ming 做 'do, make'); participle -qun, 'one who …' + dative-locative -a, 'to those who' (verb, participle + case) [做的每行]
glossary.kebteġülsütü: kebteġül — night guard; plural -s + -tü 'having', 'having night-guards' (noun + plural + possessive) [宿衞有的]
glossary.kešigtentü: kešigten — guardsman, member of the guard; -tü 'having', 'having guardsmen' (noun + possessive) [扈衞(每)有的]
glossary.küčün-dür: küčü — strength (stem küčün- before a case ending); dative-locative -dür, 'by strength, in strength' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [氣力 裏]
glossary.auγa: auγa — might, vigour (noun; sense taken from the Ming 氣, 'breath, spirit'; uncertain) [氣]
glossary.žiluγ̇a-duri: žiluγ̇a — rein, management, control (Ming 調度); dative-locative -dur + (i) + reflexive-possessive -jan, 'under one's own rein' (noun + case; this token is the stem with dative-locative, the (i) being Shiratori's) [調度裏 自的行]
glossary.oroγ̇uluγsan-dur: oro- — to enter; causative -γ̇ul-, 'make enter, bring in'; past participle -γsan + dative-locative -dur, 'at the time of having brought in' (verb, causative participle + case) [敎入了 時]
glossary.miṅγad-ača: miṅγan — thousand; plural -d + ablative -ača, 'from the thousands' (numeral noun + plural + case) [千每行]
glossary.oroγ̇uludqun: oro- — to enter; causative -γ̇ul-, 'bring in'; -dqun, polite plural command (Ming 您), 'be so good as to bring in' (verb, causative, polite imperative; the ending is read from the Ming) [敎入您]
glossary.düġürgen: düġür- — to be full; causative -ge-, 'fill'; converb -n, 'filling, making full' (verb, causative converb) [敎滿]
glossary.oroγ̇ulqu-ji: oro- — to enter; causative -γ̇ul-, 'bring in'; participle -qu, 'what is to be brought in' + accusative -ji (verb, causative participle + case) [敎入的]
glossary.miṅγad-ta: miṅγan — thousand; plural -d + dative-locative -ta, 'to the thousands' (numeral noun + plural + case) [千每行]
glossary.tuṅγarun: tuṅγa- — to proclaim, make known; converb of time -run, 'when proclaiming' (verb, converb) [傳布時]
glossary.duri-jin: duri — plain, commoner (stem uncertain; Ming 白身, 'bare person'); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the commoner' (noun + case) [白身(的)]
glossary.ororun: oro- — to enter; converb of time -run, 'when entering' (verb, converb) [入時]
glossary.said-i: sai — good; plural -d + accusative -i, 'the good ones (object)' (adjective used as noun + plural + case) [好的每行]
glossary.oroγ̇ultuγai: oro- — to enter; causative -γ̇ul-, 'bring in'; optative -tuγai (Ming 者), 'let them bring in, let them be brought in' (verb, causative, optative, third person) [敎入者︀]
glossary.iletügei: ile- — to send, bring (reading uncertain; the Ming glosses it as it does iretügei); optative -tügei, 'let them bring' (verb, optative, front-vowel form; possibly a variant of ire-) [敎來者︀]
glossary.nökörtü: nökör — companion, follower; -tü 'having', 'having companions' (noun + possessive) [伴當有的]
glossary.hužaγ̇ur-ača: hužaγ̇ur — root, origin, base; ablative -ača, 'from the root, from the stock' (noun + case) [根源行]
glossary.jabuγ̇ulqun-i: jabu- — to go; causative -γ̇ul-, 'make go'; participle -qun, 'one who is made to go' + accusative -i (verb, causative participle + case) [敎行每的 行]
glossary.bökelerün: bökele- — to exert strength, show prowess; converb of time -rün, 'when showing prowess' (verb, converb) [氣力做 時]
glossary.žaγ̇un-ača: žaγun — hundred; ablative -ača, 'from the hundreds' (numeral noun + case) [百處]
glossary.öġügsen: ög- — to give; past participle -gsen, 'given, which was given' (verb, past participle) [與了的]
glossary.γadi: γadi — alone, by oneself (stem uncertain); the token left before the instrumental -jar in γad(i)-jar, 'by himself' (Ming 獨自 自的行 glosses the whole word) (adverb or noun; analysis uncertain) [獨自 自的行]
glossary.qubi-ača: qubi — share, portion; ablative -ača, 'from the share' (noun + case) [分子 行]
glossary.kemlegsen: kemle- — to fix a limit, set a measure (from kem 'limit'); past participle -gsen, 'fixed, set' (verb, past participle) [限定了的]
glossary.kemi: kem — limit, bound; the token left before the instrumental -jer in kem(i)-jer, 'by the limit' (Ming 限依着 glosses the whole word) (noun) [限依着]
glossary.ača: -ača — ablative: from (written as a separate word after qubi-) (case suffix, back-vowel form) [行]
glossary.dabaqun: daba- — to cross, transgress; participle -qun, 'one who transgresses' (verb, participle) [越了每的]
glossary.bultarižu: bultari- — to shirk, dodge; converb -žu, 'shirking' (verb, converb) [𧻞避着]
glossary.jabuqui-ban: jabu- — to go, move about; participle -qui (-qu with -i) + reflexive-possessive -ban, 'one's own going' (verb, participle + reflexive-possessive) [行的 自的行]
glossary.berkešijeġsü: berkešije- — to find hard, make difficulty (from berke 'hard'); conditional -ġsü (reading uncertain; Ming 呵), 'if (he) finds it hard' (verb, conditional) [作難︀呵]
glossary.besu-ji: besu — other, another; accusative -ji after a vowel, 'another (object)' (noun/adjective + case) [別的 行]
glossary.ereġülüžü: ereġül- — to blame, hold at fault (stem uncertain; Ming 罪); converb -žü, 'blaming' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [罪着]
glossary.dotona: dotona — inside, within (Ming 裏行) (adverb or postposition) [裏行]
glossary.surulčasu: sur- — to learn; -lča- 'together'; first-person optative -su, 'let us learn together' (verb, reciprocal, optative first person) [共學我]
glossary.idγatuγai: idγa- — to hinder, stop, obstruct (Ming 阻當; not the idγa- 'to urge', Ming 勸, found elsewhere); optative -tuγai (Ming 者), 'let (them) hinder'; with bu, 'let (them) not hinder' (verb, optative, third person) [阻當者︀]
glossary.boluγsaγ̇ar: bol- — to become, be (Ming 做 'do, make'); past participle -uγsan + instrumental -γ̇ar, 'by what was done, according to' (verb, participle + case, back-vowel form) [做了的依着]
glossary.žarligi: žarliγ — command, decree (Ming 聖旨); the token left before the instrumental -jar in žarlig(i)-jar, 'according to the decree' (the (i) is Shiratori's) (noun) [聖旨 依着]
glossary.düġürgetügei: düġür- — to be full; causative -ge-, 'fill'; optative -tügei (Ming 者), 'let it be made full' (verb, causative, optative, third person, front-vowel form) [敎滿者︀]
glossary.kebteġül-dür: kebteġül — night guard; dative-locative -dür, 'into the night guard' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [宿衞裏]
glossary.oroqun-i: oro- — to enter; participle -qun, 'one who enters' + accusative -i, 'those who enter (object)' (verb, participle + case) [入的每行]
glossary.kebteġül-i: kebteġül — night guard; accusative -i, 'the night guard (object)' (noun + case) [宿衞行]
glossary.jeke-neġürin: Jeke-Neġürin — Yeke-Ne'ürin, a man's name (Ming 人名; the name is jeke 'great' with a second element, meaning uncertain) [人名]
glossary.ilγaba: ilγa- — to pick out, select (Ming 選揀); past -ba, 'picked out' (verb, past tense) [選揀了]
glossary.qorčin-i: qorčin — quiver-bearer, archer; accusative -i, 'the quiver-bearers (object)' (noun + case) [帶弓箭的行]
glossary.jesün-teġe: Jesün-Teġe — Jesün-Te'e, a man's name (Ming 人名; the second element is not explained) [人名]
glossary.tüge-jin: Tüge — Tüge, a man's name (Ming 人名); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Tüge' (personal name + case) [人名 的]
glossary.bügidei-lüġe: Bügidei — Bügidei, a man's name (Ming 人名); comitative -lüġe, 'together with Bügidei' (personal name + case) [人名 一同]
glossary.turγaγ̇ud-luγ̇a: turγaγ — day guard (an inference from the Ming 散班, '(scattered) shift'); plural -ud + comitative -luγ̇a, 'together with the day guards' (noun + plural + case, back-vowel form) [散 班(每)一同]
glossary.kešig-tür: kešig — turn of duty, watch, shift (Ming 班); dative-locative -tür, 'in the turn' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [班裏]
glossary.oroldurun: oro- — to enter; -ldu- 'together'; converb of time -run, 'when entering together' (verb, reciprocal, converb) [入時]
glossary.bügidei: Bügidei — Bügidei, a man's name (Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.qorqudaγ: Qorqudaγ — Qorqudaq, a man's name (Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.lablaqa: Lablaqa — Lablaqa, a man's name (Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.aγsaquj-a: aγsa- — to wear, carry (stem inferred; Ming 帶); participle -quj (-qu with -i before a vowel) + dative-locative -a, 'to those who wear' (verb, participle + case) [帶的行]
glossary.qorčini: qorčin — quiver-bearer; the token left before the reflexive-possessive -jan in qorčin(i)-jan, 'one's own quiver-bearers' (noun; the (i) is Shiratori's) [帶弓箭的(自的)行]
glossary.düġürġežü: düġür- — to be full; causative -ġe-, 'fill'; converb -žü, 'filling, making full' (verb, causative converb, front-vowel form) [敎滿着]
glossary.ögere: Ögere — Ögere, a man's name (Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.čerbi-lüġe: čerbi — cherbi, an office or rank (meaning of the title not known; Ming 官名); comitative -lüġe, 'together with the cherbi' (noun + case) [官名 一同]
glossary.uruγ-ača: uruγ — lineage, kin, clan; ablative -ača, 'from the lineage' (noun + case) [宗族行]
glossary.iluγai-jin: Iluγai — Iluqai, a man's name (Ming 人名); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Iluqai' (personal name + case) [人名的]
glossary.alčidai-ji: Alčidai — Alchidai, a man's name (Ming 人名); accusative -ji after a vowel, 'Alchidai (object)' (personal name + case) [人名行]
glossary.doqolqu: Doqolqu — Doqolqu, a man's name (Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.čanai: Čanai — Chanai, a man's name (Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.alči-jin: Alči — Alchi, a man's name (Ming 人名); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of Alchi' (personal name + case) [人名的]
glossary.aqutai: Aqutai — Aqutai, a man's name (Ming 人名) [人名]
glossary.ilγaγsan: ilγa- — to pick out, select; past participle -γsan, 'picked out, selected' (verb, past participle) [選揀來的]
glossary.qorčin-luγ̇a: qorčin — quiver-bearer; comitative -luγ̇a, 'together with the quiver-bearers' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [帶弓箭 一同]
glossary.čaγ̇ada: čaγ̇a — nearness, side of the person (Ming 貼身); dative-locative -da, 'at one's side, near' (noun + case) [貼身]
glossary.kešigten-i: kešigten — guardsman, member of the guard; accusative -i, 'the guardsmen (object)' (noun + case) [護衞的(每)行]
glossary.bökeležü: bökele- — to exert strength, show prowess; converb -žü, 'showing prowess' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [氣力做着]
glossary.kešiġüd-ün: kešig — turn of duty, watch, shift; plural -üd; genitive -ün, 'of the turns' (noun + plural + case, front-vowel form) [護衞的每(的)] · also with Ming 班每 的 ('of the turns', 班 'turn') later in the part
glossary.ötökülekün-i: ötögü — old man, elder (printed ötökü-); -le- 'act as'; participle -kün; accusative -i, 'the heads (object)' (noun + verb-maker + participle + case; analysis tentative, as for aqalažu; the Ming 爲長的(每)行 reads 'to those who act as head') [爲長的(每)行]
glossary.tüširün: tüši- — to appoint, entrust with; converb of time -rün, 'when appointing' (verb, converb) [委付]
glossary.alčidai: Alčidai — Alchidai, a man's name (personal name; Ming gives only 人名) [人名]
glossary.ötöküs-i: ötögü — old man, elder; plural -s; accusative -i, 'the elders, the heads (object)' (noun + plural + case) [爲長的每行]
glossary.oroqui: oro- — to enter; participle -qui (the participle -qu with a final -i; ending uncertain), 'entering' (verb, participle) [入的]
glossary.kešig-ün: kešig — turn of duty, watch, shift; genitive -ün, 'of the turn' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [班的]
glossary.kešiglegsed: kešig — turn of duty; -le- 'serve a turn'; past participle plural -gsed, 'those who have served a turn' (noun + verb-maker + participle plural, front-vowel form) [輪班的每]
glossary.bügüdgežü: bügüdge- — to muster, count over (stem uncertain; compare bügüde 'all'); converb -žü, 'mustering' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [點全着]
glossary.jeġüdgeldütügei: jeġüdge- — to change, relieve (stem uncertain); reciprocal -ldü- 'one another'; optative -tügei, 'let them relieve one another' (verb, reciprocal, optative, front-vowel form) [交換者︀]
glossary.kešigtü: kešig — turn of duty; possessive -tü, 'having a turn, on duty' (noun + possessive, front-vowel form) [護衞 有的] · also with Ming 扈衞 有的 (a variant of 護衞) and with Ming 護衞 alone
glossary.hoγ̇araγ̇asu: hoγara- — to miss, fall short (stem inferred from the Ming 脫了 'slip off'); conditional -γasu, 'if (he) misses' (verb, conditional) [脫了呵]
glossary.oγ̇araγsan: hoγara- — to miss, fall short (printed without h); past participle -γsan, 'one who has missed' (verb, participle) [脫了的]
glossary.kešigtü-ji: kešig — turn of duty; possessive -tü; accusative -ji, 'the one on duty (object)' (noun + possessive + case, front-vowel form; the Ming 行 marks the object) [護衞的 行]
glossary.beriġes: beriġe — rod, switch (Ming 條子); plural -s, 'rods, strokes' (noun + plural) [條子(每)]
glossary.süitügei: süi- — to instruct, discipline? (Ming 敎導 'instruct'; with 'rods' it is read as 'give strokes'; stem uncertain); optative -tügei, 'let …' (verb, optative, third person; reading uncertain) [敎導者︀]
glossary.γad: γad — body (Ming 體), paired with beje in γad beje (noun) [體]
glossary.nojad-tur: nojan — noyan, officer; plural -d; dative-locative -tur, 'to the officers' (noun + plural + case, back-vowel form) [官人每 行]
glossary.šöjüġed: šöjü- — to instruct, discipline? (Ming 敎導 'instruct'; perhaps the same verb as süi- in süitügei; stem uncertain); converb -ġed, 'having …ed' (verb, converb of completed action; reading uncertain) [敎導了]
glossary.berkešijen: berkešije- — to find hard, make difficulty (from berke 'hard'); converb -n, '…ing' (verb, converb; ending uncertain) [作難︀]
glossary.kešigten-e: kešigten — guardsman, member of the guard; dative-locative -e, 'to the guardsmen' (noun + case) [宿衞的每 行]
glossary.sonosγadqun: sonos- — to hear; causative -γa- 'make hear'; polite plural imperative -dqun, 'you (plural) make (them) hear' (verb, causative, imperative) [敎聽您]
glossary.sonosγaγ̇asu: sonos- — to hear; causative -γa- 'make hear'; conditional -γasu, 'if (you) make (them) hear' (verb, causative, conditional) [敎聽呵]
glossary.dabaγ̇asu: daba- — to cross over, transgress (Ming 越); conditional -γasu, 'if (he) transgresses' (verb, conditional) [越了呵]
glossary.žariγ-un: žarliγ — command, decree (printed žariγ, without the l); genitive -un, 'of the decree' (noun + case) [聖旨的]
glossary.aqalaγdaba: aqa — elder brother, elder; -la- 'act as'; -γda- passive (tentative); past -ba, 'was made head' (noun + verb-maker + passive + tense; analysis tentative) [爲長了]
glossary.hoṅžidudqun: hoṅžidu- — to reproach, blame (stem uncertain; Ming 怪責); polite plural imperative -dqun, 'you (plural) reproach' (verb, imperative) [怪責者︀您]
glossary.žiγ̇adqun: žiγa- — to tell, report (Ming 吿); polite plural imperative -dqun, 'you (plural) report' (verb, imperative) [吿您]
glossary.mököriġülkün: mököri- — to cut down (stem inferred from the Ming 處斬 'execute'); causative -ġül- 'have done'; future participle -kün (as in mököriġüldekün; tentative), 'the one to be put to death' (verb, causative, participle; reading tentative) [合處斬的]
glossary.josutan: josu — custom, right, reason; possessive plural -tan, 'those having right, rightly' (noun + possessive plural; the Ming 理有的每 'those in the right' is read here as 'rightly') [理有的每]
glossary.mököriġülü-že: mököri- — to cut down; causative -ġül-; future-aorist -ü (tentative); assertion particle -že, '… indeed have … cut down' (the person of the subject is not shown) (verb, causative, tense + particle; reading tentative) [處斬也者︀]
glossary.nišiγdaqun: niši- — to strike (stem inferred from the Ming 打); passive -γda-; participle -qun, 'the one to be beaten' (verb, passive, participle; reading tentative) [合打的每]
glossary.nišid-že: niši- — to strike; -d (ending uncertain, perhaps first person plural); assertion particle -že, 'indeed … strike' (verb + particle; ending uncertain) [打 也者︀]
glossary.aqalaba: aqa — elder brother, elder; -la- 'act as'; past -ba, 'acted as head, was the head' (noun + verb-maker + tense; analysis tentative) [爲長了]
glossary.beriġedešü: beriġe — rod, switch; -de- 'strike with the rod' (tentative); conditional -šü (the Ming 呵 'if'; the usual conditional is -ġasu / -ġesü, so the ending is as printed), 'if … beats with a rod' (noun + verb-maker + conditional) [條子打呵]
glossary.beriġe-jin: beriġe — rod, switch; genitive -jin, 'of the rod' (noun + case, -jin after a vowel) [條子 的]
glossary.beriġe: beriġe — rod, switch (Ming 條子) (noun) [條子]
glossary.nudurγa-jin: nudurγa — fist; genitive -jin, 'of the fist' (noun + case, -jin after a vowel) [拳頭 的]
glossary.mudrγa: nudurγa — fist (printed mudrγa, probably a slip for nudurγa; the Han transcription is the same as for nudurγa-jin) (noun) [拳頭]
glossary.qariγ̇ultuγai: qariγ̇u — answer, return; -l- verb-maker (perhaps 'cause to return', Ming 敎囘); optative -tuγai, 'let … be returned' (noun + verb-maker + optative; stem uncertain) [敎囘者︀]
glossary.γadanadus: γadana — outside; -dus, plural ending (uncertain), 'those outside' (adverb + plural; ending uncertain) [在外每] · also with Ming 在外的每 ('those who are outside')
glossary.nojad-ača: nojan — noyan, officer; plural -d; ablative -ača, 'than the officers' (noun + plural + case, back-vowel form) [官人(每)行] · also ‘from among the officers’ (Ming 官人每行)
glossary.kešigtü-jin: kešig — turn of duty; possessive -tü; genitive -jin, 'of the one on duty' (noun + possessive + case) [護衞有的的]
glossary.kešigten-dür: kešigten — guardsman, member of the guard; dative-locative -dür, 'to the guardsmen' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [護衞的(每)行]
glossary.miṅγaliγ̇ud: miṅγan — thousand; -li- 'having' (tentative); plural -γud, 'thousand-commanders' (numeral noun + suffixes; analysis tentative) [千戶每]
glossary.kešigtü-dür: kešig — turn of duty; possessive -tü; dative-locative -dür, 'to the one on duty' (noun + possessive + case, front-vowel form) [護衞行]
glossary.kereldüġesü: kerel- — to quarrel, fight (Ming 鬪毆); reciprocal -ldü- 'with one another'; conditional -ġesü, 'if (they) fight' (verb, reciprocal, conditional) [鬪毆呵]
glossary.miṅγaloγ̇udai: miṅγan — thousand; -lo- 'having' (tentative; the back-vowel counterpart of -li- in miṅγaliγ̇ud); plural -γud; genitive -ai (tentative), 'of the thousand-commanders' (numeral noun + suffixes; analysis tentative) [千戶每的]
glossary.ereġüleje: ereġüle- — to blame, hold guilty (stem inferred from the Ming 罪; the glossary has ereġül- in ereġülüžü); hortative -je (first person plural), 'let us hold guilty' (verb, hortative) [罪咱]
glossary.jabudal: jabudal — going about, movement (jabu- 'go' + -dal, verbal noun; tentative) (noun) [行]
glossary.naran-u: naran — sun; genitive -u, the form after a stem in n, 'of the sun' (noun + case) [日的]
glossary.γaltaj-a: γal — fire (Ming 光 'light'); possessive -tai; -a dative-locative (tentative), 'in the light, while it has light' (noun + possessive + case; reading uncertain) [光有(的)行]
glossary.žailažü: žaila- — to give way, step aside (Ming 躱 'avoid'; the glossary's žaila-); converb -žü, 'stepping aside' (verb, converb; written -žü although the stem has back vowels) [躱着]
glossary.γaržu: γar- — to go out; converb -žu, 'going out' (verb, converb) [出着]
glossary.qonan: qono- — to pass the night; converb -n, 'passing the night' (verb, converb) [宿]
glossary.taγ̇ulžu: taγ̇ul- — to hand over (Ming 分付); converb -žu, 'handing over' (verb, converb) [分付着]
glossary.idetele: ide- — to eat; converb -tele, 'until, while eating' (verb, converb) [喫 直到]
glossary.kirüġe-dür: kirüġe — gathering place? (Ming 聚馬 'assembled horses'; the word is not known elsewhere in the glossary, the sense is a guess); dative-locative -dür, 'at the gathering' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [聚馬]
glossary.kelečilešü: keleči- — to speak, converse (stem tentative; Ming 通話); -le- verb-maker; converb -šü (tentative), 'conversing' (verb, converb; reading tentative) [通話着]
glossary.qor-tur: qor — quiver; dative-locative -tur, 'to the quiver' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [箭筒 行]

glossary.qoināča-γ̇an: qoina — behind, after; ablative -ča, 'from behind'; reflexive-possessive -γ̇an, 'one's own' (noun + case + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form; Ming 自後自的行) [自後自的行]

glossary.teb: Teb — Teb, a shaman's name (personal name) [巫名]

glossary.hičere: hičere — shame, disgrace (noun; Ming 羞耻) [羞耻]
glossary.baraγdaluγ̇a-že: bara- — to end, finish, be settled; passive -γda-; past -luγ̇a (Ming 來, 'had been'); particle -že, 'it is so, indeed' (verb, passive past + particle) [定了了來罷]
glossary.teli: teli — that matter (reading uncertain; sense from the Ming 那事) (noun) [那事]

glossary.hünegen: hünegen — fox (noun; Ming 野狐, part of a place name here) [野狐]

glossary.maqalai-jin: maqalai — fur cap (Ming 皮帽); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the fur cap' (noun + case) [皮帽 的]
glossary.balija: balija — teaching, instruction (Ming 敎訓; form uncertain) (noun) [敎訓]
glossary.taniγ̇uluγ̇asu: tani- — to know, recognise; causative -γ̇ul-, 'make known, teach'; conditional -γ̇asu, 'if (one) makes known' (verb, causative, conditional, back-vowel form) [敎認呵]
glossary.bolu-že: bol- — to become, be; linking vowel -u + assertion particle -že, 'let it be, so be it' (Ming 也者; the stem is bol-) (verb + particle) [中 也者︀]
glossary.kele-ġen: kele- — to speak, say; -ġen, reflexive-possessive 'one's own' (Ming 自的行; reading uncertain), 'speak your own' (verb + reflexive-possessive; uncertain) [說(自的行)]
glossary.qolbaγ̇aran: qolbaγ̇ara- — to join, go side by side (stem inferred from the Ming 並; variant of qolbara-); converb -n, 'side by side' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [並行]
glossary.qolbaγ̇aratala: qolbaγ̇ara- — to join, go side by side (stem inferred from the Ming 並; variant of qolbara-); converb -tala, 'until, while going side by side' (verb, converb) [並行]
glossary.ötögen: Ötögen — Etügen, the Earth, the earth-mother's name (Ming 地 'land') (proper name; also ötögen in the sense 'earth') [地]
glossary.salqu: salγa- — to divide, separate; participle -qu, 'dividing' (verb, participle) [分的]
glossary.situ: situ — like, as (Ming 般; compare metü) (postposition) [般]
glossary.aγ̇udkin: aγ̇ud- — to widen (stem inferred from aγ̇ui 'wide' and the Ming 敎寬 'cause to be wide'); -kin, converb ending (uncertain), 'widening' (verb, converb; uncertain) [敎寬]
glossary.salγaja: salγa- — to divide, separate; hortative -ja, 'let me divide, let us divide' (Ming 咱) (verb, hortative, back-vowel form) [分咱]
glossary.kürülčedkün: kürü- — to reach, hold to; reciprocal -lče-, 'together'; polite plural imperative -dkün, 'reach together, you (all)' (verb, reciprocal, imperative; Ming 敎共到您) [敎共到您]
glossary.ineġeġülüdkün: ineġe- — to laugh; causative -ġül- + linking vowel; polite plural imperative -dkün, 'make (them) laugh, you (all)' (verb, causative, imperative, front-vowel form) [敎咲您]
glossary.qabqariγ̇uludqun: qabqari- — to laugh loudly, guffaw (stem inferred from the Ming 大咲); causative -γ̇ul- + linking vowel; polite plural imperative -dqun (compare -dkün), 'make (them) guffaw, you (all)' (verb, causative, imperative, back-vowel form) [敎大咲您]
glossary.kürkü-jin: kürü- — to reach, hold to; participle -kü + genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the reaching' (verb, participle + case) [到的]
glossary.kigdelüġei: ki- — to do, make; passive -gde-; past -lüġei, 'was done, were done' (Ming 被做來) (verb, passive, past, front-vowel form) [被做來]
glossary.bolγaγdaluγ̇ai: bol- — to become; causative -γa- + passive -γda-; past -luγ̇ai, 'was made to become, was done' (Ming 被做了來) (verb, causative passive, past, back-vowel form) [被做了來]
glossary.uruγ̇ud-ača: uruγ — descendants, offspring; plural -ud; ablative -ača, 'from the descendants' (Ming 子孫每行) (noun + plural + case, back-vowel form) [子孫每(行)]
glossary.salγalduja: salγa- — to divide, separate; reciprocal -ldu-, 'together'; hortative -ja, 'let us divide together' (Ming 敎分咱) (verb, reciprocal, hortative, back-vowel form) [敎分咱]
glossary.osoldaqun: osolda- — to be negligent, remiss (stem inferred from the Ming 怠慢); -qun, ending of the polite plural (uncertain), 'you (all) are remiss' (verb; uncertain) [怠慢了]
glossary.qaγan-eče: qaγan — qan, sovereign, emperor; ablative -eče, 'from the Qaγan' (noun + case; front-vowel -eče on a back-vowel word, as printed) [皇帝(自)]
glossary.keġegdeġesü: keġe- — to say; passive -gde-; conditional -ġesü, 'if (one) is told' (verb, passive, conditional, front-vowel form) [被說呵]
glossary.jaγ̇u-ban: jaγ̇u — what; reflexive-possessive -ban after a vowel, 'one's own what' (pronoun + reflexive-possessive, back-vowel form) [甚麽自的行]
glossary.ügülekü: ügüle- — to speak, to say; participle -kü, 'to speak, the speaking' (verb, participle) [說]
glossary.čidaqui-bar: čida- — to be able, can; participle -qui + instrumental -bar, 'by ability, according to what one can' (verb, participle + case, back-vowel form) [能的 依着]
glossary.qataγ̇učisuγai: qataγ̇uči- — to be careful, take care (stem inferred from the Ming 謹愼); optative -suγai, 'let me be careful' (verb, optative, back-vowel form) [謹︀愼我]
glossary.keġemü-že: keġe- — to say; present -mü, 'says' + assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, present + particle) [說有也者︀]
glossary.olaṅ-dur: olaṅ — green grass (Ming 靑草); dative-locative -dur, 'in the green grass' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [靑草 裏]
glossary.qučiγ̇asu: quči- — to wrap up, embrace (stem inferred from the Ming 包褁); conditional -γ̇asu, 'if (one) wraps' (verb, conditional, back-vowel form) [包褁呵]
glossary.hüker-e: hüker — ox; dative-locative -e, 'by the ox' (names the doer of a passive; Ming 行) (noun + case, front-vowel form) [牛行]
glossary.idegdekü: ide- — to eat; passive -gde-; participle -kü, 'to be eaten' (verb, passive, participle, front-vowel form) [被喫]
glossary.eġükün-dür: eġükün — fat, grease (Ming 脂膏); dative-locative -dür, 'in the fat' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [脂膏 裏]
glossary.noγaj-a: noγai — dog; dative-locative -a (j is a glide), 'by the dog' (names the doer of a passive; Ming 行) (noun + case) [狗行]
glossary.qandaγai: qandaγai — an animal (Ming 獸名 'beast name'; not further identified) (noun) [獸名]
glossary.söles: söle- — to follow, comply with (stem inferred from the Ming 順應); -s, converb ending (uncertain), 'following' (verb, converb; uncertain) [順應着]
glossary.aldaquj-uγ̇u: alda- — to err, fail; participle -qu + glide -j- + question particle -uγ̇u (Ming 麽), 'will he not fail?' (verb, participle + particle, back-vowel form) [不中麽]
glossary.edül-jüġen-že: edül — these (Ming 這些; ede + -l, uncertain); reflexive-possessive -jüġen, 'one's own'; assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (here the Ming 但 'only' glosses the whole word) (pronoun + reflexive-possessive + particle, front-vowel form) [這些自的行但]
glossary.öġödei: Ögödei — Ögödei, a man's name (printed Öġödei) (personal name) [人名]
glossary.eimün: eimün — such, of this kind (Ming 這般每) (adjective or pronoun) [這般每]
glossary.umartaγsan-i: umarta- — to forget; past participle -γsan, 'forgotten'; accusative -i, 'the forgotten (thing)' (verb, participle + case, back-vowel form) [忘了的 行]
glossary.duradγažu: duradγa- — to recall, remind, mention; converb -žu, 'reminding' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [提說着]
glossary.umtaraγsan-i: umtara- — to fall asleep (stem inferred from the Ming 睡); past participle -γsan, 'asleep'; accusative -i, 'the one who slept' (verb, participle + case, back-vowel form) [睡着了的 行]
glossary.seriġülžü: seri- — to wake; causative -ġül-, 'rouse'; converb -žü, 'rousing' (verb, causative converb, front-vowel form) [喚省着]
glossary.žeġerde-jin: žeġerde — bay horse (Ming 赤馬); genitive -jin after a vowel, 'of the bay horse' (noun + case) [赤馬的]
glossary.qožidan: qožida- — to lag behind (stem inferred from the Ming 落後); converb -n, 'lagging' (verb, converb) [落後]
glossary.solaitan: solaita- — to leave a gap (stem inferred from the Ming 空缺 'vacancy'); converb -n, 'leaving a gap' (verb, converb) [空缺]
glossary.žöbšijen: žöbši- — to approve, assent (Ming 道是 'say it is so'); -jen, converb ending (uncertain), 'agreeing' (verb, converb; uncertain) [道是]
glossary.nigeni: nigen — one; accusative -i, 'the one'; followed by reflexive -jen as a separate token (numeral + case) [一箇 自的行]
glossary.medeġül: mede- — to know, to manage (Ming 管); causative -ġül, 'have (it) managed, put in charge' (the bare stem used as imperative; uncertain) (verb, causative, imperative, front-vowel form) [敎管]
glossary.urug-i: uruγ — descendants, offspring; accusative -i, 'the descendants (object)' (noun + case) [子孫行]
glossary.nigen-i: nigen — one; accusative -i, 'the one (object)' (numeral + case) [一箇行]
glossary.hutaruγ̇asu: hutaru- — to destroy, ruin (stem inferred from the Ming 毀); conditional -γ̇asu, 'if (one) destroys' (verb, conditional, back-vowel form) [毀了呵]
glossary.endedkün: ende- — to go wrong, err (stem inferred from the Ming 差); -dkün, polite plural imperative or statement (uncertain), 'err, you (all)' (verb; uncertain) [差了您]
glossary.aldaqun-ta: alda- — to err, fail, lose; -qun, ending of the polite plural (uncertain); ta, 'you' (plural polite), 'you (all) fail' (verb + pronoun; uncertain) [失了您]
glossary.öġükün-dür: eġükün — fat, grease (Ming 脂膏; printed öġükün); dative-locative -dür, 'in the fat' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [脂膏 裏]
glossary.nigen-üġü: nigen — one; particle -üġü (the Ming 也 'even, also'; compare the question -üġü), 'even one' (numeral + particle; uncertain) [一箇也]
glossary.törekü: töre- — to be born; participle -kü, 'to be born' (the Ming 麽 marks the question) (verb, participle) [生麽]
glossary.burqan-dur: Burqan — Burqan, a man's name; dative-locative -dur, 'to Burqan' (personal name + case, back-vowel form) [人名 行]
glossary.tasuldažu: tasul- — to cut off (stem inferred from the Ming 斷); passive -da-; converb -žu, 'being cut off' (verb, passive converb, back-vowel form) [被斷着]
glossary.ölülčen: ölülče- — to settle by confrontation, bear witness (stem inferred from the Ming 折證); converb -n, 'confronting' (verb, converb) [折證]
glossary.morila: mori — horse; verb-maker -la-, 'to ride'; the bare stem used as imperative, 'mount!' (noun-derived verb, imperative) [上馬]
glossary.ašaγambu: Ašaγambu — Asha Gambu, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
glossary.nemen: neme- — to add, increase; converb -n, 'adding' (verb, converb) [添]
glossary.ašaγambu-da: Ašaγambu — Asha Gambu, a man's name; dative-locative -da, 'to, by Asha Gambu' (the doer of a passive; uncertain) (personal name + case) [人名 行]
glossary.ügülegden: ügüle- — to speak, to say; passive -gde-; converb -n, 'being said' (verb, passive converb) [被說]
glossary.kelbes: kelbe- — to turn over, turn about (stem inferred from the Ming 翻); -s, converb ending (uncertain), 'turning' (verb, converb; uncertain) [翻着]
glossary.berketü: berke — hard, difficult (Ming 難); possessive -tü, 'having difficulty, difficult' (adjective + possessive, front-vowel form) [難︀ 有的]
glossary.büküi-dür-že: bü- — to be; participle -küi + dative-locative -dür, 'at the time of being'; assertion particle -že, 'indeed' (verb, participle + case + particle, front-vowel form) [有時 且罷]
glossary.batuda: batu — firm, strong (Ming 堅固); dative-locative -da used as an adverb, 'firmly' (adjective + case, back-vowel form) [堅固 行]
glossary.taulai: taulai — hare, the Hare year of the twelve-year cycle (noun; the Ming 免 is evidently a miswritten 兔 'hare') [免︀年]
glossary.arai-jar: Arai — Arai, a place name (a mountain Arai occurs elsewhere); instrumental -jar after a vowel, 'by way of Arai' (name + case, back-vowel form) [地名(依)着]
glossary.qatun-ača: qatun — lady, queen, wife of a qan; ablative -ača, 'from among the ladies' (noun + case, back-vowel form) [娘子內]
glossary.ajalarun: ajala- — to set out on a campaign, march (stem inferred from the Ming 征進); converb of time -run, 'when setting out' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [征進時]
glossary.deġü-ner-eče: deġü — younger brother; plural -ner (of kinsfolk) + ablative -eče, 'from the younger brothers' (noun + plural + case, front-vowel form) [弟(每自)]
glossary.žebe-jin: Žebe — Jebe, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel (linking -j-), 'of Jebe' (name + case) [人名的]
glossary.sübeġetei-jin: Sübeġetei — Sübegetei, a man's name; genitive -jin after a vowel (linking -j-), 'of Sübegetei' (name + case) [人名的]
glossary.toqučar-i: Toqučar — Toquchar, a man's name; accusative -i, marks the object (name + case) [人名行]
glossary.sultan-u: Sultan — sultan, the Muslim ruler (a title); genitive -u, 'of the sultan' (title + case, back-vowel form) [囘囘王名(的)]
glossary.qamsadqun: qamsa- — to join, combine (as in qamsan, Ming 併); here the Ming 夾攻 gives 'attack from both sides'; plural polite imperative -dqun, 'you all …!' (verb, imperative) [夾攻您]
glossary.melig-ün: Melig — Melig, a man's name, borne by a Muslim lord called Qān; genitive -ün after a consonant, 'of Melig' (name + case, front-vowel form) [(人)名的]
glossary.künden: künde- — to stir, disturb, touch (reading uncertain; Ming 動); converb -n, 'disturbing' (verb, converb) [動]
glossary.nögčižüγ̇ü: nögči- — to pass on, go past (as in nögčin); past ending -žüγ̇ü, back-vowel form (verb, past; ending uncertain, cf. -žuγ̇ui) [過去了]
glossary.nögčižüġü: nögči- — to pass on, go past (as in nögčin); past ending -žüġü, front-vowel form (verb, past; ending uncertain, cf. -žuγ̇ui) [過去了]
glossary.toqučar: Toqučar — Toquchar, a man's name (name) [人名]
glossary.tarijačin-i: tarija- — to till, cultivate (stem inferred from the Ming 種田); agent suffix -čin, 'tiller, farmer'; accusative -i (noun-derived from verb + case) [種田的行]
glossary.daγ̇uližuγ̇ui: daγ̇uli- — to plunder, take captive (analysis uncertain; Ming 擄); past ending -žuγ̇ui, back-vowel form (verb, past; ending uncertain) [擄了]
glossary.melig: Melig — Melig, a man's name (name) [(人)名]
glossary.balaγadi: balaγad — towns, cities (plural in -d); with Shiratori's linking (i) before reflexive -jan, 'one's own towns' (noun, plural; the token left by balaγad(i)-jan) [城子(每)自的行]
glossary.qaγ̇uldaγ̇a: qaγ̇ul- — to rush, round up; here 'to plunder' (Ming 被擄掠了 'was plundered'); -da- passive, -γ̇a past/perfect (verb, passive, past; analysis uncertain) [被擄掠了]
glossary.sartaγ̇uli: Sartaγ̇ul — the Sartaul, a people (Ming 囘囘 'Muslims'); with Shiratori's linking (i) before reflexive -jan, 'one's own Sartaul' (people name; the token left by Sartaγ̇ul(i)-jan) [囘囘 自的行]
glossary.žalaldiṅ: Žalaldiṅ — Jalaldin, a Muslim king's name (name) [囘囘王名]
glossary.soltan: soltan — sultan, a title (Ming 王 'king'); here written with o, beside sultan (noun, title) [王]
glossary.neiležüġü: neile- — to join, unite; past ending -žüġü, front-vowel form (verb, past; ending uncertain, cf. -žuγ̇ui) [相合了]
glossary.morilažuγ̇ui: mori — horse; -la- makes a verb, morila- 'to mount a horse'; past ending -žuγ̇ui, back-vowel form (noun-derived verb, past; ending uncertain) [上馬了]
glossary.kiduγ̇ad: kidu- — to kill off, slay (as in kiduba; here the Ming has 殺 without 盡); converb of completed action -γ̇ad, 'having killed' (verb, converb, back-vowel form) [殺︀了]
glossary.udarar: Udarar — Udarar, a town (name; also spelled Udirar, Udurar) [城名]
glossary.jabuγdarun: jabu- — to go, travel; -γda- passive, converb of time -run, 'when being made to go' (Ming 被行時) (verb, passive, converb, back-vowel form) [被行時]
glossary.müren-dür: müren — river; dative-locative -dür, 'in the river' (noun + case, front-vowel form) [河裏]
glossary.süġebe-že: süġe- — to be cut off, perish (stem inferred from the Ming 絕了); past -be + assertive particle -že, 'perished indeed' (verb, past + particle, front-vowel form) [絕了 也者︀]
glossary.badkesen-i: Badkesen — Badkesen, a town; accusative -i (name + case) [城名行]
glossary.baruγ̇an-keġer-i: Baruγ̇an-Keġer — Baru'an-Keger, a place; accusative -i (name + case) [地名行]
glossary.žalijartai: Žalijar — Jalair, a people (a spelling beside Žalair); -tai possessive, 'having, of the Jalair' (people name + possessive; Ming 種名 'people name') [種名]
glossary.bala-ji: Bala — Bala, a man's name; accusative -ji after a vowel (name + case) [人名 行]
glossary.taičuγ̇ud-ača: Taičuγ̇ud — the Taichi'ud, a people; ablative -ača, 'from the Taichi'ud' (people name + case, back-vowel form) [種(名)行]
glossary.kižaγ̇ar: kižiγ̇ar — edge, border, frontier (noun; printed kižaγ̇ar here) [邊]
glossary.melig-i: Melig — Melig, a man's name; accusative -i (name + case) [(人)名行]
glossary.daižiγ̇ulba: daiži- — to be afraid (stem inferred from the Ming 驚); -γ̇ul- causative, past -ba, 'caused to fear' (verb, causative, past, back-vowel form) [敎驚了]
glossary.mököriġülün: mököri- — to cut down, behead (stem uncertain; Ming 斬); -ġül- causative, converb -n, 'having (them) cut down' (verb, causative, converb) [斬]
glossary.medekü-dēče: mede- — to know, manage (Ming 管的); participle -kü + ablative -dēče (long-vowel form, cf. tendēče), 'from the one who manages' (verb, participle + case; analysis uncertain) [管的 行]
glossary.barula-keġer-eče: Barula-Keġer — Barula-Keger, a place; ablative -eče, 'from Barula-Keger' (name + case, front-vowel form) [地名行]
glossary.tolui-ji: Tolui — Tolui; accusative -ji after a vowel (name + case) [人名 行]
glossary.udirar: Udarar — Udarar, a town (name; printed Udirar here) [城名]
glossary.bügüdbe: bügüd- — to be whole, complete (stem inferred from the Ming 完全了; uncertain); past -be, 'was complete' (verb, past, front-vowel form) [完全了]
glossary.kun-ü-ġen: ken — who (interrogative pronoun; printed Kun- here, but the Han 客 reads ke- and the Ming 誰 says 'who'); genitive -ü + reflexive-possessive -ġen, 'whose own' (pronoun + case + reflexive, front-vowel form) [誰的自的(行)]
glossary.öġödei-jüġen: Ögödei — Ögödei, a man's name; -jüġen reflexive-possessive after a vowel, 'one's own Ögödei' (name + reflexive, front-vowel form) [人名 自的行]
glossary.udurar: Udarar — Udarar, a town (name; printed Udurar here) [城名]
glossary.küličen: küli- — to wait, wait for (as in küličēbe; Ming 等候); -čen converb (form uncertain) (verb, converb) [等候]
glossary.altan-γorqan-u: Altan-Γorqan — Altan-Gorqan, a place; genitive -u, 'of Altan-Gorqan' (name + case, back-vowel form) [地名(的)]
glossary.soltan-u: soltan — sultan (title; Ming 王); genitive -u, 'of the sultan' (title + case, back-vowel form) [王的]
glossary.žusalaṅ: žun — summer; -sa- verb-maker 'to spend the summer' + -laṅ place-noun, 'summering place' (Ming 過夏處) (noun-derived; analysis uncertain) [過夏處]
glossary.baγ̇ud-že: baγ̇u- — to come down, halt, camp (the Ming 囘 reads 'turn back'); -d ending (plural/perfective, uncertain) + assertive particle -že (verb + particle) [囘 也者︀]
glossary.neile: neile- — to join, unite; bare stem used as an imperative, 'join!', in a quotation (verb, imperative) [相合]
glossary.tan: -tan — possessive plural, 'those having' (uncertain); here 'and the like' after a name (Ming 等; cf. teriġüten) [等]
glossary.ebden: ebde- — to break, destroy; converb -n, 'breaking' (verb, converb) [破]
glossary.ebdeġed: ebde- — to break, destroy; converb of completed action -ġed, 'having broken' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [破了]
glossary.örüṅgeči: Ürüṅgeči — Ürüngechi, a town (printed Örüṅgeči here, Ürüṅgeči elsewhere) (name) [城名]
glossary.γarγažuγ̇u: γarγa- — to bring out, put out (γar- 'go out' + causative; stem read from the Ming); narrative past -žuγ̇u (verb, past tense; uncertain) [出了]
glossary.šigi-quduqu: Šigi-Quduqu — Shigi-Qutuqu, a man's name (personal name) [人名]
